items.prompt: Many students are not able to afford university fees. (move 3: “be able to” → noun)
items.answer: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
accepted: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
The inability of many students to afford university fees is a concern.
Many students' inability to afford university fees is a concern.
items.reason: “are not able to” → “lack the ability to” / “inability” (able → ability, 9.1-এর table-এর মতো)।

items.prompt: The implementation of the improvement of the quality of the provision of education is required.
items.answer: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
accepted: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
The quality of education needs to be improved.
Educational quality must be improved.
items.reason: ৪টি “of” phrase-এর noun-শিকল অপাঠ্য; একটি শক্ত idea (quality of education) রাখুন আর কাজটির জন্য verb form ব্যবহার করুন।

items.prompt: The reduction of the consumption of water by the population of the city is a necessity.
items.answer: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
accepted: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
Reducing water consumption in the city is necessary.
The city needs to reduce its water consumption.
items.reason: স্তূপ করা noun-গুলোর একটিকে আবার verb-এ ফেরান (reduction → reduce) আর “of the population of the city”-এর বদলে possessive ব্যবহার করুন।

items.prompt: There was an expansion in the utilisation of the internet by the elderly for the purpose of communication.
items.answer: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
accepted: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
Internet use among older people for communication has expanded.
More elderly people now use the internet to communicate.
items.reason: “utilisation” হলো “use”-এর একটি ফোলানো noun, আর “for the purpose of communication” হলো “to communicate”-এর জায়গায় কুয়াশা; formal মানে শব্দবহুল নয়।

items.prompt: The occurrence of the failure of the system was a consequence of the lack of maintenance.
items.answer: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
accepted: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
The system's failure was caused by a lack of maintenance.
A lack of maintenance caused the system to fail.
items.reason: “The occurrence of the failure” কিছুই যোগ করে না; বড়জোর একটি nominalisation (failure বা lack) রাখুন, আর কারণটা একটি স্পষ্ট verb-কে বহন করতে দিন।

g10_editing.title: 10. সম্পূর্ণ Essay Editing ও Speaking Transcript Polish
blocks: পরীক্ষার পরিবেশে integrated self-editing: ৬-pass checklist, বেশি ভুল থেকে কম ভুলের ক্রমে সাজানো ৫টি পূর্ণ ভুলে-ভরা essay ঠিক করা, আর ৫টি spoken answer-কে scripted না শুনিয়ে এক band ওপরে তোলা।

এতদিন প্রতিটি অধ্যায়ে আপনি এক সময়ে এক ধরনের ভুল ঠিক করেছেন, আর আগে থেকেই জানতেন কী খুঁজতে হবে। আসল পরীক্ষা এমন নয়। একটি আসল essay-তে মডিউল ১ থেকে ৩-এর সব নিয়ম একসঙ্গে কাজ করে, ভুলগুলো মিশে থাকে, কোনো লেবেল থাকে না, আর পাশে কোনো answer key ছাড়াই সময়ের চাপে নিজের ভুল নিজেকেই ধরতে হয়। এই শেষ module ঠিক সেই দক্ষতাটাই শেখায়: integrated self-editing। আপনি সব ধরনের ভুলে ভরা পুরো essay ঠিক করবেন, তারপর আসল spoken answer-কে safe-but-basic থেকে controlled-and-flexible পর্যায়ে তুলবেন।
10.1 এই workbook অধ্যায়টি কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবেন

নিচের প্রতিটি editing task একটি পূর্ণ, ভুলে-ভরা essay বা paragraph - মোটামুটি Band 5.5 থেকে 6.0 মানের লেখা, যেখানে আপনার পড়া নির্দিষ্ট ধরনের ভুলগুলো বসিয়ে দেওয়া আছে। “কোথায় ভুল মনে হচ্ছে” তা খুঁজতে এলোমেলোভাবে না পড়ে একটি নিয়মমাফিক ক্রমে কাজ করুন।
Agreement pass: প্রতিটি verb-কে তার আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে দেখুন (অধ্যায় ১)।
Tense pass: প্রতিটি time frame সঠিক ও সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ কি না দেখুন (অধ্যায় ২)।
Article pass: প্রতিটি singular noun-এর আগে a / an / the / zero ঠিক আছে কি না দেখুন (অধ্যায় ৩)।
Preposition pass: dependent preposition ও data preposition-গুলো দেখুন (অধ্যায় ৪)।
Structure pass: fragment, run-on আর comma splice আছে কি না দেখুন; নানা ধরনের complex sentence আছে কি না খুঁজুন (অধ্যায় ৫)।
Range pass: যেখানে মানানসই, সেখানে অন্তত একটি passive, একটি conditional আর কিছু hedging আছে কি (অধ্যায় ৬, ৭)? একটি নির্ভুল high-band structure আছে কি (অধ্যায় ৮, ৯)?
প্রতিটি item-এর জন্য আলাদা pass করুন। এক পড়াতেই সব ধরার চেষ্টা করলেই ভুল ফসকে যায়; proofreading-এ specialist সবসময় generalist-কে হারায়।

এই অধ্যায়ের exercise-এ ৫টি editing essay আছে, বেশি ভুলযুক্ত (Essay 1) থেকে কম ভুলযুক্ত (Essay 5) ক্রমে সাজানো। প্রতিটির সঙ্গে একটি সংশোধিত model version আর ধরন অনুযায়ী ভুলের বিশ্লেষণ আছে, যাতে দেখতে পান আপনার ৬টি pass-এর কোনটি কোন ভুল ধরত। ক্রম অনুযায়ী করুন; পরের essay-গুলো ধরে নেয় যে আগের সংশোধনগুলো আপনি আত্মস্থ করে ফেলেছেন।

আপনি essay-টা নিজের স্টাইলে নতুন করে লিখছেন না। লেখকের অর্থ ঠিক রেখে নির্ভুলতা আর range-এর জন্য ন্যূনতম যতটুকু সংশোধন দরকার, শুধু ততটুকুই করছেন। পরীক্ষার শেষ পাঁচ মিনিটে নিজের লেখার ক্ষেত্রেও ঠিক এটাই করতে হবে।

Speaking-এও grammar মূল্যায়ন হয়, একই Grammatical Range and Accuracy criterion-এর অধীনে, কিন্তু লক্ষ্যটা আলাদা: Speaking-এ দরকার real time-এ নিয়ন্ত্রিত নমনীয়তা (controlled flexibility), লেখার মতো ঘন গঠন (written density) নয়। Exercise-এর ৫টি speaking item-এ একটি আসল, basic-but-safe spoken answer দেওয়া আছে; এই কোর্সে শেখানো move-গুলোই ঠিকঠাক যোগ করে, scripted না শুনিয়ে, সেটিকে এক band ওপরে তুলতে হবে।
আগে মৌলিক নির্ভুলতা ঠিক করুন: agreement, tense আর article, কারণ এগুলোতেই সবচেয়ে বেশি নম্বর কাটে।
একটি complex sentence যোগ করুন: দুটি ধারণা জুড়তে একটি because, although বা which clause।
একটি tense contrast যোগ করুন: range দেখাতে past, present আর future-এর মধ্যে যাতায়াত করুন (“I used to … but now I … and I think I'll …”)।
একটি hedging phrase যোগ করুন: “it depends,” “I'd say,” “on the whole,” “tend to”।
চাইলে জোর দেওয়ার জন্য একটি স্বাভাবিক cleft: “what I really enjoy is …”

লক্ষ্য হলো নির্ভুল ও নমনীয় spoken English, মুখস্থ করা paragraph নয়। Part 2 answer-এ একটি স্বাভাবিক complex sentence আর একটি tense contrast আপনার score-এর জন্য মুখস্থ করা idiom-এর চেয়ে অনেক বেশি কাজ করবে।
কেন integrated editing-ই পরীক্ষার আসল দক্ষতা

দুটি writing task-এর শেষেই কয়েক মিনিট editing-এ খরচ করা উচিত। যাঁরা নিয়মমাফিক edit করেন, তাঁরা Grammatical Range and Accuracy-তে যাঁরা করেন না তাঁদের চেয়ে প্রায়ই আধা band বেশি পান, কারণ একই slip-গুলো (বাদ পড়া -s, বাদ পড়া article, if-clause-এ will) যেমন খুব সাধারণ, তেমনি নির্দিষ্ট লক্ষ্যে করা pass-এ সহজেই ধরা পড়ে। Speaking-এ মসৃণভাবে self-correct করার ক্ষমতা (“the number of people were, sorry, was rising”) নিজেই নিয়ন্ত্রণের একটি ইতিবাচক লক্ষণ। এই অধ্যায় সেই অভ্যাস গড়ে তোলে, যা আপনার শেখা সবকিছুকে পরীক্ষার পরিবেশে নম্বরে রূপান্তর করে।

যে skill-এ কাজে লাগে: Writing, Speaking
Editing-এ লাভ: শেষ পাঁচ মিনিটে নিয়মমাফিক ৬-pass edit সাধারণত বেশিরভাগ agreement, tense ও article slip দূর করে দেয়।
Speaking-এ self-correction: “They has - sorry, they have - improved a lot recently.”
৫টি editing essay আর ৫টি speaking-polish item এই অধ্যায়ের exercise-এ আছে। এরপর অধ্যায় ১১-তে বইয়ের প্রতিটি exercise-এর সম্পূর্ণ, ধাপে-ধাপে answer key দেওয়া আছে।

g10_editing_practice.title: 10. Practice · সম্পূর্ণ Essay Editing ও Speaking Transcript Polish
blocks: এক পড়াতেই সব grammar ভুল ধরার চেষ্টা করলেই ভুল ফসকে যায়। প্রতিটি নিয়মের জন্য আলাদা, একটিমাত্র বিষয়ে মনোযোগ দেওয়া pass চালান -- আগে agreement, তারপর tense, তারপর article, তারপর preposition -- কারণ proofreading-এ specialist সবসময় generalist-কে হারায়।
**কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ:** এই checklist আগের সব অধ্যায়কে একটি একক, বারবার ব্যবহারযোগ্য editing routine-এ বেঁধে দেয়, যা জমা দেওয়ার আগে যেকোনো essay-তে চালাতে পারবেন।
1. **Agreement pass** -- প্রতিটি verb-কে তার আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে দেখুন (অধ্যায় ১)।
2. **Tense pass** -- প্রতিটি time frame সঠিক ও সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ কি না দেখুন (অধ্যায় ২)।
3. **Article pass** -- প্রতিটি singular noun-এর আগে a/an/the/zero ঠিক আছে কি না দেখুন (অধ্যায় ৩)।
4. **Preposition pass** -- dependent preposition ও data preposition-গুলো দেখুন (অধ্যায় ৪)।

এক পড়াতেই সব ধরার চেষ্টা না করে **প্রতিটি item-এর জন্য আলাদা pass করুন**। Proofreading-এ specialist সবসময় generalist-কে হারায় -- একটিমাত্র বিষয়ে মনোযোগ দেওয়া pass এমন ভুল ধরে, যা সাধারণভাবে একবার পড়ে গেলে পুরোপুরি চোখ এড়িয়ে যায়।

blocks.title: Exercise 10.1 · সম্পূর্ণ Essay Editing
blocks.instructions: ৫টি ভুলে-ভরা essay, বেশি ভুল থেকে কম ভুলের ক্রমে সাজানো। প্রতিটিতে ৬-pass checklist চালান এবং লেখকের অর্থ ঠিক রেখে সঠিকভাবে আবার লিখুন। Essay 5-এ এর সঙ্গে একটি high-band structure যোগ করতেও বলা হয়েছে।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 1 (heavily flawed). Correct every error, preserving the meaning. “In many country, the number of student who go abroad for study have increased in recent years. This trend have both advantage and disadvantage. On one hand, student who studies in foreign university gets access to better facility and they can learns new culture. On other hand, it is very expensive and many family cannot affords it. In my opinion, if government will provide more scholarship, this problem can be solved. According to me, the advantage is more than the disadvantage.”
items.answer: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accepted: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Agreement: country→countries, student→students, have→has (the number singular), studies→study, gets→gain, learns→learn, affords→afford। Article: on the one hand, on the other hand, the government। Conditional: “if government will provide”→“if the government provided … could be solved” (if-clause-এ will বসে না)। Register: “According to me”→“Overall / In my view”; “advantage is more than”→“advantages outweigh the disadvantages”।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 2. Correct every error. “Nowadays, technology have changed the way we communicate. In the past, people was writing letters which take many days to arrive. But now, we can sends a message in a second. Although this is convenient, but it also have some negative effect. For example, many young people spends too much time on their phone and they forgets how to talk face to face. If this trend continue, our social skill will became weaker.”
items.answer: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
accepted: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
items.reason: Agreement: have→has, can sends→send, have→has, spends→spend, forgets→forget, skill→skills। Tense: “was writing”→“wrote” (অতীতের অভ্যাস), “take”→“took”। Structure: “Although … but” হলো double connector - “but” বাদ দিন। Conditional: “if … continue … will became”→“continues … will become” (will-এর পরে base verb)। Plural/article: effect→effects, phone→phones।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 3. Correct every error. “Pollution is one of the most serious problem in the world today. The main cause of it are the vehicles and the factories. In big cities, the air quality have become very poor, and many people suffers from breathing disease. Government should took strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we do something about this issue.”
items.answer: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
accepted: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
items.reason: Agreement: problem→problems (“one of the most”-এর পরে), cause … are→causes are, have become→has become (subject “quality”), suffers→suffer, disease→diseases। Verb form: “should took”→“should take”। Article: “the vehicles and the factories”→সাধারণ অর্থে “vehicles and factories”; “Government”→“Governments”। Mixed conditional আগে থেকেই সঠিক (“had acted … would not be … now”)। “It is high time”-এর পরে past subjunctive বসে: “we did”, “we do” নয়।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 4 (lightly flawed). Correct every error. “There is many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offers more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, the access to good education and healthcare are better. However, urban life also have its drawbacks, such as pollution and high cost of living. Despite of these problems, the majority of people still prefers city life.”
items.answer: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
accepted: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
items.reason: Agreement: “There is many”→“There are many”, offers→offer, “access … are”→“access … is” (subject হলো “access”, singular), have→has, prefers→prefer (এখানে subject “majority of people”-কে plural ধরা হয়েছে)। Preposition: “Despite of”→“Despite” (“of” বসে না)। Article: “a high cost of living”।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 5 (subtle errors + one range upgrade). Correct the errors, then add ONE high-band structure (an inversion, a cleft, or a nominalisation) where it fits. “Renewable energy has become more important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This is a positive development, but it is also expensive. Not only it reduces emissions, it also creates jobs. The transition will take time, but it is necessary.”
items.answer: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
accepted: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
items.reason: মূল লেখাটি প্রায় নির্ভুল; আসল সংশোধন হলো inversion: “Not only it reduces”→“Not only does it reduce …, but it also creates” (সামনে আনা “not only”-এর পরে question word order)। দেখানো ঐচ্ছিক upgrade: register-এর জন্য “increasingly important”, nominalised cohesive subject হিসেবে “This shift”, আর density-র জন্য “the transition to clean energy”।

blocks: Speaking-ও Writing-এর মতো একই Grammatical Range and Accuracy criterion-এ মূল্যায়ন হয়, কিন্তু লক্ষ্যটা আলাদা: real time-এ নিয়ন্ত্রিত নমনীয়তা, লেখার মতো ঘন গঠন নয়। আগে মৌলিক নির্ভুলতা ঠিক করুন, তারপর একটি complex sentence আর একটি tense contrast যোগ করুন।
**কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ:** পরীক্ষার্থীরা প্রায়ই Writing-এর grammar-এর জন্য দরকারের বেশি প্রস্তুতি নেন, অথচ Speaking-এ একই criterion-এর জন্য যথেষ্ট প্রস্তুতি নেন না, যদিও সেখানে লক্ষ্যটা আলাদা।
1. **আগে মৌলিক নির্ভুলতা ঠিক করুন** -- agreement, tense আর article, কারণ এগুলোতেই সবচেয়ে বেশি নম্বর কাটে।
2. **একটি complex sentence যোগ করুন** -- দুটি ধারণা জুড়তে একটি because, although বা which clause।
3. **একটি tense contrast যোগ করুন** -- range দেখাতে past, present আর future-এর মধ্যে যাতায়াত করুন: I used to..., but now I...
নির্ভুল, নমনীয় spoken English -- মুখস্থ করা paragraph নয়। Part 2 answer-এ একটি স্বাভাবিক complex sentence আর একটি tense contrast আপনার score-এর জন্য মুখস্থ করা idiom-এর চেয়ে অনেক বেশি কাজ করবে।

blocks.title: Exercise 10.2 · Speaking Transcript Polish
blocks.instructions: ৫টি basic-but-safe spoken answer। মৌলিক নির্ভুলতা ঠিক করে এবং একটি complex sentence, একটি tense contrast ও একটি hedging phrase যোগ করে প্রতিটিকে এক band ওপরে তুলুন, তবে যেন scripted না শোনায়।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 1. Raise this Part 1 answer one band, keeping it natural. “Yes, I like reading. I read many book. My favourite is story book. I read every day because it is relaxing.”
items.answer: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
accepted: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
items.reason: সংশোধন: “many book”→“a lot of books”, “story book”→“fiction”। Range যোগ: একটি because clause, একটি hedging phrase (“I'd say”), আর cleft-এর মতো জোর (“it's the best way … to unwind”), সঙ্গে tense/register-এর উন্নতি।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 2. Raise this Part 1 answer one band. “I live in Dhaka. It is big city. There is many people. I like it because my family is here.”
items.answer: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
accepted: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
items.reason: সংশোধন: “big city”→“a very large … city”, “There is many”→“there are a lot of”। Range যোগ: একটি relative clause (“which is …”), একটি contrast clause (“Although …”), আর একটি reason clause (“because …”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 3. Raise this Part 2 answer one band. “I want to talk about my phone. I use it every day. It is very useful. I use it for call and internet. I cannot live without it.”
items.answer: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
accepted: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
items.reason: সংশোধন: “for call”→“for making calls”। Range যোগ: একটি cleft opener (“The possession I'd like to talk about is …”), একটি relative clause, একটি hedging phrase (“honestly … I'm not sure”), আর conditional-এর ছোঁয়া (“how I'd manage without it”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 4. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Yes, technology changed our life. Before, people did everything by hand. Now, machine do the work. I think it is good.”
items.answer: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
accepted: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
items.reason: সংশোধন: “changed”→“has changed”, “life”→“lives”, “machine do”→“machines … handle”। Range যোগ: একটি contrast clause (“Whereas … used to …”), একটি tense contrast (অতীতের অভ্যাস বনাম বর্তমান), hedging (“On the whole, I'd say”), আর একটি concession (“though it does have …”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 5. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Government should help poor people. They can give money and job. If they do this, poverty will reduce.”
items.answer: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
accepted: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
items.reason: সংশোধন: “Government”→“governments”, “poor people”→“people living in poverty”, “give money and job”→“providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities”। Range যোগ: একটি second conditional (“If … were implemented … would be likely to fall”), hedging (“be likely to”), আর একটি concession clause।

g11_review.title: 11. Answer Key, Diagnostic Index ও Exam Routine
blocks: নতুন drill নয়, বরং একটি consolidation reference: ভুল উত্তর কীভাবে review করবেন, সবচেয়ে বেশি হওয়া ভুলগুলোর একটি diagnostic index আর প্রতিটি ঠিক করার একটিমাত্র নিয়ম, পুরো অধ্যায়-মানচিত্র, এবং পরীক্ষার ১০ মিনিটের self-edit routine।

এই কোর্সের প্রতিটি exercise নিজেই নিজেকে যাচাই করে: উত্তর জমা দিলে platform আপনাকে সঠিক version, সেটি কেন সঠিক তার কারণ, আর মূল নিয়মটি ব্যাখ্যা করা একটি বাংলা নোট দেখায়। এই শেষ অধ্যায়টি আরেক সেট drill নয়। এটি একটি consolidation reference - কোনো ভুল বারবার ফিরে এলে এখানে ফিরে আসবেন, যাতে সেই একটি নিয়ম খুঁজে পান যা পুরো এক পরিবারের ভুল ঠিক করে দেয়। এটিকে diagnostic index হিসেবে ব্যবহার করুন: যে ভুলটা বারবার করছেন সেটি চিহ্নিত করুন, তারপর নিয়মটি আর যে অধ্যায় থেকে সেটি এসেছে তা আবার পড়ুন।
কোনো item ভুল হলে শুধু সঠিক উত্তরটা পড়ে এগিয়ে যাবেন না। ৩০ সেকেন্ড সময় নিয়ে ভুলটা নির্ণয় করুন, কারণ একই ধরনের ভুল আপনার নিজের লেখায় আবার ফিরে আসবে।
Model answer আর reason একসঙ্গে পড়ুন, যাতে শুধু সংশোধনটা নয়, নিয়মটা কীভাবে কাজ করছে তাও দেখতে পান।
ভুলের ধরনের নাম দিন: এটা কি agreement, tense, article, preposition, structure, নাকি range-এর সমস্যা?
ওই ধরনের মূল অধ্যায়ে ফিরে যান (মানচিত্রটি 11.3-এ আছে) এবং যে একটি নিয়ম এটি নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে সেটি আবার পড়ুন।
নিয়মটি সঠিকভাবে প্রয়োগ করে নিজে দুটি নতুন বাক্য লিখুন। শুধু চিনতে পারা নয়, নিজে গঠনটি তৈরি করতে পারাই সেটিকে আপনার active grammar-এ নিয়ে আসে।
11.2 সবচেয়ে বেশি হওয়া ভুল, আর প্রতিটি ঠিক করার একটিমাত্র নিয়ম
বাংলাদেশি পরীক্ষার্থীদের লেখায় এই ভুলগুলোই সবচেয়ে বেশি দেখা যায়। এই ছোট table-টা আত্মস্থ করলে আপনার বারবার হওয়া ভুলের বেশিরভাগই দূর হয়ে যাবে।
Verb মেলে আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে, সবচেয়ে কাছের noun-এর সঙ্গে নয়।
Uncountable noun-এ a/an বসে না, plural-ও হয় না।
শেষ হয়ে যাওয়া বছরের জন্য past simple, present perfect নয়।
‘Since/for’-এর সঙ্গে perfect tense বসে, present continuous নয়।
সরাসরি অনুবাদ থেকে আসা preposition: discuss X; in my opinion।
Data preposition: increase by; reach (‘to’ ছাড়া)।
Dependent clause একা দাঁড়াতে পারে না (fragment)।
দুটি clause জুড়তে শুধু comma যথেষ্ট নয় (comma splice)।
ঢালাও দাবিকে hedge করুন: may, tend to, generally।
সামনে আনা negative-এর পরে question word order ব্যবহার করুন।
১২টি tense; past simple বনাম present perfect; simple বনাম continuous
time/place/data preposition; dependent preposition; মাতৃভাষা (L1) থেকে আসা ভুলের সংশোধন
clause; adverbial ও relative clause; fragment/run-on/splice
বিভিন্ন tense-এ passive; impersonal frame; process writing
verb/adjective → noun; academic density ও cohesion
৬-pass self-edit; spoken answer-কে এক band ওপরে তোলা

পরীক্ষার দিন আপনার গড়ে তোলা grammar তখনই কাজে আসবে, যখন self-edit করার জন্য সময় রাখবেন। প্রতিটি writing task-এর শেষ কয়েক মিনিট নির্দিষ্ট লক্ষ্যে review-এর জন্য রাখুন, এবং অধ্যায় ১০-এর pass-গুলো ক্রম অনুযায়ী চালান।

Task 1 (~৩ মিনিট রাখুন): প্রতিটি tense ডেটার time frame-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে দেখুন; data preposition (by, from, to, of) দেখুন; “the number of” আর “the proportion of”-এর পরে singular verb বসেছে কি না দেখুন।

Task 2 (~৫ মিনিট রাখুন): agreement, article আর preposition pass চালান; কোনো if-clause-এ “will” নেই তা নিশ্চিত করুন; নানা ধরনের complex sentence আর অন্তত একটি পরিচ্ছন্ন high-band structure আছে কি না নিশ্চিত করুন।
Speaking (real time-এ): agreement বা tense-এর কোনো slip কানে এলে মসৃণভাবে self-correct করে এগিয়ে যান; পরিচ্ছন্ন self-correction নিয়ন্ত্রণের লক্ষণ, দুর্বলতার নয়।

কোনো নিয়ম জানা আর চাপের মধ্যে সেটি প্রয়োগ করা দুটি আলাদা দক্ষতা, আর এ দুয়ের ফাঁক কেবল এই অধ্যায়ে বর্ণিত review-এর অভ্যাস দিয়েই পূরণ হয়। যে পরীক্ষার্থীরা নিজের বারবার হওয়া ভুল নির্ণয় করেন, মূল নিয়মে ফিরে যান, তারপর নিজে নতুন সঠিক উদাহরণ তৈরি করেন, তাঁরা শুধু একবার drill শেষ করা পরীক্ষার্থীদের চেয়ে অনেক দ্রুত উন্নতি করেন। এই কোর্সের প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরকে একটি তথ্য হিসেবে দেখুন - কোন একটি নিয়ম আবার দেখতে হবে, তার তথ্য। ভুল থেকে নিয়ম, নিয়ম থেকে নতুন প্রয়োগ - এই loop-ই পড়াশোনাকে উচ্চতর band-এ রূপান্তর করে।

যে skill-এ কাজে লাগে: Writing, Speaking
Review loop: ভুল উত্তর → ভুলের ধরনের নাম দিন → নিয়মটি আবার পড়ুন → নিজে দুটি সঠিক বাক্য লিখুন।
Exam routine: শেষ কয়েক মিনিট সবসময় ৬টি editing pass ক্রম অনুযায়ী চালানোর জন্য রাখুন।

এখানেই কোর্স শেষ। সঠিক গঠনগুলো স্বয়ংক্রিয় মনে না হওয়া পর্যন্ত যেকোনো অধ্যায়ের exercise-এ ফিরে গিয়ে অনুশীলন করুন; platform আপনাকে score দিতে থাকবে এবং প্রতিটি item-এর reason ও বাংলা নোট দেখাতে থাকবে।

g01_agreement_1.title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग (1/2)
g01_agreement_1.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: वाक्यका आधारभूत भागहरू, र ती ८ वटा agreement case जसले तपाईंको अंक निर्धारण गर्छन्। पूरै परीक्षामा सबैभन्दा कम मेहनतमा accuracy-मा सबैभन्दा ठूलो फाइदा यहीँबाट आउँछ।

IELTS-का कुनै खास technique-मा जानुअघि तपाईंका वाक्यहरू संरचनाका हिसाबले ठीक हुनैपर्छ। यो module-ले ती ४ वटा गल्ती सुधार्छ, जसले तपाईंको Writing र Speaking-को हरेक लाइनमा चुपचाप अंक घटाइरहेका हुन्छन्: subject-सँग नमिल्ने verb, घटनालाई गलत समयमा राख्ने tense, छुटेका वा गलत ठाउँमा राखिएका article, र गलत preposition। यीमध्ये कुनै पनि गाह्रो छैन। सबै बानीका कुरा हुन्। Module 1 ले सही बानीलाई तपाईंको स्वाभाविक बानी बनाउँछ, ताकि Module 2 सम्म पुग्दा तपाईं यस्तो जगमाथि ठूला र महत्वाकांक्षी वाक्य बनाउन सक्नुहोस्, जहाँबाट अंक चुहिँदैन।
1.1 सुरुमा, वाक्यका आधारभूत भागहरू (आफूलाई थाहा छ जस्तो लागे पनि यहीँबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्)

यो किताबले तपाईंलाई केही पनि थाहा छैन भनेर मान्छ, त्यसैले हामी वाक्यका भागहरूबाट सुरु गर्छौं। बंगाली बोल्न यी नामहरू कण्ठ गर्नु पर्दैन, तर यो किताबका लगभग हरेक नियम यिनै नामहरू प्रयोग गरेर भनिएका छन्, त्यसैले यिनलाई चिन्न सिक्नुहोस्।
हरेक साधारण English वाक्यमा २ वटा अनिवार्य भाग हुन्छन्, र प्रायः तेस्रो भाग पनि हुन्छ:
Subject भनेको त्यो व्यक्ति वा चीज हो जसको बारेमा वाक्य छ, अर्थात् काम गर्ने। “Students study hard,” मा subject हो students।
Verb भनेको काम वा कुनै अवस्था हो। “Students study hard,” मा verb हो study। Verb be (is, am, are, was, were) ले काम होइन, अवस्था देखाउँछ: “The graph is clear.”
Object भनेको त्यो व्यक्ति वा चीज हो जसमाथि काम हुन्छ। “Students use the internet,” मा object हो the internet।
English-को सामान्य क्रम हो Subject + Verb + Object (S + V + O)। Students (S) use (V) the internet (O).

बंगाली Subject-Object-Verb भाषा हो। আমি ভাত খাই को शाब्दिक अर्थ हो “I rice eat,” जहाँ verb एकदम अन्त्यमा छ। English-मा verb दोस्रो स्थानमा, subject-को ठीक पछि आउँछ: “I eat rice.” तपाईंले लेखेको कुनै English वाक्य गलत लागे, सबैभन्दा पहिले बंगाली बानीले verb वाक्यको अन्त्यतिर सरेको छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस्।

“Agreement” को अर्थ हो मिल्नु। Subject-verb agreement भनेको verb-ले number-मा आफ्नो subject-सँग मिल्नुपर्छ भन्ने नियम हो। Singular subject (एउटा) ले verb-को एउटा रूप लिन्छ; plural subject (एकभन्दा बढी) ले अर्को रूप। पूरा कुरा यत्ति हो। यो chapter-को बाँकी भाग ती case-हरूको बारेमा छ जहाँ असली subject चिन्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।
Present simple tense-मा subject singular हो कि plural, त्यसअनुसार verb बदलिन्छ।
हजारौं बंगलादेशी candidate फस्ने यो पासोमा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: noun र verb-मा -s को अर्थ उल्टो हुन्छ।
Noun-मा -s को अर्थ plural हो: one student, many students।
Verb-मा -s को अर्थ singular हो: he works, they work।
त्यसैले सही वाक्यमा प्रायः -s या त noun-मा हुन्छ या verb-मा, तर दुवैमा हुँदैन: The student works. (singular noun, verb-मा -s लाग्छ) / The students work. (plural noun, verb-मा -s हुँदैन)
Verb be र have irregular हुन्, यिनलाई कण्ठ गर्नैपर्छ:
The result is clear. / The results are clear. The number has risen. / The numbers have risen.

g01_agreement_2.title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग (2/2)
g01_agreement_2.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: 1.3 तपाईंको अंक साँच्चै निर्धारण गर्ने case-हरू

मूल नियम सजिलो छ। अंक काटिने चाहिँ तलका case-हरूमा हो, जहाँ असली subject लुकेको हुन्छ, अर्कै रूपमा हुन्छ, वा नजिकैको अर्को noun भन्दा verb-बाट टाढा हुन्छ। यी ८ वटा राम्ररी सिक्नुहोस्, तपाईंको लेखाइबाट लगभग सबै agreement गल्ती हट्छन्।
Case 1 · Subject र verb-को बीचका शब्दहरू
Verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग कहिल्यै होइन। लेख्नेहरू सबैभन्दा नजिकको शब्दतिर तानिन्छन्, र त्यो प्रायः गलत हुन्छ।
The list of items are on the table.
The list of items is on the table.
Subject “list” (singular) हो, “items” होइन। बीचको phrase काटिदिनुहोस्, सत्य स्पष्ट हुन्छ: “The list … is.”
The quality of the answers were poor.
The quality of the answers was poor.
Technique: subject पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्, अनि त्यो र verb-को बीचका सबै शब्द मनमनै मेटाउनुहोस्। “The list of items is.”
Case 2 · “The number of” र “a number of”
यो जोडी Writing Task 1 मा बारम्बार आउँछ, र दुवैले एकअर्काको उल्टो व्यवहार गर्छन्।
“The number of + plural noun” ले singular verb लिन्छ (subject number हो, एउटा अंक)।
“A number of + plural noun” ले plural verb लिन्छ (यसको अर्थ केवल ‘धेरै वटा’ हो)।
The number of tourists has increased since 2010. / A number of tourists were waiting outside the museum.
Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff जस्ता शब्दले एउटा समूहको नाम बुझाउँछन्। IELTS academic writing-मा हरेकलाई एउटै एकाइ मानेर singular verb प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
The government is planning three new policies. / The committee has reached a decision.

(British English-मा कहिलेकाहीँ plural verb पनि चल्छ, जब जोड समूहका छुट्टाछुट्टै सदस्यमा हुन्छ: “the team are arguing among themselves.” IELTS academic Writing-मा singular नै राख्नुहोस् र एकनासले राख्नुहोस्। यो सुरक्षित छ र कहिल्यै गलत हुँदैन।)
Each, every, everyone, everybody, someone, anyone, nobody, either, neither, one - यी सबै singular हुन्, वरिपरिका शब्द जतिसुकै plural देखिए पनि।
Each of the students has a laptop. (“have” होइन) / Everyone in the classes was present. / Neither of the options is acceptable.
यी जोडी connector-हरूसँग verb नजिकको subject-सँग मिल्छ, अर्थात् verb-को सबैभन्दा नजिक भएको subject-सँग।

Neither the manager nor the employees were informed. (नजिकको subject: employees, plural) / Neither the employees nor the manager was informed. (नजिकको subject: manager, singular) / Not only the students but also the teacher was worried.
And ले जोडिएका २ वटा subject लगभग सधैं plural हुन्छन्।
The teacher and the students were in the hall. / Poverty and unemployment remain serious problems.
अपवाद: जब दुई शब्दले मिलेर एउटै चीज बुझाउँछन्, तब singular मान्नुहोस्: “Bread and butter is a common breakfast.” IELTS-मा यो विरलै आउँछ।
There पछि verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, जुन verb पछि आउँछ।
There is a serious problem. (subject: problem, singular) / There are several factors. (subject: factors, plural) / There is a range of options. (subject: range, singular)
Case 8 · Uncountable noun, परिमाण, र inverted structure

Uncountable noun-लाई singular मानिन्छ र तिनले कहिल्यै plural -s लिँदैनन्। IELTS-मा धेरै आउने यो set एकैपटक कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work।
The informations are correct and he gave many advices.
The information is correct and he gave a lot of advice.
समय, पैसा र दूरीको परिमाणलाई एउटै मात्रा मानिन्छ, त्यसैले तिनले singular verb लिन्छन्। Ten years is a long time to wait. / Five thousand taka is not enough.

Inverted structure-मा (जहाँ verb subject भन्दा अगाडि आउँछ) पनि verb subject-सँगै मिल्छ। वाक्य not only वा hardly जस्ता negative adverb बाट सुरु हुँदा verb पछिको subject खोज्नुहोस् र त्यसैसँग मिलाउनुहोस्। Hardly ever does the government reverse such a decision. / Only after 2010 did the figures begin to fall.
(Inversion पूरा रूपमा Chapter 8 मा पढ्नुहुनेछ। यहाँ केवल agreement त्यहाँ पनि लागू हुन्छ भन्ने ख्याल गर्नुहोस्।)
बंगाली भाषीहरूले agreement-मा किन गल्ती गर्छन्

तपाईंले गर्ने लगभग हरेक subject-verb agreement गल्तीको जरा एउटै तथ्य हो: English verb जस्तो singular वा plural subject अनुसार आफ्नो ending बदल्छ, बंगाली verb त्यसरी बदलिँदैन। Verb-को रूप যায় (jay) “he” र “they” दुवैका लागि उस्तै हुन्छ। बंगालीले person र आदर (formality) देखाउँछ, तर English ले verb-मा माग्ने singular-plural बदलाव बंगालीमा अनिवार्य छैन। तपाईंको मातृभाषाले यो बदलावको बानी कहिल्यै बसालेन, त्यसैले यो छुट्दा तपाईंको कानले तपाईंलाई सचेत गराउँदैन।

Error type 1 · छुटेको third-person -s। बंगालीमा -s थपिँदैन, त्यसैले सिक्नेहरूले जताततै base verb लेख्छन्।
✗ He go to the market every day. / The population increase rapidly.
✓ He goes to the market every day. / The population increases rapidly.

Error type 2 · छुटेको वा गलत “is / are”। साधारण भनाइमा बंगालीमा प्रायः is का लागि छुट्टै शब्द हुँदैन (সে ভালো = “he good”), त्यसैले सिक्नेहरूले यसलाई छुटाउँछन् वा गलत number-को रूप छान्छन्।
✗ Many people is using the internet. / The graph show that pollution have increased.
✓ Many people are using the internet. / The graph shows that pollution has increased.
यो एउटै नियमले तपाईंको band किन रोक्छ

Examiner-ले सबैभन्दा पहिले subject-verb agreement-को गल्ती नै देख्छन्, किनकि यो लगभग हरेक उत्तरको पहिलो लाइनमै आउँछ र दोहोरिइरहन्छ। बारम्बार agreement गल्ती भएको script Grammatical Range and Accuracy मा Band 7 पुग्न सक्दैन, idea जतिसुकै राम्रा भए पनि, किनकि Band 7 को criterion अनुसार धेरैजसो वाक्य गल्तीरहित हुनुपर्छ। हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा agreement गल्ती भयो भने त्यो सम्भव हुँदैन। सबैभन्दा बढी नोक्सान Writing Task 1 मा हुन्छ, जुन the number of, the proportion of, the figure for जस्ता subject-मा चल्छ, र यी हरेक singular हुन्। Agreement सुधार्नु नै पूरै परीक्षामा सबैभन्दा कम मेहनतमा accuracy-मा सबैभन्दा ठूलो फाइदा हो।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The number of visitors has risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists has fallen.
Task 2: Although the government provides free healthcare, demand continues to outstrip supply.
Speaking Part 2: My family lives in a small town, and each of my brothers has a different job.
Chapter 1 यहाँ सकियो। अब Chapter 2 (Tense Mastery & Time Precision) आउँछ।

g01_agreement_practice.title: 1. Practice · Subject-Verb Agreement र वाक्यको जग
g01_agreement_practice.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: Verb ले number-मा आफ्नो subject-सँग मिल्नुपर्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग होइन। Singular subject ले verb-को -s रूप लिन्छ; plural subject ले लिँदैन। यो एउटा बानी ठीक भयो भने तपाईंको लेखाइको सबैभन्दा सामान्य agreement गल्ती हट्छ।
**किन महत्वपूर्ण छ:** तपाईंले लेख्ने हरेक वाक्यमा subject-verb agreement जाँचिन्छ, त्यसैले यहाँको एउटा नराम्रो बानीले बारम्बार अंक काट्छ।
Present simple मा **singular subject** (he, she, it, एउटा चीज) ले verb **+ s/es** लिन्छ: the student works।
**Plural subject** ले **base verb** लिन्छ, -s बिना: the students work।
Noun र verb-मा -s उल्टो हुन्छ: noun-मा -s को अर्थ plural, verb-मा -s को अर्थ singular। सही वाक्यमा विरलै दुवैमा -s हुन्छ।
The result is clear र the results are clear; the number has risen र the numbers have risen।

blocks.title: Exercise 1.1 · गल्ती चिन्ने र सुधार्ने
blocks.instructions: तलका हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा subject-verb agreement गल्ती छ, तीन वटा बाहेक, जुन पहिल्यै सही छन्। गलत वाक्यहरूलाई सही गरी फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, र सही वाक्यहरूका लागि “Correct.” लेख्नुहोस्। Key हेर्नुअघि कलमले आफैं गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The list of approved candidates are posted on the noticeboard.
items.answer: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
accepted: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
items.reason: Subject “list” (singular) हो, “candidates” होइन।

items.prompt: Each of the students have submitted their assignment.
items.answer: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
accepted: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
Each of the students has submitted their assignment.
items.reason: “Each of” सधैं singular हुन्छ।

items.prompt: The government are introducing a new tax next year.
items.answer: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
accepted: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
items.reason: Collective noun-लाई एउटै एकाइ मान्दा academic writing-मा singular verb लाग्छ।

items.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the test.
items.answer: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
accepted: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
items.reason: “Neither…nor” सँग verb नजिकको subject “students” (plural) सँग मिल्छ।

items.prompt: The number of accidents on this road have increased.
items.answer: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
accepted: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
items.reason: “The number of” singular हो।

items.prompt: There is several reasons for this decline.
items.answer: There are several reasons for this decline.
accepted: There are several reasons for this decline.
items.reason: असली subject “reasons” plural हो।

items.prompt: A large amount of information were collected during the survey.
items.answer: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
accepted: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
items.reason: “Information” uncountable र singular हो, त्यसैले “amount … was.”

items.prompt: Ten kilometres are a long way to walk in the heat.
items.answer: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
accepted: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
items.reason: एउटा दूरीलाई एउटै मात्रा मानिन्छ: singular verb।

items.prompt: The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.reason: “Committee” लाई एउटै एकाइ मान्दा singular “has” लाग्छ।

items.prompt: The quality of the roads in rural areas are very poor.
items.answer: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
accepted: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
items.reason: Subject “quality” (singular) हो, “roads” वा “areas” होइन।

items.prompt: Poverty and illiteracy remains major obstacles to development.
items.answer: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
accepted: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
items.reason: “And” ले जोडिएका २ वटा subject plural हुन्छन्।

items.prompt: Everyone in the two classes were given a certificate.
items.answer: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
accepted: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
items.reason: “Everyone” singular हो।

items.prompt: Not only the manager but also the workers is unhappy with the plan.
items.answer: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
accepted: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
items.reason: “Not only…but also” सँग verb नजिकको subject “workers” (plural) सँग मिल्छ।

items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The data collected over ten years show a clear pattern.
items.reason: “Data” लाई plural वा mass noun मानिन्छ; यहाँ “the data … show” स्वीकार्य र एकनासको छ।

items.prompt: My knowledge of these topics are limited.
items.answer: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
accepted: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
items.reason: “Knowledge” uncountable र singular हो; subject “knowledge” हो, “topics” होइन।

items.answer: A number of students have failed to register on time.
accepted: A number of students have failed to register on time.
items.reason: “A number of” को अर्थ “several” हो र यसले plural verb लिन्छ।

items.prompt: The population of the coastal cities have grown rapidly.
items.answer: The population of the coastal cities has grown rapidly.
accepted: The population of the coastal cities has grown rapidly.
items.reason: Subject “population” (singular) हो, “cities” होइन।

items.prompt: Neither of the two proposals seem practical.
items.answer: Neither of the two proposals seems practical.
accepted: Neither of the two proposals seems practical.
items.reason: “Neither” singular हो।

items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
Statistics is a subject that many students find difficult.
items.reason: कुनै विषयको नामका रूपमा “Statistics” singular हो: “statistics is.”

items.prompt: The equipment in the laboratories need to be replaced.
items.answer: The equipment in the laboratories needs to be replaced.
accepted: The equipment in the laboratories needs to be replaced.
items.reason: “Equipment” uncountable र singular हो।

blocks: धेरैजसो agreement गल्ती मूल नियमबाट होइन, ती ८ वटा लुकेका case-बाट आउँछन् जहाँ असली subject लुकेको, ढिला आउने, वा अर्को noun-सँग जोडिएको हुन्छ। यी ८ वटा सिक्नुहोस्, तपाईंका essay-का लगभग सबै agreement गल्ती हराउँछन्।
**किन महत्वपूर्ण छ:** मूल नियम सजिलो छ; अंक काटिने चाहिँ ती case-हरूमा हो जहाँ असली subject चिन्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।
**Subject र verb-को बीचका शब्द:** तिनलाई बेवास्ता गर्नुहोस् -- verb असली subject-सँग मिल्छ, सबैभन्दा नजिकको noun-सँग होइन।
**"The number of" (singular) र "a number of" (plural):** the number of tourists has increased, तर a number of tourists were waiting।
**Collective noun** (government, team, committee): IELTS academic writing-मा singular।
**Indefinite pronoun** (each, everyone, neither) सधैं singular हुन्छन्।
**"And" ले जोडिएका compound subject**: लगभग सधैं plural।
**"There is / there are"**: verb पछि आउने कुरासँग मिल्छ।
**Uncountable noun र परिमाण** (information, ten years): plural जस्तो देखिए पनि singular।

blocks.title: Exercise 1.2 · IELTS Essay सम्पादन
blocks.instructions: तलको paragraph एउटा Band 5.5 Task 2 essay बाट लिइएको हो। यसमा १० वटा subject-verb agreement गल्ती छन्। ती खोज्नुहोस्, अनि पूरै paragraph सही गरी फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Nowadays, the number of people who works from home have increased dramatically. There is many reasons for this change. First, technology allow employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offer flexible arrangements. However, some managers believes that productivity fall when staff is not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweighs the disadvantages, and this trend are likely to continue.
items.answer: Nowadays, the number of people who work from home has increased dramatically. There are many reasons for this change. First, technology allows employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offers flexible arrangements. However, some managers believe that productivity falls when staff are not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweigh the disadvantages, and this trend is likely to continue.
accepted: Nowadays, the number of people who work from home has increased dramatically. There are many reasons for this change. First, technology allows employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offers flexible arrangements. However, some managers believe that productivity falls when staff are not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweigh the disadvantages, and this trend is likely to continue.
items.reason: १० वटा agreement गल्ती: who works→work; have increased→has increased (the number singular हो); There is→There are; technology allow→allows; each of … offer→offers; managers believes→believe; productivity fall→falls; staff is→staff are; advantages … outweighs→outweigh; this trend are→is।

g02_tenses_1.title: 2. Tense-मा दक्षता र समयको सटीकता (1/2)
g02_tenses_1.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: १२ वटा tense-को पूरा नक्सा, IELTS ले अंक दिने ५ वटा tense, र ती २ वटा महत्त्वपूर्ण जोडी (past simple बनाम present perfect, present simple बनाम present continuous), जसबाट नै लगभग सबै tense गल्ती हुन्छन्।

Subject-verb agreement ले तपाईंको verb-लाई मिलायो। Tense ले तिनलाई सही समयमा राख्छ। IELTS-मा यो grammar-को सानो कुरा होइन; यो अर्थको कुरा हो। Writing Task 1 ले पहिले नै भइसकेको वा अहिले भइरहेको data वर्णन गर्छ, Task 2 ले भविष्यवाणी र सामान्यीकरण गर्छ, अनि Speaking बारम्बार विगतका कथा र भविष्यका योजनाबीच आउजाउ गर्छ। Verb-लाई गलत समयमा राख्नुभयो भने तपाईंले grammar-मा सानो slip मात्र गर्नुभएको हुँदैन, घटना कहिले भयो भन्ने बारे गलत कुरा भन्नुभएको हुन्छ। त्यसैले examiner-हरू tense-माथिको नियन्त्रणलाई Band 6 बाट 7 मा पुग्ने एउटा मुख्य संकेत मान्छन्।
2.1 Tense वास्तवमा के हो (केही पनि थाहा छ भनेर नमानी)
एउटा English tense ले एकै पटक २ वटा जानकारी बोक्छ:
Time: past, present, वा future। (घटना कहिले भयो?)
Aspect: simple, continuous, perfect, वा perfect continuous। (यो एउटा पूरा, सकिएको घटना हो, चलिरहेको काम हो, अर्को कुनै समयसँग जोडिएको काम हो, कि यिनको मिश्रण?)

३ वटा time गुणा ४ वटा aspect बराबर १२ वटा tense। सुन्दा धेरै लाग्छ, तर IELTS-का लागि राम्रो खबर के हो भने तीमध्ये ५ वटाले नै लगभग 90 प्रतिशत काम गर्छन्। यो अध्यायले ती ५ वटालाई अगाडि राख्छ, तर पूरा नक्सा पनि देखाउँछ, ताकि केही पनि रहस्य नरहोस्।
एउटा पूरा घटना, एउटा fact, एउटा बानी
पछिको कुनै समयसँग जोडिएको काम; “before now / before then”
पूरा table एक पटक पढ्नुहोस्, ताकि हरेक रूप चिन्न सक्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि 2.3 मा जानुहोस्, जहाँ हामी सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण ५ वटालाई अगाडि ल्याउँछौं।
विगतको काम जुन अझै सान्दर्भिक छ; अहिलेसम्मको trend
Prices have been rising for a decade.
Sales were falling when the law changed.
विगतको अर्को कामभन्दा अघि भएको अझ पहिलेको काम
It had been raining for hours before it stopped.
भविष्यवाणी; तुरुन्तै गरिएको निर्णय; भविष्यको fact
Demand will rise over the next decade.
By 2030, most cars will be running on electricity.
भविष्यको कुनै बिन्दुअघि नै सकिने काम
By 2040, the city will have doubled in size.
By June she will have been working here for ten years.

p.p. = past participle (verb-को तेस्रो रूप: go / went / gone; rise / rose / risen)। धेरै प्रयोग हुने irregular verb-हरूको सूची किताबको अन्त्यमा Appendix A मा छ। Vocabulary जसरी सिक्नुभयो, त्यसरी नै यिनलाई निश्चित item-का रूपमा सिक्नुहोस्।
2.3 IELTS ले साँच्चै अंक दिने ५ वटा tense
यी ५ वटाले नै तपाईं जुनसुकै graph वर्णन गर्न र जुनसुकै Speaking question-को सही उत्तर दिन सक्नुहुन्छ। बाँकीको चिन्ता गर्नुअघि यिनमा माहिर हुनुहोस्।
Present simple: fact, बानी, सामान्य सत्य, र Task 2 मा आफ्नो धारणा (position) देखाउन।
Present continuous: अहिले भइरहेको कुरा र हालको trend देखाउन।
Past simple: सकिएका घटना र graph-को विगतको data देखाउन।
Present perfect: वर्तमानसम्म आइपुग्ने काम र trend-का लागि।
Future (will / going to): भविष्यवाणी र योजनाका लागि।
यी ५ वटाभित्रका २ वटा जोडीबाट नै लगभग सबै tense गल्ती हुन्छन्। अध्यायको बाँकी भागले यी २ जोडीको अभ्यास गराउँछ, किनभने यिनलाई ठीक गरे tense-का धेरैजसो अंक ठीक हुन्छन्।

g02_tenses_2.title: 2. Tense-मा दक्षता र समयको सटीकता (2/2)
g02_tenses_2.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: 2.4 महत्त्वपूर्ण जोडी 1 · Past simple बनाम present perfect
बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूमा tense सम्बन्धी यो नै सबैभन्दा सामान्य अलमल हो, र Task 1 मा यही निर्णायक हुन्छ।
Past simple प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् जब समय सकिइसकेको हुन्छ, र प्रायः त्यो उल्लेख गरिएको हुन्छ: in 2010, last year, two decades ago, between 2000 and 2010।
Present perfect प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् जब काम अहिलेसम्म आइपुग्छ, वा ठ्याक्कै समय महत्त्वपूर्ण हुँदैन: यसका संकेत since, for, over the past decade, recently, so far, already हुन्।
Past simple: The population rose in 2010. (सकिएको एउटा वर्ष) / Present perfect: The population has risen since 2010. (2010 देखि वर्तमानसम्म)
सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट संकेत समय जनाउने शब्द नै हो:
so far, up to now, already, lately
The company has launched its first product in 2009.
The company launched its first product in 2009.
Since 2020, remote work became far more common.
Since 2020, remote work has become far more common.
“Since” ले अहिलेसम्म जोड्छ, त्यसैले present perfect।

बंगालीमा “আমি দেখেছিলাম” र “আমি দেখেছি” लगभग उस्तै सुनिन सक्छन्, त्यसैले समय जनाउने शब्दलाई निर्णय गर्न दिनुहोस्: निश्चित सकिएको समय (in 2010, last year, ago) भए past simple; since, for वा recently भए present perfect।

विगतको कुनै वर्षसँग बाँधिएको data भए past simple; वर्तमानसम्म चलिरहेको trend भए present perfect।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing
Task 1: Sales fell in 2015 but have recovered every year since.
2.5 महत्त्वपूर्ण जोडी 2 · Present simple बनाम present continuous
स्थायी fact, बानी वा सामान्य सत्यका लागि present simple प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Task 2 का धेरैजसो topic sentence र process वर्णन यही tense-मा हुन्छन्।
ठीक अहिले भइरहेको कुरा वा अस्थायी हालको trend-का लागि present continuous प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, विशेषगरी currently, at the moment, these days, nowadays जस्ता शब्द हुँदा।
Present simple (सामान्य सत्य): Governments spend public money on healthcare. / Present continuous (हालको trend): The number of remote workers is increasing steadily.
Task 2 को सामान्य सत्य: Many people believe that university education should be free. / Task 1 को हालको trend: Demand for electric vehicles is rising sharply at present.
2.6 Future का रूप · will, going to, र present continuous
IELTS-मा भविष्य जनाउन ३ वटा रूप पर्याप्त छन्:
will + base verb: भविष्यवाणी, भविष्यका सामान्य fact, र बोल्दाबोल्दै गरिएको निर्णय। If this trend continues, sea levels will rise further.
be going to + base verb: पहिले नै तय भइसकेका योजना, र अहिलेको प्रमाणमा आधारित भविष्यवाणी। The government is going to introduce a carbon tax next year.
present continuous: तय भइसकेका व्यक्तिगत कार्यक्रम (प्रायः Speaking मा)। I am meeting my supervisor tomorrow.
Task 1 को projection (भविष्यको अनुमान देखाउने graph) र Task 2 का परिणामका लागि will नै मुख्य भरोसा हो: Unless emissions are cut, the planet will face irreversible damage.
2.7 कम्तीमा चिन्नैपर्ने perfect र continuous tense-हरू
तपाईंलाई सधैं १२ वटै चाहिँदैन, तर यिनलाई चिन्न सक्नुभयो भने prompt सही तरिकाले पढ्न सक्नुहुन्छ, र स्वाभाविक रूपमा मिल्दा यिनले range बढाउँछन्।
Past perfect (had + p.p.) ले विगतका २ घटनामध्ये कुन पहिले भयो भनेर देखाउँछ। Speaking Part 2 मा कथा भन्दा काम लाग्छ। By the time the report was published, the situation had already changed.
Present perfect continuous (have been + -ing) ले अहिलेसम्म चलिरहेको trend-को अवधिमा जोड दिन्छ। House prices have been rising steadily for over a decade.
Future perfect (will have + p.p.) ले भविष्यको कुनै बिन्दुसम्म पूरा हुने परिवर्तनको अनुमान गर्छ, Task 1 का forecast-मा निकै प्रभावकारी। By 2040, the population will have doubled.
यिनलाई सजावटका लागि होइन, साँच्चैको range-का लागि प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Speaking को कथामा एउटा सही past perfect ले नियन्त्रण देखाउँछ; जबरजस्ती राखिएको, नमिल्ने past perfect गल्तीजस्तै देखिन्छ।

बंगलादेशी script-हरूमा continuous tense-का २ वटा गल्ती सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिन्छन्। दुवै -ing रूपको अति प्रयोगबाट आउँछन्, आंशिक रूपमा किनभने बंगाली भाषाले आफ्नो continuous रूप English भन्दा धेरै खुला रूपमा प्रयोग गर्छ।

Error type 1 · Stative verb continuous हुन सक्दैन। केही verb-ले चलिरहेको काम होइन, एउटा अवस्था जनाउँछन्: know, believe, understand, mean, agree, want, need, prefer, like, love, hate, seem, appear, belong, own, contain, consist, depend, र स्वामित्व (possession) जनाउँदा have।
✗ I am knowing the answer. / He is having two cars. / I am understanding your point now.
✓ I know the answer. / He has two cars. / I understand your point now.

Error type 2 · “Since” र “for” ले perfect लिन्छन्, present continuous होइन। विगतमा सुरु भएर अहिले पनि चलिरहेको trend-मा present perfect वा present perfect continuous प्रयोग हुन्छ, साधारण present continuous कहिल्यै होइन।
✗ The population is increasing since 2010. / Prices are rising for the last five years.
✓ The population has increased / has been increasing since 2010. / Prices have been rising for the last five years.
Time frame ले नै Task 1 जिताउँछ वा हराउँछ

Writing Task 1 मा tense ऐच्छिक accuracy होइन; यो उत्तरको मेरुदण्ड हो। विगतको मितिको दायरा भएको chart भए सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म past simple-मै रहनुपर्छ। वर्तमानसम्म आइपुग्ने trend-ले present perfect लिन्छ। भविष्यको projection भएको graph-ले will वा is expected to लिन्छ। Task 2 मा सामान्य सत्य र तपाईंको आफ्नो धारणा present simple-मा हुन्छन्, अनि परिणाम र भविष्यवाणीले future लिन्छन्।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: Car sales peaked in 2015, have fallen every year since, and are expected to stabilise after 2025.
Task 2: Because cities continue to expand, housing shortages will worsen unless governments act now.
Speaking Part 3: Attitudes have changed a great deal recently, and I think they will keep changing.
Chapter 2 यहीँ सकियो। अब Chapter 3 (Articles & Noun Types) आउँछ।

g02_tenses_practice.title: 2. Practice · Tense-मा दक्षता र समयको सटीकता
g02_tenses_practice.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: English-का १२ वटा tense-मध्ये IELTS-मा लगभग सबै काम ५ वटाले मात्र गर्छन्: present simple, present continuous, past simple, present perfect, र future का रूप। बाँकीको चिन्ता गर्नुअघि यी ५ वटामा माहिर हुनुहोस्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** ५ वटा tense मात्रले तपाईं जुनसुकै graph वर्णन गर्न र लगभग जुनसुकै Speaking question-को सही उत्तर दिन सक्नुहुन्छ।
**Present simple** -- fact, बानी, सामान्य सत्य, Task 2 मा आफ्नो धारणा।
**Present continuous** -- अहिले भइरहेको कुरा, हालको trend।
**Past simple** -- सकिएका घटना, graph-को विगतको data।
**Present perfect** -- अहिलेसम्म आइपुग्ने काम वा trend।

बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूको लेखाइमा लगभग सबै tense गल्ती यी ५ वटाभित्रका २ जोडीबाट हुन्छन् -- past simple बनाम present perfect, र present simple बनाम present continuous। यी २ जोडी ठीक गरे tense-का धेरैजसो अंक ठीक हुन्छन्।

blocks.title: Exercise 2.1 · Tense छनोट
blocks.instructions: कोष्ठकभित्रको verb-लाई सही tense-मा राख्नुहोस्। हरेक item-को एउटै उत्तम उत्तर हुन्छ, जुन त्यसको समयको संकेत वा अर्थले तय गर्छ।

items.prompt: In 2008, the company (open) ______ its first overseas office.
items.answer: opened
accepted: opened
items.reason: सकिएको वर्ष (2008), त्यसैले past simple।

items.prompt: Since 2015, the government (invest) ______ heavily in renewable energy.
items.answer: has invested
accepted: has invested
items.reason: “Since 2015” ले अहिलेसम्म जोड्छ, त्यसैले present perfect।

items.prompt: At the moment, the number of tourists (rise) ______ rapidly.
items.answer: is rising
accepted: is rising
items.reason: “At the moment” छ, त्यसैले present continuous।

items.prompt: Water (freeze) ______ at zero degrees Celsius.
items.answer: freezes
accepted: freezes
items.reason: सामान्य वैज्ञानिक सत्य, त्यसैले present simple।

items.prompt: By the time the survey ended, attitudes (already / change) ______.
items.answer: had already changed
accepted: had already changed
items.reason: विगतको अर्को घटनाअघि नै सकिएको काम, त्यसैले past perfect।

items.prompt: I (know) ______ the answer to that question. (correct the tense if wrong)
items.answer: know
accepted: know
items.reason: “I am knowing” गलत हो; know stative हो, त्यसैले simple present-मै रहन्छ।

items.prompt: House prices (increase) ______ steadily for the last ten years.
items.answer: have been increasing
accepted: have been increasing
have increased
items.reason: “For the last ten years” ले अहिलेसम्म जोड्छ; present perfect continuous ले अवधिमा जोड दिन्छ।

items.prompt: If this trend continues, the population (double) ______ by 2050.
items.answer: will double
accepted: will double
items.reason: साँच्चै सम्भव भविष्यवाणी, त्यसैले “will” सहितको first-conditional future।

items.prompt: Last summer, the temperature (rise) ______ by three degrees.
items.answer: rose
accepted: rose
items.reason: “Last summer” सकिएको समय हो, त्यसैले past simple।

items.prompt: Nowadays, more and more people (work) ______ from home.
items.answer: are working
accepted: are working
items.reason: “Nowadays” र हालको trend, त्यसैले present continuous।

items.prompt: The factory (close) ______ down in 1998 and has never reopened.
items.answer: closed
accepted: closed
items.reason: सकिएको घटना (1998), त्यसैले past simple।

items.prompt: Over the past decade, technology (transform) ______ the way we communicate.
items.answer: has transformed
accepted: has transformed
items.reason: “Over the past decade” ले अहिलेसम्म जोड्छ, त्यसैले present perfect।

items.prompt: He (have) ______ two brothers and one sister. (state, not action)
items.answer: has
accepted: has
items.reason: स्वामित्व (possession) stative हो; यहाँ “is having” गलत हुन्छ।

items.prompt: Between 2000 and 2010, unemployment (fall) ______ gradually.
items.answer: fell
accepted: fell
items.reason: विगतको सकिएको दायरा (2000 देखि 2010), त्यसैले past simple।

items.prompt: Currently, the government (consider) ______ three new proposals.
items.answer: is considering
accepted: is considering
items.reason: “Currently” छ, त्यसैले present continuous।

items.prompt: She (understand) ______ the problem now, after the explanation. (correct the tense if wrong)
items.answer: understands
accepted: understands
items.reason: “Is understanding” गलत हो; understand stative हो, त्यसैले present simple।

items.prompt: By 2030, most new cars (be) ______ electric, experts predict.
items.answer: will be
accepted: will be
items.reason: भविष्यको कुनै बिन्दुका लागि भविष्यवाणी, त्यसैले future simple।

items.prompt: The graph shows that consumption (drop) ______ sharply in 2012.
items.answer: dropped
accepted: dropped
items.reason: सकिएको वर्ष (2012) सँग बाँधिएको, त्यसैले past simple।

items.prompt: So far this year, exports (grow) ______ by twelve per cent.
items.answer: have grown
accepted: have grown
items.reason: “So far this year” ले अहिलेसम्म जोड्छ, त्यसैले present perfect।

items.prompt: Governments (spend) ______ large sums on defence every year. (general truth)
items.answer: spend
accepted: spend
items.reason: दोहोरिइरहने सामान्य सत्य (“every year”), त्यसैले present simple।

blocks: Recap · Task 1 का Trend-का लागि Tense
Past simple कि present perfect? Task 1 लेखाइमा tense सम्बन्धी यो नै सबैभन्दा सामान्य अलमल हो। नियम समयसँग जोडिएको छ: सकिएको अवधिले past simple लिन्छ, अहिलेसम्म आइपुग्ने अवधिले present perfect लिन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूमा tense सम्बन्धी यो नै सबैभन्दा सामान्य अलमल हो, र Task 1 को trend वर्णनमा यही निर्णायक हुन्छ।
**Past simple** प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् जब समय सकिइसकेको हुन्छ र प्रायः उल्लेख गरिएको हुन्छ: in 2010, last year, two decades ago।
**Present perfect** प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् जब काम अहिलेसम्म आइपुग्छ, वा ठ्याक्कै समय महत्त्वपूर्ण हुँदैन: since, for, over the past decade, recently।
The population rose in 2010 (सकिएको एउटा वर्ष) बनाम the population has risen since 2010 (2010 देखि वर्तमानसम्म)।

"in 2015" वा "two decades ago" जस्ता समय जनाउने शब्दले past simple माग्छन्; "since 2015", "for five years", वा "so far" ले present perfect माग्छन्। पहिले समयको expression scan गर्ने बानी बसाल्नुहोस् -- verb-को बारेमा सोच्नुअघि नै यसले तपाईंलाई tense बताइदिन्छ।

blocks.title: Exercise 2.2 · Task 1 को Trend वर्णन
blocks.instructions: Trend वर्णन गर्दै एउटा paragraph लेख्नुहोस्: सकिएको data-का लागि past simple, वर्तमानसम्मको परिवर्तनका लागि present perfect, र projection-का लागि future को कुनै रूप प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि model सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Write one accurate paragraph describing the trend for “Coffee consumption per person in Country X, 1990 to 2030 (projected).” Use the past simple for finished data, the present perfect for the change up to the present (assume “now” is 2025), and a future form for the projection. Notes: 1990 low, about 2 kg; rose steadily through the 1990s; 2000 reached 5 kg; fell slightly between 2005 and 2010; has risen again every year since 2010; 2025 stands at about 8 kg; projected to reach 10 kg by 2030.
items.answer: In 1990, coffee consumption in Country X was low, at roughly 2 kilograms per person. It then rose steadily throughout the 1990s, reaching 5 kilograms by 2000. Consumption fell slightly between 2005 and 2010, but it has risen every year since, and it now stands at about 8 kilograms per person. Looking ahead, the figure is projected to reach 10 kilograms by 2030.
accepted: In 1990, coffee consumption in Country X was low, at roughly 2 kilograms per person. It then rose steadily throughout the 1990s, reaching 5 kilograms by 2000. Consumption fell slightly between 2005 and 2010, but it has risen every year since, and it now stands at about 8 kilograms per person. Looking ahead, the figure is projected to reach 10 kilograms by 2030.
items.reason: was, rose, reaching, fell = उल्लेख गरिएका वर्षसहितको सकिएको विगतको data (past simple)। has risen = परिवर्तन वर्तमानसम्म आइपुग्छ (present perfect)। now stands = 2025 को अहिलेको अवस्था (present simple)। is projected to reach = भविष्यको अनुमान (forecast)।

g03_articles.title: 3. Article (A, An, The) र Noun-का प्रकार
g03_articles.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: बंगाली भाषीहरूले सबैभन्दा धेरै गल्ती गर्ने एउटै ठाउँ। Countable र uncountable noun, ३ वटा article र zero article, proofreading-का लागि ४ चरणको निर्णय गर्ने तरिका, र fixed case-हरू।

यो पूरै किताबमा तपाईंले एउटा मात्र chapter सुधार्नुहुन्छ भने, यही सुधार्नुहोस्। जसको मातृभाषामा article हुँदैन, उनीहरूका लागि article नै सबैभन्दा धेरै गल्ती हुने एउटै ठाउँ हो, र बंगाली, हिन्दी, उर्दू र नेपाली - कुनैमा पनि a / an / the-को सिधा मिल्ने शब्द छैन। यो सानोतिनो कुरा होइन। अरू कुरामा बलियो Band 7 स्तरका candidate-हरू पनि Band 6.0 मै अड्किनुको एक नम्बर कारण article-को गल्ती हो, किनभने यी गल्ती बारम्बार हुन्छन्, लगभग हरेक वाक्यमा देखिन्छन्, र तपाईंको कानले यिनलाई समात्न सक्दैन: तपाईंको मातृभाषाले कानलाई त्यसको अभ्यास कहिल्यै गराएन।
तपाईं a / an प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ कि सक्नुहुन्न भन्ने कुरा यही फरकमा भर पर्छ, त्यसैले article-का नियमभन्दा पहिले यो सिक्नुहोस्।
Countable noun गन्न सकिन्छ र यसको plural रूप हुन्छ: one book, two books; a student, five students। Singular-मा यिनले a / an लिन सक्छन्।
Uncountable noun-लाई एउटै पूरा मात्रा (mass) मानिन्छ; यसको plural रूप हुँदैन र a / an पनि लाग्दैन: information (कहिल्यै informations होइन), water, advice।

बंगलादेशी candidate-हरू धेरै चिप्लिने, धेरै प्रयोग हुने uncountable noun-हरू, जसलाई एउटै block-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नु राम्रो: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work, luggage, baggage, software, staff, homework, feedback, transport, machinery, vocabulary।
Uncountable noun गन्नुपर्दा partitive phrase (एकाइ जनाउने शब्द) र of प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्:
a study / a piece of research
a piece of furniture / an item of furniture
Article ३ वटा छन् (a, an, the), र चौथो विकल्प पनि छ: कुनै article नै नराख्ने, जसलाई zero article भनिन्छ। हरेक singular countable noun-का लागि यी ४ मध्ये एउटा सोचेर छान्नुपर्छ।

एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको, singular, countable चीजका लागि a / an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, प्रायः पहिलो पटक उल्लेख गर्दा। a र an मध्ये कुन छान्ने भन्ने कुरा उच्चारणको आवाजमा भर पर्छ, हिज्जेमा होइन। Vowel आवाजअघि an, consonant आवाजअघि a प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
a university, a European country (यी “y” consonant आवाजबाट सुरु हुन्छन्)
an hour, an honest man (h उच्चारण हुँदैन, त्यसैले vowel आवाज)
an MBA, an X-ray (vowel आवाजबाट सुरु हुने अक्षरका नाम)
I saw a documentary last night. (पहिलो उल्लेख, निश्चित नगरिएको) / She wants to become an engineer. (एक जना, निश्चित नगरिएको)
Noun निश्चित हुँदा, अर्थात् पाठक वा सुन्नेलाई तपाईंले ठ्याक्कै कुनको कुरा गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने थाहा हुँदा, the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। यस्तो धेरै तरिकाले हुन्छ:
पहिले नै उल्लेख भइसकेको छ: I saw a documentary. The documentary was about climate change.
त्यो एउटा मात्र छ: the sun, the government, the internet, the environment।
वरपरका शब्दले त्यसलाई निश्चित बनाएका छन्: the number of cars, the graph above, the capital of Bangladesh।
Superlative र ordinal-सँग: the highest figure, the most important factor, the first step।
The chart shows the number of visitors. (दुवै निश्चित) / Solar power is the cleanest option available. (superlative)
यी अवस्थामा कुनै article प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्:
सामान्य अर्थमा भनिएका plural countable noun: Books are expensive. Cars cause pollution.
सामान्य अर्थमा भनिएका uncountable noun: Water is essential. Education matters. Poverty is rising.
धेरैजसो proper noun: धेरैजसो देश, सहर, मानिस र भाषाका नाम: Bangladesh, Dhaka, English।
Education is a basic right. (सामान्य uncountable, zero article) / Cars contribute to pollution. (सामान्य plural + सामान्य uncountable)
3.3 निर्णय गर्ने तरिका (proofread गर्दा यो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)
कुनै पनि singular noun जाँच्दा यी प्रश्न क्रमैसँग सोध्नुहोस्:
यो countable हो? होइन भने (uncountable), a / an प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन। निश्चित भए the, सामान्य भए zero article छान्नुहोस्। यहीँ रोकिनुहोस्।
हो भने (countable): यो निश्चित, थाहा भएको, वा एउटा मात्र (unique) हो? हो भने the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
निश्चित होइन र singular हो भने: a / an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् (उच्चारणको आवाज हेरेर)।
सामान्य अर्थको plural हो भने: zero article प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
केही article-को छनोट पक्का (fixed) हुन्छ, र यिनलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै item-का रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ:
the internet, the environment, the economy, the government, the media, the public, the world - यिनले the लिन्छन् (एउटा मात्र भएको मानिन्छ)।
Superlative ले सधैं the लिन्छ: the best, the largest, the most significant।
संस्थालाई त्यसको मूल कामका लागि प्रयोग गर्दा zero article लाग्छ: go to school, go to university, go to hospital (British प्रयोग), in prison, at home। निश्चित भवन भन्न खोज्दा मात्र the थप्नुहोस्।

देश: धेरैजसो देशले zero article लिन्छन् (Bangladesh, France, China), तर केही plural वा “united/republic” भएका नामले the लिन्छन्: the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, the Philippines।

पहिलो उल्लेख र त्यसपछि दोस्रो उल्लेख: a ले चिनाउनुहोस्, the ले फेरि उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्। examiner-हरूले खोज्ने परम्परागत a बाट the-मा जाने चाल यही हो: The chart shows a sharp rise in 2018. The rise continued into 2019.
बंगाली भाषीहरू article-मा किन गल्ती गर्छन्

बंगाली भाषामा article नै छैन, त्यसैले तपाईंको मनको grammar-मा यो वर्ग नै हुँदैन; त्यसैले यसलाई अनुवाद गरेर होइन, English-को मात्र छुट्टै प्रणालीका रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ। ३ वटा गल्तीका ढाँचा सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिन्छन्।

Error type 1 · निश्चित र एउटा मात्र भएका चीजअघि “the” छुटाउनु।
✗ Internet has changed our lives. / Government should fund school.
✓ The internet has changed our lives. / The government should fund schools.

Error type 2 · Uncountable noun-सँग “a / an” प्रयोग गर्नु। यही हो “an advice / an information” गल्ती।
✗ He gave me an advice. / She did a research on it.
✓ He gave me some advice / a piece of advice. / She did research / a study on it.

Error type 3 · Singular countable noun-अघि article पूरै छुटाउनु।
✗ Government should take step to reduce pollution.
✓ The government should take steps to reduce pollution.
Band 6 मै अड्किने एक नम्बर कारण

हरेक task-मा article-को नियन्त्रण धेरै बाक्लोसँग जाँचिन्छ। Task 1-मा एउटै वाक्यमा ३ वटा छुट्टाछुट्टै article-निर्णय चाहिन सक्छ: “The chart shows the number of visitors to a museum.” Task 2-का सामान्यीकरणमा ढाँचा उल्टिएर zero article र the-मा पुग्छ: “Governments should protect the environment.” गल्ती यति धेरै हुने भएकाले नै यो त्यो परम्परागत फरक हो, जसका कारण idea-मा Band 7 जस्तो लाग्ने script-ले Grammatical Range and Accuracy-मा Band 6 पाउँछ।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The graph illustrates the proportion of households with an internet connection.
Task 2: Education is widely seen as the key to development, and governments should therefore fund schools properly.
Speaking Part 2: The person who influenced me most was a teacher at my primary school.
Chapter 3 यहीँ सकियो। त्यसपछि Chapter 4 (Prepositions & Dependency Rules) आउँछ।

g03_articles_practice.title: 3. Practice · Article (A, An, The) र Noun-का प्रकार
g03_articles_practice.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: हरेक singular countable noun-का लागि सोचेर एउटा छनोट गर्नुपर्छ: a/an, the, वा कुनै article नै नराख्ने। नियम एउटै प्रश्नमा टिकेको छ -- यो noun लेख्ने र पढ्ने दुवैका लागि निश्चित हो कि होइन?
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूको लेखाइमा article-का गल्ती सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने -- र सबैभन्दा देखिने -- गल्तीमध्ये पर्छन्, किनभने बंगाली भाषामा article-को कुनै प्रणाली नै छैन।

**a/an** -- एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको, singular, countable चीज, प्रायः पहिलो उल्लेख। छनोट **उच्चारणको आवाजमा भर पर्छ, हिज्जेमा होइन**: a university (consonant आवाज), an hour (h उच्चारण हुँदैन, vowel आवाज)।
**the** -- noun निश्चित छ: पहिले नै उल्लेख भइसकेको, एउटा मात्र भएको (the sun, the government), वा वरपरका शब्दले निश्चित बनाएको (the number of cars)।
**zero article** -- सामान्य अर्थमा प्रयोग भएका plural र uncountable noun, र धेरैजसो proper noun।

आफैंलाई सोध्नुहोस्: यो पहिले उल्लेख भइसकेको छ, वा यो एउटा मात्र छ? हो भने the प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। यो एउटा, निश्चित नगरिएको उदाहरण हो भने a/an प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। दुवै लागू हुँदैनन् भने कुनै article प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Article राख्ने
blocks.instructions: Article-हरू हटाइएका छन्। चाहिने ठाउँमा a, an, वा the राखेर हरेक वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। केही खाली ठाउँमा zero article (कुनै शब्द नराख्ने) चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: ___ education is ___ key to ___ economic development.
items.answer: Education is the key to economic development.
accepted: Education is the key to economic development.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “education” र “development” ले zero article लिन्छन्; “the key” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: She is ___ most hard-working student in ___ class.
items.answer: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
accepted: She is the most hard-working student in the class.
items.reason: Superlative र एउटा निश्चित class, दुवैले “the” लिन्छन्।

items.prompt: ___ chart shows ___ number of tourists visiting ___ museum.
items.answer: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
accepted: The chart shows the number of tourists visiting a museum.
items.reason: “the chart,” “the number of,” र पहिलो उल्लेख “a museum.”

items.prompt: ___ internet has transformed ___ way people communicate.
items.answer: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
accepted: The internet has transformed the way people communicate.
items.reason: “the internet” एउटा मात्र छ; “the way” पछाडिको clause-ले निश्चित भएको छ।

items.prompt: He wants to become ___ honest lawyer after ___ university.
items.answer: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
accepted: He wants to become an honest lawyer after university.
items.reason: “honest”-को vowel आवाजअघि “an” (h उच्चारण हुँदैन); संस्थाका रूपमा “university” ले zero article लिन्छ।

items.prompt: ___ pollution is ___ serious problem in ___ major cities.
items.answer: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
accepted: Pollution is a serious problem in major cities.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “pollution”; पहिलो उल्लेख “a problem”; सामान्य plural “cities.”

items.prompt: I read ___ interesting article yesterday. ___ article was about ___ climate change.
items.answer: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
accepted: I read an interesting article yesterday. The article was about climate change.
items.reason: पहिलो उल्लेख “an,” दोस्रो उल्लेख “the,” सामान्य “climate change.”

items.prompt: ___ government should invest more in ___ public transport.
items.answer: The government should invest more in public transport.
accepted: The government should invest more in public transport.
items.reason: “the government” निश्चित छ; “public transport” सामान्य uncountable हो।

items.prompt: ___ United States and ___ United Kingdom signed ___ agreement.
items.answer: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
accepted: The United States and the United Kingdom signed an agreement.
items.reason: यी देशका नामले “the” लिन्छन्; पहिलो उल्लेख “an agreement.”

items.prompt: ___ sun rises in ___ east.
items.answer: The sun rises in the east.
accepted: The sun rises in the east.
items.reason: दुवै एउटा मात्र छन्।

items.prompt: ___ poverty remains ___ obstacle to ___ progress in ___ developing world.
items.answer: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
accepted: Poverty remains an obstacle to progress in the developing world.
items.reason: सामान्य “poverty” र “progress”; पहिलो उल्लेख “an obstacle”; “the developing world” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: She gave me ___ useful advice about ___ visa process.
items.answer: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.
accepted: She gave me useful advice about the visa process.
items.reason: “advice” uncountable हो (“a” लाग्दैन); “the visa process” निश्चित छ।

items.prompt: ___ number of ___ students who fail ___ exam is rising.
items.answer: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.
accepted: The number of students who fail the exam is rising.
items.reason: “the number of,” सामान्य “students,” निश्चित “exam.”

items.prompt: My brother is ___ engineer, and he works for ___ large company.
items.answer: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.
accepted: My brother is an engineer, and he works for a large company.
items.reason: “an engineer” (vowel आवाज), पहिलो उल्लेख “a company.”

items.prompt: ___ water is essential for ___ life on ___ Earth.
items.answer: Water is essential for life on Earth.
accepted: Water is essential for life on Earth.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable र proper noun “Earth” ले zero article लिन्छन्।

items.prompt: We stayed in ___ hotel near ___ airport; ___ hotel was cheap.
items.answer: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
accepted: We stayed in a hotel near the airport; the hotel was cheap.
items.reason: पहिलो उल्लेख “a hotel,” थाहा भएको “the airport,” दोस्रो उल्लेख “the hotel.”

items.prompt: ___ research shows that ___ exercise improves ___ mental health.
items.answer: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.
accepted: Research shows that exercise improves mental health.
items.reason: सबै सामान्य/uncountable, त्यसैले zero article।

items.prompt: ___ environment must be protected for ___ future generations.
items.answer: The environment must be protected for future generations.
accepted: The environment must be protected for future generations.
items.reason: “the environment” एउटा मात्र छ; “future generations” सामान्य plural।

items.prompt: He spent ___ hour reading ___ book about ___ history of ___ Bangladesh.
items.answer: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
accepted: He spent an hour reading a book about the history of Bangladesh.
items.reason: “an hour” (h उच्चारण हुँदैन), पहिलो उल्लेख “a book,” “the history of X” निश्चित, proper noun “Bangladesh” zero।

items.prompt: ___ traffic in ___ capital is ___ major source of ___ air pollution.
items.answer: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
accepted: The traffic in the capital is a major source of air pollution.
items.reason: “the traffic” निश्चित, “the capital” निश्चित, पहिलो उल्लेख “a source,” सामान्य “air pollution.”

items.prompt: ___ knowledge is power, but ___ information alone is not ___ knowledge.
items.answer: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.
accepted: Knowledge is power, but information alone is not knowledge.
items.reason: सबै सामान्य uncountable।

items.prompt: She is ___ best doctor in ___ hospital where I work.
items.answer: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
accepted: She is the best doctor in the hospital where I work.
items.reason: Superlative र निश्चित गरिएको hospital।

items.prompt: ___ children in ___ rural areas often lack access to ___ good schools.
items.answer: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.
accepted: Children in rural areas often lack access to good schools.
items.reason: सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म सबै सामान्य plural।

items.prompt: ___ economy grew by ___ five per cent in ___ first quarter.
items.answer: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
accepted: The economy grew by five per cent in the first quarter.
items.reason: “the economy” एउटा मात्र छ, “five per cent”-अघि कुनै article छैन, “the first quarter” ordinal हो।

items.prompt: ___ solar power is ___ cleaner alternative to ___ fossil fuels.
items.answer: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
accepted: Solar power is a cleaner alternative to fossil fuels.
items.reason: सामान्य uncountable “solar power,” पहिलो उल्लेख “a cleaner alternative,” सामान्य plural “fossil fuels.”

blocks: a/an प्रयोग गर्न मिल्छ कि मिल्दैन भन्ने कुरा पहिले एउटा फरकमा भर पर्छ: यो noun गन्न सकिन्छ? information र advice जस्ता uncountable noun-ले कहिल्यै plural -s लिँदैनन्, र एक्लै कहिल्यै a/an लिँदैनन्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** article र plural-का नियम लागू हुन्छन् कि हुँदैनन् भन्ने कुरा यही फरकले तय गर्छ, त्यसैले Chapter 3-मा यो सबैभन्दा पहिले आउनुपर्छ।
**Countable noun** गन्न सकिन्छ र यसको plural रूप हुन्छ: one book, two books। Singular-मा यिनले a/an लिन्छन्।
**Uncountable noun** एउटै पूरा मात्रा हो, यसको **plural रूप हुँदैन** र **a/an लाग्दैन**: information (कहिल्यै informations होइन), water, advice।
कण्ठ गर्नुपर्ने, IELTS-मा धेरै प्रयोग हुने set
information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, work, luggage, software, staff, homework.
**partitive phrase** प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्: an advice होइन, a piece of advice; a furniture होइन, a piece of furniture वा an item of furniture।

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Countable र Uncountable गल्ती पत्ता लगाउने
blocks.instructions: हरेक वाक्यमा एउटा noun गलत तरिकाले प्रयोग भएको छ, प्रायः uncountable noun-लाई plural -s वा a / an दिएर। हरेक वाक्य सही बनाएर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The teacher gave us many useful advices before the exam.
items.answer: The teacher gave us much useful advice before the exam.
accepted: The teacher gave us much useful advice before the exam.

items.answer: I need some information about the application process.
accepted: I need some information about the application process.

items.prompt: She bought new furnitures for her apartment.

accepted: She bought new furniture for her apartment.
items.reason: “furniture”-को plural हुँदैन; गन्नुपर्दा “pieces of furniture” प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

accepted: The laboratory does not have enough equipment.

accepted: He has made good progress in his studies this year.
items.reason: “progress” uncountable हो: “a” लाग्दैन।
