accepted: The researchers published several important studies last year.
items.reason: “research” uncountable हो; गन्न मिल्ने शब्द “studies” हो।

items.answer: We had a lot of homework during the holidays.
accepted: We had a lot of homework during the holidays.
items.reason: “homework” uncountable हो।

items.answer: The company installed new software on every computer.
accepted: The company installed new software on every computer.

items.answer: There was heavy traffic on the road this morning.
accepted: There was heavy traffic on the road this morning.
items.reason: “traffic” uncountable हो: plural हुँदैन, र “were” होइन, “was.”

items.prompt: The hotel provides free accommodations for its staffs.
items.answer: The hotel provides free accommodation for its staff.
accepted: The hotel provides free accommodation for its staff.
items.reason: दुवै uncountable: plural हुँदैन।

accepted: My knowledge of physics is quite limited.
items.reason: “knowledge” uncountable र singular हो।

accepted: The government spent a huge amount of money on the project.

accepted: She gave me some good news yesterday.
She gave me two pieces of good news yesterday.

g04_prepositions.title: 4. Preposition र Dependent Preposition-का नियम
g04_prepositions.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: समय, ठाउँ र दिशा जनाउने preposition, Task 1-का data preposition, block बनाएर कण्ठ गर्नुपर्ने dependent preposition, र ती सिधा-अनुवादका गल्तीहरू जसले लेखाइ बंगलादेशीको हो भनेर तुरुन्तै देखाउँछन्।

Preposition भनेका साना शब्दहरू हुन् (in, on, at, by, for, to, of, from, with), जसले अरू शब्दहरू समय, ठाउँ र दिशाका हिसाबले एकअर्कासँग कसरी जोडिएका छन् भनेर देखाउँछन्। हेर्दा सानो कुरा जस्तो लागे पनि यो परीक्षाका गल्तीहरूको ठूलो हिस्सा यहीँबाट आउँछ, र त्यसको कारण एउटै छ: preposition तर्कले होइन, pattern हेरेर कण्ठ गर्नुपर्छ। English-ले किन interested in भन्छ तर good at र afraid of भन्छ, त्यसको कुनै नियम छैन। यी fixed collocation हुन् - native कानलाई कि ठीक सुनिन्छन्, कि सुनिँदैनन्। बंगाली भाषीका लागि यो समस्या हो, किनभने तपाईंको स्वाभाविक बानी बंगालीको preposition सिधै अनुवाद गर्ने हुन्छ, तर बंगालीले यी सम्बन्धहरू फरक तरिकाले देखाउँछ।

Preposition कुनै noun वा pronoun-को अगाडि बस्छ र एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ: the book is on the table (ठाउँ), the meeting is at three (समय), she walked into the room (दिशा)। यसपछि आउने noun-लाई यसको object भनिन्छ। Tense अध्यायमा तपाईंले पहिल्यै देखिसकेको एउटा मुख्य नियम यहाँ फेरि आउँछ: preposition-पछि verb सधैं -ing form-मा आउँछ, कहिल्यै infinitive-मा होइन। Interested in studying, responsible for managing, capable of solving।
4.2 समयका preposition · in, on, at र यिनका छिमेकीहरू
समयका मुख्य ३ वटा preposition-ले “zooming in” तर्क मान्छन् - लामो समयदेखि बिस्तारै एकदम ठ्याक्कै बिन्दुसम्म।
महिना, वर्ष, ऋतु, शताब्दी, लामो अवधि
in July, in 2020, in winter, in the 1990s
on Monday, on 5 May, on weekdays
at 5 p.m., at night, at the weekend, at the start
IELTS-का लागि काम लाग्ने समयका अरू preposition:
since + सुरु भएको बिन्दु (present perfect-सँग आउँछ): since 2010, since January।
for + समयको लम्बाइ: for five years, for a decade।
during + एउटा अवधि (जब केही कुरा त्यही अवधिभित्र हुन्छ): during the 1990s, during the recession।
by + एउटा deadline (त्यसभन्दा ढिलो होइन): by 2030, by the end of the decade।
from … to / until + समयको फैलावट: from 2000 to 2010, until 2015।
In Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew since five years.
On Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew for five years.
in = कुनै ठाउँ वा क्षेत्रभित्र: in the room, in Dhaka, in the world।
on = कुनै सतह वा रेखामाथि: on the wall, on the coast, on the second floor।
at = कुनै निश्चित बिन्दु वा ठाउँमा: at the station, at the top, at home।
into / onto / to ले चाल वा दिशा देखाउँछन्: walk into the room, climb onto the roof, go to work।
The figures are shown in the chart, on the vertical axis, at the top of the page.
4.4 Task 1-का data preposition (fixed phrase-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्)
यी combination-हरूले graph-मा हुने उतारचढाव र परिमाण बताउँछन्। Writing Task 1-मा यिनमा कुनै छुट हुँदैन, र examiner-ले हरेक एकदम सही होस् भन्ने अपेक्षा गर्छन्।
Sales increased with 20 per cent and reached to a peak in June.
Sales increased by 20 per cent and reached a peak in June.
प्रतिशतका लागि “increase by”; अनि “reach a peak”-मा “reach”-पछि कुनै preposition आउँदैन।
एउटा बलियो Task 1 sentence-ले प्रायः यीमध्ये धेरैलाई एकैसाथ जोड्छ: The price rose by five dollars, from 20 to 25, reaching a peak of 25 in March.
धेरै verb, adjective र noun-पछि एउटा निश्चित preposition आउँछ। यसमा कुनै तर्क छैन; हरेकलाई एउटा unit-का रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ। Block बनाएर कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्, र आफैं मुखमा नआउन्जेल प्रयोग गरिरहनुहोस्।
The policy resulted in higher costs.
The panel consists of five experts.
The essay focuses on two causes.
Families struggle to cope with rising costs.
Individuals are responsible for their choices.
People are more aware of the risks.
The system is capable of handling demand.
This trend is similar to the previous one.
Urban life is different from rural life.
He is good at solving problems.
The economy is dependent on exports.
The issue is related to poverty.
The course is suitable for beginners.
यी गल्तीहरू बंगालीको संरचना शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद गर्दा आउँछन्। यी एकदमै सामान्य छन् र examiner-ले देख्नेबित्तिकै चिन्छन्, त्यसैले यिनलाई सच्याउँदा छिटो र देखिने गरी accuracy बढ्छ।

discuss / enter / reach / marry ले सिधै object लिन्छन् - कुनै preposition चाहिँदैन
✗ discuss about the topic / enter into the room / reach to the destination / marry with her
✓ discuss the topic / enter the room / reach the destination / marry her

according to me / return back / comprise of / mention about / cope up with - यी गल्ती हुन्
✗ According to me / return back home / comprise of three parts / mention about it / cope up with
✓ In my opinion / return home / comprise three parts / mention it / cope with

Preposition-ले तपाईंको score-मा २ वटा ठाउँमा प्रष्ट असर गर्छ। Writing Task 1-मा data preposition-हरू (by, from, to, of, at) यति standard हुन्छन् कि एउटा गल्ती भए पनि तुरुन्तै accuracy error-का रूपमा आँखामा पर्छ। Writing Task 2 र Speaking-मा dependent preposition (depend on, lead to, responsible for, solution to) र सिधा-अनुवादका गल्तीहरू (discuss about, according to me) ले नियन्त्रित English-लाई अनियन्त्रित English-बाट छुट्याउँछन्। यी collocation भएकाले सही प्रयोग गर्दा तपाईंको Lexical Resource score पनि बढ्छ - अर्थात् फाइदा दोब्बर।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: Unemployment rose by four points, from six to ten per cent, before falling to eight in 2015.
Task 2: A lack of investment in public transport contributes to congestion and leads to higher emissions.
Speaking Part 3: It really depends on the situation, but on balance I think education is the solution to most of these problems.
अध्याय ४ सकियो, साथै मोड्युल १ पनि सकियो। अब मोड्युल २ (Band 7.0+ Complex Structures), अध्याय ५ आउँछ।

g04_prepositions_practice.title: 4. Practice · Preposition र Dependent Preposition-का नियम
g04_prepositions_practice.group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: धेरै verb, adjective र noun एउटा निश्चित preposition-सँग बाँधिएका हुन्छन्, र यो जोडीको पछाडि कुनै तर्क हुँदैन -- हरेकलाई एउटा fixed unit-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नैपर्छ: depend ON, responsible FOR, an increase IN।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Dependent preposition पूरै कण्ठ गर्ने कुरा हो, तर academic writing-मा यी जताततै हुन्छन्; र बाँकी sentence बलियो भए पनि यहाँ गल्ती भयो भने त्यो basic error जस्तै देखिन्छ।
शब्दको प्रकार अनुसार block बनाएर सिक्नुहोस्
**Verb + preposition:** depend on, lead to, result in, result from।
**Adjective + preposition:** responsible for, interested in, aware of, capable of।
**Noun + preposition:** an increase/rise in, a reason for, a solution to, an effect/impact on।

यहाँ कुनै shortcut छैन -- हरेक जोडीलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै २ वटा शब्दका रूपमा होइन, एउटा chunk-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्, र पूरा sentence-भित्र अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्, जबसम्म जोडी खोजेर निकाल्नुपर्ने नभई आफैं मनमा आउँदैन।

blocks: Recap · L1 (मातृभाषा) बाट अनुवादका trap-बाट बच्ने

Preposition-ले एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ -- ठाउँ, समय वा दिशा -- र यसको object यसपछि आउँछ। तपाईंको English अलिकति अनौठो लाग्छ भने, fixed English pattern प्रयोग गर्नुको सट्टा बंगालीको preposition pattern सिधै अनुवाद गर्नुभयो कि भनेर जाँच्नुहोस्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** बंगाली भाषीहरूका धेरैजसो preposition-का गल्ती English जोडीलाई आफ्नै fixed unit-का रूपमा नसिकी L1 को pattern शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद गर्दा आउँछन्।
Preposition कुनै noun वा pronoun-को अगाडि बस्छ र एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ: on the table (ठाउँ), at three (समय), into the room (दिशा)। यसपछि आउने noun-लाई यसको object भनिन्छ।

जब कुनै preposition-बारे पक्का हुनुहुन्न, बंगालीबाट सिधै अनुवाद गर्ने मोहमा नपर्नुहोस्। बरु पूरा fixed English phrase-लाई एउटा chunk-का रूपमा सम्झनुहोस् -- depend on, "depend from" वा "depend of" होइन -- किनभने English preposition विरलै बंगालीका preposition-सँग एक-एक गरी मेल खान्छन्।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.2 · L1 बाट सिधा अनुवादको गल्ती सच्याउने
blocks.instructions: हरेक sentence-मा बंगालीबाट सिधा अनुवादका कारण एउटा preposition-को गल्ती छ। हरेकलाई सही बनाएर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: According to me, the government should act quickly.
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
accepted: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
items.reason: आफ्नै विचार भन्न “according to me” गलत हो।

items.prompt: We discussed about the new policy for an hour.
items.answer: We discussed the new policy for an hour.
accepted: We discussed the new policy for an hour.
items.reason: “discuss”-पछि “about” चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: He entered into the classroom without knocking.
items.answer: He entered the classroom without knocking.
accepted: He entered the classroom without knocking.
items.reason: “enter”-पछि “into” चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: The teacher emphasised on the importance of grammar.
items.answer: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.
accepted: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.
items.reason: “emphasise”-ले सिधै object लिन्छ।

items.prompt: After the trip, they returned back to their village.
items.answer: After the trip, they returned to their village.
accepted: After the trip, they returned to their village.
items.reason: “return” को अर्थ नै “go back” हो, त्यसैले “back” अनावश्यक हो।

items.prompt: The report comprises of five main sections.
items.answer: The report comprises five main sections.
accepted: The report comprises five main sections.
items.reason: “comprise”-पछि “of” आउँदैन (वा “is composed of” प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)।

items.prompt: She married with a doctor last year.
items.answer: She married a doctor last year.
accepted: She married a doctor last year.
items.reason: “marry”-ले सिधै object लिन्छ।

items.prompt: I want to request to you for some help.
items.answer: I want to ask you for some help.
accepted: I want to ask you for some help.
I want to make a request to you for some help.
items.reason: “request to you” गलत हो।

items.prompt: The essay mentioned about three possible solutions.
items.answer: The essay mentioned three possible solutions.
accepted: The essay mentioned three possible solutions.
items.reason: “mention”-पछि “about” चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: The researchers investigated about the causes of pollution.
items.answer: The researchers investigated the causes of pollution.
accepted: The researchers investigated the causes of pollution.
items.reason: “investigate”-ले सिधै object लिन्छ।

items.prompt: We must cope up with the rising cost of living.
items.answer: We must cope with the rising cost of living.
accepted: We must cope with the rising cost of living.
items.reason: “up” चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: The minister reached to the venue an hour late.
items.answer: The minister reached the venue an hour late.
accepted: The minister reached the venue an hour late.
items.reason: “reach”-पछि “to” आउँदैन।

items.prompt: My opinion is different than yours on this matter.
items.answer: My opinion is different from yours on this matter.
accepted: My opinion is different from yours on this matter.
items.reason: “different from” नै standard academic form हो।

items.prompt: Students should concentrate in their studies.
items.answer: Students should concentrate on their studies.
accepted: Students should concentrate on their studies.
items.reason: “concentrate on”, “in” होइन।

items.prompt: The country is suffering with severe traffic congestion.
items.answer: The country is suffering from severe traffic congestion.
accepted: The country is suffering from severe traffic congestion.
items.reason: “suffer from”।

g05_complex.title: 5. Complex Sentence र Subordinate Clause
g05_complex.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: Band 7-का लागि सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण एउटै structure। Clause-का आधारभूत कुरा, sentence-का ३ प्रकार, adverbial र relative clause, comma-को नियम, अनि fragment, run-on र comma splice सच्याउने तरिका।

मोड्युल १ ले तपाईंका sentence-हरूलाई सही बनायो। मोड्युल २ ले तिनमा विविधता ल्याउँछ। यही चरणमा आएर लेखाइ छोटा, सुरक्षित वाक्यहरूको सूचीजस्तो सुनिन छोड्छ र जोडिएको argument-जस्तो पढिन थाल्छ। Grammatical Range and Accuracy-को Band 7 descriptor ले “a variety of complex structures used with some flexibility” माग्छ, र यो मोड्युलले ठ्याक्कै त्यही दिन्छ: subordinate clause-बाट बनेका complex sentence, academic tone-का लागि passive voice, र सम्भावनाबारे तर्क गर्न conditional।

Band 7 पुग्नका लागि complex sentence नै सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण एउटै structure हो, किनभने range-को सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट संकेत यही हो। यसले दुई वटा छुट्टाछुट्टै छोटा sentence-को सट्टा एउटै नियन्त्रित sentence भित्र दुई विचारबीचको तार्किक सम्बन्ध (contrast, reason, condition, time) देखाउन दिन्छ।
Clause भनेको subject र verb भएको शब्दहरूको समूह हो। Clause २ प्रकारका हुन्छन्, र पूरै अध्याय यी दुईलाई छुट्याएर चिन्न सक्नुमै आधारित छ।
Independent clause ले पूरा विचार व्यक्त गर्छ र एक्लै sentence बनेर उभिन सक्छ: “Cities offer jobs.”

Dependent (subordinate) clause-मा subject र verb हुन्छ, तर यो एक्लै उभिन सक्दैन, किनभने यसको सुरुमा रहेको subordinating शब्दले यसलाई अधुरो छोड्छ: “Although cities offer jobs …” यसले तपाईंलाई बाँकी भागको प्रतीक्षा गराउँछ।
Complex sentence ले एउटा independent clause-लाई कम्तीमा एउटा dependent clause-सँग जोड्छ: Although cities offer jobs, (dependent) they are crowded. (independent)
5.2 Sentence-का ३ प्रकार, र complex sentence-ले किन अंक दिलाउँछ
Cities offer jobs, but they are crowded.
Although cities offer jobs, they are crowded.

Band 5-को लेखाइमा प्रायः simple sentence मात्र हुन्छन्। Band 6-को लेखाइमा simple र compound मिसिएका हुन्छन्। Band 7-को लेखाइले complex sentence नियन्त्रणमा राखेर प्रयोग गर्छ र तिनलाई विभिन्न किसिमले प्रयोग गर्छ। यसका मुख्य २ वटा औजार छन्: adverbial clause (5.3) र relative clause (5.4)।

Adverbial clause भनेको subordinating conjunction-बाट सुरु हुने dependent clause हो, जसले आफ्नो विचार main clause-सँग कसरी जोडिएको छ भनेर देखाउँछ। Subordinator-हरूलाई तिनले जनाउने सम्बन्धअनुसार समूह बनाएर सिक्नुहोस्।
Although it is costly, it works.
Prices rose because demand outstripped supply.
if, unless, provided that, as long as
Unless action is taken, the trend will continue.
Laws were tightened so that accidents would fall.
The cost was so high that the plan collapsed.
उद्देश्य देखाउन सबैभन्दा काम लाग्ने छोटो रूप in order to + base verb (वा केवल to + base verb) हो: The city expanded the metro in order to reduce congestion.

Dependent clause पहिले आयो भने त्यसपछि comma राख्नुहोस्। पछि आयो भने सामान्यतया comma चाहिँदैन। Although it is costly, it works. (dependent clause अगाडि, त्यसैले comma) / It works although it is costly. (dependent clause पछि, comma छैन)

Relative clause ले relative pronoun (who, which, that, where, whose) प्रयोग गरेर कुनै noun-बारे जानकारी थप्छ। यसले दुई वटा छोटा sentence हुने कुरालाई एउटै परिपक्व sentence-मा समेट्न दिन्छ, जसले सिधै range बढाउँछ।
Students who study abroad gain independence.
Solar power, which is clean, is expanding.
The policy that failed was expensive.
Cities where rents are high lose young workers.
Families whose income is low need support.
Defining र non-defining: comma-ले अर्थ बदल्छ
अंक यही भागबाट आउँछ, र यो सजावट मात्र होइन। Comma-हरूले sentence-को अर्थ नै बदल्छन्।
Defining clause ले ठ्याक्कै कुन भनेर चिनाउँछ, त्यसैले यो अनिवार्य हुन्छ। यसमा comma लाग्दैन। Students who cheat are expelled. (cheat गर्नेहरू मात्र)
Non-defining clause ले थप, अनावश्यक जानकारी दिन्छ, र यसलाई दुवैतिर comma-ले घेरिन्छ। The students, who were tired, left early. (सबै जना)

that defining clause-मा मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Non-defining clause-मा which वा who प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, कहिल्यै that होइन। गलत: My school, that is very old, is famous. सही: My school, which is very old, is famous.

Relative clause-पछि pronoun राखेर subject फेरि नदोहोर्याउनुहोस्। यो बंगलादेशीहरूमा निकै सामान्य गल्ती हो। गलत: People which live in cities they pay more rent. सही: People who live in cities pay more rent.

Reduced relative clause (Band 8-को स्पर्श): प्रायः relative pronoun र verb be हटाएर phrase-लाई अझ कसिलो बनाउन सकिन्छ। Governments that invest in renewables … → Governments investing in renewables … / The report which was published last year … → The report published last year …

विद्यार्थीहरूले पहिलो पटक complex sentence लेख्न खोज्दा ३ वटा punctuation-का गल्ती देखिन्छन्। तीनै वटा एउटा clause कहाँ सकिन्छ र अर्को कहाँ सुरु हुन्छ भन्ने कुरा अझै महसुस नगर्दा हुन्छन्। दुई वटा independent clause जोड्ने ४ वटा सही तरिका छन्: full stop, semicolon, comma + coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS), वा subordinator प्रयोग गरेर एउटा clause-लाई dependent clause बनाउने। एक्लो comma कहिल्यै यीमध्ये पर्दैन।

गल्ती १ · Fragment (dependent clause-लाई एक्लै छोडिएको)।
✗ Because the weather was bad. The event was cancelled.
✓ Because the weather was bad, the event was cancelled.

गल्ती २ · Run-on (दुई clause, कुनै जोड बिना)।
✗ I studied hard I failed the exam.
✓ I studied hard, but I failed the exam.

गल्ती ३ · Comma splice (दुई clause केवल comma-ले जोडिएका)।
✗ Internet use rose rapidly, people spent more time online.
✓ Internet use rose rapidly, so people spent more time online.

आधिकारिक Band 7 descriptor-को phrase “a variety of complex structures” हो। यहाँ variety शब्द नै महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: केवल because clause मात्र भएको essay-ले, हरेक clause सही भए पनि, range देखाउँदैन। एउटा Task 2 essay भरि यी छरेर प्रयोग गर्ने लक्ष्य राख्नुहोस्: एउटा contrast clause (although), एउटा reason clause (since), एउटा conditional (if), र एक-दुई वटा relative clause।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (contrast + relative): While online learning widens access, it cannot fully replace the discipline that a classroom provides.
Task 2 (reason + condition): Because demand continues to rise, prices will keep climbing unless supply increases.
Speaking Part 3: People who grow up in cities often value convenience, whereas those from rural areas tend to prioritise community.
अध्याय ५ समाप्त। यसपछि अध्याय ६ (Passive Voice & Academic Detachment) आउँछ।

g05_complex_practice.title: 5. Practice · Complex Sentence र Subordinate Clause
g05_complex_practice.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: Simple sentence-ले तपाईंलाई Band 5 सम्म पुर्याउँछ। Complex sentence -- एउटा independent clause + एउटा dependent clause -- यही नै Band 7-को लेखाइले नियन्त्रणमा राखेर विविध रूपमा प्रयोग गर्छ। मुख्य २ वटा औजार सिक्नुहोस्: adverbial clause र relative clause।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Sentence-को विविधतालाई सिधै अंक दिइन्छ, र Band 5-6 को लेखाइबाट Band 7+ मा पुग्ने सबैभन्दा ठूलो एउटै उपाय complex sentence हो।
Cities offer jobs, but they are crowded.
Although cities offer jobs, they are crowded.

Band 5-को लेखाइमा प्रायः simple sentence मात्र हुन्छन्। Band 6-को लेखाइमा simple र compound मिसिएका हुन्छन्। **Band 7-को लेखाइले complex sentence नियन्त्रणमा राख्छ र तिनमा विविधता ल्याउँछ** -- adverbial clause (if/although/because) र relative clause (who/which/that) दुवै प्रयोग गरेर।

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Sentence जोड्ने अभ्यास
blocks.instructions: हरेक जोडी simple sentence-लाई bracket-मा दिइएको सम्बन्धअनुसार, relative clause वा adverbial clause प्रयोग गरेर एउटै complex sentence-मा जोड्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Public transport is cheap. Many people still drive. (contrast)
items.answer: Although public transport is cheap, many people still drive.
accepted: Although public transport is cheap, many people still drive.
items.reason: “although” प्रयोग गरेको contrast clause।

items.prompt: The lake dried up. Rainfall had declined for years. (reason)
items.answer: The lake dried up because rainfall had declined for years.
accepted: The lake dried up because rainfall had declined for years.
items.reason: “because” प्रयोग गरेको reason clause।

items.prompt: The company hired a manager. She had ten years of experience. (relative)
items.answer: The company hired a manager who had ten years of experience.
accepted: The company hired a manager who had ten years of experience.
items.reason: “who” प्रयोग गरेको relative clause।

items.prompt: Governments invest in education. Their economies tend to grow faster. (relative / condition)
items.answer: Governments that invest in education tend to see their economies grow faster.
accepted: Governments that invest in education tend to see their economies grow faster.
items.reason: Defining relative clause।

items.prompt: Fees rose sharply. Enrolment dropped. (time)
items.answer: Once fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.
accepted: Once fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.
When fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.
items.reason: “once” प्रयोग गरेको time clause।

items.prompt: The city built new cycle lanes. It wanted to cut congestion. (purpose)
items.answer: The city built new cycle lanes in order to cut congestion.
accepted: The city built new cycle lanes in order to cut congestion.
items.reason: “in order to” प्रयोग गरेर उद्देश्य (purpose)।

items.prompt: Renewable energy is expensive at first. It becomes cheaper over time. (contrast)
items.answer: Although renewable energy is expensive at first, it becomes cheaper over time.
accepted: Although renewable energy is expensive at first, it becomes cheaper over time.
items.reason: Contrast clause।

items.prompt: The report was published last year. It highlighted the housing crisis. (relative, non-defining)
items.answer: The report, which was published last year, highlighted the housing crisis.
accepted: The report, which was published last year, highlighted the housing crisis.
items.reason: Non-defining relative clause: comma चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Action is not taken soon. The situation will worsen. (condition)
items.answer: Unless action is taken soon, the situation will worsen.
accepted: Unless action is taken soon, the situation will worsen.
items.reason: “unless” प्रयोग गरेको condition clause।

items.prompt: Many families live in rural areas. They lack access to good hospitals. (relative)
items.answer: Many families who live in rural areas lack access to good hospitals.
accepted: Many families who live in rural areas lack access to good hospitals.
items.reason: Defining relative clause।

items.prompt: The policy was popular. It was eventually withdrawn. (contrast)
items.answer: Although the policy was popular, it was eventually withdrawn.
accepted: Although the policy was popular, it was eventually withdrawn.
items.reason: Contrast clause।

items.prompt: Solar power is clean. It is expanding rapidly. (relative, non-defining)
items.answer: Solar power, which is clean, is expanding rapidly.
accepted: Solar power, which is clean, is expanding rapidly.
items.reason: Non-defining relative clause: comma चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Demand outstripped supply. Prices rose sharply. (reason)
items.answer: Prices rose sharply because demand outstripped supply.
accepted: Prices rose sharply because demand outstripped supply.
items.reason: Reason clause।

items.prompt: Students study abroad. They gain independence and confidence. (relative)
items.answer: Students who study abroad gain independence and confidence.
accepted: Students who study abroad gain independence and confidence.
items.reason: Defining relative clause।

items.prompt: The factory closed in 1998. Hundreds of workers lost their jobs. (time / result)
items.answer: When the factory closed in 1998, hundreds of workers lost their jobs.
accepted: When the factory closed in 1998, hundreds of workers lost their jobs.
items.reason: Time clause।

items.prompt: Cities are crowded and expensive. Young workers often leave them. (reason)
items.answer: Because cities are crowded and expensive, young workers often leave them.
accepted: Because cities are crowded and expensive, young workers often leave them.
items.reason: Reason clause।

items.prompt: The government raises taxes. Public services can be funded properly. (purpose)
items.answer: The government raises taxes so that public services can be funded properly.
accepted: The government raises taxes so that public services can be funded properly.
items.reason: Purpose clause।

items.prompt: This is the town. I grew up there. (relative, place)
items.answer: This is the town where I grew up.
accepted: This is the town where I grew up.
items.reason: “where” प्रयोग गरेको ठाउँ जनाउने relative clause।

items.prompt: Technology keeps advancing. Many traditional jobs are disappearing. (concession)
items.answer: Even though technology keeps advancing, many traditional jobs are disappearing.
accepted: Even though technology keeps advancing, many traditional jobs are disappearing.
items.reason: Concession clause।

items.prompt: Some countries recycle most of their waste. Others send it to landfill. (contrast)
items.answer: While some countries recycle most of their waste, others send it to landfill.
accepted: While some countries recycle most of their waste, others send it to landfill.
items.reason: “while” प्रयोग गरेको contrast clause।

blocks: Defining र non-defining relative clause हेर्दा झन्डै उस्तै देखिन्छन् -- फरक केवल एक जोडी comma हो, तर त्यही punctuation-ले sentence-को अर्थ पूरै बदलिदिन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Relative clause-को यही भागले वास्तवमा अंक दिलाउँछ -- comma-हरू सजावट होइनन्, तिनले sentence-को अर्थ बदल्छन्।
**Defining clause** ले ठ्याक्कै कुन भनेर चिनाउँछ र यो अनिवार्य हुन्छ -- comma लाग्दैन: Students who cheat are expelled (cheat गर्नेहरू मात्र)।
**Non-defining clause** ले थप, अनावश्यक जानकारी दिन्छ, र दुवैतिर comma-ले घेरिन्छ: The students, who were tired, left early (सबै जना)।
**that** defining clause-मा मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Non-defining clause-मा **which** वा **who** प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् -- कहिल्यै that होइन।
Relative clause-पछि pronoun राखेर subject फेरि नदोहोर्याउनुहोस् (बंगाली भाषाको प्रभावले हुने निकै सामान्य गल्ती)।
Reduced relative clause-ले sentence-लाई अझ कसिलो बनाउँछ: governments that invest in renewables → governments investing in renewables।

blocks.title: Exercise 5.2 · Punctuation र Relative Clause सुधार
blocks.instructions: हरेक sentence-मा या त comma छुटेको छ, या relative pronoun छुटेको छ, या punctuation-को गल्ती छ। हरेकलाई सही बनाएर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The city which is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
items.answer: The city that is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
accepted: The city that is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
The city which is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
items.reason: Defining clause: comma चाहिँदैन। “which” पनि स्वीकार्य छ।

items.prompt: My brother who lives in Canada is an engineer. (I have only one brother.)
items.answer: My brother, who lives in Canada, is an engineer.
accepted: My brother, who lives in Canada, is an engineer.
items.reason: दाजुभाइ एक जना मात्र, त्यसैले clause non-defining हो: comma चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Students who cheat in exams they are usually expelled.
items.answer: Students who cheat in exams are usually expelled.
accepted: Students who cheat in exams are usually expelled.
items.reason: दोहोरिएको subject “they” हटाउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: The report was clear, it recommended three changes.
items.answer: The report was clear; it recommended three changes.
accepted: The report was clear; it recommended three changes.
The report was clear. It recommended three changes.
items.reason: Semicolon वा full stop प्रयोग गरेर comma splice सच्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: Although the policy was expensive. It reduced accidents significantly.
items.answer: Although the policy was expensive, it reduced accidents significantly.
accepted: Although the policy was expensive, it reduced accidents significantly.
items.reason: Fragment-लाई comma-ले main clause-सँग जोड्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Solar power which is renewable is becoming cheaper.
items.answer: Solar power, which is renewable, is becoming cheaper.
accepted: Solar power, which is renewable, is becoming cheaper.
items.reason: Non-defining: दुवैतिर comma।

items.prompt: People which live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.
items.answer: People who live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.
accepted: People who live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.
items.reason: मानिसका लागि “who”, “which” होइन।

items.prompt: Governments that invest in transport, tend to see lower long-term costs.
items.answer: Governments that invest in transport tend to see lower long-term costs.
accepted: Governments that invest in transport tend to see lower long-term costs.
items.reason: Defining clause: अनावश्यक comma हटाउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: The scheme was popular, however it was cancelled after two years.
items.answer: The scheme was popular; however, it was cancelled after two years.
accepted: The scheme was popular; however, it was cancelled after two years.
items.reason: “however” ले केवल comma-को भरमा दुई clause जोड्न सक्दैन; semicolon प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The teacher whose class I attended last year has now retired.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The teacher whose class I attended last year has now retired.
items.reason: स्वामित्व जनाउन “whose”; sentence पहिले नै सही बनेको छ।

items.prompt: Because the weather was extremely bad. The outdoor event was postponed.
items.answer: Because the weather was extremely bad, the outdoor event was postponed.
accepted: Because the weather was extremely bad, the outdoor event was postponed.
items.reason: Fragment-लाई जोड्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Dhaka which is the capital of Bangladesh is extremely crowded.
items.answer: Dhaka, which is the capital of Bangladesh, is extremely crowded.
accepted: Dhaka, which is the capital of Bangladesh, is extremely crowded.
items.reason: Non-defining: ठाउँ एउटै मात्र छ, त्यसैले comma।

items.prompt: The students were tired they left the lecture early.
items.answer: The students were tired, so they left the lecture early.
accepted: The students were tired, so they left the lecture early.
items.reason: “so” प्रयोग गरेर comma splice / run-on सच्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: This is the hospital where my mother she works.
items.answer: This is the hospital where my mother works.
accepted: This is the hospital where my mother works.
items.reason: दोहोरिएको subject “she” हटाउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: The company hired a candidate that qualifications were outstanding.
items.answer: The company hired a candidate whose qualifications were outstanding.
accepted: The company hired a candidate whose qualifications were outstanding.
items.reason: स्वामित्व जनाउन “whose” चाहिन्छ, “that” होइन।

g06_passive.title: 6. Passive Voice र Academic तटस्थता
g06_passive.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: तपाईंलाई चाहिने हरेक tense-मा passive, passive कहिले रोज्ने, academic तटस्थताका लागि impersonal “It is …” ढाँचाहरू, र दुई वटा मुख्य trap: गलत participle र धेरै प्रयोग।

Passive voice ले कामको object-लाई sentence-को subject बनाइदिन्छ, त्यसैले ध्यान “कसले गर्‍यो” मा होइन, “के भयो” मा पर्छ। Academic writing-लाई formal र impersonal tone दिने दुई-तीन वटा structure मध्ये यो एउटा हो, र IELTS-का २ वटा खास ठाउँमा यो अनिवार्य छ: Task 1 process diagram, जुन लगभग पूरै passive-मा लेखिन्छ, र Task 2 essay, जहाँ व्यक्तिगत register भन्दा impersonal register बढी objective सुनिन्छ। राम्रोसँग प्रयोग गर्दा passive ले तपाईंको tone माथि उठाउँछ; जताततै प्रयोग गर्दा लेखाइ भारी र जिम्मेवारी पन्छाउने जस्तो लाग्छ।

एउटै घटनाको वर्णन गर्ने दुई वटा sentence तुलना गर्नुहोस्: Active: Workers transport the materials. (subject = workers, काम गर्ने) / Passive: The materials are transported (by workers). (subject = materials, जसमाथि काम हुन्छ)

Active voice-मा subject आफैँ काम गर्छ। Passive voice-मा subject-माथि काम हुन्छ, र काम गर्ने (doer) या त हराउँछ, या अन्त्यमा by लगाएर थपिन्छ। Formula कहिल्यै बदलिँदैन: active sentence-को object + be-को एउटा form + past participle (+ by + doer)। be-को सही form (जसले tense बोक्छ) र past participle ठीक भयो भने passive ठीक हुन्छ।
Tense be भागमा हुन्छ; past participle उस्तै रहन्छ। यो table-ले तपाईंलाई साँच्चै चाहिने tense-हरूको रूपान्तर देखाउँछ।
Pattern ध्यान दिनुहोस्: tense जुनसुकै होस्, अन्त्यमा सधैँ past participle (transported) आउँछ, र त्यसको अगाडिको be form बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ।
Passive खास परिस्थितिका लागि एउटा औजार हो, सधैँको बानी होइन। यसलाई यस्तो बेला प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्:
Doer थाहा छैन, प्रस्ट छ, वा महत्त्वपूर्ण छैन। New traffic laws were introduced in 2019. (कसले ल्यायो भन्ने प्रस्टै छ)।
तपाईं objective, impersonal tone चाहनुहुन्छ। It is widely believed that education reduces poverty. (“Many people believe …” भन्दा बढी academic)
तपाईं कुनै process वर्णन गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ। First, the raw beans are harvested. They are then dried, roasted, and ground before the coffee is packaged.
Passive-को एउटा खास र धेरै काम लाग्ने प्रयोग भनेको सामान्य दाबीबाट “I” र “people” हटाउनु हो, जसले लेखाइलाई बढी objective सुनाउँछ। यी ढाँचाहरू सिक्नुहोस्:
People say that tourism harms the coast.
It is said that tourism harms the coast.
Past participle ठीक राख्नुहोस्, र धेरै प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्

Passive-मा verb-को तेस्रो form चाहिन्छ, base form वा past simple होइन। बंगलादेशी विद्यार्थीहरू प्रायः participle-को अन्त्य छुटाउँछन्। Irregular past participle कण्ठ गर्नै पर्छ (Appendix A हेर्नुहोस्): build/built, write/written, take/taken, give/given, show/shown। साथै, passive धेरै प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्: पूरै essay passive-मा लेख्दा कडा र अस्वाभाविक सुनिन्छ, र जिम्मेवार को हो भन्ने कुरा लुकाउन सक्छ। Task 2-मा passive र active मिसाएर लेख्नुहोस्।

Trap १ · Past participle छैन वा गलत छ।
✗ The materials are transport to the site. / The bridge was build in 1990. / The report was wrote by the committee.
✓ The materials are transported to the site. / The bridge was built in 1990. / The report was written by the committee.

Trap २ · Passive-को धेरै प्रयोग। Passive-को ठाउँ मुख्यतः Task 1 process र impersonal सामान्य दाबीमा हो; तपाईंका argument र विचार प्रायः active-मा बढी प्रस्ट हुन्छन्।
✗ (पूरै essay passive-मा)
✓ (passive र active मिसाएर; argument active-मा)

सबैभन्दा प्रस्ट उदाहरण Writing Task 1 का process diagram हुन्: हरेक चरणको doer अप्रासंगिक भएकाले पूरै वर्णन passive present simple-मा चल्छ। Active-मै लेखिएको process उत्तर बालकजस्तो सुनिन्छ; यहाँ passive नै अपेक्षित हुन्छ। Writing Task 2-मा passive अझ छानेर प्रयोग हुन्छ, सामान्य भनाइको impersonal tone-का लागि। आफ्नै argument-का लागि active-सँग मिसाएर प्रयोग गर्दा examiner-ले तपाईं register नियन्त्रण गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्ने देख्छन्।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1 process: Once the cocoa pods have been harvested, the beans are removed, fermented, and left to dry in the sun.
Task 2 impersonal: It is often argued that stricter regulation is needed, although the costs are frequently underestimated.
Speaking Part 3: A lot is being done to improve recycling, but more could be achieved with better public awareness.
अध्याय ६ सकियो। अब अध्याय ७ (Conditionals, Hedging & Hypothetical Reasoning) आउँछ।

g06_passive_practice.title: 6. Practice · Passive Voice र Academic तटस्थता
g06_passive_practice.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: Tense जुनसुकै होस्, passive सधैँ past participle मा टुंगिन्छ -- त्यसको अगाडिको 'be' form मात्र बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ। यो एउटै pattern सिक्नुभयो भने तपाईं जुनसुकै active sentence रूपान्तर गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Passive हरेक tense-मा आउँछ, र IELTS Task 1 र academic writing यसमा निरन्तर भर पर्छन् -- त्यसैले रूपान्तर आफैँ आउने (automatic) हुनुपर्छ।
Tense **be** भागमा हुन्छ; past participle उस्तै रहन्छ।
Present simple: Workers transport the goods. → The goods are transported.
Present continuous: Workers are transporting the goods. → The goods are being transported.
Past simple: Workers transported the goods. → The goods were transported.
नबदलिने कुरा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: tense जुनसुकै होस्, अन्त्यमा सधैँ past participle (transported) आउँछ, र त्यसको अगाडिको be form मात्र बदलिएर समय देखाउँछ।

blocks.title: Exercise 6.1 · Active बाट Passive-मा रूपान्तर
blocks.instructions: हरेक active sentence-लाई उही tense राखेर passive voice-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। Doer प्रस्ट छ भने हटाउनुहोस्, र अर्थ थप्छ भने “by” लगाएर राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Farmers harvest the crop in October.
items.answer: The crop is harvested in October.
accepted: The crop is harvested in October.
The crop is harvested by farmers in October.
items.reason: Present simple।

items.prompt: The council will build a new bridge next year.
items.answer: A new bridge will be built next year.
accepted: A new bridge will be built next year.
items.reason: Future।

items.prompt: The committee wrote the report.
items.answer: The report was written by the committee.
accepted: The report was written by the committee.
items.reason: Past simple; participle “written”।

items.prompt: Workers are repairing the road at the moment.
items.answer: The road is being repaired at the moment.
accepted: The road is being repaired at the moment.
items.reason: Present continuous।

items.prompt: People have wasted a great deal of water.
items.answer: A great deal of water has been wasted.
accepted: A great deal of water has been wasted.
items.reason: Present perfect।

items.prompt: The government introduced new laws in 2019.
items.answer: New laws were introduced in 2019.
accepted: New laws were introduced in 2019.
items.reason: Past simple।

items.prompt: Someone must clean the equipment after every use.
items.answer: The equipment must be cleaned after every use.
accepted: The equipment must be cleaned after every use.
items.reason: Modal।

items.prompt: Machines process the raw materials.
items.answer: The raw materials are processed.
accepted: The raw materials are processed.
The raw materials are processed by machines.
items.reason: Present simple।

items.prompt: They had completed the survey before the deadline.
items.answer: The survey had been completed before the deadline.
accepted: The survey had been completed before the deadline.
items.reason: Past perfect।

items.prompt: Volunteers are planting thousands of trees this year.
items.answer: Thousands of trees are being planted this year.
accepted: Thousands of trees are being planted this year.
items.reason: Present continuous।

items.prompt: The factory produces two thousand cars a day.
items.answer: Two thousand cars are produced a day.
accepted: Two thousand cars are produced a day.
items.reason: Present simple।

items.prompt: A famous architect designed the building.
items.answer: The building was designed by a famous architect.
accepted: The building was designed by a famous architect.
items.reason: “by” phrase-ले साँच्चैको जानकारी थपिरहेको छ, त्यसैले यसलाई राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The authorities should encourage recycling.
items.answer: Recycling should be encouraged.
accepted: Recycling should be encouraged.
Recycling should be encouraged by the authorities.
items.reason: Modal।

items.prompt: Engineers are testing the new system.
items.answer: The new system is being tested.
accepted: The new system is being tested.
items.reason: Present continuous।

items.prompt: People believe that tourism damages the environment. (use the impersonal “It is …”)
items.answer: It is believed that tourism damages the environment.
accepted: It is believed that tourism damages the environment.
items.reason: Impersonal passive।

blocks: Passive सधैँको बानी होइन -- यो ३ वटा खास परिस्थितिका लागि औजार हो: doer थाहा नभएको वा प्रस्ट भएको बेला, objective tone चाहिँदा, र कुनै process वर्णन गर्दा। Process diagram ठ्याक्कै यही तेस्रो अवस्था हो।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Process-diagram भएको Task 1 passive बिना स्वाभाविक रूपमा लेख्नै लगभग असम्भव छ, किनकि चरणहरू कसले गर्छ भन्दा चरणहरू नै बढी महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छन्।
**Doer थाहा छैन, प्रस्ट छ, वा महत्त्वपूर्ण छैन**: New traffic laws were introduced in 2019 (कसले ल्यायो भन्ने प्रस्टै छ)।
तपाईं **objective, impersonal tone** चाहनुहुन्छ: It is widely believed that education reduces poverty ("many people believe" भन्दा बढी academic)।
तपाईं **कुनै process वर्णन गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ** -- चरणहरूको एउटा क्रम, जहाँ ध्यान विभिन्न चरण पार गर्दै जाने सामग्री वा उत्पादनमा हुन्छ, काम गर्ने मानिसहरूमा होइन।
खासगरी process diagram-मा हरेक चरण passive-मा र एउटै tense-मा (प्रायः present simple) राख्नुहोस्, ताकि क्रम कामदारहरूको कथा जस्तो नभई एउटा system जस्तो पढियोस्।

blocks.title: Exercise 6.2 · Process Diagram लेखाइ
blocks.instructions: सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म passive present simple र उपयुक्त sequencing word (first, then, next, after that, once, finally) प्रयोग गरेर करिब १५० शब्दको एउटा paragraph लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Write one paragraph of about 150 words describing how glass bottles are recycled, using the passive present simple throughout and sequencing words. Stages: used glass bottles collected from homes and bins; transported to a recycling plant; sorted by colour; washed to remove labels and dirt; crushed into small pieces called cullet; melted in a furnace at very high temperature; moulded into new bottles; new bottles filled, labelled, and sent to shops.
items.answer: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
accepted: The diagram illustrates the process by which used glass bottles are recycled into new ones. First, used bottles are collected from homes and public bins, after which they are transported to a recycling plant. On arrival, the glass is sorted by colour into clear, green, and brown, and it is then washed thoroughly so that labels and dirt are removed. Next, the clean glass is crushed into small fragments known as cullet. Once this stage is complete, the cullet is melted in a furnace at an extremely high temperature until it becomes liquid. The molten glass is then moulded into the shape of new bottles. Finally, the finished bottles are filled, labelled, and sent to shops, where the cycle can begin again.
items.reason: हरेक चरण passive present simple-मा छ (are collected, is sorted, is melted, are sent), किनकि doer अप्रासंगिक छ; क्रम देखाउने शब्दहरूले (first, then, next, once, finally) क्रमलाई जोडेर राखेका छन्; र tense सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म एउटै रहेको छ।

g07_conditionals.title: 7. Conditionals, Hedging र Hypothetical Reasoning
g07_conditionals.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-को रूपमा चार वटा conditional, Task 2-मा सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण first कि second भन्ने छनोट, conditional-का धेरैजसो गल्ती हटाउने एउटै नियम, र academic सावधानीका लागि hedging-को toolkit।

Conditional प्रयोग गरेर तपाईं सम्भावनाबारे तर्क गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ: कुनै कुरा सत्य भयो भने के हुन्छ, सत्य भएको भए के हुन्थ्यो, र विगत फरक भएको भए के हुने थियो। यो परिणाम (consequence) र अनुमान (hypothesis)-को grammar हो, र Task 2-मा यसको भूमिका मुख्य छ - किनकि त्यहाँ लगभग हरेक तर्क वास्तवमा लुकेको conditional नै हो: सरकारले X गर्‍यो भने Y हुनेछ। Conditional-को साथमा hedging पनि आउँछ, अर्थात् सावधानीको भाषा (may, tend to, it is likely that)। यसले तपाईंका दाबीलाई पूर्ण वा एकतर्फी सुनिन दिँदैन, र लेखनलाई नापिएको र academic बनाउँछ।

हरेक conditional-मा एउटा if-clause (शर्त) र एउटा main clause (नतिजा) हुन्छ। यिनको क्रम जस्तो पनि हुन सक्छ; if-clause पहिले आयो भने त्यसपछि comma राखिन्छ। If demand rises, prices increase. = Prices increase if demand rises. चार वटा standard conditional-बीचको फरक यी दुई clause-को tense pattern-मा मात्र हुन्छ, र हरेकले वास्तविकताको फरक मात्रा देखाउँछ।
If you heat ice, it melts.
If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
अवास्तविक वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो वर्तमान/भविष्य
If I were rich, I would fund schools.
If they had invested, the crisis would have been avoided.

Table-लाई वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-को रूपमा पढ्नुहोस्: zero सधैँ सत्य हुन्छ, first वास्तवमै सम्भव हुन्छ, second कल्पना गरिएको वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो हुन्छ, र third अहिले असम्भव हुन्छ, किनकि त्यो समय बितिसकेको छ। सही conditional छान्नु भनेको तपाईं आफ्नो दाबीलाई कति वास्तविक सुनाउन चाहनुहुन्छ भन्ने छान्नु हो।
Second conditional-मा “were” बारे एउटा कुरा: formal English-मा सबै subject-सँग were प्रयोग हुन्छ (“If the government were to act …”), र Writing-मा यही सुरक्षित छनोट हो।
7.3 First कि second: Task 2-मा सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण छनोट
तपाईंका conditional-सम्बन्धी धेरैजसो गल्ती र छनोट अन्त्यमा first कि second भन्ने प्रश्नमै आएर टुङ्गिन्छन्, त्यसैले यो जोडीको राम्रोसँग अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्।
तपाईंले साँच्चै सम्भव ठान्नुभएको वास्तविक प्रस्तावका लागि first conditional प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। If the government invests in public transport, congestion will decrease.
Hypothetical कुरा वा कल्पनाको रूपमा राखिएको सुझावका लागि second conditional प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। If every citizen planted a tree, the city would be greener.
If the government will raise taxes, spending falls.
If the government raises taxes, spending will fall.
First conditional-को if-clause-मा present simple आउँछ, कहिल्यै “will” आउँदैन।
If I would be in charge, I would ban cars.
If I were in charge, I would ban cars.
Second conditional-को if-clause-मा past simple / “were” आउँछ, कहिल्यै “would” आउँदैन।
Conditional-का धेरैजसो गल्ती हटाउने एउटै नियम

If-clause-मा कहिल्यै “will” वा “would” नराख्नुहोस्। “Will” र “would”-को ठाउँ result clause-मा मात्र हो। If-clause-लाई simple/past tense-मा राख्नुहोस् - एकै चालमा conditional-को सबैभन्दा common गल्ती हट्छ।
दुई वटा advanced तरिका स्वाभाविक रूपमा मिल्दा तपाईंको range बढाउँछन्:
Mixed conditional: विगतको शर्त, वर्तमानको नतिजा। If they had planned better (past), the city would not be so congested now (present).
Inverted conditional (formal, “if” हट्छ): Had the government acted sooner, the crisis would have been avoided. = If the government had acted sooner … (Inversion पूरा रूपमा Chapter 8-मा पढ्नुहुनेछ।)
यिनलाई एक पटक, सही तरिकाले, प्रभाव पार्नका लागि प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। जबरजस्ती घुसाइएको mixed conditional सफा standard conditional भन्दा नराम्रो हुन्छ।

Hedging भनेको कुनै दाबीलाई नरम बनाउनु हो, ताकि त्यो पूर्ण (absolute) statement नहोस्। Band 5-को लेखन बढाइचढाइ गरिएका दाबीले भरिएको हुन्छ (always, never, everyone, will definitely)। Band 8-को लेखनले आफ्ना दाबीलाई सीमित गर्छ, र अचम्मको कुरा, यसले ती दाबी झन् विश्वसनीय र academic सुनिन्छन्। तपाईंको लेखनको tone-लाई परिपक्व बनाउने यो सबैभन्दा छिटो तरिकामध्ये एक हो।
tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to
often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively
it is likely that, it appears that, there is a tendency for
many, some, a significant number of, the majority of
Junk food always causes obesity and will destroy public health.
Excessive consumption of junk food may contribute to obesity and could place a strain on public health.
“always causes” र “will destroy” बढाइचढाइ गरिएका छन्; “may contribute” र “could place a strain” नापिएका छन्।

Hedging कमजोरी वा अस्पष्टता होइन। यो तपाईं कति निश्चित हुनुहुन्छ भन्नेबारे सटीकता हो। “Immigration boosts the economy” यस्तो दाबी हो जुन तपाईं पूरै प्रमाणित गर्न सक्नुहुन्न; “Immigration can boost the economy” यस्तो दाबी हो जसको तपाईं बचाउ (defend) गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।

दुई किसिमका गल्ती सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिन्छन्। पहिलो, conditional-मा tense चुहिनु (if-clause-मा will/would राख्नु)। दोस्रो, एकतर्फी पूर्ण दाबी लेख्ने बानी, जुन आंशिक रूपमा बंगाली निबन्ध शैलीमा चलेको बलियो दाबी गर्ने प्रवृत्तिबाट आउँछ।

गल्तीको प्रकार १ · if-clause-मा “will/would”।
✗ If the price will increase, demand will fall. / If governments would ban plastic, pollution would drop.
✓ If the price increases, demand will fall. / If governments banned plastic, pollution would drop.

गल्तीको प्रकार २ · सीमा नतोकिएका पूर्ण दाबी।
✗ Technology always improves our lives. / Every student prefers online classes.
✓ Technology generally improves our lives. / Many students appear to prefer online classes.
Conditional र hedging मिलेर Task 2-को परिपक्वता तय हुन्छ

Task 2-ले दुई कुरालाई पुरस्कृत गर्छ, र यो chapter-ले ती दुवै दिन्छ। Conditional-ले तपाईंलाई परिणामबारे तर्क गर्ने ढाँचा दिन्छ (“if this policy is adopted, then …”), जुन body paragraph-को मेरुदण्ड हो। Hedging-ले ती तर्कलाई कट्टर होइन, सोचविचार गरिएको सुनाउने tone दिन्छ। जुन script-मा सही second conditional र ठीक ठाउँमा राखिएको hedging सँगै हुन्छ, त्यो स्पष्ट रूपमा Band 7-plus जस्तो पढिन्छ, किनकि यसले grammatical range र rhetorical control दुवै देखाउँछ।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (first conditional): If governments subsidise clean energy, the transition away from fossil fuels is likely to accelerate.
Task 2 (second + hedge): If education were entirely free, access might improve, though the burden on public finances would probably be considerable.
Speaking Part 3: It tends to depend on the context, but on the whole I'd say technology has made communication easier.
Chapter 7, र Module 2 यहीँ सकियो। अब Module 3 (Band 9.0 Masterclass), Chapter 8।

g07_conditionals_practice.title: 7. Practice · Conditionals, Hedging र Hypothetical Reasoning
g07_conditionals_practice.group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: चार वटा conditional वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-मा मिलाइएका छन् - सधैँ-सत्यदेखि अब-सम्भव-छैनसम्म। सही conditional छान्नु भनेको तपाईंको दाबी कति वास्तविक सुनियोस् भन्ने छान्नु हो -- यसमा गल्ती भयो भने साँच्चैको सम्भावना पनि कोरा कल्पनाजस्तो सुनिन्छ, वा उल्टो।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** कुन conditional छान्नुहुन्छ भन्ने कुराले कुनै दाबीमा तपाईं कति विश्वस्त हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने देखाउँछ, र Task 2-को तर्कमा यो धेरै ठूलो कुरा हो।
वास्तविकताको scale-को रूपमा चार वटा conditional
**Zero** -- सामान्य सत्य / वैज्ञानिक तथ्य: If you heat ice, it melts.
**First** -- भविष्यको वास्तविक, हुन सक्ने सम्भावना: If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
**Second** -- कल्पना गरिएको वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो: hypothetical वर्तमान/भविष्य।
**Third** -- अहिले असम्भव, किनकि त्यो समय बितिसकेको छ।
Scale-लाई क्रमैसँग पढ्नुहोस्: zero सधैँ सत्य, first वास्तवमै सम्भव, second कल्पना गरिएको, third असम्भव।
Formal English-मा second conditional-मा सबै subject-सँग **were** प्रयोग हुन्छ -- If the government were to act... -- र Writing-मा यही सुरक्षित छनोट हो।

blocks.title: Exercise 7.1 · Conditional फेरि लेख्ने
blocks.instructions: कोष्ठकभित्रको verb-लाई चाहिएको conditional अनुसार सही form-मा राख्नुहोस्, वा निर्देशनअनुसार वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। If-clause-मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: त्यहाँ “will” वा “would” हुँदैन।

items.prompt: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ______ (boil).
items.answer: boils
accepted: boils
items.reason: Zero conditional: सामान्य सत्य, दुवै clause-मा present simple।

items.prompt: If the government reduces tuition fees, more students ______ (enrol).
items.answer: will enrol
accepted: will enrol
items.reason: First conditional: भविष्यको वास्तविक सम्भावना।

items.prompt: If I ______ (be) the mayor, I would ban private cars in the centre.
items.answer: were
accepted: were
items.reason: Second conditional: hypothetical कुराका लागि “were”।

items.prompt: If they had listened to the experts, the disaster ______ (avoid).
items.answer: would have been avoided
accepted: would have been avoided
items.reason: Third conditional: past perfect + would have + past participle (passive)।

items.prompt: If the price of oil rises, transport costs ______ (increase).
items.answer: will increase
accepted: will increase
items.reason: First conditional।

items.prompt: If people recycled more, landfill sites ______ (fill) up less quickly.
items.answer: would fill
accepted: would fill
items.reason: Second conditional।

items.prompt: If the company had invested in training, its staff ______ (be) more productive today. (mixed)
items.answer: would be
accepted: would be
items.reason: Mixed conditional: विगतको शर्त, वर्तमानको नतिजा।

items.prompt: Ice melts if the temperature ______ (rise) above zero.
items.answer: rises
accepted: rises
items.reason: Zero conditional।

items.prompt: If more people ______ (use) public transport, the air would be cleaner.
items.answer: used
accepted: used
items.reason: Second conditional: if-clause-मा past simple।

items.prompt: If the trend continues, sea levels ______ (rise) by a metre this century.
items.answer: will rise
accepted: will rise
items.reason: First conditional: वास्तविक लाग्ने भविष्यवाणी।

items.prompt: If governments ______ (act) sooner, many species would not have become extinct.
items.answer: had acted
accepted: had acted
items.reason: Third conditional: if-clause-मा past perfect।

items.prompt: If I were you, I ______ (choose) the science course.
items.answer: would choose
accepted: would choose
items.reason: Second conditional: सल्लाह दिँदा।

items.prompt: Rewrite as an inverted conditional: If the authorities had responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.answer: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
accepted: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.reason: Inverted third conditional: “if” हटाउनुहोस्, “had”-लाई अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: If children ______ (not / get) enough sleep, their concentration suffers.
items.answer: do not get
accepted: do not get
don't get
items.reason: Zero conditional: एउटा सामान्य सत्य।

items.prompt: If renewable energy became cheaper, developing countries ______ (adopt) it faster.
items.answer: would adopt
accepted: would adopt
items.reason: Second conditional।

blocks: Band 5-को लेखन पूर्ण दाबीले भरिएको हुन्छ -- always, never, everyone। Band 8-को लेखनले modal र tendency verb प्रयोग गरेर दाबीलाई hedge गर्छ, र अचम्मको कुरा, यसले दाबी झन् विश्वसनीय सुनिन्छ, कम आत्मविश्वासी होइन।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** Band 6-7-को लेखनबाट Band 8-को लेखनमा पुग्ने सबैभन्दा छिटो र सजिलै सिक्न सकिने upgrade-मध्ये एक hedging हो -- यो toolkit हो, जन्मजात प्रतिभा होइन।

Hedging-ले दाबीलाई नरम बनाउँछ, ताकि त्यो पूर्ण (absolute) statement नहोस्। "Immigration boosts the economy" यस्तो दाबी हो जुन तपाईं पूरै प्रमाणित गर्न सक्नुहुन्न; "Immigration can boost the economy" यस्तो दाबी हो जसको तपाईं बचाउ (defend) गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
**सम्भावना देखाउने modal verb:** may, might, could, can।
**प्रवृत्ति (tendency) देखाउने verb:** tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to।
**Frequency/degree देखाउने adverb:** often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively।
**व्यक्ति नतोकिएका (impersonal) frame:** it is often argued that, it could be said that।
Hedging कमजोरी वा अस्पष्टता होइन -- यो तपाईं वास्तवमा कति निश्चित हुनुहुन्छ भन्नेबारे सटीकता हो।

blocks.title: Exercise 7.2 · Hedging Upgrade अभ्यास
blocks.instructions: हरेक वाक्यमा दाबी बढाइचढाइ गरिएको छ। उपयुक्त hedging प्रयोग गरेर वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, ताकि यो नापिएको र academic सुनियोस्।

items.prompt: Fast food always causes serious health problems.
items.answer: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
accepted: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
Fast food may cause serious health problems.
Fast food often causes serious health problems.
items.reason: पूर्ण दाबी “always causes”-लाई नरम बनाउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: Everyone agrees that social media is harmful.
items.answer: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
accepted: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
It is often argued that social media can be harmful.
items.reason: सबैलाई समेट्ने “everyone … is”-को सट्टा hedged दाबी राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Immigration will definitely boost the economy.
items.answer: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
accepted: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
Immigration can boost the economy.
items.reason: “will definitely”-को सट्टा “is likely to” राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Students who study abroad always become more independent.
items.answer: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.
accepted: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.
items.reason: “always” → “tend to”।

items.prompt: Technology never has any negative effects.
items.answer: Technology does not always have negative effects.
accepted: Technology does not always have negative effects.
Technology rarely has serious negative effects.
items.reason: एकतर्फी “never”-लाई नरम बनाउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: All young people prefer texting to phone calls.
items.answer: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
accepted: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
Many young people seem to prefer texting to phone calls.
items.reason: “all … prefer”-को सट्टा quantifier + hedge राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Higher taxes will completely solve the problem of pollution.
items.answer: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
accepted: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
Higher taxes could help to reduce pollution.
items.reason: “will completely solve” बढाइचढाइ गरिएको छ।

items.prompt: Every developed country has excellent public services.
items.answer: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.
accepted: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.
items.reason: “every … excellent” → hedged।

items.prompt: Working from home is always more productive than working in an office.
items.answer: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.
accepted: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.
items.reason: “always” → “can be”।

items.prompt: Tourism completely destroys local culture.
items.answer: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
accepted: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
Tourism can erode local culture to some extent.
items.reason: “completely destroys”-लाई नरम बनाउनुहोस्।

g08_inversion.title: 8. Inversion, Cleft Sentence र Advanced Emphasis
blocks: उच्च band-का दुर्लभ emphasis structure-हरू: question word order प्रयोग गरेर बनाइने negative-adverbial inversion, it-cleft र what-cleft, अनि धेरै होइन, एउटा मात्र - शुद्ध रूपमा - प्रयोग गर्ने अनुशासन।

Band 9 masterclass-मा तपाईंलाई स्वागत छ। अबदेखिको सबै कुरा गल्ती सुधार्ने बारेमा होइन, शुद्धता र परिष्कारको बारेमा हो। यो module-का structure-हरू धेरै दक्ष प्रयोगकर्ताको लेखाइमा स्वाभाविक रूपमा आउँछन्: यी दुर्लभ हुन्छन्, यिनले जोड (emphasis) दिन्छन्, र यिनलाई थोरै र शुद्ध रूपमा प्रयोग गर्नुपर्छ। ठीक ठाउँमा राखिएको एउटा inversion-ले दक्षता देखाउँछ; जबरजस्ती राखिएका तीनवटाले candidate-ले एउटा trick घोकेको देखाउँछ। संख्या होइन, गुणस्तर र नियन्त्रण - Module 3-को पूरै सन्देश यही हो।

Inversion भनेको subject-verb-को सामान्य क्रम उल्टाउनु हो, ताकि verb (वा auxiliary) subject-भन्दा अगाडि आओस् - यो pattern सामान्यतया प्रश्नमा मात्र देखिन्छ। Statement-मा हामी यो जोड दिनका लागि जानीजानी गर्छौं, प्रायः कुनै negative वा सीमित गर्ने expression-लाई वाक्यको सुरुमा ल्याएर। यस्तो expression सुरुमा आएपछि subject र auxiliary-ले ठाउँ साट्छन्। सामान्य: The government has rarely intervened. / Inverted: Rarely has the government intervened.

तरिका ठ्याक्कै प्रश्न बनाउने तरिका नै हो: negative adverbial-लाई अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, अनि question word order (auxiliary + subject) प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Auxiliary छैन भने प्रश्नमा जस्तै do / does / did ल्याउनुहोस्। सामान्य: The minister realised the scale of the problem only later. / Inverted: Only later did the minister realise the scale of the problem.
8.2 Trigger expression-हरू (यिनलाई एउटा set-को रूपमा सिक्नुहोस्)
यी negative वा सीमित गर्ने adverbial-मध्ये कुनै एउटालाई अगाडि ल्याउँदा inversion सुरु हुन्छ। यो set घोक्नुहोस्; यिनै प्रवेशको टिकट हुन्।
Never before has the country faced such a crisis.
Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.
Not only does it cut costs, but it also saves time.
No sooner had the policy begun than it was criticised.
Hardly had the scheme started when problems emerged.
Only after / Only when / Only by
Only by investing heavily can the goal be achieved.
Under no circumstances should this be ignored.
Little did they know how costly it would be.
Not until 2015 did the figures begin to recover.
Negative र सीमित गर्ने inversion trigger-हरू
8.3 Inverted sentence चरणबद्ध रूपमा कसरी बनाउने
सामान्य वाक्यबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्: The government has seldom acted so quickly.
Trigger छान्नुहोस् र त्यसलाई अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्: Seldom …
Question word order लागू गर्नुहोस् (subject-भन्दा अगाडि auxiliary): Seldom has the government …
वाक्य पूरा गर्नुहोस्: Seldom has the government acted so quickly.

मूल वाक्यमा auxiliary छैन भने do / does / did थप्नुहोस् र main verb-लाई base form-मा फर्काउनुहोस्, ठ्याक्कै प्रश्न बनाउँदा जस्तै। The committee only later understood the risk. → Only later did the committee understand the risk. (“understood” होइन)
8.4 Cleft sentence: जोड दिन वाक्य टुक्र्याउने

Cleft sentence (“cleave” बाट, अर्थात् टुक्र्याउनु) ले एउटा idea-लाई दुईवटा clause-मा बाँड्छ, ताकि एउटा भागमा प्रकाश पार्न सकियोस्। यो inversion-भन्दा नरम र धेरै प्रचलित emphasis tool हो, र Writing र Speaking दुवैमा निकै स्वाभाविक हुन्छ। यसका मुख्य २ वटा pattern छन्।
बनावट: It + is/was + जोड दिइएको भाग + that/who + बाँकी भाग। सामान्य: The lack of funding caused the failure. / Cleft: It was the lack of funding that caused the failure. (कारणमा प्रकाश)
बनावट: What + clause + is/was + जोड दिइएको भाग। सामान्य: We need better public transport. / Cleft: What we need is better public transport. (समाधानमा प्रकाश)
Essay वा Speaking-को उत्तरमा कुनै point जोडदार रूपमा सुरु गर्न what-cleft विशेष गरी उपयोगी हुन्छ: What many governments overlook is the long-term cost of inaction.
Agreement नबिगार्नुहोस्, धेरै प्रयोग पनि नगर्नुहोस्
यी structure-हरूको खतरा अवधारणामा होइन, प्रयोगमा हुन्छ। २ वटा गल्ती बारम्बार देखिन्छन्।

गल्ती १ · Trigger-पछि question word order बिर्सनु। Subject र auxiliary-ले ठाउँ साट्नैपर्छ; सामान्य क्रम राख्दा inversion रद्द हुन्छ।
✗ Never before the country has faced such a crisis. / Rarely politicians admit their mistakes.
✓ Never before has the country faced such a crisis. / Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.

गल्ती २ · धेरै प्रयोग। एउटै उत्तरमा धेरै inversion वा cleft राख्दा लेखाइ नाटकीय र अस्वाभाविक सुनिन्छ। लक्ष्य भनेको साँच्चै जोड दिनुपर्ने ठाउँमा राखिएको एउटा शुद्ध उदाहरण हो।
✗ (एउटै paragraph-मा तीनवटा inversion)
✓ (ठीक ठाउँमा एउटा inversion, बाँकी सामान्य क्रममा)
एउटै inversion-ले पूरै script-लाई माथि उठाउन सक्छ

Inversion र cleft दैनिक grammar होइनन्; यी त्यस्ता सजावट हुन् जसले सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो band चिनाउँछन्। Grammatical Range and Accuracy-मा Band 8 वा 9 दिन आधार खोज्ने examiner-ले ठ्याक्कै यही खोज्छन्: candidate-ले दुर्लभ, जटिल form शुद्ध र स्वाभाविक रूपमा बनाउन सक्छन् भन्ने evidence। रणनीतिक प्रयोग भनेको essay वा Speaking Part 3-को उत्तरको सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण वाक्यमा - जुन point-मा तपाईं सबैभन्दा बढी जोड दिन चाहनुहुन्छ - एउटा inversion वा cleft राख्नु हो। एक पटक, सफा तरिकाले गर्दा यो बलियो सकारात्मक signal हो। धेरै प्रयोग गर्दा यसले तपाईंकै विरुद्ध काम गर्छ।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (inversion): Not only does renewable energy reduce emissions, but it also creates long-term employment.
Task 2 (what-cleft): What is often forgotten in this debate is the cost of doing nothing.
Speaking Part 3 (it-cleft): It was really the support of my family that made the biggest difference.
Chapter 8 यहीँ सकियो। अब Chapter 9 (Nominalisation र Academic Density) आउँछ।

g08_inversion_practice.title: 8. Practice · Inversion, Cleft Sentence र Advanced Emphasis
blocks: कुनै negative वा सीमित गर्ने adverbial वाक्यको सुरुमा आएपछि inversion हुन्छ -- never, rarely, not only। यो trigger set-लाई एउटा निश्चित सूचीको रूपमा सिक्नुहोस्, अनि subject-भन्दा अगाडि auxiliary राख्ने pattern आफैँ आउन थाल्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** सही inversion examiner-ले खोज्ने सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट Band 9 signal-मध्ये एक हो -- र लापरवाहीसाथ प्रयास गर्दा सबैभन्दा सजिलै गल्ती हुने कुरामध्ये पनि एक हो।
यी negative वा सीमित गर्ने adverbial-मध्ये कुनै एउटा अगाडि आएपछि inversion सुरु हुन्छ:
**Never / Never before** -- Never before has the country faced such a crisis.
**Rarely / Seldom** -- Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.
**Not only... (but also)** -- Not only does it cut costs, but it also saves time.
पहिले trigger set घोक्नुहोस्। Trigger अगाडि आएपछि subject र auxiliary verb-ले ठ्याक्कै प्रश्नमा जस्तै ठाउँ साट्छन् -- पूरै तरिका यत्ति नै हो।

blocks.title: Exercise 8.1 · Inversion रूपान्तरण
blocks.instructions: प्रत्येक वाक्यलाई negative वा सीमित गर्ने expression-बाट सुरु गरी question word order लागू गरेर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। कुनै वाक्य पहिल्यै गलत तरिकाले inverted छ भने त्यसलाई सच्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: The government has never faced such a challenge before.
items.answer: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
accepted: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
items.reason: “never before” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, अनि auxiliary + subject।

items.prompt: Politicians rarely admit that they were wrong.
items.answer: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
accepted: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
items.reason: Auxiliary छैन, त्यसैले “do” थप्नुहोस् र base verb प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The scheme had scarcely started when problems appeared.
items.answer: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
accepted: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
items.reason: “scarcely” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “had the scheme” invert गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: We understood the true cost only after the project ended.
items.answer: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
accepted: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
items.reason: “Only after …” ले main clause-मा inversion ल्याउँछ; “did” थप्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: This document should not be shared under any circumstances.
items.answer: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
accepted: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
items.reason: “under no circumstances” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “should this document” invert गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The policy not only reduced costs but also improved safety.
items.answer: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
accepted: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
items.reason: “not only” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “did” + base verb “reduce” थप्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: They little realised how much the plan would cost.
items.answer: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
accepted: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
items.reason: “little” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “did” + base verb थप्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The figures did not begin to recover until 2016.
items.answer: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
accepted: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
items.reason: “not until 2016” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “did” प्रयोग गरेर invert गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The company had no sooner launched the product than it was copied.
items.answer: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
accepted: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
items.reason: “no sooner” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “had the company” invert गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The goal can be achieved only by working together.
items.answer: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
accepted: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
items.reason: “only by working together” अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्, “can the goal” invert गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: It is the lack of investment that has caused the decline. (identify: which cleft, and what is emphasised?)
items.answer: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
accepted: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
It-cleft, emphasising the lack of investment.
It-cleft
items.reason: It-cleft-ले “it is/was” र “that” बीचको भागमा प्रकाश पार्छ।

items.prompt: Rewrite emphasising the solution with a what-cleft: We need a long-term plan.
items.answer: What we need is a long-term plan.
accepted: What we need is a long-term plan.
items.reason: What-cleft: “What + clause + is + जोड दिइएको भाग।”

items.prompt: Seldom a government reverses such a popular policy. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.
accepted: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.
items.reason: “seldom” पछि “does” + base verb चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: Rewrite with an it-cleft emphasising “her determination”: Her determination impressed the panel.
items.answer: It was her determination that impressed the panel.
accepted: It was her determination that impressed the panel.
items.reason: Subject-मा प्रकाश पार्ने it-cleft।

items.prompt: Never before people had access to so much information. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Never before had people had access to so much information.
accepted: Never before had people had access to so much information.
items.reason: “never before” पछि invert गरेर “had people had” बनाउनुहोस्।

blocks: Cleft sentence-ले एउटा idea-लाई दुईवटा clause-मा बाँडेर एउटै भागमा प्रकाश पार्छ। यो inversion-भन्दा नरम छ, र Writing र Speaking दुवैमा धेरै बढी स्वाभाविक हुन्छ -- २ वटा pattern-ले नै लगभग सबै प्रयोग समेट्छन्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Inversion-ले माग्ने कडा grammar नियमहरू बिना नै जोड थप्ने स्वाभाविक, कम जोखिमको उपाय हो cleft sentence।
बनावट: **It + is/was + जोड दिइएको भाग + that/who + बाँकी भाग।**
सामान्य: The lack of funding caused the failure. → Cleft: It was the lack of funding that caused the failure. (कारणमा प्रकाश)
बनावट: **What + clause + is/was + जोड दिइएको भाग।**
सामान्य: We need better public transport. → Cleft: What we need is better public transport. (समाधानमा प्रकाश)
कुनै point जोडदार रूपमा सुरु गर्न what-cleft विशेष गरी उपयोगी हुन्छ: What many governments overlook is the long-term cost of inaction.

blocks.title: Exercise 8.2 · Cleft Sentence निर्माण
blocks.instructions: प्रत्येक वाक्यलाई भनिएको cleft (it-cleft वा what-cleft) मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, उल्लेख गरिएको भागमा प्रकाश पार्दै।

items.prompt: Emphasise the cause with an it-cleft: Poor planning led to the delay.
items.answer: It was poor planning that led to the delay.
accepted: It was poor planning that led to the delay.
items.reason: कारणमा it-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the solution with a what-cleft: The city needs more green spaces.
items.answer: What the city needs is more green spaces.
accepted: What the city needs is more green spaces.
items.reason: समाधानमा what-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the time with an it-cleft: The crisis began in 2008.
items.answer: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.
accepted: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.
items.reason: समय जनाउने expression-मा it-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise what people overlook with a what-cleft: People overlook the long-term costs.
items.answer: What people overlook is the long-term costs.
accepted: What people overlook is the long-term costs.
items.reason: What-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the person with an it-cleft: My mentor changed my career.
items.answer: It was my mentor who changed my career.
accepted: It was my mentor who changed my career.
items.reason: व्यक्तिका लागि “who” सहितको it-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the real issue with a what-cleft: The real issue is a lack of funding.
items.answer: What matters most is the lack of funding.
accepted: What matters most is the lack of funding.
What the real issue is is a lack of funding.
What is really at stake is the lack of funding.
items.reason: मुख्य समस्यालाई अगाडि ल्याउने what-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the place with an it-cleft: The decision was made in Parliament.
items.answer: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.
accepted: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.
items.reason: ठाउँमा it-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the action needed with a what-cleft: Governments must act now.
items.answer: What governments must do now is act.
accepted: What governments must do now is act.
What governments need to do now is act.
items.reason: गर्नुपर्ने कामलाई जोड दिने what-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the factor with an it-cleft: Education drives development.
items.answer: It is education that drives development.
accepted: It is education that drives development.
items.reason: मुख्य चालक (driver) मा it-cleft।

items.prompt: Emphasise the priority with a what-cleft: We should prioritise public health.
items.answer: What we should prioritise is public health.
accepted: What we should prioritise is public health.
items.reason: प्राथमिकतामा what-cleft।

g09_nominalisation.title: 9. Nominalisation र Academic Density
blocks: Verb/adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्ने तरिका, जसले academic register-लाई चिनाउँछ; Task 2-का लागि वाक्य फेरि बनाउने ३ वटा तरिका; cohesion device-को रूपमा nominalisation; र धेरै nominalisation गरेर लेखाइलाई कुहिरोजस्तो धमिलो नबनाउने अनुशासन।

Nominalisation भनेको verb वा adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्नु हो, र यो formal academic English-को सबैभन्दा मुख्य विशेषता हो। दैनिक बोलीचालीमा “the government decided to act, and this reduced pollution,” भनिन्छ भने academic लेखाइमा “the government's decision to act led to a reduction in pollution.” भनिन्छ। जानकारी उस्तै छ; register चाहिँ बदलिएको छ। Nominalisation-ले तपाईंलाई कम शब्दमा धेरै अर्थ राख्न, idea-हरूलाई सहज रूपमा जोड्न, र examiner-हरूले सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो band-सँग जोड्ने व्यक्तिगत नभएको, विचारमा केन्द्रित स्वर अपनाउन मद्दत गर्छ।

Nominalisation-ले काम जनाउने शब्द (verb) वा गुण जनाउने शब्द (adjective) लाई वस्तु जनाउने शब्द (noun) मा बदल्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको subject बन्न सक्छ - र यही कुराले academic लेखाइलाई अमूर्त, विचारमा आधारित अनुभूति दिन्छ।
हेर्नुहोस्, एउटै idea कसरी verb-मा आधारित (व्यक्तिगत, धेरै शब्द भएको) form-बाट noun-मा आधारित (व्यक्तिगत नभएको, कसिलो) form-मा जान्छ।
Because the company expanded quickly, it became difficult to manage.
The company's rapid expansion led to management difficulties.
“expanded” “expansion” बन्छ, “difficult to manage” “management difficulties” बन्छ; वाक्य छोटो र बढी formal हुन्छ।
The government decided to invest in schools, and this improved literacy.
The government's decision to invest in schools improved literacy.
पूरै पहिलो clause एउटा noun phrase-मा खुम्चिन्छ, जसले subject-को काम गर्न सक्छ।
तरिका ३ चरणको छ, जुन तपाईं जुनसुकै बेला प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ: काम वा गुण पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्; त्यसलाई त्यसको noun-मा बदल्नुहोस्; त्यही noun-लाई subject वा object बनाएर वाक्य फेरि बनाउनुहोस्।
9.3 Task 2-का लागि वाक्य फेरि बनाउने ३ वटा तरिका
“because” clause-लाई noun subject-मा बदल्नुहोस्। “Because pollution increased, health worsened” → “The increase in pollution worsened public health.”
सहज रूपमा जोड्न पूरै घटनालाई अर्को वाक्यको subject बनाउनुहोस्। “The factory closed. This caused unemployment.” → “The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.”
“X is important / X is able to”-को सट्टा एउटा noun राख्नुहोस्। “It is important to reduce waste” → “The reduction of waste is a priority.”

यो दोस्रो तरिका (घटना → subject) एउटा cohesion device पनि हो: अघिल्लो idea-लाई एउटा noun-ले नाम दिनु (“this closure,” “such growth,” “this development”) “moreover” जस्ता सस्ता connector बिना paragraph-हरू जोड्ने एउटा परिष्कृत तरिका हो।
धेरै nominalisation गरेर लेखाइलाई कुहिरोजस्तो धमिलो नबनाउनुहोस्

Nominalisation शक्तिशाली छ, तर यसको बिग्रने पाटो पनि साँचो हो: abstract noun-ले भरिएको वाक्य भारी, नीरस र पढ्न गाह्रो हुन्छ। Band 9-को सीप भनेको सन्तुलन हो - nominalisation-ले register माथि लैजाने, तर वाक्यलाई स्पष्ट राख्ने। २ वटा समस्या बारम्बार देखिन्छन्।

समस्या १ · Noun-को लहर। धेरै abstract noun-लाई “of”-ले एकपछि अर्को जोड्दा पढ्नै नसकिने थुप्रो बन्छ।
✗ The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
✓ Reducing energy consumption is essential.

समस्या २ · काम गर्ने को हो भन्ने पूरै हराउनु। कहिलेकाहीँ पाठकलाई कसले काम गर्‍यो भनेर थाहा हुनुपर्छ; पूरै nominalisation गर्दा जिम्मेवारी बेकारमा लुक्न सक्छ।
✗ A decision was reached and an implementation followed.
✓ The committee decided to act and then implemented the plan.

Nominalisation सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट विशेषताहरूमध्ये एक हो, जसले Band 6.5 script (जुन होसियारीसाथ बोलेको कुराजस्तो पढिन्छ) लाई Band 8 script (जुन academic लेखाइजस्तो पढिन्छ) बाट छुट्याउँछ। यसका २ वटा फाइदा सिधै marking criteria-सँग मिल्छन्: यसले Lexical Resource बढाउँछ, किनकि यसले तपाईंलाई सटीक, formal शब्द छान्न बाध्य बनाउँछ; र यसले Coherence and Cohesion बढाउँछ, किनकि अघिल्लो idea-लाई noun-ले नाम दिँदा वाक्यहरू सुन्दर तरिकाले जोडिन्छन्। निर्देशन यो हो: यसलाई सोचेर आफ्ना topic sentence र transition-हरूमा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, जहाँ कसिलोपन र formality सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ, तर व्याख्या गर्ने वाक्यहरूलाई स्पष्ट राख्नुहोस्।

कुन skill-मा काम लाग्छ: Writing
Task 2 topic sentence: The rapid urbanisation of developing nations has placed enormous pressure on public infrastructure.
Task 2 cohesion (event → subject): This expansion, however, has come at a significant environmental cost.
Task 1 summary: The overall growth in exports was matched by a comparable rise in imports.
Chapter 9, र Module 3 यहीँ सकियो। अब Module 4 (The Full Workbook), Chapter 10 आउँछ: पूरा essay editing र speaking transcript-लाई चिटिक्क बनाउने काम, त्यसपछि Chapter 11-मा सबै answer key।

g09_nominalisation_practice.title: 9. Practice · Nominalisation र Academic Density
blocks: Nominalisation-ले verb वा adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्छ -- decide decision बन्छ, difficult difficulty बन्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको subject बन्न सक्छ, र ठ्याक्कै यही कुराले academic लेखाइलाई अमूर्त, विचारमा आधारित अनुभूति दिन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** बोलचालको English र academic English बीचको फरकका लागि सबैभन्दा बढी जिम्मेवार एउटै grammatical बानी nominalisation हो।
Nominalisation-ले काम जनाउने शब्द (verb) वा गुण जनाउने शब्द (adjective) लाई वस्तु जनाउने शब्द (noun) मा बदल्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको **subject** बन्न सक्छ।

यी family-हरूलाई दुवै दिशाबाट अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् -- verb form चिन्ने र भन्नेबित्तिकै noun form बनाउने। यसैले गर्दा exam-को दबाबमा पनि nominalisation तपाईंको हातमा हुन्छ, पढ्दा मात्र चिन्ने कुरा बनेर बस्दैन।

blocks.title: Exercise 9.1 · Nominalisation अभ्यास
blocks.instructions: कोष्ठकमा दिइएको शब्दलाई nominalise गरेर हरेक वाक्यलाई अझ academic register-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, र बनेको noun-लाई subject वा object बनाउनुहोस्। एउटा item-मा धेरै nominalise गरिएको लहरलाई सजिलो बनाउन भनिएको छ।

items.prompt: The company expanded rapidly, and this created management problems. (nominalise “expanded”)
items.answer: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
accepted: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
items.reason: “expanded” → subject-को रूपमा “expansion”।

items.prompt: Because the population grew, the demand for housing rose. (nominalise “grew”)
items.answer: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
accepted: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
Population growth raised the demand for housing.
items.reason: “grew” → subject “growth”।

items.prompt: The factory closed, which caused widespread unemployment. (nominalise “closed”)
items.answer: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
accepted: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
items.reason: “closed” → “closure”।

items.prompt: It is important to reduce waste. (nominalise “reduce” and “important”)
items.answer: The reduction of waste is a priority.
accepted: The reduction of waste is a priority.
Waste reduction is important.
