نهاية الفصل 8. يليه الفصل 9 (Nominalisation & Academic Density).

g08_inversion_practice.title: 8. Practice · الـ Inversion والـ Cleft Sentences والتوكيد المتقدم
blocks: تحدث الـ inversion عندما ينتقل negative أو limiting adverbial إلى بداية الـ sentence -- never، rarely، not only. تعلّم مجموعة الـ triggers هذه كقائمة ثابتة، وسيصبح نمط الـ auxiliary قبل الـ subject تلقائيًا.
**لماذا يهم ذلك:** الـ inversion الصحيحة من أوضح علامات Band 9 التي يبحث عنها الـ examiner -- ومن أسهلها في الخطأ إذا حاولتها دون انتباه.
تحدث الـ inversion عندما ينتقل أحد هذه الـ negative أو limiting adverbials إلى البداية:
**Never / Never before** -- Never before has the country faced such a crisis.
**Rarely / Seldom** -- Rarely do politicians admit their mistakes.
**Not only... (but also)** -- Not only does it cut costs, but it also saves time.
احفظ مجموعة الـ triggers أولًا. وعندما يصبح الـ trigger في البداية، يتبادل الـ subject والـ auxiliary verb مكانيهما تمامًا كما في السؤال -- وهذه هي الآلية كلها.

blocks.title: Exercise 8.1 · التحويل إلى Inversion
blocks.instructions: أعد كتابة كل sentence بحيث تبدأ بالتعبير المنفي أو المُقيِّد، مع تطبيق ترتيب كلمات السؤال. وإذا كانت الـ sentence فيها inversion خاطئة أصلًا، فصحّحها.

items.prompt: The government has never faced such a challenge before.
items.answer: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
accepted: Never before has the government faced such a challenge.
items.reason: قدّم “never before”، ثم auxiliary + subject.

items.prompt: Politicians rarely admit that they were wrong.
items.answer: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
accepted: Rarely do politicians admit that they were wrong.
items.reason: لا يوجد auxiliary، لذلك أضف “do” واستخدم الـ base verb.

items.prompt: The scheme had scarcely started when problems appeared.
items.answer: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
accepted: Scarcely had the scheme started when problems appeared.
items.reason: قدّم “scarcely”، واعكس الترتيب إلى “had the scheme.”

items.prompt: We understood the true cost only after the project ended.
items.answer: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
accepted: Only after the project ended did we understand the true cost.
items.reason: “Only after …” تُحدث inversion في الـ main clause؛ أضف “did.”

items.prompt: This document should not be shared under any circumstances.
items.answer: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
accepted: Under no circumstances should this document be shared.
items.reason: قدّم “under no circumstances”، واعكس الترتيب إلى “should this document.”

items.prompt: The policy not only reduced costs but also improved safety.
items.answer: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
accepted: Not only did the policy reduce costs, but it also improved safety.
items.reason: قدّم “not only”، وأضف “did” + الـ base verb “reduce.”

items.prompt: They little realised how much the plan would cost.
items.answer: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
accepted: Little did they realise how much the plan would cost.
items.reason: قدّم “little”، وأضف “did” + الـ base verb.

items.prompt: The figures did not begin to recover until 2016.
items.answer: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
accepted: Not until 2016 did the figures begin to recover.
items.reason: قدّم “not until 2016”، واعكس الترتيب باستخدام “did.”

items.prompt: The company had no sooner launched the product than it was copied.
items.answer: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
accepted: No sooner had the company launched the product than it was copied.
items.reason: قدّم “no sooner”، واعكس الترتيب إلى “had the company.”

items.prompt: The goal can be achieved only by working together.
items.answer: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
accepted: Only by working together can the goal be achieved.
items.reason: قدّم “only by working together”، واعكس الترتيب إلى “can the goal.”

items.prompt: It is the lack of investment that has caused the decline. (identify: which cleft, and what is emphasised?)
items.answer: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
accepted: It-cleft; it emphasises the cause, “the lack of investment.”
It-cleft, emphasising the lack of investment.
It-cleft
items.reason: الـ it-cleft تسلّط الضوء على العنصر الواقع بين “it is/was” و“that.”

items.prompt: Rewrite emphasising the solution with a what-cleft: We need a long-term plan.
items.answer: What we need is a long-term plan.
accepted: What we need is a long-term plan.
items.reason: What-cleft: “What + clause + is + العنصر المؤكَّد.”

items.prompt: Seldom a government reverses such a popular policy. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.
accepted: Seldom does a government reverse such a popular policy.
items.reason: بعد “seldom” تحتاج “does” + الـ base verb.

items.prompt: Rewrite with an it-cleft emphasising “her determination”: Her determination impressed the panel.
items.answer: It was her determination that impressed the panel.
accepted: It was her determination that impressed the panel.
items.reason: It-cleft تسلّط الضوء على الـ subject.

items.prompt: Never before people had access to so much information. (fix the inversion)
items.answer: Never before had people had access to so much information.
accepted: Never before had people had access to so much information.
items.reason: اعكس الترتيب إلى “had people had” بعد “never before.”

blocks: الـ cleft sentence تقسم فكرة واحدة إلى اثنتين من الـ clauses لتسليط الضوء على عنصر واحد. وهي ألطف من الـ inversion وأكثر طبيعية بكثير في Writing و Speaking معًا -- ونمطان فقط يغطيان كل الاستخدامات تقريبًا.
**لماذا يهم ذلك:** الـ cleft sentences طريقة طبيعية وقليلة المخاطرة لإضافة التوكيد، بدون قواعد الـ grammar الأكثر صرامة التي تتطلبها الـ inversion.
البنية: **It + is/was + العنصر المؤكَّد + that/who + بقية الجملة.**
Plain: The lack of funding caused the failure. → Cleft: It was the lack of funding that caused the failure. (الضوء على السبب)
Plain: We need better public transport. → Cleft: What we need is better public transport. (الضوء على الحل)
الـ what-cleft مفيدة بشكل خاص لافتتاح فكرة بتوكيد: What many governments overlook is the long-term cost of inaction.

blocks.title: Exercise 8.2 · بناء الـ Cleft Sentence
blocks.instructions: أعد كتابة كل sentence بنوع الـ cleft المطلوب (it-cleft أو what-cleft)، مع تسليط الضوء على العنصر المذكور.

items.prompt: Emphasise the cause with an it-cleft: Poor planning led to the delay.
items.answer: It was poor planning that led to the delay.
accepted: It was poor planning that led to the delay.
items.reason: It-cleft على السبب.

items.prompt: Emphasise the solution with a what-cleft: The city needs more green spaces.
items.answer: What the city needs is more green spaces.
accepted: What the city needs is more green spaces.
items.reason: What-cleft على الحل.

items.prompt: Emphasise the time with an it-cleft: The crisis began in 2008.
items.answer: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.
accepted: It was in 2008 that the crisis began.
items.reason: It-cleft على تعبير الزمن.

items.prompt: Emphasise what people overlook with a what-cleft: People overlook the long-term costs.
items.answer: What people overlook is the long-term costs.
accepted: What people overlook is the long-term costs.
items.reason: What-cleft.

items.prompt: Emphasise the person with an it-cleft: My mentor changed my career.
items.answer: It was my mentor who changed my career.
accepted: It was my mentor who changed my career.
items.reason: It-cleft مع “who” للشخص.

items.prompt: Emphasise the real issue with a what-cleft: The real issue is a lack of funding.
items.answer: What matters most is the lack of funding.
accepted: What matters most is the lack of funding.
What the real issue is is a lack of funding.
What is really at stake is the lack of funding.
items.reason: What-cleft تُبرز القضية الأساسية.

items.prompt: Emphasise the place with an it-cleft: The decision was made in Parliament.
items.answer: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.
accepted: It was in Parliament that the decision was made.
items.reason: It-cleft على المكان.

items.prompt: Emphasise the action needed with a what-cleft: Governments must act now.
items.answer: What governments must do now is act.
accepted: What governments must do now is act.
What governments need to do now is act.
items.reason: What-cleft على الإجراء المطلوب.

items.prompt: Emphasise the factor with an it-cleft: Education drives development.
items.answer: It is education that drives development.
accepted: It is education that drives development.
items.reason: It-cleft على العامل المحرِّك.

items.prompt: Emphasise the priority with a what-cleft: We should prioritise public health.
items.answer: What we should prioritise is public health.
accepted: What we should prioritise is public health.
items.reason: What-cleft على الأولوية.

g09_nominalisation.title: 9. الـ Nominalisation والكثافة الأكاديمية (Academic Density)
blocks: تحويل الـ verb أو الـ adjective إلى noun، وهو ما يميّز الـ academic register؛ و3 طرق لإعادة بناء الجملة في Task 2؛ والـ nominalisation كأداة cohesion؛ وضرورة ألّا تبالغ في الـ nominalisation حتى يصبح النص غامضًا كالضباب.

الـ Nominalisation (التحويل إلى اسم) هو تحويل verb أو adjective إلى noun، وهو أوضح سمة تميّز الإنجليزية الأكاديمية الرسمية. ففي الكلام اليومي نقول “the government decided to act, and this reduced pollution,” أما في الكتابة الأكاديمية فنقول “the government's decision to act led to a reduction in pollution.” المعلومة نفسها تمامًا، لكن الـ register تغيّر كليًا. يساعدك الـ nominalisation على وضع معنى أكثر في كلمات أقل، وعلى ربط الأفكار بسلاسة، وعلى استخدام الأسلوب غير الشخصي الذي يركّز على المفاهيم، وهو الأسلوب الذي يربطه الـ examiner بأعلى الـ band.

يحوّل الـ nominalisation كلمة تدل على فعل (verb) أو كلمة تدل على صفة (adjective) إلى كلمة تدل على شيء (noun). وعندما تصبح الفكرة noun يمكن أن تكون الـ subject في الجملة، وهذا ما يعطي النص الأكاديمي طابعه المجرد القائم على المفاهيم.
عائلات شائعة من verb→noun و adjective→noun
لاحظ كيف تنتقل الفكرة نفسها من صيغة تعتمد على الـ verb (شخصية وكثيرة الكلمات) إلى صيغة تعتمد على الـ noun (غير شخصية ومكثّفة).
Because the company expanded quickly, it became difficult to manage.
The company's rapid expansion led to management difficulties.
تصبح “expanded” هي “expansion,” وتصبح “difficult to manage” هي “management difficulties”؛ فتصير الجملة أقصر وأكثر رسمية (formal).
The government decided to invest in schools, and this improved literacy.
The government's decision to invest in schools improved literacy.
يتحوّل الـ clause الأول كله إلى noun phrase واحدة يمكن أن تعمل كـ subject.
الطريقة خطوة من 3 مراحل يمكنك تطبيقها متى شئت: ابحث عن الفعل أو الصفة؛ حوّلها إلى الـ noun الخاص بها؛ ثم أعد بناء الجملة حول هذا الـ noun بوصفه subject أو object.
9.3 ثلاث طرق لإعادة بناء الجملة في Task 2
حوّل clause يبدأ بـ “because” إلى noun subject. “Because pollution increased, health worsened” → “The increase in pollution worsened public health.”
اجعل حدثًا كاملًا هو الـ subject في الجملة التالية، لتربط الأفكار بسلاسة. “The factory closed. This caused unemployment.” → “The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.”
ضع noun مكان “X is important / X is able to”. “It is important to reduce waste” → “The reduction of waste is a priority.”

هذه الطريقة الثانية (الحدث → subject) هي أيضًا أداة cohesion: فتسمية الفكرة السابقة بـ noun (“this closure,” “such growth,” “this development”) طريقة راقية لربط الـ paragraph دون connector سهل ومستهلك مثل “moreover.”
لا تبالغ في الـ nominalisation حتى يصبح النص ضبابيًا

الـ Nominalisation أداة قوية، لكن خطرها حقيقي: الجملة المحشوة بالـ abstract noun تصبح ثقيلة وجافة وصعبة القراءة. مهارة Band 9 هي التوازن: أن تستخدم الـ nominalisation لترفع الـ register مع إبقاء الجملة واضحة. وهناك مشكلتان تتكرران.

المشكلة 1 · سلسلة الأسماء (noun string). ربط عدة abstract noun ببعضها بـ “of” يصنع كومة لا تُقرأ.
✗ The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
✓ Reducing energy consumption is essential.

المشكلة 2 · ضياع الفاعل تمامًا. أحيانًا يحتاج القارئ أن يعرف من قام بالفعل؛ والـ nominalisation الكامل قد يُخفي المسؤولية بشكل غير مفيد.
✗ A decision was reached and an implementation followed.
✓ The committee decided to act and then implemented the plan.
علامة الـ register في أعلى الـ band

الـ Nominalisation من أوضح السمات التي تفرّق بين script بمستوى Band 6.5 (يُقرأ كأنه كلام منطوق بعناية) و script بمستوى Band 8 (يُقرأ ككتابة أكاديمية). وفائدتاه ترتبطان مباشرة بـ marking criteria: فهو يرفع Lexical Resource لأنه يجبرك على اختيار كلمات دقيقة ورسمية، ويرفع Coherence and Cohesion لأن تسمية الفكرة السابقة بـ noun تربط الجمل بأناقة. والتوجيه هنا: استخدمه عن قصد في الـ topic sentence وفي الـ transition، حيث تهمّ الكثافة والرسمية أكثر، مع إبقاء جمل الشرح واضحة.

المهارات التي يفيدها: Writing
Task 2 topic sentence: The rapid urbanisation of developing nations has placed enormous pressure on public infrastructure.
Task 2 cohesion (event → subject): This expansion, however, has come at a significant environmental cost.
Task 1 summary: The overall growth in exports was matched by a comparable rise in imports.
نهاية Chapter 9، ونهاية Module 3. يليه Module 4 (The Full Workbook)، Chapter 10: تحرير essay كامل وتحسين نص Speaking المكتوب (transcript)، ثم مفاتيح الإجابات (answer key) كاملة في Chapter 11.

g09_nominalisation_practice.title: 9. Practice · الـ Nominalisation والكثافة الأكاديمية (Academic Density)
blocks: Recap · الـ Nominalisation من أجل الكثافة الأكاديمية

الـ Nominalisation يحوّل الـ verb أو الـ adjective إلى noun، فتصبح decide هي decision، وتصبح difficult هي difficulty. وعندما تصبح الفكرة noun يمكن أن تكون الـ subject في الجملة، وهذا بالضبط ما يعطي النص الأكاديمي طابعه المجرد القائم على المفاهيم.
**لماذا هذا مهم:** الـ Nominalisation هو العادة النحوية الأكثر مسؤولية عن الفرق بين الإنجليزية في المحادثة والإنجليزية الأكاديمية.
يحوّل الـ nominalisation كلمة تدل على فعل (verb) أو كلمة تدل على صفة (adjective) إلى كلمة تدل على شيء (noun). وعندما تصبح الفكرة noun يمكن أن تكون الـ **subject** في الجملة.

التدرّب على هذه العائلات في الاتجاهين، أي أن تعرف صيغة الـ verb وأن تُنتج صيغة الـ noun متى احتجت إليها، هو ما يجعل الـ nominalisation متاحًا لك تحت ضغط الامتحان، بدلًا من أن يكون شيئًا تعرفه فقط عندما تقرأ.

blocks.title: Exercise 9.1 · تدريب على الـ Nominalisation
blocks.instructions: أعد كتابة كل جملة بـ register أكاديمي أكثر، وذلك بتحويل الكلمة التي بين القوسين إلى noun، واجعل هذا الـ noun هو الـ subject أو الـ object. وفي سؤال واحد عليك أن تبسّط سلسلة أسماء فيها nominalisation زائد.

items.prompt: The company expanded rapidly, and this created management problems. (nominalise “expanded”)
items.answer: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
accepted: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
items.reason: تصبح “expanded” هي “expansion” وتعمل كـ subject.

items.prompt: Because the population grew, the demand for housing rose. (nominalise “grew”)
items.answer: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
accepted: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
Population growth raised the demand for housing.
items.reason: تصبح “grew” هي “growth” كـ subject.

items.prompt: The factory closed, which caused widespread unemployment. (nominalise “closed”)
items.answer: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
accepted: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
items.reason: تصبح “closed” هي “closure.”

items.prompt: It is important to reduce waste. (nominalise “reduce” and “important”)
items.answer: The reduction of waste is a priority.
accepted: The reduction of waste is a priority.
Waste reduction is important.
items.reason: تصبح “reduce” هي “reduction”؛ وفكرة “important” تصبح “priority.”

items.prompt: The government decided to invest in railways, and this improved transport. (nominalise “decided”)
items.answer: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.
accepted: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.
items.reason: تصبح “decided” هي “decision.”

items.prompt: Because energy is consumed at a high rate, emissions have risen. (nominalise “consumed”)
items.answer: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
accepted: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
High energy consumption has raised emissions.
items.reason: تصبح “consumed” هي “consumption.”

items.prompt: The team failed to plan properly, which led to delays. (nominalise “failed”)
items.answer: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.
accepted: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.
items.reason: تصبح “failed” هي “failure.”

items.prompt: Many species have become extinct, and this worries scientists. (nominalise “become extinct”)
items.answer: The extinction of many species worries scientists.
accepted: The extinction of many species worries scientists.
items.reason: تصبح “become extinct” هي “extinction.”

items.prompt: The city developed quickly, and this attracted investors. (nominalise “developed”)
items.answer: The city's rapid development attracted investors.
accepted: The city's rapid development attracted investors.
items.reason: تصبح “developed” هي “development.”

items.prompt: Prices increased sharply, which reduced consumer spending. (nominalise “increased”)
items.answer: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.
accepted: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.
items.reason: تصبح “increased” هي “increase in.”

items.prompt: People are more aware of climate change, and this has changed behaviour. (nominalise “aware”)
items.answer: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.
accepted: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.
items.reason: تصبح “aware” هي “awareness.”

items.prompt: The two countries cooperated, and trade improved. (nominalise “cooperated”)
items.answer: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.
accepted: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.
items.reason: تصبح “cooperated” هي “cooperation.”

items.prompt: Simplify the noun string: The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
items.answer: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
accepted: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
Cutting energy consumption is essential.
items.reason: فكّك كومة الـ “of” وأعدها إلى صيغة واضحة.

items.prompt: The scientists analysed the data carefully, and this revealed a pattern. (nominalise “analysed”)
items.answer: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.
accepted: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.
items.reason: تصبح “analysed” هي “analysis.”

items.prompt: Because the roads were poor, transport costs were high. (nominalise “poor”)
items.answer: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
accepted: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
The poor state of the roads raised transport costs.
items.reason: تصبح “poor (roads)” هي “the poor condition of the roads.”

blocks.title: Exercise 9.2 · إعادة البناء وإزالة الضباب
blocks.instructions: أُضيف هذا التمرين ليكتمل Chapter 9 (فكل chapter آخر فيه تمرينان). الأسئلة 1–6: أعد كتابة كل جملة باستخدام طريقة إعادة البناء المذكورة بين القوسين من 9.3. الأسئلة 7–10: في كل جملة nominalisation زائد؛ أعد كتابتها لتبقى رسمية لكن تُقرأ بوضوح، كما في مربع “Do not over-nominalise into fog”.

items.prompt: Because traffic increased, air quality in the city declined. (move 1: “because” clause → noun subject)
items.answer: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
accepted: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
The increase in traffic led to a decline in the city's air quality.
Increased traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
items.reason: الـ clause الذي يبدأ بـ “because” يصبح الـ noun subject “the increase in traffic”؛ و“declined” تصبح “a decline in”.

items.prompt: Because the region became poorer, crime rose sharply. (move 1)
items.answer: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
accepted: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
Growing poverty in the region led to a sharp rise in crime.
The increase in poverty in the region caused a sharp rise in crime.
items.reason: تصبح “became poorer” هي “poverty” (الـ adjective poor → الـ noun poverty، كما في جدول 9.1)؛ و“rose” تصبح “a rise in”.

items.prompt: The government banned plastic bags. This reduced litter on beaches. (move 2: event → subject of the next sentence)
items.answer: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
accepted: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
The ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
items.reason: تتحوّل الجملة الأولى إلى الـ noun phrase “the ban on plastic bags”، وتصبح هي الـ subject.

items.prompt: Many young people migrated to cities. This weakened rural communities. (move 2)
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
accepted: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
The large-scale migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
items.reason: تصبح “migrated” هي “the migration of”؛ والحدث كله أصبح الآن الـ subject.

items.prompt: It is important to protect endangered species. (move 3: “It is important to …” → noun)
items.answer: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
accepted: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
The protection of endangered species is essential.
Protecting endangered species is a priority.
items.reason: تصبح “to protect” هي “the protection of”، وكلمة “important” الغامضة تصبح noun complement دقيقًا (“a priority”).

items.prompt: Many students are not able to afford university fees. (move 3: “be able to” → noun)
items.answer: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
accepted: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
The inability of many students to afford university fees is a concern.
Many students' inability to afford university fees is a concern.
items.reason: تصبح “are not able to” هي “lack the ability to” / “inability” (able → ability، كما في جدول 9.1).

items.prompt: The implementation of the improvement of the quality of the provision of education is required.
items.answer: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
accepted: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
The quality of education needs to be improved.
Educational quality must be improved.
items.reason: سلسلة أسماء فيها أربع عبارات “of” لا يمكن قراءتها؛ احتفظ بفكرة قوية واحدة (quality of education) واستخدم صيغة verb للفعل.

items.prompt: The reduction of the consumption of water by the population of the city is a necessity.
items.answer: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
accepted: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
Reducing water consumption in the city is necessary.
The city needs to reduce its water consumption.
items.reason: أعد أحد الأسماء المتراكمة إلى verb (reduction → reduce)، وضع صيغة ملكية (possessive) مكان “of the population of the city”.

items.prompt: There was an expansion in the utilisation of the internet by the elderly for the purpose of communication.
items.answer: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
accepted: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
Internet use among older people for communication has expanded.
More elderly people now use the internet to communicate.
items.reason: “utilisation” هي noun متضخّم بدل “use”، و“for the purpose of communication” ضباب بدل “to communicate”؛ فالرسمية لا تعني كثرة الكلمات.

items.prompt: The occurrence of the failure of the system was a consequence of the lack of maintenance.
items.answer: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
accepted: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
The system's failure was caused by a lack of maintenance.
A lack of maintenance caused the system to fail.
items.reason: “The occurrence of the failure” لا تضيف شيئًا؛ احتفظ بـ nominalisation واحد على الأكثر (failure أو lack) ودع verb واضحًا يحمل السبب.

g10_editing.title: 10. تحرير الـ Essay كاملًا وتحسين الـ Speaking Transcript
g10_editing.group: الوحدة 4 · The Full Workbook (كتاب التمارين الكامل)
blocks: التحرير الذاتي المتكامل في ظروف الامتحان: قائمة المراجعة ذات المراحل الست (six-pass checklist)، وخمسة essay كاملة فيها أخطاء لتصلحها، من الكثيرة الأخطاء إلى القليلة الأخطاء، وخمس إجابات Speaking لترفع كلًّا منها band واحدًا دون أن تبدو محفوظة.

في كل chapter حتى الآن كنت تصلح نوعًا واحدًا من الأخطاء في كل مرة، وكنت تعرف مسبقًا ما الذي تبحث عنه. الامتحان الحقيقي ليس كذلك. ففي الـ essay الحقيقي تعمل كل قواعد Module 1 إلى Module 3 في الوقت نفسه، والأخطاء مختلطة وبلا عناوين، وعليك أن تكتشف أخطاءك بنفسك تحت ضغط الوقت دون مفتاح إجابات بجانبك. هذه الـ module الأخيرة تدرّبك على هذه المهارة بالضبط: التحرير الذاتي المتكامل. ستصلح essay كاملة فيها كل أنواع الأخطاء، ثم ترفع مستوى إجابات Speaking حقيقية من إجابات آمنة لكن بسيطة إلى إجابات متحكَّم فيها ومرنة.
10.1 كيف تستخدم هذا الـ chapter من كتاب التمارين

كل مهمة تحرير أدناه هي essay أو paragraph كاملة فيها أخطاء، مكتوبة بمستوى Band 5.5 إلى 6.0 تقريبًا، ووُضعت فيها أنواع الأخطاء التي درستها تحديدًا. اعمل بترتيب منظّم، بدلًا من القراءة العشوائية بحثًا عن “أشياء تبدو خاطئة”.
قائمة مراجعة التحرير الذاتي (اتّبعها بهذا الترتيب)
مرحلة الـ Agreement: طابق كل verb مع الـ subject الحقيقي له (Chapter 1).
مرحلة الـ Tense: تأكّد أن كل إطار زمني صحيح وثابت (Chapter 2).
مرحلة الـ Article: افحص كل singular noun لترى هل يحتاج a / an / the أو لا شيء (zero) (Chapter 3).
مرحلة الـ Preposition: افحص الـ dependent preposition وحروف الجر الخاصة بالبيانات (data prepositions) (Chapter 4).
مرحلة الـ Structure: ابحث عن الـ fragment والـ run-on والـ comma splice؛ وتأكّد من وجود تنوّع في الـ complex sentence (Chapter 5).
مرحلة الـ Range: هل يوجد على الأقل passive واحد، و conditional واحد، وبعض الـ hedging حيث يناسب (Chapters 6, 7)؟ وهل توجد بنية دقيقة واحدة من مستوى الـ band العالي (Chapters 8, 9)؟
قم بمرحلة مراجعة منفصلة لكل بند. فمحاولة اكتشاف كل شيء في قراءة واحدة هي سبب تسرّب الأخطاء؛ وفي التدقيق، المتخصص يتفوّق على من يفعل كل شيء مرة واحدة.

في تمرين هذا الـ chapter خمس essay للتحرير، مرتّبة من الكثيرة الأخطاء (Essay 1) إلى القليلة الأخطاء (Essay 5). لكل منها نسخة نموذجية مصحّحة وتفصيل للأخطاء حسب نوعها، لترى أيّ مرحلة من مراحلك الست كانت ستكتشف كل خطأ. حلّها بالترتيب؛ فالـ essay المتأخرة تفترض أنك استوعبت التصحيحات السابقة.

أنت لا تعيد كتابة الـ essay بأسلوبك الخاص. بل تقوم بأقل قدر من التصحيحات اللازمة للدقة والتنوّع (range)، مع الحفاظ على المعنى الذي أراده الكاتب. وهذا بالضبط ما يجب أن تفعله مع الـ script الخاص بك في آخر خمس دقائق من الامتحان.

الـ Grammar يُقيَّم في Speaking أيضًا، تحت المعيار نفسه Grammatical Range and Accuracy، لكن الهدف مختلف: في Speaking تحتاج إلى مرونة متحكَّم فيها في الوقت الحقيقي، لا إلى الكثافة الكتابية. تعطيك أسئلة Speaking الخمسة في التمرين إجابة منطوقة حقيقية، بسيطة لكن آمنة، وتطلب منك رفعها band واحدًا بإضافة الحركات التي علّمها هذا الكورس بالضبط، دون أن تبدو محفوظة.
أدوات رفع المستوى في Speaking، مرتّبة حسب قيمتها:
أصلِح الدقة الأساسية أولًا: الـ agreement والـ tense والـ article، لأنها الأكثر كلفة في الدرجات.
أضف complex sentence واحدة: clause بـ because أو although أو which لتربط فكرتين.
أضف tense contrast: تنقّل بين الماضي والحاضر والمستقبل لتُظهر الـ range (“I used to … but now I … and I think I'll …”).
أضف hedging phrase واحدة: “it depends,” “I'd say,” “on the whole,” “tend to.”
ويمكنك اختياريًا إضافة cleft طبيعية واحدة للتأكيد: “what I really enjoy is …”
الهدف إنجليزية منطوقة دقيقة ومرنة، لا paragraph محفوظة. فـ complex sentence طبيعية واحدة و tense contrast واحد في إجابة Part 2 يفيدان درجتك أكثر من idiom محفوظ.
لماذا التحرير المتكامل هو مهارة الامتحان الحقيقية

ينتهي كل من مهمتَي الكتابة ببضع دقائق يجب أن تُخصَّص للتحرير، والمرشحون الذين يحرّرون بطريقة منظّمة يكسبون عادةً نصف band في Grammatical Range and Accuracy أكثر ممن لا يفعلون، لأن الهفوات نفسها (حرف -s ساقط، أو article ناقص، أو will داخل if-clause) شائعة وسهلة الاكتشاف في مرحلة مراجعة مركّزة. وفي Speaking، القدرة على تصحيح النفس بسلاسة (“the number of people were, sorry, was rising”) هي بحد ذاتها علامة إيجابية على التحكّم. هذا الـ chapter يبني العادة التي تحوّل كل ما تعلّمته إلى درجات في ظروف الامتحان.

المهارات التي يفيدها: Writing, Speaking
مكسب التحرير: التحرير المنظّم بست مراحل في آخر خمس دقائق يزيل عادةً معظم هفوات الـ agreement والـ tense والـ article.
تصحيح النفس في Speaking: “They has - sorry, they have - improved a lot recently.”
الـ essay الخمس للتحرير وأسئلة تحسين Speaking الخمسة موجودة في تمارين هذا الـ chapter. ثم يقدّم Chapter 11 مفاتيح الإجابات (answer key) كاملة وخطوة بخطوة لكل تمرين في الكتاب.

g10_editing_practice.title: 10. Practice · تحرير الـ Essay كاملًا وتحسين الـ Speaking Transcript
g10_editing_practice.group: الوحدة 4 · The Full Workbook (كتاب التمارين الكامل)
blocks: محاولة اكتشاف كل أخطاء الـ grammar في قراءة واحدة هي سبب تسرّب الأخطاء. قم بمرحلة مراجعة منفصلة تركّز على شيء واحد لكل قاعدة: الـ agreement، ثم الـ tense، ثم الـ article، ثم الـ preposition؛ لأن المتخصص في التدقيق يتفوّق على من يفعل كل شيء مرة واحدة.
**لماذا هذا مهم:** هذه هي قائمة المراجعة التي تجمع كل الـ chapter السابقة في روتين تحرير واحد يمكنك تكراره على أي essay قبل أن تسلّمها.
1. **مرحلة الـ Agreement** -- طابق كل verb مع الـ subject الحقيقي له (Chapter 1).
2. **مرحلة الـ Tense** -- تأكّد أن كل إطار زمني صحيح وثابت (Chapter 2).
3. **مرحلة الـ Article** -- افحص كل singular noun لترى هل يحتاج a/an/the أو لا شيء (zero) (Chapter 3).
4. **مرحلة الـ Preposition** -- افحص الـ dependent preposition وحروف الجر الخاصة بالبيانات (data prepositions) (Chapter 4).

قم **بمرحلة مراجعة منفصلة لكل بند** بدلًا من محاولة اكتشاف كل شيء في قراءة واحدة. في التدقيق، المتخصص يتفوّق على من يفعل كل شيء مرة واحدة؛ فالمراجعة التي تركّز على شيء واحد تكتشف أخطاء تفوت القراءة العامة تمامًا.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.1 · تحرير الـ Essay كاملًا
blocks.instructions: خمس essay فيها أخطاء، مرتّبة من الكثيرة الأخطاء إلى القليلة الأخطاء. طبّق قائمة المراجعة ذات المراحل الست على كل واحدة وأعد كتابتها بشكل صحيح، مع الحفاظ على المعنى الذي أراده الكاتب. وفي Essay 5 يُطلب منك أيضًا إضافة بنية واحدة من مستوى الـ band العالي.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 1 (heavily flawed). Correct every error, preserving the meaning. “In many country, the number of student who go abroad for study have increased in recent years. This trend have both advantage and disadvantage. On one hand, student who studies in foreign university gets access to better facility and they can learns new culture. On other hand, it is very expensive and many family cannot affords it. In my opinion, if government will provide more scholarship, this problem can be solved. According to me, the advantage is more than the disadvantage.”
items.answer: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accepted: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Agreement: country→countries، student→students، have→has (لأن the number مفرد)، studies→study، gets→gain، learns→learn، affords→afford. Articles: on the one hand، on the other hand، the government. Conditional: “if government will provide”→“if the government provided … could be solved” (لا نضع will في الـ if-clause). Register: “According to me”→“Overall / In my view”؛ “advantage is more than”→“advantages outweigh the disadvantages.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 2. Correct every error. “Nowadays, technology have changed the way we communicate. In the past, people was writing letters which take many days to arrive. But now, we can sends a message in a second. Although this is convenient, but it also have some negative effect. For example, many young people spends too much time on their phone and they forgets how to talk face to face. If this trend continue, our social skill will became weaker.”
items.answer: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
accepted: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
items.reason: Agreement: have→has، can sends→send، have→has، spends→spend، forgets→forget، skill→skills. Tense: “was writing”→“wrote” (عادة في الماضي)، “take”→“took.” Structure: “Although … but” فيها connector مزدوج، فاحذف “but.” Conditional: “if … continue … will became”→“continues … will become” (الـ base verb بعد will). Plurals/articles: effect→effects، phone→phones.

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 3. Correct every error. “Pollution is one of the most serious problem in the world today. The main cause of it are the vehicles and the factories. In big cities, the air quality have become very poor, and many people suffers from breathing disease. Government should took strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we do something about this issue.”
items.answer: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
accepted: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
items.reason: Agreement: problem→problems (بعد “one of the most”)، cause … are→causes are، have become→has become (الـ subject هو “quality”)، suffers→suffer، disease→diseases. صيغة الـ verb: “should took”→“should take.” Articles: “the vehicles and the factories”→“vehicles and factories” بمعنى عام؛ “Government”→“Governments.” الـ mixed conditional صحيح أصلًا (“had acted … would not be … now”). وعبارة “It is high time” يأتي بعدها الـ past subjunctive: “we did” وليس “we do.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 4 (lightly flawed). Correct every error. “There is many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offers more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, the access to good education and healthcare are better. However, urban life also have its drawbacks, such as pollution and high cost of living. Despite of these problems, the majority of people still prefers city life.”
items.answer: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
accepted: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
items.reason: Agreement: “There is many”→“There are many”، offers→offer، “access … are”→“access … is” (الـ subject هو “access” وهو مفرد)، have→has، prefers→prefer (الـ subject “majority of people” يُعامَل هنا كجمع). Preposition: “Despite of”→“Despite” (بدون “of”). Article: “a high cost of living.”

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 5 (subtle errors + one range upgrade). Correct the errors, then add ONE high-band structure (an inversion, a cleft, or a nominalisation) where it fits. “Renewable energy has become more important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This is a positive development, but it is also expensive. Not only it reduces emissions, it also creates jobs. The transition will take time, but it is necessary.”
items.answer: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
accepted: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
items.reason: النص الأساسي دقيق تقريبًا؛ والتصحيح الأهم هو الـ inversion: “Not only it reduces”→“Not only does it reduce …, but it also creates” (ترتيب كلمات السؤال بعد “not only” في بداية الجملة). تحسينات اختيارية موضّحة: “increasingly important” لرفع الـ register، و“This shift” كـ subject مُحوَّل إلى اسم (nominalised) يربط الأفكار، و“the transition to clean energy” لزيادة الكثافة.

blocks: يُقيَّم Speaking بالمعيار نفسه Grammatical Range and Accuracy الذي يُقيَّم به Writing، لكن الهدف مختلف: مرونة متحكَّم فيها في الوقت الحقيقي، لا الكثافة الكتابية. أصلِح الدقة الأساسية أولًا، ثم أضف complex sentence واحدة و tense contrast واحدًا.
**لماذا هذا مهم:** كثيرًا ما يستعد المرشحون أكثر من اللازم لـ grammar في Writing، ويستعدون أقل من اللازم للمعيار نفسه في Speaking، حيث الهدف مختلف.
أدوات رفع المستوى في Speaking، مرتّبة حسب قيمتها
1. **أصلِح الدقة الأساسية أولًا** -- الـ agreement والـ tense والـ article، لأنها الأكثر كلفة في الدرجات.
2. **أضف complex sentence واحدة** -- clause بـ because أو although أو which لتربط فكرتين.
3. **أضف tense contrast** -- تنقّل بين الماضي والحاضر والمستقبل لتُظهر الـ range: I used to..., but now I...
إنجليزية منطوقة دقيقة ومرنة -- لا paragraph محفوظة. فـ complex sentence طبيعية واحدة و tense contrast واحد في إجابة Part 2 يفيدان درجتك أكثر من idiom محفوظ.

blocks.title: Exercise 10.2 · تحسين الـ Speaking Transcript
blocks.instructions: خمس إجابات منطوقة بسيطة لكن آمنة. ارفع كل واحدة منها band واحدًا بإصلاح الدقة الأساسية وإضافة complex sentence و tense contrast و hedging phrase، دون أن تبدو محفوظة.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 1. Raise this Part 1 answer one band, keeping it natural. “Yes, I like reading. I read many book. My favourite is story book. I read every day because it is relaxing.”
items.answer: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
accepted: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
items.reason: التصحيح: “many book”→“a lot of books”، “story book”→“fiction.” إضافة الـ range: clause بـ because، و hedging phrase (“I'd say”)، وتأكيد يشبه الـ cleft (“it's the best way … to unwind”)، مع رفع في الـ tense والـ register.

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 2. Raise this Part 1 answer one band. “I live in Dhaka. It is big city. There is many people. I like it because my family is here.”
items.answer: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
accepted: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
items.reason: التصحيح: “big city”→“a very large … city”، “There is many”→“there are a lot of.” إضافة الـ range: relative clause (“which is …”)، و contrast clause (“Although …”)، و reason clause (“because …”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 3. Raise this Part 2 answer one band. “I want to talk about my phone. I use it every day. It is very useful. I use it for call and internet. I cannot live without it.”
items.answer: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
accepted: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
items.reason: التصحيح: “for call”→“for making calls.” إضافة الـ range: افتتاح بـ cleft (“The possession I'd like to talk about is …”)، و relative clause، و hedging phrase (“honestly … I'm not sure”)، ولمسة conditional (“how I'd manage without it”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 4. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Yes, technology changed our life. Before, people did everything by hand. Now, machine do the work. I think it is good.”
items.answer: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
accepted: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
items.reason: التصحيح: “changed”→“has changed”، “life”→“lives”، “machine do”→“machines … handle.” إضافة الـ range: contrast clause (“Whereas … used to …”)، و tense contrast (عادة في الماضي مقابل الحاضر)، و hedging (“On the whole, I'd say”)، و concession (“though it does have …”).

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 5. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Government should help poor people. They can give money and job. If they do this, poverty will reduce.”
items.answer: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
accepted: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
items.reason: التصحيح: “Government”→“governments”، “poor people”→“people living in poverty”، “give money and job”→“providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities.” إضافة الـ range: second conditional (“If … were implemented … would be likely to fall”)، و hedging (“be likely to”)، و concession clause.

g11_review.title: 11. مفاتيح الإجابات، والفهرس التشخيصي، وروتين الامتحان
g11_review.group: الوحدة 4 · The Full Workbook (كتاب التمارين الكامل)
blocks: مرجع لتثبيت ما تعلّمته وليس تدريبات جديدة: كيف تراجع إجابة خاطئة، وفهرس تشخيصي لأكثر الأخطاء تكرارًا مع القاعدة الواحدة التي تصلح كل خطأ، وخريطة الـ chapter كاملة، وروتين التحرير الذاتي لمدة عشر دقائق في الامتحان.

كل تمرين في هذا الكورس يصحّح نفسه: عندما ترسل إجابة، تعرض لك المنصة النسخة الصحيحة، وسبب صحتها، وملاحظة باللغة العربية تشرح القاعدة الأساسية. هذا الـ chapter الأخير ليس مجموعة تدريبات أخرى، بل هو مرجع للتثبيت، المكان الذي تعود إليه عندما يتكرر خطأ ما، لتجد القاعدة الواحدة التي تصلح عائلة كاملة من الأخطاء. استخدمه كفهرس تشخيصي: حدّد الخطأ الذي تكرّره، ثم أعد قراءة القاعدة والـ chapter الذي جاءت منه.
عندما تخطئ في سؤال، لا تكتفِ بقراءة الإجابة الصحيحة ثم تنتقل. خصّص ثلاثين ثانية لتشخيص الخطأ، لأن نوع الخطأ نفسه سيعود في كتابتك.
اقرأ الـ model answer والسبب معًا، لترى القاعدة وهي تعمل، لا التصحيح فقط.
سمِّ نوع الخطأ: هل هو agreement أم tense أم article أم preposition أم structure أم مشكلة في الـ range؟
ارجع إلى الـ chapter الأصلي لهذا النوع (الخريطة في 11.3) وأعد قراءة القاعدة الواحدة التي تحكمه.
اكتب جملتين جديدتين من عندك تطبّقان القاعدة بشكل صحيح. فإنتاج الصيغة، لا مجرد التعرّف عليها، هو ما ينقلها إلى الـ grammar التي تستخدمها فعليًا.
11.2 أكثر الأخطاء تكرارًا، والقاعدة الواحدة التي تصلح كل خطأ
هذه هي الأخطاء التي تظهر أكثر من غيرها في الـ script التي يكتبها الطلاب البنغلاديشيون. إذا استوعبت هذا الجدول القصير، فستتخلّص من معظم أخطائك المتكررة.
الـ verb يتوافق مع الـ subject الحقيقي، لا مع أقرب noun.
الـ uncountable noun لا يأخذ a/an ولا يُجمع (plural).
السنة المنتهية تأخذ الـ past simple، لا الـ present perfect.
‘Since/for’ تأخذان perfect tense، لا الـ present continuous.
حروف جر من الترجمة الحرفية: discuss X؛ in my opinion.
حروف الجر مع البيانات (data prepositions): increase by؛ reach (بدون ‘to’).
الـ dependent clause لا يمكن أن يقف وحده (fragment).
الـ clause اثنان يحتاجان إلى أكثر من comma (comma splice).
خفّف الادعاءات المطلقة بالـ hedging: may، tend to، generally.
بعد negative في بداية الجملة، استخدم ترتيب كلمات السؤال (question word order).
11.3 خريطة الـ chapter (أين توجد كل قاعدة)
مطابقة الـ verb مع الـ subject؛ الحالات الثماني الصعبة
الـ tense الاثنا عشر؛ past simple مقابل present perfect؛ simple مقابل continuous
حروف الجر للزمن والمكان والبيانات (time/place/data prepositions)؛ الـ dependent preposition؛ تصحيحات أخطاء اللغة الأم (L1)
الـ clause؛ الـ adverbial clause والـ relative clause؛ fragments/run-ons/splices
الـ passive في كل الـ tense؛ الصيغ غير الشخصية (impersonal frames)؛ كتابة وصف العمليات (process writing)
الـ conditional الأربعة؛ قاعدة الـ if-clause؛ أدوات الـ hedging
الـ inversion بعد negative adverbial؛ it-clefts و what-clefts
verb/adjective → noun؛ الكثافة الأكاديمية والـ cohesion
التحرير الذاتي بست مراحل (six-pass)؛ رفع الإجابات المنطوقة band واحدًا
11.4 روتين العشر دقائق الأخيرة في الامتحان
في يوم الامتحان، لن يفيدك الـ grammar الذي بنيته إلا إذا تركت وقتًا لتطبيق التحرير الذاتي. خصّص آخر بضع دقائق من كل مهمة كتابة لمراجعة مركّزة، وطبّق مراحل Chapter 10 بالترتيب.
Task 1 (اترك نحو 3 دقائق): طابق كل tense مع الإطار الزمني للبيانات؛ افحص حروف الجر مع البيانات (by, from, to, of)؛ وتأكّد أن “the number of” و“the proportion of” يأخذان singular verb.

Task 2 (اترك نحو 5 دقائق): قم بمراحل الـ agreement والـ article والـ preposition؛ تأكّد أنه لا توجد “will” داخل if-clause؛ وتأكّد أن لديك تنوّعًا في الـ complex sentence وبنية واحدة نظيفة على الأقل من مستوى الـ band العالي.
Speaking (في الوقت الحقيقي): إذا سمعت نفسك تخطئ في agreement أو tense، فصحّح بسلاسة وتابع؛ فالتصحيح الذاتي النظيف علامة على التحكّم، لا على الضعف.

معرفة القاعدة وتطبيقها تحت الضغط مهارتان مختلفتان، والفجوة بينهما لا تُغلق إلا بعادة المراجعة التي يشرحها هذا الـ chapter. فالمرشحون الذين يشخّصون أخطاءهم المتكررة، ويعودون إلى القاعدة التي تحكمها، ثم يكتبون أمثلة صحيحة جديدة، يتحسّنون أسرع بكثير ممن يحلّون التدريبات مرة واحدة فقط. اعتبر كل إجابة خاطئة في هذا الكورس معلومة تخبرك بأي قاعدة واحدة يجب أن تراجعها. هذه الدائرة، من الخطأ إلى القاعدة إلى إنتاج جديد، هي ما يحوّل الدراسة إلى band أعلى.

المهارات التي يفيدها: Writing, Speaking
دائرة المراجعة: إجابة خاطئة → سمِّ نوع الخطأ → أعد قراءة القاعدة → اكتب جملتين صحيحتين من عندك.
روتين الامتحان: خصّص دائمًا الدقائق الأخيرة لتطبيق مراحل التحرير الست بالترتيب.
بهذا يكتمل الكورس. ارجع إلى تمارين أي chapter وتدرّب حتى تصبح الصيغ الصحيحة تلقائية؛ وستستمر المنصة في تقييمك وعرض السبب والملاحظة باللغة العربية لكل سؤال.

g01_agreement_1.title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement & Dasar-Dasar Kalimat (1/2)
g01_agreement_1.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Bagian-bagian penyusun kalimat dan delapan kasus agreement yang menentukan nilai Anda. Inilah peningkatan akurasi yang paling berharga dan paling mudah didapat di seluruh ujian.

Sebelum teknik khusus IELTS apa pun, kalimat Anda harus benar secara mekanis dulu. Modul ini memperbaiki empat kesalahan yang diam-diam menurunkan skor Anda di setiap baris tulisan dan ucapan Anda: verb yang tidak cocok dengan subject-nya, tense yang menempatkan kejadian di waktu yang salah, article yang hilang atau salah pakai, dan preposition yang salah. Tidak ada satu pun yang sulit. Semuanya adalah kebiasaan. Modul 1 menjadikan kebiasaan yang benar sebagai kebiasaan otomatis Anda, sehingga di Modul 2 Anda bisa membangun kalimat yang ambisius di atas dasar yang tidak membuang nilai.
1.1 Pertama, bagian-bagian penyusun kalimat (mulailah di sini walaupun Anda merasa sudah tahu)

Buku ini menganggap Anda belum tahu apa-apa, jadi kita mulai dari bagian-bagian kalimat. Anda tidak perlu menghafal istilah-istilah ini untuk berbicara bahasa Bangla, tetapi hampir setiap aturan di buku ini dijelaskan dengan istilah tersebut, jadi belajarlah mengenalinya.
Setiap kalimat dasar bahasa Inggris punya dua bagian wajib dan sering kali bagian ketiga:
Subject adalah orang atau benda yang dibicarakan dalam kalimat, yaitu yang melakukan tindakan. Dalam “Students study hard,” subject-nya adalah students.
Verb adalah tindakan atau keadaan. Dalam “Students study hard,” verb-nya adalah study. Verb be (is, am, are, was, were) menunjukkan keadaan, bukan tindakan: “The graph is clear.”
Object adalah orang atau benda yang menerima tindakan. Dalam “Students use the internet,” object-nya adalah the internet.
Urutan normal dalam bahasa Inggris adalah Subject + Verb + Object (S + V + O). Students (S) use (V) the internet (O).

Bahasa Bangla adalah bahasa Subject-Object-Verb. আমি ভাত খাই secara harfiah berarti “I rice eat,” dengan verb di paling akhir. Bahasa Inggris menaruh verb di posisi kedua, tepat setelah subject: “I eat rice.” Kalau kalimat bahasa Inggris yang Anda tulis terasa salah, hal pertama yang perlu dicek adalah apakah verb-nya bergeser ke akhir karena kebiasaan bahasa Bangla.

“Agreement” artinya sekadar kecocokan. Subject-verb agreement adalah aturan bahwa verb harus cocok dengan subject-nya dalam hal jumlah. Subject singular (satu) memakai satu bentuk verb; subject plural (lebih dari satu) memakai bentuk lain. Itulah seluruh idenya. Sisa bab ini membahas kasus-kasus di mana menemukan subject yang sebenarnya itu sulit.
Dalam tense present simple, verb berubah tergantung apakah subject-nya singular atau plural.
Perhatikan jebakan yang menjerat ribuan kandidat Bangladesh: -s punya arti terbalik antara noun dan verb.
Pada noun, -s berarti plural: one student, many students.
Pada verb, -s berarti singular: he works, they work.
Jadi kalimat yang benar sering punya -s di noun atau di verb, tetapi tidak di keduanya: The student works. (singular noun, verb diberi -s) / The students work. (plural noun, verb tanpa -s)
Verb be dan have tidak beraturan (irregular) dan harus dihafal:
The result is clear. / The results are clear. The number has risen. / The numbers have risen.

g01_agreement_2.title: 1. Subject-Verb Agreement & Dasar-Dasar Kalimat (2/2)
g01_agreement_2.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: 1.3 Kasus-kasus yang benar-benar menentukan nilai Anda

Aturan intinya mudah. Nilai hilang pada kasus-kasus di bawah ini, di mana subject yang sebenarnya tersembunyi, tersamar, atau letaknya lebih jauh dari verb dibanding noun lain yang lebih dekat. Kuasai delapan kasus ini dan Anda akan menghapus hampir semua kesalahan agreement dari tulisan Anda.
Kasus 1 · Kata-kata di antara subject dan verb
Verb cocok dengan subject yang sebenarnya, tidak pernah dengan noun yang paling dekat. Penulis cenderung tertarik ke kata yang paling dekat, dan biasanya itu salah.
The list of items are on the table.
The list of items is on the table.
Subject-nya adalah “list” (singular), bukan “items”. Coret frasa di tengah dan kebenarannya langsung terlihat: “The list … is.”
The quality of the answers were poor.
The quality of the answers was poor.
Teknik: temukan subject-nya, lalu dalam pikiran hapus setiap kata di antara subject dan verb. “The list of items is.”
Kasus 2 · “The number of” versus “a number of”
Pasangan ini sangat sering muncul di Writing Task 1, dan keduanya berperilaku berlawanan.
“The number of + plural noun” memakai verb singular (subject-nya adalah number, satu angka).
“A number of + plural noun” memakai verb plural (artinya hanya “beberapa”).
The number of tourists has increased since 2010. / A number of tourists were waiting outside the museum.

Kata-kata seperti government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff menyebut sebuah kelompok. Dalam IELTS academic writing, anggap masing-masing sebagai satu kesatuan dan pakai verb singular.
The government is planning three new policies. / The committee has reached a decision.

(British English kadang membolehkan verb plural kalau fokusnya pada anggota-anggotanya secara individu: “the team are arguing among themselves.” Untuk IELTS academic Writing, tetaplah singular dan konsisten. Ini lebih aman dan tidak pernah salah.)
Each, every, everyone, everybody, someone, anyone, nobody, either, neither, one semuanya singular, betapapun plural kata-kata di sekitarnya terlihat.
Each of the students has a laptop. (bukan “have”) / Everyone in the classes was present. / Neither of the options is acceptable.
Dengan connector berpasangan ini, verb cocok dengan subject yang lebih dekat, yaitu yang paling dekat dengan verb.

Neither the manager nor the employees were informed. (subject yang lebih dekat: employees, plural) / Neither the employees nor the manager was informed. (subject yang lebih dekat: manager, singular) / Not only the students but also the teacher was worried.
Kasus 6 · Compound subject yang digabung dengan “and”
Dua subject yang digabung dengan and hampir selalu plural.
The teacher and the students were in the hall. / Poverty and unemployment remain serious problems.
Pengecualian: kalau dua kata itu menggambarkan satu hal gabungan, anggap singular: “Bread and butter is a common breakfast.” Ini jarang muncul di IELTS.
Setelah there, verb cocok dengan subject yang sebenarnya, yang datang setelah verb.
There is a serious problem. (subject: problem, singular) / There are several factors. (subject: factors, plural) / There is a range of options. (subject: range, singular)
Kasus 8 · Uncountable noun, jumlah, dan struktur terbalik (inverted)

Uncountable noun dianggap singular dan tidak pernah diberi -s plural. Hafalkan kelompok kata yang sering muncul di IELTS ini sekaligus: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work.
The informations are correct and he gave many advices.
The information is correct and he gave a lot of advice.
Jumlah waktu, uang, dan jarak dianggap sebagai satu kuantitas, jadi memakai verb singular. Ten years is a long time to wait. / Five thousand taka is not enough.

Inverted structure (di mana verb datang sebelum subject) tetap cocok dengan subject-nya. Kalau kalimat dimulai dengan negative adverb seperti not only atau hardly, cari subject setelah verb lalu cocokkan. Hardly ever does the government reverse such a decision. / Only after 2010 did the figures begin to fall.
(Anda akan mempelajari inversion secara lengkap di Bab 8. Di sini, cukup perhatikan bahwa agreement tetap berlaku.)
Mengapa penutur bahasa Bangla membuat kesalahan agreement

Hampir setiap kesalahan subject-verb agreement yang Anda buat berasal dari satu fakta: verb bahasa Bangla tidak mengubah akhirannya agar cocok dengan subject singular atau plural seperti verb bahasa Inggris. Bentuk verb যায় (jay) sama persis untuk “he” dan untuk “they.” Bahasa Bangla menandai persona dan tingkat kesopanan, tetapi tidak mewajibkan perubahan singular-plural pada verb seperti yang dituntut bahasa Inggris. Karena bahasa pertama Anda tidak pernah melatih perubahan ini, telinga Anda tidak memberi peringatan saat perubahan itu hilang.

Error type 1 · -s orang ketiga yang hilang. Karena bahasa Bangla tidak menambahkan -s, pelajar menulis base verb di mana-mana.
✗ He go to the market every day. / The population increase rapidly.
✓ He goes to the market every day. / The population increases rapidly.

Error type 2 · “is / are” yang hilang atau salah. Bahasa Bangla sering tidak punya kata tersendiri untuk is dalam pernyataan sederhana (সে ভালো = “he good”), jadi pelajar menghilangkannya atau memilih bentuk number yang salah.
✗ Many people is using the internet. / The graph show that pollution have increased.
✓ Many people are using the internet. / The graph shows that pollution has increased.
Mengapa satu aturan ini membatasi band Anda

Subject-verb agreement adalah kesalahan yang pertama kali diperhatikan examiner, karena muncul di baris pertama hampir setiap jawaban dan terus berulang. Tulisan dengan kesalahan agreement yang berulang tidak bisa mencapai Band 7 di Grammatical Range and Accuracy, sebagus apa pun idenya, karena kriteria Band 7 mensyaratkan sebagian besar kalimat bebas dari kesalahan. Satu kesalahan agreement di setiap kalimat menghilangkan hal itu. Kerugian terbesar ada di Writing Task 1, yang penuh dengan subject seperti the number of, the proportion of, the figure for, dan semuanya singular. Memperbaiki agreement adalah peningkatan akurasi yang paling berharga dan paling mudah didapat di seluruh ujian.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: The number of visitors has risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists has fallen.
Task 2: Although the government provides free healthcare, demand continues to outstrip supply.
Speaking Part 2: My family lives in a small town, and each of my brothers has a different job.
Akhir Bab 1. Berikutnya Bab 2 (Penguasaan Tense & Ketepatan Waktu).

g01_agreement_practice.title: 1. Practice · Subject-Verb Agreement & Dasar-Dasar Kalimat
g01_agreement_practice.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Verb harus cocok dengan subject-nya dalam hal jumlah, bukan dengan noun yang paling dekat. Subject singular memakai bentuk verb dengan -s; subject plural tidak. Kuasai satu refleks ini dan Anda menghapus kesalahan agreement yang paling umum dalam tulisan Anda.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Subject-verb agreement diperiksa di setiap kalimat yang Anda tulis, jadi satu kebiasaan buruk di sini membuat Anda kehilangan nilai berulang kali.
Dalam present simple, **subject singular** (he, she, it, satu benda) memakai verb **+ s/es**: the student works.
**Subject plural** memakai **base verb**, tanpa -s: the students work.
-s punya arti terbalik antara noun dan verb: pada noun, -s berarti plural; pada verb, -s berarti singular. Kalimat yang benar jarang punya -s di keduanya.
The result is clear dibandingkan the results are clear; the number has risen dibandingkan the numbers have risen.

blocks.title: Exercise 1.1 · Identifikasi dan Koreksi
blocks.instructions: Setiap kalimat di bawah ini mengandung kesalahan subject-verb agreement, kecuali tiga kalimat yang sudah benar. Tulis ulang setiap kalimat yang salah dengan benar, dan untuk kalimat yang benar tulis “Correct.” Kerjakan dengan pena sebelum mengecek kunci jawaban.

items.prompt: The list of approved candidates are posted on the noticeboard.
items.answer: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
accepted: The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.
items.reason: Subject-nya adalah “list” (singular), bukan “candidates.”

items.prompt: Each of the students have submitted their assignment.
items.answer: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
accepted: Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment.
Each of the students has submitted their assignment.
items.reason: “Each of” selalu singular.

items.prompt: The government are introducing a new tax next year.
items.answer: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
accepted: The government is introducing a new tax next year.
items.reason: Collective noun sebagai satu kesatuan memakai verb singular dalam academic writing.

items.prompt: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the test.
items.answer: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
accepted: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.
items.reason: Dengan “neither…nor,” verb cocok dengan subject yang lebih dekat, yaitu “students” (plural).

items.prompt: The number of accidents on this road have increased.
items.answer: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
accepted: The number of accidents on this road has increased.
items.reason: “The number of” bersifat singular.

items.prompt: There is several reasons for this decline.
items.answer: There are several reasons for this decline.
accepted: There are several reasons for this decline.
items.reason: Subject yang sebenarnya, “reasons,” adalah plural.

items.prompt: A large amount of information were collected during the survey.
items.answer: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
accepted: A large amount of information was collected during the survey.
items.reason: “Information” adalah uncountable dan singular, jadi “amount … was.”

items.prompt: Ten kilometres are a long way to walk in the heat.
items.answer: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
accepted: Ten kilometres is a long way to walk in the heat.
items.reason: Satu jarak dianggap sebagai satu kuantitas: verb singular.

items.prompt: The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The committee has agreed on the final budget.
items.reason: “Committee” sebagai satu kesatuan memakai “has” yang singular.

items.prompt: The quality of the roads in rural areas are very poor.
items.answer: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
accepted: The quality of the roads in rural areas is very poor.
items.reason: Subject-nya adalah “quality” (singular), bukan “roads” atau “areas.”

items.prompt: Poverty and illiteracy remains major obstacles to development.
items.answer: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
accepted: Poverty and illiteracy remain major obstacles to development.
items.reason: Dua subject yang digabung dengan “and” bersifat plural.

items.prompt: Everyone in the two classes were given a certificate.
items.answer: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
accepted: Everyone in the two classes was given a certificate.
items.reason: “Everyone” bersifat singular.

items.prompt: Not only the manager but also the workers is unhappy with the plan.
items.answer: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
accepted: Not only the manager but also the workers are unhappy with the plan.
items.reason: Dengan “not only…but also,” verb cocok dengan subject yang lebih dekat, yaitu “workers” (plural).

items.prompt: The data collected over ten years show a clear pattern.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The data collected over ten years show a clear pattern.
items.reason: “Data” dianggap sebagai plural atau mass noun; “the data … show” dapat diterima dan konsisten di sini.

items.prompt: My knowledge of these topics are limited.
items.answer: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
accepted: My knowledge of these topics is limited.
items.reason: “Knowledge” adalah uncountable dan singular; subject-nya adalah “knowledge,” bukan “topics.”

items.prompt: A number of students has failed to register on time.
items.answer: A number of students have failed to register on time.
accepted: A number of students have failed to register on time.
items.reason: “A number of” berarti “several” dan memakai verb plural.

items.prompt: The population of the coastal cities have grown rapidly.
items.answer: The population of the coastal cities has grown rapidly.
accepted: The population of the coastal cities has grown rapidly.
items.reason: Subject-nya adalah “population” (singular), bukan “cities.”

items.prompt: Neither of the two proposals seem practical.
items.answer: Neither of the two proposals seems practical.
accepted: Neither of the two proposals seems practical.
items.reason: “Neither” bersifat singular.

items.prompt: Statistics is a subject that many students find difficult.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
Statistics is a subject that many students find difficult.
items.reason: “Statistics” sebagai nama mata pelajaran bersifat singular: “statistics is.”

items.prompt: The equipment in the laboratories need to be replaced.
items.answer: The equipment in the laboratories needs to be replaced.
accepted: The equipment in the laboratories needs to be replaced.
items.reason: “Equipment” adalah uncountable dan singular.

blocks: Ringkasan · Delapan Kasus Agreement yang Menjebak

Sebagian besar kesalahan agreement tidak berasal dari aturan inti -- melainkan dari delapan kasus tersamar di mana subject yang sebenarnya tersembunyi, tertunda, atau tergabung dengan noun lain. Pelajari delapan kasus ini dan hampir semua kesalahan agreement di essay Anda akan hilang.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Aturan intinya mudah; nilai hilang pada kasus-kasus di mana subject yang sebenarnya sulit dikenali.
**Kata-kata di antara subject dan verb:** abaikan saja -- verb cocok dengan subject yang sebenarnya, bukan dengan noun yang paling dekat.
**"The number of" (singular) vs "a number of" (plural):** the number of tourists has increased, tetapi a number of tourists were waiting.
**Collective noun** (government, team, committee): singular dalam IELTS academic writing.
**"Neither...nor", "either...or"**: verb cocok dengan subject yang lebih dekat.
**"There is / there are"**: cocok dengan apa yang datang setelah verb.
**Uncountable noun dan jumlah** (information, ten years): singular, walaupun terlihat plural.

blocks.title: Exercise 1.2 · Editing Essay IELTS
blocks.instructions: Paragraph di bawah ini berasal dari essay Task 2 Band 5.5. Di dalamnya ada sepuluh kesalahan subject-verb agreement. Temukan kesalahannya, lalu tulis ulang seluruh paragraph dengan benar.

items.prompt: Nowadays, the number of people who works from home have increased dramatically. There is many reasons for this change. First, technology allow employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offer flexible arrangements. However, some managers believes that productivity fall when staff is not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweighs the disadvantages, and this trend are likely to continue.
items.answer: Nowadays, the number of people who work from home has increased dramatically. There are many reasons for this change. First, technology allows employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offers flexible arrangements. However, some managers believe that productivity falls when staff are not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweigh the disadvantages, and this trend is likely to continue.
accepted: Nowadays, the number of people who work from home has increased dramatically. There are many reasons for this change. First, technology allows employees to stay connected from anywhere. Second, each of the major companies now offers flexible arrangements. However, some managers believe that productivity falls when staff are not in the office. In my opinion, the advantages of remote work outweigh the disadvantages, and this trend is likely to continue.
items.reason: Sepuluh kesalahan agreement: who works→work; have increased→has increased (the number bersifat singular); There is→There are; technology allow→allows; each of … offer→offers; managers believes→believe; productivity fall→falls; staff is→staff are; advantages … outweighs→outweigh; this trend are→is.

g02_tenses_1.title: 2. Penguasaan Tense & Ketepatan Waktu (1/2)
g02_tenses_1.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Peta dua belas tense, lima tense yang dihargai IELTS, dan dua pasangan penting (past simple vs present perfect, present simple vs present continuous) yang menjadi sumber hampir semua kesalahan tense.

Subject-verb agreement membuat verb Anda cocok. Tense membuat verb berada di waktu yang tepat. Di IELTS ini bukan soal grammar yang kecil; ini soal makna. Writing Task 1 menggambarkan data yang sudah terjadi atau sedang terjadi sekarang, Task 2 membuat prediksi dan generalisasi, dan Speaking terus berpindah antara cerita masa lalu dan rencana masa depan. Kalau Anda menaruh verb di waktu yang salah, Anda tidak hanya membuat kesalahan grammar, tetapi juga mengatakan sesuatu yang tidak benar tentang kapan hal itu terjadi. Itulah sebabnya examiner menganggap penguasaan tense sebagai tanda utama lompatan dari Band 6 ke Band 7.
2.1 Apa sebenarnya tense itu (tanpa asumsi apa pun)
Sebuah tense bahasa Inggris membawa dua informasi sekaligus:
Waktu: past, present, atau future. (Kapan hal itu terjadi?)

Aspect: simple, continuous, perfect, atau perfect continuous. (Apakah itu kejadian utuh yang sudah selesai, tindakan yang sedang berlangsung, tindakan yang terhubung dengan waktu lain, atau campuran?)

Tiga waktu dikali empat aspect menghasilkan dua belas tense. Kedengarannya banyak, tetapi kabar baiknya untuk IELTS: lima di antaranya mengerjakan sekitar 90 persen pekerjaan, dan bab ini menonjolkan lima tense itu sambil tetap menunjukkan peta lengkapnya supaya tidak ada yang membingungkan.
tindakan yang sedang berlangsung, belum selesai
tindakan yang terhubung dengan waktu sesudahnya; “sebelum sekarang / sebelum saat itu”
tindakan yang berlangsung sampai titik tertentu, dengan durasi
Pelajari seluruh tabel ini sekali supaya Anda bisa mengenali setiap bentuk. Lalu lanjut ke 2.3, di mana kita menonjolkan lima tense yang paling penting.
sedang terjadi sekarang; tren saat ini
tindakan masa lalu yang masih relevan; tren sampai sekarang
durasi tindakan yang berlanjut sampai sekarang
Prices have been rising for a decade.
kejadian selesai pada waktu yang sudah selesai
tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada satu momen di masa lalu
Sales were falling when the law changed.
tindakan masa lalu yang lebih awal sebelum tindakan masa lalu lainnya
durasi sampai satu titik di masa lalu
It had been raining for hours before it stopped.
prediksi; keputusan spontan; fakta masa depan
Demand will rise over the next decade.
tindakan yang sedang berlangsung pada satu momen di masa depan
By 2030, most cars will be running on electricity.
tindakan yang selesai sebelum satu titik di masa depan
By 2040, the city will have doubled in size.
durasi sampai satu titik di masa depan
By June she will have been working here for ten years.

p.p. = past participle (bentuk ketiga: go / went / gone; rise / rose / risen). Daftar irregular verb yang sering dipakai ada di Appendix A di bagian belakang buku. Pelajari sebagai hafalan tetap, seperti Anda mempelajari vocabulary.
2.3 Lima tense yang benar-benar dihargai IELTS
Dengan lima tense ini Anda bisa menggambarkan grafik apa pun dan menjawab pertanyaan Speaking apa pun dengan akurat. Kuasai dulu kelimanya sebelum memikirkan yang lain.
Present simple untuk fakta, kebiasaan, kebenaran umum, dan posisi/pendapat di Task 2.
Present continuous untuk hal yang sedang terjadi sekarang dan untuk tren saat ini.
Past simple untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai dan data grafik historis.
Present perfect untuk tindakan dan tren yang berlangsung sampai sekarang.
Future (will / going to) untuk prediksi dan rencana.
Dua pasangan di dalam lima tense ini menyebabkan hampir semua kesalahan tense. Sisa bab ini melatih dua pasangan itu, karena memperbaikinya akan menyelamatkan sebagian besar nilai tense Anda.

g02_tenses_2.title: 2. Penguasaan Tense & Ketepatan Waktu (2/2)
g02_tenses_2.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: 2.4 Pasangan penting 1 · Past simple versus present perfect
Ini adalah kebingungan tense yang paling umum bagi kandidat Bangladesh, dan sangat menentukan di Task 1.
Pakai past simple kalau waktunya sudah selesai, dan sering disebutkan: in 2010, last year, two decades ago, between 2000 and 2010.
Pakai present perfect kalau tindakannya berlangsung sampai sekarang, atau kalau waktu persisnya tidak penting: ditandai dengan since, for, over the past decade, recently, so far, already.
Past simple: The population rose in 2010. (tahun yang sudah selesai) / Present perfect: The population has risen since 2010. (dari 2010 sampai sekarang)
Tanda yang paling jelas adalah kata waktunya:
Tanda PAST SIMPLE (waktu yang sudah selesai)
so far, up to now, already, lately
The company has launched its first product in 2009.
The company launched its first product in 2009.
Tahun yang sudah selesai, past simple.
Since 2020, remote work became far more common.
Since 2020, remote work has become far more common.

Dalam bahasa Bangla, “আমি দেখেছিলাম” dan “আমি দেখেছি” bisa terdengar hampir sama, jadi biarkan kata waktu yang menentukan: waktu tertentu yang sudah selesai (in 2010, last year, ago) memakai past simple; since, for atau recently memakai present perfect.

Data yang terikat pada tahun di masa lalu memakai past simple; tren yang berlangsung sampai sekarang memakai present perfect.

Skill: Writing
Task 1: Sales fell in 2015 but have recovered every year since.
2.5 Pasangan penting 2 · Present simple versus present continuous
Pakai present simple untuk fakta permanen, kebiasaan, atau kebenaran umum. Ini adalah tense untuk sebagian besar topic sentence di Task 2 dan untuk deskripsi proses.
Pakai present continuous untuk sesuatu yang sedang terjadi saat ini atau tren sementara saat ini, terutama dengan kata-kata seperti currently, at the moment, these days, nowadays.
Present simple (kebenaran umum): Governments spend public money on healthcare. / Present continuous (tren saat ini): The number of remote workers is increasing steadily.
Kebenaran umum di Task 2: Many people believe that university education should be free. / Tren saat ini di Task 1: Demand for electric vehicles is rising sharply at present.
2.6 Bentuk future · will, going to, dan present continuous
Tiga bentuk mencakup masa depan di IELTS:
will + base verb: prediksi, fakta umum masa depan, dan keputusan yang dibuat saat berbicara. If this trend continues, sea levels will rise further.
be going to + base verb: rencana yang sudah diputuskan, dan prediksi berdasarkan bukti saat ini. The government is going to introduce a carbon tax next year.
present continuous: janji/pengaturan pribadi yang sudah pasti (kebanyakan di Speaking). I am meeting my supervisor tomorrow.
Untuk proyeksi di Task 1 (grafik yang meramalkan masa depan) dan konsekuensi di Task 2, will adalah andalan utama: Unless emissions are cut, the planet will face irreversible damage.
2.7 Tense perfect dan continuous yang setidaknya perlu Anda kenali
Anda tidak akan terus-menerus membutuhkan kedua belas tense, tetapi dengan mengenalinya Anda bisa membaca soal dengan benar dan menambah variasi (range) kalau memang wajar.

Past perfect (had + p.p.) menunjukkan mana dari dua kejadian masa lalu yang terjadi lebih dulu. Berguna dalam cerita Speaking Part 2. By the time the report was published, the situation had already changed.
Present perfect continuous (have been + -ing) menekankan durasi tren yang berlangsung sampai sekarang. House prices have been rising steadily for over a decade.
Future perfect (will have + p.p.) memproyeksikan perubahan yang sudah selesai pada satu titik di masa depan, kuat untuk prakiraan di Task 1. By 2040, the population will have doubled.

Pakai tense ini untuk variasi yang sungguhan, bukan hiasan. Satu past perfect yang akurat dalam cerita Speaking menunjukkan penguasaan; past perfect yang dipaksakan dan tidak cocok akan terbaca sebagai kesalahan.

Dua kesalahan continuous tense mendominasi tulisan kandidat Bangladesh. Keduanya berasal dari pemakaian bentuk -ing yang berlebihan, sebagian karena bahasa Bangla memakai bentuk continuous-nya lebih bebas daripada bahasa Inggris.

Error type 1 · Stative verb tidak bisa berbentuk continuous. Beberapa verb menggambarkan keadaan, bukan tindakan yang sedang berlangsung: know, believe, understand, mean, agree, want, need, prefer, like, love, hate, seem, appear, belong, own, contain, consist, depend, dan have kalau artinya kepemilikan.
✗ I am knowing the answer. / He is having two cars. / I am understanding your point now.
✓ I know the answer. / He has two cars. / I understand your point now.

Error type 2 · “Since” dan “for” memakai perfect, bukan present continuous. Tren yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut sampai sekarang memakai present perfect atau present perfect continuous, tidak pernah present continuous biasa.
✗ The population is increasing since 2010. / Prices are rising for the last five years.
✓ The population has increased / has been increasing since 2010. / Prices have been rising for the last five years.
Kerangka waktu menentukan menang atau kalah di Task 1

Di Writing Task 1, tense bukan akurasi tambahan; tense adalah tulang punggung jawaban. Grafik dengan rentang waktu di masa lalu harus tetap memakai past simple dari awal sampai akhir. Tren yang berlangsung sampai sekarang memakai present perfect. Grafik dengan proyeksi masa depan memakai will atau is expected to. Di Task 2, kebenaran umum dan posisi Anda sendiri memakai present simple, sedangkan konsekuensi dan prediksi memakai future.

Skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: Car sales peaked in 2015, have fallen every year since, and are expected to stabilise after 2025.
Task 2: Because cities continue to expand, housing shortages will worsen unless governments act now.
Speaking Part 3: Attitudes have changed a great deal recently, and I think they will keep changing.
Akhir Bab 2. Berikutnya Bab 3 (Article & Jenis Noun).

g02_tenses_practice.title: 2. Practice · Penguasaan Tense & Ketepatan Waktu
g02_tenses_practice.group: Modul 1 · Mesin Grammar Dasar dari Nol hingga Mahir
blocks: Dari dua belas tense bahasa Inggris, hanya lima yang mengerjakan hampir semua pekerjaan di IELTS: present simple, present continuous, past simple, present perfect, dan bentuk future. Kuasai kelimanya sebelum memikirkan yang lain.
**Mengapa ini penting:** Anda bisa menggambarkan grafik apa pun dan menjawab hampir semua pertanyaan Speaking dengan akurat hanya dengan lima tense.
**Present simple** -- fakta, kebiasaan, kebenaran umum, posisi di Task 2.
