blocks.title: Exercise 4.15.1 · Vocabulary মেলানো
blocks.instructions:
প্রতিটি term (১ থেকে ১০)-এর সাথে তার অর্থ (a থেকে j) মেলান। শুধু অক্ষরটি লিখুন।

a. a planned route or schedule for a trip
b. the friendly treatment of guests
c. a place to which someone travels
d. a short trip, often for pleasure
e. tourism that protects the environment
f. turning something into a business for profit
g. a place or feature that draws visitors
h. to involve oneself deeply in something
i. to go somewhere new or risky
j. to reduce something in quality

items.prompt: hospitality
items.answer: b
accepted: the friendly treatment of guests
items.reason: b. অতিথিদের সাথে আন্তরিক ব্যবহার।

items.prompt: itinerary
items.answer: a
accepted: a planned route or schedule for a trip
items.reason: a. একটি ভ্রমণের পরিকল্পিত রুট বা সময়সূচি।

items.prompt: destination
items.answer: c
accepted: a place to which someone travels
items.reason: c. যে জায়গায় কেউ ভ্রমণে যায়।

items.prompt: excursion
items.answer: d
accepted: a short trip, often for pleasure
items.reason: d. ছোট একটি ভ্রমণ, সাধারণত আনন্দের জন্য।

items.prompt: commercialisation
items.answer: f
accepted: turning something into a business for profit
items.reason: f. লাভের জন্য কোনো কিছুকে ব্যবসায় পরিণত করা।

items.prompt: ecotourism
items.answer: e
accepted: tourism that protects the environment
items.reason: e. এমন পর্যটন যা পরিবেশকে রক্ষা করে।

items.prompt: immerse
items.answer: h
accepted: to involve oneself deeply in something
items.reason: h. কোনো কিছুর মধ্যে নিজেকে গভীরভাবে ডুবিয়ে দেওয়া।

items.prompt: venture
items.answer: i
accepted: to go somewhere new or risky
items.reason: i. নতুন বা ঝুঁকির কোনো জায়গায় যাওয়া।

items.prompt: degrade
items.answer: j
accepted: to reduce something in quality
items.reason: j. কোনো কিছুর মান খারাপ করে ফেলা।

items.prompt: attraction
items.answer: g
accepted: a place or feature that draws visitors
items.reason: g. এমন জায়গা বা বৈশিষ্ট্য যা দর্শনার্থীদের টানে।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.15.2 · Essay-এর বাক্য পূর্ণ করা
blocks.instructions: এই topic-এর একটি term দিয়ে প্রতিটি Task 2 বাক্য পূর্ণ করুন।

items.prompt: Tourism can significantly ______ the local economy.
items.answer: boost

items.prompt: Travelling abroad helps ______ a young person’s horizons.
items.answer: broaden

items.prompt: Mass tourism can put a serious ______ on local resources.
items.answer: strain

items.prompt: Sensible regulation helps ______ fragile natural attractions.
items.answer: preserve

items.prompt: Cultural travel promotes greater ______ understanding between nations.
items.answer: cultural

blocks: **কেন:** এখানে target হলো boost the local economy, broaden one’s horizons, put a strain on, preserve attractions আর cultural understanding। এগুলো নির্দিষ্ট collocation।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.15.3 · Speaking অনুশীলন (Simulation Drill)
blocks.instructions: Part 3-এর প্রতিটি প্রশ্নের উত্তর ২–৩টি বাক্যে দিন। অন্তত একটি target idiom আর একটি collocation ব্যবহার করুন। তারপর model answer-এর সাথে মিলিয়ে দেখুন।

items.prompt: Why do you think international travel has become so popular?
items.answer: International travel has boomed because it broadens people’s horizons and offers a welcome change of scenery; once you catch the travel bug, exploring new destinations becomes hard to resist.

items.prompt: Does tourism do more good or harm to a country?
items.answer: It does both; tourism can boost the local economy and promote cultural understanding, yet mass tourism puts a strain on local resources and can degrade the very attractions people come to see.

items.prompt: Do you prefer package holidays or independent travel?
items.answer: I lean toward independent travel, because it lets you get off the beaten track and immerse yourself in local life, though a package holiday is more convenient if you are short on time.

v5_rule.title: কঠোর আলাদা রাখার নিয়ম
blocks: এই অধ্যায়টা একটাই নিয়মের ওপর দাঁড়িয়ে। Lexical Resource-এ নম্বর পাওয়া-না-পাওয়া অন্য যেকোনো একক অভ্যাসের চেয়ে এই নিয়মটাই বেশি ঠিক করে দেয়: informal idiom-এর জায়গা Speaking-এ, Writing Task 2-তে নয়। যে expression interview-তে আপনাকে নম্বর এনে দেয়, সেটাই essay-তে নম্বর কাটাতে পারে। এটা লেখার ধরনের ছোট কোনো পছন্দের ব্যাপার নয়; এটা register-এর নিয়ম, আর উঁচু band-এ ঠিক register-টাই পরীক্ষা করা হয়।

কেন এই ভাগটা এত কড়া, দেখুন। IELTS Speaking স্বাভাবিক, তাৎক্ষণিক ভাষাকে নম্বর দেয়। তাই ঠিক জায়গায় বসানো একটা idiom (it was a blessing in disguise, I was over the moon) বোঝায় যে আপনি সাবলীল একজন speaker-এর মতোই English ব্যবহার করতে পারেন। কিন্তু Writing Task 2 হলো একটা formal academic essay।

সেখানে idiom পড়তে হালকা, অগম্ভীর আর বেমানান লাগে। Idiom-টা যত চমৎকারই হোক, এটা আপনার লেখার সুরকে Band 6-এর দিকে নামিয়ে আনে। Examiner জানতে চান না “এই candidate idiom জানেন কি না।” Examiner জানতে চান “এই candidate জানেন কি না কোন ধরনের ভাষা কোথায় মানায়।”
**Task 2-এর জন্য নিরাপদ:** এটা কি পত্রিকার সম্পাদকীয় বা academic article-এ স্বাভাবিক শোনাবে? যদি হ্যাঁ, তাহলে essay-তে ব্যবহার করুন।
**Speaking-এর জন্য রাখুন:** এটা কি বন্ধুর সাথে আড্ডায় মানানসই শোনাবে? যদি হ্যাঁ, তাহলে এটাকে Writing Task 2 থেকে দূরে রাখুন।

**Phrasal verb:** অনেক phrasal verb নিরপেক্ষ, লেখায় একদম ঠিক আছে (carry out, bring about, result in)। Task 2 থেকে যেগুলো বাদ রাখবেন, সেগুলো হলো informal, idiom-ধরনের: get its act together, cough up, pull your socks up। সন্দেহ হলে একটা formal verb বেছে নিন (organise, pay, improve)।

v5_idioms_1.title: Speaking-এর ৫০টি idiom (১–২৫)
blocks: Interview-তে স্বাভাবিক শোনাতে এগুলো ব্যবহার করুন। Part লেবেল দেখায় কোনটা কোথায় সবচেয়ে ভালো মানায়। এগুলোর একটাও Task 2 essay-তে নেবেন না।
**once in a blue moon**: খুব কম, কালেভদ্রে। উদাহরণ: I eat out once in a blue moon.
**a piece of cake**: খুব সহজ। উদাহরণ: For me, cooking is a piece of cake.
**cost an arm and a leg**: খুব দামি হওয়া। উদাহরণ: Concert tickets cost an arm and a leg.
**a stone’s throw away**: খুব কাছে। উদাহরণ: My office is a stone’s throw away from home.
**a rip-off**: যেটার দাম অন্যায়ভাবে বেশি নেওয়া হয়। উদাহরণ: That cafe is a total rip-off.
**hit it off**: প্রথম দেখাতেই মিলে যাওয়া, ভাব হয়ে যাওয়া। উদাহরণ: We hit it off the moment we met.
**call it a day**: দিনের কাজ শেষ করা। উদাহরণ: By six, I usually call it a day.
**get the hang of it**: কোনো কিছু কীভাবে করতে হয় তা শিখে ফেলা। উদাহরণ: It took me a week to get the hang of it.
**lend a hand**: সাহায্য করা। উদাহরণ: I often lend a hand at home.
**money doesn’t grow on trees**: টাকা সীমিত, সহজে আসে না। উদাহরণ: My parents always said money doesn’t grow on trees.
**hit the books**: খুব মন দিয়ে পড়াশোনা করা। উদাহরণ: I need to hit the books this weekend.
**over the moon**: খুবই খুশি। উদাহরণ: I was over the moon when I passed.
**on cloud nine**: আনন্দে আত্মহারা। উদাহরণ: On my wedding day, I was on cloud nine.
**down in the dumps**: মন খারাপ, হতাশ। উদাহরণ: I felt down in the dumps after the result.
**butterflies in my stomach**: উত্তেজনা মেশানো নার্ভাস ভাব। উদাহরণ: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
**get cold feet**: একদম শেষ মুহূর্তে ভয় পেয়ে যাওয়া। উদাহরণ: I nearly got cold feet before the speech.
**a fish out of water**: নতুন পরিবেশে অস্বস্তি লাগা। উদাহরণ: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish out of water.
**the last straw**: সহ্যের শেষ সীমা, যার পরে আর সহ্য করা যায় না। উদাহরণ: The delay was the last straw.
**a blessing in disguise**: বিপদের মধ্যে লুকানো ভালো দিক। উদাহরণ: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
**the icing on the cake**: ভালো জিনিসের ওপর বাড়তি আরেকটা ভালো পাওয়া। উদাহরণ: The view was the icing on the cake.
**in at the deep end**: কোনো প্রস্তুতি ছাড়াই কঠিন কাজে নেমে পড়া। উদাহরণ: I was thrown in at the deep end on day one.
**burn the midnight oil**: অনেক রাত পর্যন্ত কাজ বা পড়াশোনা করা। উদাহরণ: Before finals, I burn the midnight oil.
**go the extra mile**: বিশেষ চেষ্টা করা, যতটা দরকার তার চেয়ে বেশি করা। উদাহরণ: Good teachers go the extra mile.
**pull your socks up**: চেষ্টা আরও বাড়ানো। উদাহরণ: I had to pull my socks up after the mock test.
**get the ball rolling**: কোনো কিছু শুরু করা। উদাহরণ: Let me get the ball rolling on the project.

v5_idioms_2.title: Speaking-এর ৫০টি idiom (২৬–৫০)
blocks: **get to grips with**: কোনো কিছু বুঝতে বা সামলাতে শুরু করা। উদাহরণ: It takes time to get to grips with a new city.
**a foot in the door**: শুরুর একটা সুযোগ। উদাহরণ: An internship gets your foot in the door.
**spread your wings**: স্বাধীন হওয়া এবং নতুন কিছু চেষ্টা করা। উদাহরণ: University lets young people spread their wings.
**keep up with the times**: যুগের সাথে তাল মিলিয়ে চলা। উদাহরণ: Businesses must keep up with the times.
**hit the nail on the head**: একদম ঠিক কথাটা বলা। উদাহরণ: You’ve hit the nail on the head.
**see the bigger picture**: পুরো পরিস্থিতিটা বোঝা। উদাহরণ: Leaders must see the bigger picture.
**think outside the box**: সৃজনশীলভাবে, নতুন ভাবে চিন্তা করা। উদাহরণ: Innovation means thinking outside the box.
**keep an open mind**: নতুন ধারণা মেনে নেওয়ার মন রাখা। উদাহরণ: It helps to keep an open mind.
**sit on the fence**: কোনো পক্ষ না নেওয়া। উদাহরণ: On this issue, I refuse to sit on the fence.
**a mixed blessing**: যার ভালো ও খারাপ দুই দিকই আছে। উদাহরণ: Social media is a mixed blessing.
**the best of both worlds**: একসাথে দুই রকম সুবিধা। উদাহরণ: Remote work offers the best of both worlds.
**every cloud has a silver lining**: খারাপের মধ্যেও ভালো কিছু আসতে পারে। উদাহরণ: Every cloud has a silver lining.
**on the same wavelength**: একই রকম চিন্তা করা। উদাহরণ: My colleague and I are on the same wavelength.
**in the same boat**: একই কঠিন অবস্থায় থাকা। উদাহরণ: During the crisis, we were all in the same boat.
**kill two birds with one stone**: এক কাজে দুটো সমস্যার সমাধান করা। উদাহরণ: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
**at the drop of a hat**: সাথে সাথে, কোনো দ্বিধা ছাড়াই। উদাহরণ: She would travel at the drop of a hat.
**add fuel to the fire**: খারাপ অবস্থাকে আরও খারাপ করা। উদাহরণ: His comment only added fuel to the fire.
**a needle in a haystack**: খুঁজে পাওয়া প্রায় অসম্ভব। উদাহরণ: Finding a quiet flat there is like finding a needle in a haystack.
**pull strings**: প্রভাব খাটিয়ে কিছু আদায় করা। উদাহরণ: He pulled strings to get the job.
**face the music**: নিজের কাজের ফল মেনে নেওয়া। উদাহরণ: Sooner or later, you have to face the music.
**bite off more than you can chew**: সামর্থ্যের চেয়ে বেশি দায়িত্ব নিয়ে ফেলা। উদাহরণ: I bit off more than I could chew last term.
**learn something the hard way**: কঠিন অভিজ্ঞতার মধ্য দিয়ে কিছু শেখা। উদাহরণ: I learned time management the hard way.
**in the middle of nowhere**: একদম দূরের, নির্জন জায়গায়। উদাহরণ: The resort was in the middle of nowhere.
**a change of scenery**: জায়গা বদলে মন ভালো করা। উদাহরণ: A holiday gives you a change of scenery.
**the trip of a lifetime**: জীবনের ভুলতে না পারা ভ্রমণ। উদাহরণ: Visiting the mountains was the trip of a lifetime.

v5_collocations_1.title: Writing-এর ৫০টি collocation (১–২৫)
blocks: এগুলো Writing Task 2-তে ব্যবহার করুন। প্রতিটাই formal এবং essay-তে মানানসই।
**it is widely acknowledged that**: অনেকেই সত্য বলে মেনে নেন যে। উদাহরণ: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
**there is no denying that**: এটা অস্বীকার করা যায় না যে। উদাহরণ: There is no denying that technology has reshaped work.
**a growing body of evidence suggests that**: দিন দিন বাড়তে থাকা গবেষণা দেখাচ্ছে যে। উদাহরণ: A growing body of evidence suggests that pollution harms cognition.
**it can be argued that**: যুক্তি দিয়ে বলা যায় যে। উদাহরণ: It can be argued that fees limit access.
**this essay will examine both views**: বোঝায় যে essay-টা দুই দিক সমানভাবে দেখবে। উদাহরণ: This essay will examine both views before offering an opinion.
**a widely held view**: একটি প্রচলিত মত। উদাহরণ: A widely held view is that competition improves standards.
**it stands to reason that**: এটা যুক্তিসঙ্গত যে। উদাহরণ: It stands to reason that better roads reduce delays.
**a compelling argument**: জোরালো, বিশ্বাসযোগ্য যুক্তি। উদাহরণ: There is a compelling argument for renewable subsidies.
**a valid point**: যুক্তিসঙ্গত একটা কথা। উদাহরণ: Opponents make a valid point about cost.
**proponents argue that**: সমর্থকেরা দাবি করেন যে। উদাহরণ: Proponents argue that automation raises productivity.
**critics contend that**: বিরোধীরা জোর দিয়ে বলেন যে। উদাহরণ: Critics contend that it destroys jobs.
**it is worth noting that**: একটা বিষয় খেয়াল করার মতো। উদাহরণ: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
**play a pivotal role in**: খুব গুরুত্বপূর্ণ, কেন্দ্রীয় ভূমিকা রাখা। উদাহরণ: Education plays a pivotal role in development.
**give rise to**: ঘটানো, কারণ হওয়া। উদাহরণ: Rapid growth gives rise to inequality.
**stem from**: কোনো কিছু থেকে উৎপত্তি হওয়া। উদাহরণ: Many problems stem from poverty.
**be attributed to**: কোনো কারণ দিয়ে ব্যাখ্যা করা যাওয়া। উদাহরণ: The decline can be attributed to weak demand.
**a contributing factor**: কয়েকটি কারণের মধ্যে একটি। উদাহরণ: Poor diet is a contributing factor in obesity.
**have far-reaching consequences**: ব্যাপক প্রভাব ফেলা। উদাহরণ: Climate change has far-reaching consequences.
**as a direct result of**: সরাসরি এর কারণে। উদাহরণ: As a direct result of the ban, sales fell.
**while it is true that**: একটা কথা মেনে নেওয়া (এটা সত্য যে…)। উদাহরণ: While it is true that costs are high, benefits outweigh them.
**contrary to popular belief**: সাধারণ ধারণার উল্টো। উদাহরণ: Contrary to popular belief, remote work can raise output.
**despite the fact that**: পুরো একটা clause দিয়ে ছাড় দেওয়া (যদিও…)। উদাহরণ: Despite the fact that it is costly, the plan is justified.
**on the one hand … on the other hand**: দুই দিক পাশাপাশি তুলে ধরা। উদাহরণ: On the one hand it saves time; on the other, it isolates people.
**to a certain extent**: কিছুটা, আংশিকভাবে। উদাহরণ: This is true to a certain extent.
**address the issue**: কোনো সমস্যার মোকাবিলা করা। উদাহরণ: Governments must address the issue urgently.

v5_collocations_2.title: Writing-এর ৫০টি collocation (২৬–৫০)
blocks: **tackle the root cause**: সমস্যার মূল কারণের মোকাবিলা করা। উদাহরণ: Lasting change means tackling the root cause.
**implement effective measures**: ভালো নীতি বা পদক্ষেপ চালু করা। উদাহরণ: Cities should implement effective measures against pollution.
**a viable solution**: কাজে লাগানোর মতো সমাধান। উদাহরণ: Public transport is a viable solution to congestion.
**weigh the pros and cons**: ভালো-মন্দ দুই দিক বিবেচনা করা। উদাহরণ: Policymakers must weigh the pros and cons.
**strike a balance between**: দুইয়ের মাঝে ন্যায্য মাঝামাঝি পথ খুঁজে বের করা। উদাহরণ: We must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
**take into account**: বিবেচনায় নেওয়া। উদাহরণ: Any policy must take into account rural needs.
**a significant proportion of**: উল্লেখযোগ্য একটা অংশ। উদাহরণ: A significant proportion of graduates work abroad.
**the vast majority of**: প্রায় সবাই, বেশির ভাগ। উদাহরণ: The vast majority of commuters use trains.
**in the long run**: সময়ের সাথে, দীর্ঘমেয়াদে। উদাহরণ: In the long run, prevention is cheaper.
**in the short term**: শিগগিরই, অল্প সময়ের জন্য। উদাহরণ: In the short term, costs may rise.
**an integral part of**: অপরিহার্য একটা অংশ। উদাহরণ: Art is an integral part of education.
**gain momentum**: শক্তি বা গতি বাড়তে থাকা। উদাহরণ: The movement has gained momentum.
**pose a serious threat to**: বিপদে ফেলা, গুরুতর হুমকি হওয়া। উদাহরণ: Rising seas pose a serious threat to coasts.
**have a detrimental effect on**: ক্ষতি করা। উদাহরণ: Stress has a detrimental effect on health.
**reap the benefits of**: কোনো কিছুর সুফল ভোগ করা। উদাহরণ: Future generations will reap the benefits of this investment.
**at the expense of**: অন্য কিছু ত্যাগ করে, অন্য কিছুর বিনিময়ে। উদাহরণ: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
**a case in point**: উপযুক্ত একটা উদাহরণ। উদাহরণ: Singapore is a case in point.
**to illustrate this**: উদাহরণ দিতে গেলে। উদাহরণ: To illustrate this, consider public transport in Tokyo.
**bear in mind that**: মনে রাখা। উদাহরণ: We must bear in mind that resources are finite.
**shed light on**: স্পষ্ট করা, আলোকপাত করা। উদাহরণ: The study sheds light on the causes.
**in light of**: বিবেচনা করে, এর আলোকে। উদাহরণ: In light of these findings, reform is needed.
**from my perspective**: আমার মতে। উদাহরণ: From my perspective, the benefits outweigh the risks.
**more often than not**: সাধারণত, বেশির ভাগ সময়। উদাহরণ: More often than not, early action is cheaper.
**by and large**: মোটের ওপর, সাধারণভাবে। উদাহরণ: By and large, the policy has succeeded.
**draw a firm conclusion**: স্পষ্ট সিদ্ধান্তে পৌঁছানো। উদাহরণ: It is difficult to draw a firm conclusion from limited data.

v5_practice.title: Practice · Register বাছাই ও idiom ঠিক করা

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Register ও Style বাছাই
blocks.instructions: নিচের প্রতিটি বাক্য এমনভাবে লেখা, যেন এটা Writing Task 2 essay-র অংশ। ঠিক করুন underline করা ভাষাটা formal essay-র জন্য ঠিক আছে কি না (তাহলে W দিন), নাকি এটা শুধু Speaking-এর (তাহলে S দিন)। প্রতিটি S-এর জন্য বাক্যটা Task 2-এর উপযোগী formal academic English-এ আবার লিখুন।

items.prompt: Nowadays, a lot of kids are glued to their phones around the clock.
items.answer: S - These days, many children spend excessive time on their smartphones.
items.reason: A lot of kids, glued to, around the clock - এগুলো সবই informal।

items.prompt: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: The government needs to get its act together on pollution.
items.answer: S - The government must take decisive action on pollution.
items.reason: Get its act together হলো informal।

items.prompt: This policy could have far-reaching consequences.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: At the end of the day, it is up to the individual.
items.answer: S - Ultimately, the responsibility lies with the individual.
items.reason: At the end of the day, it is up to - এগুলো informal।

items.prompt: Renewable energy plays a pivotal role in cutting emissions.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Fast food is a rip-off and bad for you.
items.answer: S - Fast food is both overpriced and detrimental to health.
items.reason: A rip-off, bad for you - এগুলো informal।

items.prompt: There is no denying that technology has transformed education.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Loads of people reckon that exams are unfair.
items.answer: S - A significant proportion of people believe that exams are unfair.
items.reason: Loads of, reckon - এগুলো informal।

items.prompt: Poverty can be attributed to a range of social factors.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Young people these days could not care less about tradition.
items.answer: S - Many young people today show little interest in tradition.
items.reason: Could not care less হলো informal।

items.prompt: Governments must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Social media is a double-edged sword, to be honest.
items.answer: S - Social media brings both clear benefits and serious drawbacks.
items.reason: To be honest হলো মুখের কথার hedge (কথা নরম করার ভাষা)।

items.prompt: This crisis stems from decades of underinvestment.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: If you ask me, the whole system is a mess.
items.answer: S - In my view, the current system is deeply flawed.
items.reason: If you ask me, a mess - এগুলো informal।

items.prompt: A growing body of evidence suggests a link between diet and disease.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Tourism can boost the economy, but it is a bit of a mixed bag.
items.answer: S - Tourism can boost the economy, though it brings mixed outcomes.
items.reason: A bit of a mixed bag হলো informal।

items.prompt: In the long run, prevention is cheaper than treatment.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: The rich should cough up more tax.
items.answer: S - The wealthy should contribute more in taxes.
items.reason: Cough up হলো informal।

items.prompt: It is worth noting that not all solutions are equally effective.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

blocks: **কেন:** informal idiom আর phrasal verb Task 2 essay-র register নামিয়ে দেয়। ফলে বাকি vocabulary সমৃদ্ধ হলেও Lexical Resource-এর নম্বর কমে যায়। Formal করে আবার লেখা বাক্যগুলো অর্থ ঠিক রাখে এবং academic সুর ফিরিয়ে আনে।

blocks.title: Exercise 5.2 · Idiom বদলানো
blocks.instructions: নিচের প্রতিটি Speaking উত্তরে একটা idiom আছে, যেটা ভুলভাবে মনে রাখা, ভুল জায়গায় ব্যবহার করা বা একদম ভুল। Underline করা অংশটা সঠিক ও স্বাভাবিক রূপে আবার লিখুন। সঠিক idiom-টা type করুন।

items.prompt: When I got the scholarship, I was on cloud seven.
items.answer: on cloud nine
items.reason: “cloud seven” নয়; সঠিক রূপ on cloud nine।

items.prompt: The final test was a piece of pie for me.
items.answer: a piece of cake
items.reason: “a piece of pie” নয়; সঠিক idiom হলো a piece of cake।

items.prompt: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish in the water.
items.answer: a fish out of water
items.reason: “a fish in the water” নয়। a fish out of water মানে নতুন পরিস্থিতিতে অস্বস্তি লাগা; “in the water” বললে অর্থ উল্টে যায়।

items.prompt: My university is just a stone throw from my house.
items.answer: a stone’s throw from
accepted: a stone's throw from
items.reason: “a stone throw” নয়; সঠিক রূপ a stone’s throw from (possessive)।

items.prompt: Learning to drive was a really steep hill at first.
items.answer: a steep learning curve
items.reason: “a steep hill” নয়; সঠিক idiom হলো a steep learning curve।

items.prompt: We managed to kill two birds in one stone by cycling to work.
items.answer: kill two birds with one stone
items.reason: “in one stone” নয়; সঠিক রূপ with one stone।

items.prompt: After the experiment failed, it was back to the painting board.
items.answer: back to the drawing board
items.reason: “the painting board” নয়; সঠিক idiom হলো back to the drawing board।

items.prompt: Honestly, I would travel at the drop of the hat.
items.answer: at the drop of a hat
items.reason: “the drop of the hat” নয়; সঠিক রূপ at the drop of a hat।

v6_intro.title: পুরো workbook: কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবেন
blocks: এই অধ্যায়ে বইয়ের সবকিছু পরীক্ষার পরিবেশে একসাথে কাজে লাগানো হবে। Part 1-এ ২টি অনুশীলন আছে: ২০টি sentence transformation, যেখানে সাদামাটা Band 6-এর বাক্যকে ঝকঝকে Band 9-এর বাক্যে তুলতে হবে; আর ৫টি সম্পূর্ণ Band 6 essay, যেগুলো আপনাকে Band 8.5 থেকে 9.0 মানে আবার লিখতে হবে। Part 2-এ model উত্তরসহ ৫টি পূর্ণ Speaking simulation আছে। কলম হাতে নিয়ে কাজ করুন, model পড়ার আগে প্রতিটি item নিজে চেষ্টা করুন, আর key-এর সাথে নিজের লেখা মিলিয়ে দেখুন - নিজেকে প্রশ্ন করুন, অধ্যায় ১ থেকে ৫-এর ঠিক কোন tool-টা আপনি কাজে লাগাতে পারেননি।
Model পড়ার আগে প্রতিটি item নিজে চেষ্টা করুন।

v6_transformations.title: Section 1 · ২০টি sentence transformation

blocks.title: Section 1: ২০টি Sentence Transformation চ্যালেঞ্জ
blocks.instructions: নিচের প্রতিটি বাক্য মোটামুটি Band 6.0 মানের। প্রতিটিকে একটা করে Band 9.0 মানের বাক্যে আবার লিখুন: vocabulary উন্নত করুন, মাতৃভাষা থেকে আসা ভুল ঠিক করুন, আর গঠন আরও আঁটসাঁট করুন। লক্ষ্য হলো নির্ভুলতা, শুধু লম্বা শব্দ নয়।

items.prompt: Nowadays, technology is a very important thing in our life.
items.answer: In the modern era, technology plays an indispensable role in our daily lives.
items.reason: Upgrade: very important thing-এর বদলে indispensable role।

items.prompt: Many people think that money can make them happy.
items.answer: Many people believe that wealth is the key to happiness.
items.reason: Upgrade: think-এর বদলে believe; money-র বদলে wealth; বাক্যটা আরও আঁটসাঁট।

items.prompt: Pollution is a big problem and it is very bad for our health.
items.answer: Pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Upgrade: big problem আর very bad - দুটো মিলে একটা নির্দিষ্ট collocation হয়ে গেছে।

items.prompt: The government should give more money to education.
items.answer: The government should allocate greater funding to education.
items.reason: Upgrade: give more money to-এর বদলে allocate greater funding।

items.prompt: A lot of students go abroad to get a good job.
items.answer: A significant proportion of students go abroad in pursuit of well-paid employment.
items.reason: Upgrade: a lot of-এর বদলে a significant proportion of; a good job-এর বদলে well-paid employment।

items.prompt: Cutting trees is a very bad thing for the environment.
items.answer: Deforestation has a detrimental effect on the environment.
items.reason: Upgrade: cutting trees-এর বদলে deforestation; very bad thing-এর বদলে detrimental effect।

items.prompt: Children spend too much time on their phones and it is not good.
items.answer: Children spend excessive time on their phones, which can be detrimental to their development.
items.reason: Upgrade: অস্পষ্ট not good-এর জায়গায় একটা নির্দিষ্ট ফলাফল বসানো হয়েছে।

items.prompt: Public transport can help to reduce traffic in the cities.
items.answer: An efficient public transport system can substantially reduce urban traffic congestion.
items.reason: Upgrade: help to reduce traffic-এর বদলে reduce traffic congestion।

items.prompt: Exams give a lot of pressure to students.
items.answer: Examinations place considerable pressure on students.
items.reason: Upgrade: give a lot of pressure to-এর বদলে place considerable pressure on।

items.prompt: Tourism is good for the economy of a country.
items.answer: Tourism makes a substantial contribution to a nation’s economy.
items.reason: Upgrade: good for the economy-র বদলে makes a substantial contribution।

blocks: **Task 2-এর প্রশ্ন (Opinion - মতামত):** Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

blocks.instructions: এই Band 6.0 essay-টা Band 8.5 থেকে 9.0 মানে আবার লিখুন: idea-গুলো একই রাখুন, কিন্তু ভাষা উন্নত করুন (L1 থেকে আসা ভুল সরান, বেশি ব্যবহৃত শব্দ বদলান, cohesive device ব্যবহার করুন, প্রতিটি paragraph-এ অন্তত একটা formal collocation যোগ করুন)। তারপর model rewrite-এর সাথে মিলিয়ে দেখুন।

items.prompt:
Nowadays, education is a very important thing for everyone. Some people think that university education should be free for all students. I am agree with this idea because it has many good points.

First, free university can help poor students. Many talented students cannot go to university because it is very costly. If education is free, they can also get a chance to study and get a good job. This is good for the whole country because it makes more skilled people.

But some people say that free education is a big problem for the government. The government has to spend a lot of money and this money comes from tax. Also, if university is free, maybe some students will not study seriously.

However, I think the advantages are more than the disadvantages. A country becomes strong when its people are educated. So the government should give importance on free education.

In conclusion, I agree that university education should be free because it helps poor students and it is good for the country.
items.answer:
It is often argued that university education should be provided free of charge to all students. I strongly agree with this view, primarily because it widens access and strengthens the economy in the long run.

The most compelling argument concerns equality of opportunity. At present, many talented young people are unable to attend university because tuition fees are prohibitively expensive. If higher education were free, these students could also pursue their ambitions and secure well-paid employment. Society as a whole would reap the benefits, since a larger pool of skilled graduates drives national productivity.

Admittedly, critics contend that free education places a heavy financial burden on the state, funded ultimately through taxation. They further argue that students may value their studies less when they cost nothing.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks are outweighed by the wider gains. A nation prospers when its population is well educated, and public investment in universities tends to pay for itself through higher earnings and tax revenue. Governments should therefore prioritise funding for higher education.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that university education should be free, as it removes financial barriers for disadvantaged students and yields lasting benefits for the country.
items.reason: মূল upgrade-গুলো: I am agree-এর বদলে I strongly agree; give importance on-এর বদলে prioritise; but-এর বদলে Admittedly এবং Nevertheless; একটা second conditional (if … were free … could); আর collocation: reap the benefits, place a burden on, drive productivity।

items.prompt:
There is a big debate about when children should start school. Some people think children should start school when they are very young. Other people think it is better to start later. In this essay I will discuss about both sides.

On one hand, starting school early has many good points. Young children can learn many things quickly. They also learn how to make friends and follow rules. This helps them in the future.

On the other hand, some people think early school is bad for children. Small children need to play and they should not have pressure. If they start too early, maybe they will not enjoy their childhood. Also, they can feel stress.

In my opinion, both sides have good points. But I think it is better to start school at a normal age, not too early and not too late. Children should learn but they should also have time to play.

In conclusion, there are different opinions about this topic. I think a balance is the best way for children.
items.answer:
There is considerable debate about the ideal age for children to begin formal schooling. While some argue that children should start as early as possible, others maintain that a later start is preferable. This essay will examine both views before giving my opinion.

On the one hand, an early start offers clear advantages. Young children absorb new knowledge remarkably quickly, and school helps them develop social skills such as making friends and following rules, which benefit them throughout life.

On the other hand, critics contend that beginning school too soon can be detrimental. Young children need ample time to play and should not face academic pressure prematurely; otherwise, they may lose the freedom of childhood and experience unnecessary stress.

From my perspective, both positions have merit, but the most sensible approach is to strike a balance: children should begin at a moderate age, neither too early nor too late, so that structured learning and free play can coexist.

In conclusion, although opinions on this issue differ, I believe a balanced starting age best serves children’s long-term development.
items.reason: মূল upgrade-গুলো: discuss about-এর বদলে examine; good points-এর বদলে advantages ও merit; bad-এর বদলে detrimental; strike a balance; on the one hand … on the other hand নির্ভুলভাবে ব্যবহার।

items.prompt:
Traffic congestion is a very big problem in many cities today. There are many causes of this problem and we can find some solutions also.

The main cause is that there are too many cars on the road. Nowadays, many people can buy their own car, so the roads become full. Another cause is that public transport is not good in many cities, so people prefer private cars. Also, roads are old and small.

This problem causes many difficulties. People waste a lot of time in traffic and it also creates pollution.

There are some solutions for this problem. First, the government should make public transport better so that people use it. Second, they can build more roads and flyovers. Also, they can make a rule to reduce cars in the city center.

In conclusion, traffic congestion is a serious problem but it can be solved if the government takes good steps.
items.answer:
Traffic congestion has become a pressing problem in many cities. This essay will outline its principal causes before proposing several viable solutions.

The primary cause is the sheer number of vehicles on the roads. As incomes rise, private car ownership has soared, leaving streets heavily congested. A further factor is inadequate public transport, which pushes commuters toward private cars, while ageing and narrow road networks compound the problem. The consequences are significant: commuters waste countless hours in gridlock, and vehicle emissions worsen urban air quality.

Fortunately, the issue can be addressed. Governments should first invest in efficient mass transit so that commuters have an attractive alternative to driving. Expanding the road network and building flyovers would ease the burden on existing routes. In addition, introducing a congestion charge would discourage private car use in city centres.

In conclusion, although traffic congestion is a serious problem, it can be substantially reduced if authorities implement effective measures, particularly by improving public transport and discouraging unnecessary car journeys.

items.prompt:
These days, more and more people are working from home. Some people think it has many advantages, but others think it has disadvantages. In my opinion, the advantages are more.

There are many good things about working from home. First, people can save time because they do not need to travel to office. So they can spend this time with family. Second, they feel relaxed and comfortable in their home.

But there are also some bad things. When people work from home, they can feel lonely. Also, sometimes it is difficult to focus because of family and other distractions. Some people also work less.

However, I think the advantages are bigger. With good discipline, people can do their work properly at home. Companies also save money on office rent.

In conclusion, working from home has both good and bad sides, but I believe the advantages are more than the disadvantages.
items.answer:
In recent years, remote working has become increasingly widespread. While it carries certain drawbacks, I firmly believe that its advantages outweigh them.

The benefits are considerable. Firstly, employees no longer need to commute, which saves a great deal of time that can instead be spent with family. Secondly, working in the comfort of one’s own home can reduce stress and improve wellbeing.

Admittedly, there are disadvantages. Remote workers may feel isolated from colleagues, and domestic distractions can make it difficult to concentrate; a minority may also become less productive without direct supervision.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks can largely be overcome. With sufficient self-discipline, most people can work just as effectively from home, and employers benefit too, since they can reduce expenditure on office space. On balance, the flexibility and savings that remote working offers are more significant than its shortcomings.

In conclusion, although working from home has both merits and limitations, I am convinced that its advantages, particularly greater flexibility and reduced commuting, clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

Nowadays, many people prefer fast food instead of home-cooked meals. There are some reasons for this and I think it is a negative development.

There are many reasons why people like fast food. The main reason is that people are very busy today, so they do not have time to cook. Fast food is quick and easy. Another reason is that fast food is tasty and cheap. Also, there are many fast food shops everywhere.

However, I think this is a negative thing. Fast food has a lot of fat and sugar, so it is very bad for health. It causes many diseases like obesity. Home-cooked food is more healthy and clean.

items.answer:
These days, a growing number of people favour fast food over home-cooked meals. This essay will explain why this shift has occurred and argue that it is, on balance, a negative development.

Several factors explain the trend. The primary reason is the hectic pace of modern life: many people simply lack the time to prepare meals, and fast food is quick and convenient. In addition, it is inexpensive and palatable, and outlets are now ubiquitous in most cities.

However, I regard this development as largely detrimental. Fast food is typically high in fat, salt, and sugar, and therefore has a harmful effect on health, contributing to conditions such as obesity and heart disease. Home-cooked meals, by contrast, are generally more nutritious and hygienic.

In conclusion, although people increasingly turn to fast food because it is fast and affordable, I believe the trend is a negative one, since it poses a serious threat to public health.

**Part 2 cue card · Describe a place you enjoy visiting.**
You should say:
• where it is
• how often you go there
• what you do there
• why you enjoy visiting it

I’d like to talk about a small hill town called Bandarban, in the southeast of Bangladesh. It isn’t exactly a stone’s throw away from where I live, so I only manage to go there once in a blue moon, maybe once a year, but it’s always worth the long journey.

What I love about it is that it’s completely off the beaten track. While a lot of tourists head to the crowded beaches, Bandarban is quieter and surrounded by breathtaking scenery: green hills, winding rivers, and tiny villages. When I’m there, I usually go hiking, explore the local markets, and just soak up the peace and quiet.

The main reason I enjoy it so much is that it gives me a real change of scenery. Living in a busy city, I’m always caught up in the daily grind, so escaping to the hills feels like a breath of fresh air. The last time I went, I reached the top of a hill right at sunrise, and honestly, that view was the icing on the cake. It was almost the trip of a lifetime, and I came back feeling completely recharged.
**Why do people enjoy travelling to new places?**

I think travel broadens people’s horizons. When you visit somewhere unfamiliar, you experience a different culture and way of life, which gives you a fresh perspective. For a lot of people it’s also a chance to escape their routine and recharge, so it’s really the best of both worlds: you relax and you learn something at the same time.

By and large, yes. Tourism can boost the local economy and create jobs, especially in remote areas. That said, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because mass tourism can put a strain on local resources and even degrade natural attractions, so it has to be managed carefully.
**Do people travel more now than in the past?**

Definitely. Air travel has become far more affordable, and social media makes distant places look appealing, so more people have caught the travel bug. In the past, international travel was a luxury; nowadays, it’s within reach for the average family.

v6_speaking_2.title: Speaking simulation 2 · Describe a skill you would like to learn.

**Part 2 cue card · Describe a skill you would like to learn.**
You should say:
• what the skill is
• how you would learn it
• how long it might take
• why you want to learn it

A skill I’d really love to learn is playing the guitar. I’ve wanted to pick it up for years, but I’ve never had the time to properly sit down and practise.

I’d probably learn it through a mix of online tutorials and a local teacher, because I think I’d need someone to help me get the hang of the basics. I imagine it would be a steep learning curve at first, especially learning the chords, and I’d have to burn the midnight oil to make real progress. Realistically, it might take a year or so before I could play a full song without stumbling.

The main reason I want to learn it is that music is a wonderful way to unwind after a long day. At the moment I’m caught up in the daily grind, and I think playing an instrument would help me relax and switch off completely. On top of that, being able to play at family gatherings would be the icing on the cake. Even if I’m never brilliant at it, I’d be over the moon just to strum a few tunes for the people I love.
**Is it better to learn a skill from a teacher or by yourself?**

It depends on the skill, but I think a teacher gives you a real head start. They can spot your mistakes and stop you from picking up bad habits. That said, teaching yourself builds discipline, so ideally you’d combine the two and get the best of both worlds.
**Why do some people find it hard to learn new skills as adults?**

More often than not, it comes down to time and confidence. Adults are busy and afraid of failing, so they give up before they really get to grips with it. Children, by contrast, learn through trial and error without worrying about looking silly.

Absolutely. I’d argue that schools place too much emphasis on exams and not enough on practical, transferable skills. Teaching things like budgeting or basic coding would equip students far better for real life.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn-টা পড়াশোনা আর চেষ্টা নিয়ে idiom-এর ওপর ভর করে (pick it up, get the hang of, a steep learning curve, burn the midnight oil, the daily grind, switch off, the icing on the cake, over the moon), সাথে স্বাভাবিক verb unwind। Part 3-এ register ওপরে ওঠে a head start, the best of both worlds, get to grips with, trial and error দিয়ে, আর essay-ধরনের collocation place emphasis on, transferable skills ও equip students দিয়ে। এগুলো দেখায় যে candidate হালকা গল্প বলা থেকে যুক্তিপূর্ণ আলোচনায় সহজে যেতে পারেন।

v6_speaking_3.title: Speaking simulation 3 · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.**
You should say:
• what it is
• how you use it
• how often you use it
• why it is so useful to you

The piece of technology I find most useful is, without a doubt, my smartphone. It sounds obvious, but I honestly couldn’t get through the day without it. I use it around the clock, from the moment I wake up to the moment I go to sleep.

I rely on it for pretty much everything: checking emails, navigating unfamiliar streets, paying bills, and staying in touch with family. Because so much information is at my fingertips, tasks that used to take hours are now a piece of cake. If I need directions, for instance, I no longer have to ask around; I just tap the screen and go.

The main reason it’s so useful is that it’s basically several devices rolled into one, so it saves me a huge amount of time. Of course, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because I can easily end up glued to the screen, but as long as I keep it in check, the benefits far outweigh that. For me, it’s genuinely a game changer, and it’s honestly hard to imagine going back to life without it.
**Has technology made people’s lives easier or more stressful?**

It’s genuinely both. On the one hand, technology has transformed the way we work and communicate, making everything faster. On the other, being constantly connected can be exhausting, and a lot of people struggle to switch off. So I’d say it’s a mixed blessing.
**Do you think people rely too much on technology?**

More often than not, yes. Many of us can’t navigate without a map app or even remember a phone number anymore. It’s convenient, but it does make you wonder whether we’re quietly losing some basic skills along the way.
**How might technology change the way we work in the future?**

I imagine automation will reshape the job market completely. A lot of routine tasks will be automated, which could render some jobs obsolete, but it should also create brand-new roles. The key will be helping people keep up with the times through proper retraining.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn-টা অনায়াসে কথা বলার মতো শোনাতে প্রযুক্তি-ধাঁচের idiom ব্যবহার করে (around the clock, at my fingertips, a piece of cake, a double-edged sword, glued to the screen, keep it in check, a game changer)। Part 3-এ আসে formal-ঘেঁষা collocation: transform the way we, a mixed blessing, reshape the job market, render obsolete, আর keep up with the times। এটা এমন একজন candidate-এর ভালো উদাহরণ, যিনি Part 2-তে আলাপের সুরে আর Part 3-এ বেশি বিশ্লেষণের সুরে কথা বলতে পারেন, কিন্তু কখনো essay-র মতো আড়ষ্ট হয়ে যান না।

v6_speaking_4.title: Speaking simulation 4 · Describe a time when you helped someone.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a time when you helped someone.**
You should say:
• who you helped
• how you helped them
• why they needed help
• how you felt about helping them

I’d like to talk about a time I helped a younger cousin of mine who was struggling with his studies. He was in at the deep end, preparing for a big exam, and he was really down in the dumps because he’d fallen badly behind.

I offered to lend a hand and tutor him a couple of evenings a week. We went through the topics he found difficult, and I tried to help him get to grips with the trickier concepts. It wasn’t always a piece of cake, because he’d lost a lot of confidence, so I had to go the extra mile to keep him motivated.

He needed help because both his parents worked long hours and couldn’t sit with him, so he’d basically been left to cope on his own. In the end, he pulled his socks up and passed with flying colours.

Honestly, I was over the moon when I heard the result. Helping him turned out to be a real labour of love, and seeing him succeed was the icing on the cake. It reminded me just how rewarding it is to give someone a helping hand when they need it.
**Why is it important to help others in society?**

I think helping others creates a stronger sense of community. When people lend a hand, it builds trust and mutual support, which benefits everyone. A society where people only look out for themselves tends to be far more divided.
**Should helping others be taught in schools?**

Definitely. Schools play a pivotal role in shaping a child’s character, so encouraging students to volunteer instils values like empathy and responsibility. If children learn to help early on, it usually stays with them for life.
**Do people help each other less than they used to?**

It’s hard to say, but many would argue that busy, urban lifestyles have made people more self-centred. That said, social media has also made it easier to organise help quickly, so in some ways the spirit of helping is alive and well, just in a different form.

**Lexical analysis:** এই long turn-টা একটা অভিজ্ঞতার গল্প বলে, তাই এতে স্বাভাবিক idiom ঘন হয়ে আছে: in at the deep end, down in the dumps, lend a hand, get to grips with, a piece of cake, go the extra mile, pull his socks up, pass with flying colours, over the moon, a labour of love, the icing on the cake, আর a helping hand। জোর করে না বসিয়ে একসাথে ব্যবহার করলে এগুলো সত্যিকারের সাবলীলতা বোঝায়। এরপর Part 3-এ আসে বেশি academic play a pivotal role in, shaping character আর instil values, যেগুলো সমাজ নিয়ে বিমূর্ত আলোচনায় মানায়।

v6_speaking_5.title: Speaking simulation 5 · Describe an environmental problem in your area.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe an environmental problem in your area.**
You should say:
• what the problem is
• what causes it
• how it affects people
• what could be done to solve it

The biggest environmental problem in my city is air pollution, which has become a really pressing concern over the last few years. On a bad day, the air is so hazy that you can barely see across the street.

The main causes are the sheer number of vehicles on the roads and the emissions from nearby factories. Because the city has grown so quickly, the infrastructure simply hasn’t kept up, so traffic is bumper to bumper for most of the day, and all those vehicles emit huge amounts of pollution.

It affects people in a big way. Many residents suffer from breathing problems, and children and the elderly are hit the hardest. Honestly, on some mornings it feels like the whole city grinds to a halt under a blanket of smog.

As for solutions, I think the authorities need to invest in public transport and gradually discourage private car use, perhaps through a congestion charge. Planting more trees and creating green spaces would help too. It certainly won’t be solved overnight, but if everyone plays their part, I’m hopeful things can improve.
**Whose responsibility is it to protect the environment?**

I’d say it’s a shared responsibility. Governments need to implement effective measures and regulate industry, but individuals also have to play their part by cutting their carbon footprint. Neither side can solve it alone.
**Are people today more environmentally aware than before?**

By and large, yes. People are far more conscious of issues like climate change, and going green has become quite mainstream. That said, awareness doesn’t always translate into action, so there’s still a long way to go.

To a certain extent. Renewable energy and cleaner transport are genuine game changers that could mitigate a lot of damage. But technology alone isn’t a silver bullet; it has to go hand in hand with real changes in how we live and consume.

**Lexical analysis:** এই topic-টা essay-র বিষয়ের কাছাকাছি, তাই long turn-টা স্বাভাবিক idiom (bumper to bumper, grinds to a halt, play their part) মিশিয়েছে এমন topic collocation-এর সাথে, যেগুলো অধ্যায় ৪-এও আছে (a pressing concern, emissions, infrastructure, invest in public transport, discourage private car use, congestion charge, green spaces)। Part 3 আরও বেশি যুক্তির ভাষায় যায়: implement effective measures, carbon footprint, going green, mitigate, a game changer, a silver bullet, আর go hand in hand। এটা দেখায় Speaking Part 3 আর essay vocabulary-র মধ্যে কাজের মিল কতটা, আর idiom-গুলো কথাকে মুখস্থ বলার মতো না শুনিয়ে স্বাভাবিক কথার মতো শোনায়।

v1_intro.title: बंगलादेशी विद्यार्थीको L1 Interference Fixer
v1_intro.group: अध्याय १ · L1 Interference Fixer (बंगालीको प्रभावले हुने गल्ती)
blocks: धेरैजसो बंगलादेशी candidate-हरूले सबैभन्दा सजिलो अङ्क यहीँ गुमाउँछन्। यो अध्यायका वाक्यहरू कमजोर विद्यार्थीले लेख्दैनन्। यी वाक्य राम्रा, धाराप्रवाह बोल्ने विद्यार्थीहरूले लेख्छन् - जसको English-लाई भित्रभित्रै चुपचाप बंगाली भाषाले आकार दिइरहेको हुन्छ।

तलको हरेक गल्ती वास्तवमा एकदम सही बंगाली सोचको हुबहु अनुवाद हो। समस्या बंगाली भाषामा होइन। समस्या भनेको बंगाली वाक्यको बनावटलाई शब्द-शब्द गरेर English-मा लैजानु हो - र examiner-ले यो तुरुन्तै चिनिहाल्छन्।

यसलाई first-language (L1) interference भनिन्छ, अर्थात् मातृभाषाको प्रभाव। यो गल्ती पहिल्यै अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ, यसको एउटा निश्चित pattern हुन्छ - र pattern भएकैले यसलाई सुधार्न सकिन्छ। सबै ३० वटा गल्ती ध्यान दिएर पढ्नुहोस्, र तीमध्ये कुन-कुन तपाईं आफैँ गर्नुहुन्छ भनेर टिपेर राख्नुहोस्।

त्यसपछि अन्तिमका दुई वटा exercise set answer key हेर्नुअघि कलम लिएर गर्नुहोस्। हरेक गल्तीमा तपाईंले ५ वटा कुरा पाउनुहुन्छ: गलत वाक्य, त्यो गल्ती जन्माउने बंगाली logic, Band 9 स्तरको सही रूप, ठ्याक्कै कुन grammar वा शब्दको नियम, र यो गल्तीले तपाईंलाई कति नोक्सान गर्छ भन्ने बारेमा examiner-को दृष्टिकोण।

v1_errors_1.title: ३० वटा मुख्य गल्ती (१–१०)
v1_errors_1.group: अध्याय १ · L1 Interference Fixer (बंगालीको प्रभावले हुने गल्ती)
blocks: I discussed about the problem with my teacher.
I discussed the problem with my teacher.

Discuss एउटा transitive verb हो: यसको पछाडि कुनै preposition बिना सिधै object आउँछ। enter, approach, reach, marry, request र lack-मा पनि यही नियम लाग्छ। तपाईं discuss a problem भन्नुहुन्छ, discuss about a problem होइन। noun प्रयोग गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने have a discussion about भन्नुहोस्।
আমি শিক্ষকের সাথে সমস্যাটি নিয়ে আলোচনা করেছি. यहाँ নিয়ে (niye) शब्दले “about”-को अर्थ बोक्छ, त्यसैले विद्यार्थीहरू discuss-सँग about जोडिदिन्छन्।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** यो एउटै preposition बंगलादेशी candidate-को लेखाइ चिन्ने सबैभन्दा भरपर्दो चिह्नमध्ये एक हो। यो Grammatical Range and Accuracy र Lexical Resource दुवैमा पर्छ, किनभने यो collocation-को गल्ती हो। एक पटक भए त्यो slip हो; बारम्बार भए यो पक्का बानी बनिसकेको देखिन्छ, र त्यसले तपाईंलाई Band 6.5-मै रोकिराख्छ।
The writer emphasised on the need for reform.
The writer emphasised the need for reform. / The writer placed emphasis on the need for reform.
Emphasise transitive हो र यसपछि कुनै preposition आउँदैन। on चाहिँ noun रूपसँग मात्र आउँछ: place emphasis on, put stress on। कुनै एउटा बनावट रोज्नुहोस्; दुवैलाई मिसाउनुहुँदैन।
লেখক সংস্কারের প্রয়োজনীয়তার উপর জোর দিয়েছেন. জোর দেওয়া (jor deoa, “to give stress”)-सँग উপর (upor, “on”) आउँछ, त्यसैले English-मा पनि on सर्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** कुनै लेख वा policy-ले के “highlight” गर्छ भन्ने Task 2 essay-हरूमा यो निरन्तर आउँछ। यसलाई सही लेख्दा examiner-ले बुझ्छन् कि एउटै विचारको verb र noun दुवै रूप तपाईंको नियन्त्रणमा छन् - Band 7-ले ठ्याक्कै यही flexibility-लाई पुरस्कृत गर्छ।
We reached to the station just before the train left.
We reached the station just before the train left. / We arrived at the station just in time.
Reach transitive हो: reach a place, कुनै preposition चाहिँदैन। arrive रोज्नुहुन्छ भने यसपछि at (कुनै एउटा ठाउँ) वा in (ठूलो क्षेत्र) आउँछ: arrive at the station, arrive in Dhaka।
আমরা স্টেশনে পৌঁছেছি. স্টেশন-मा लागेको स्थान बुझाउने प्रत्यय ে (-e, “to/at”) English-मा to बन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Reach to सानो तर धेरै देखिने गल्ती हो, खासगरी Speaking Part 2-को कथा भन्दा। यसलाई सुधार्दा तपाईंको कथा भनाइबाट बारम्बार लाग्ने accuracy penalty हट्छ।
My cousin is married with a doctor.
My cousin is married to a doctor.
निश्चित collocation married to हो, married with कहिल्यै होइन। अर्को व्यक्तिसँग मिलेर केही गर्दा with आउँछ, तर विवाह भएको व्यक्तिको लागि married to भनिन्छ। engaged to, related to-सँग तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
আমার চাচাতো ভাইয়ের একজন ডাক্তারের সাথে বিয়ে হয়েছে. সাথে (shathe)-को अर्थ “with” हो, त्यसैले married-पछि with आउँछ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** नातासम्बन्धका शब्द Speaking Part 1 (family)-मा निरन्तर आउँछन्। यहाँको collocation slip एक्लै हेर्दा सानो हो, तर स्वाभाविक शब्द-जोडी सुन्न खोजिरहेका examiner-लाई यो सम्झनामा रहन्छ।
My manager is senior than me.
My manager is senior to me. / My manager is more experienced than I am.
Latin-बाट आएका केही comparative adjective-पछि than होइन, to आउँछ: senior to, junior to, superior to, inferior to, prior to। सामान्य comparative (bigger, faster)-पछि मात्र than आउँछ।
আমার ম্যানেজার আমার থেকে সিনিয়র. থেকে (theke)-को अर्थ “from” र “than” दुवै हो, त्यसैले विद्यार्थीहरू senior-पछि than प्रयोग गर्छन्।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** superior to र prior to सही प्रयोग गर्नु Band 7.5-को एउटा शान्त संकेत हो। यसले कम प्रचलित शब्द र तिनका collocation-को जानकारी देखाउँछ, जसलाई band descriptor-ले सिधै पुरस्कृत गर्छ।
I prefer reading books than watching television.
I prefer reading books to watching television.
Prefer-पछि than होइन, to आउँछ: prefer A to B। दुवै option verb भए दुवैलाई एउटै रूपमा राख्नुहोस्: prefer reading to watching। अर्को बनावट would rather read than watch हो, जहाँ than सही हो।
আমি টেলিভিশন দেখার থেকে বই পড়া বেশি পছন্দ করি. यहाँ पनि থেকে (theke, “than/from”)-ले than तानेर ल्याउँछ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Prefer Speaking Part 1-मा धेरै प्रयोग हुने verb हो। prefer to pattern यो अध्यायको सबैभन्दा फाइदाजनक सुधारमध्ये एक हो, किनभने तपाईं यसलाई लगभग हरेक interview-मा प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ।
She is very good in mathematics and physics.
She is very good at mathematics and physics.
सीप बुझाउने adjective-पछि at आउँछ: good at, skilled at, talented at, poor at। in चाहिँ पूरै विषय-क्षेत्रका लागि मात्र, फरक बनावटमा प्रयोग हुन्छ (a degree in physics)।
সে অঙ্ক আর পদার্থবিজ্ঞানে খুব ভালো. विषयका नाममा लागेको स्थान बुझाउने ে (-e, “in”) in बन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Speaking Part 1 (study and work)-मा क्षमताको वर्णन गर्नैपर्छ। Good at र good in adjective-plus-preposition-को क्लासिक परीक्षा हो, र यहाँ लगातार सही हुँदा तपाईंको collocation profile माथि उठ्छ।
My teacher gave me a very useful advice.
My teacher gave me a very useful piece of advice. / My teacher gave me some very useful advice.
Advice uncountable हो: a/an लाग्दैन, plural -s लाग्दैन, र verb singular हुन्छ। गन्नुपर्यो भने partitive प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्: a piece of advice, two pieces of advice।
আমার শিক্ষক আমাকে একটি খুব দরকারি উপদেশ দিয়েছেন. উপদেশ (upodesh, “advice”) बंगालीमा countable हो, त्यसैले একটি (ekti, “a/one”) जोडिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Uncountable noun-को नियन्त्रण यत्तिकै होइन, कारणले नै South Asian गल्तीहरूको checklist-मा छ। a advice वा advices लेख्नु तुरुन्तै Band 6-को word-formation चिह्न हो; piece of लगाएर सुधार्दा तपाईंलाई नियम थाहा छ भन्ने देखिन्छ।
The library provides many informations and equipments.
The library provides a great deal of information and equipment.

Information, equipment, furniture, research, knowledge, accommodation, traffic र progress सबै English-मा uncountable हुन्। यिनमा कहिल्यै -s लाग्दैन। मात्रा बुझाउन a great deal of, a large amount of वा much प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
লাইব্রেরি অনেক তথ্য এবং সরঞ্জাম সরবরাহ করে. তথ্য (tottho) र সরঞ্জাম (shoronjam) बंगालीमा countable जस्तै व्यवहार गर्छन्, त्यसैले English-को plural -s थपिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** यी आठ वटा शब्द लगभग हरेक academic essay-मा आउँछन्। यीमध्ये एउटैलाई पनि बारम्बार plural बनाउँदा Lexical Resource Band 6-मा झर्न सक्छ, किनभने word formation त्यही criterion भित्र मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ।
I am completely agree with this statement.
I completely agree with this statement. / I am in complete agreement with this statement.
Agree पूर्ण verb हो, adjective होइन। यसको साथमा am/is/are आउँदैन। कि verb प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् (I agree), कि noun phrase (I am in agreement)। am agree कहिल्यै होइन।
আমি এই বক্তব্যের সাথে সম্পূর্ণ একমত. একমত (ekmot) “सहमत” हुनुको अवस्था हो, जुन adjective जस्तो लाग्छ, त्यसैले विद्यार्थीहरू am थपिदिन्छन्।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Agree-and-disagree essay सबैभन्दा धेरै आउने Task 2 प्रकार हो। पहिलो वाक्यमै I am agree लेख्दा examiner-ले तपाईंको तर्क पढ्नुअघि नै Band 5.5-को grammar profile देख्छन्। यो धेरै मूल्यवान सुधार हो।

v1_errors_2.title: ३० वटा मुख्य गल्ती (११–२०)
v1_errors_2.group: अध्याय १ · L1 Interference Fixer (बंगालीको प्रभावले हुने गल्ती)
blocks: Everybody in my office are working overtime this week.
Everybody in my office is working overtime this week.
Everybody, everyone, somebody, nobody, each र neither grammar-को हिसाबले singular हुन् र यिनपछि singular verb आउँछ, जतिसुकै मानिसको कुरा गरून्। बीचमा आउने phrase (in my office)-ले यो नियम बदल्दैन।
আমার অফিসের সবাই এই সপ্তাহে অতিরিক্ত সময় কাজ করছে. সবাই (shobai, “everybody”)-ले धेरै मानिसलाई जनाउँछ, त्यसैले verb plural जस्तो लाग्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Indefinite pronoun-सँग subject-verb agreement Band 6-को एउटा बारम्बार हुने slip हो। यो पूरै लेखाइभरि दोहोरिने भएकाले यहाँ एउटा सही बानी बसाल्दा हरेक paragraph-मा अङ्क जोगिन्छ।
One of my friend is studying in Canada.
One of my friends is studying in Canada.
one of-पछि noun plural हुनैपर्छ (one of my friends), किनभने तपाईं एउटा समूहबाट एक जना छान्दै हुनुहुन्छ। तर verb भने singular नै रहन्छ, किनभने वास्तविक subject one हो: one of my friends is।
আমার এক বন্ধু কানাডায় পড় ছে. এক বন্ধু (ek bondhu, “one friend”) बंगालीमा singular हो, त्यसैले friend singular नै रहन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** यो दुई भागको trap हो: noun plural, verb singular। candidate-हरूले प्रायः एउटा भाग सुधार्छन् र अर्को छुटाउँछन्। दुवै सही हुनु Speaking Part 1-मा Band 7-को स्पष्ट accuracy संकेत हो।
Every students must bring their identity card.
Every student must bring their identity card. / All students must bring their identity cards.
Every र each-पछि सधैँ singular noun र singular verb आउँछ: every student is। plural noun चाहिन्छ भने determiner बदलेर all बनाउनुहोस्: all students are।
প্রত্যেক ছাত্রকে তাদের পরিচয়পত্র আনতে হবে. बंगाली noun-लाई plural रूपमा बाँध्नुपर्दैन, त्यसैले ছাত্র (chhatro, “student”)-लाई लचिलो रूपमा बुझिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Every-सँग plural noun राख्नु countability-को आधारभूत गल्ती हो, जसले Grammatical Range and Accuracy-लाई छिट्टै सीमित गर्छ। मनमा every-लाई singular-सँग जोडिदिएपछि यो सुधार यान्त्रिक रूपमै हुन्छ।
The number of road accidents are increasing every year.
The number of road accidents is increasing every year.

यो वाक्यको subject number (singular) हो, accidents होइन। The number of + plural noun-पछि singular verb आउँछ। यसको तुलनामा a number of + plural noun-को अर्थ “several” (केही/धेरै) हो र यसपछि plural verb आउँछ: a number of accidents are unreported।
সড় ক দুর্ঘটনার সংখ্যা প্রতি বছর বাড় ছে. plural अर्थ “accidents” verb-को ठीक अगाडि बस्छ र verb-लाई plural तर्फ तान्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** यही phrase, the number of, Task 1-मा सधैँ काम लाग्ने phrase हो। यसमा agreement सही गर्नु data description-मा पाइने सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट देखिने accuracy जितमध्ये एक हो।
Despite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.
Despite the heavy rain, the ceremony continued. / In spite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.

Despite-पछि of आउँदैन। In spite of-मा भने of रहन्छ। दुवैपछि noun वा -ing रूप आउँछ, पूरा clause कहिल्यै आउँदैन। पूरा clause-का लागि although प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्: Although it rained heavily, the ceremony continued.
ভারী বৃষ্টি সত্ত্বেও, অনুষ্ঠান চলতে থাকল. সত্ত্বেও (sotteo)-को अनुवाद “in spite of” हुन्छ, त्यसैले विद्यार्थीहरू दुईलाई मिसाएर despite of बनाउँछन्।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** despite of मिश्रण बंगलादेशी Task 2 लेखाइमा concession-सम्बन्धी सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्तीमध्ये एक हो। concession essay-को मुख्य चाल भएकाले यो गल्ती धेरै देखिन्छ, त्यसैले यसलाई पूरै हटाउनु लायक छ।
After his studies, he returned back to his hometown.
After his studies, he returned to his hometown.
Return-को अर्थ नै “go back” (फर्केर जानु) हो, त्यसैले returned back दोहोरो हो। repeat again, revert back, reverse back र ascend up-मा पनि यस्तै दोहोरोपन हुन्छ। एउटै verb प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
পড়াশোনা শেষে সে তার নিজ শহরে ফিরে গেছে. ফিরে যাওয়া (phire jaoa)-मा नै “फर्केर जानु”-को अर्थ छ, त्यसैले English-मा माथिबाट back थपिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** दोहोरोपन Lexical Resource-को कमजोरी हो: यसले शब्दको अर्थ पूरा आत्मसात् भएको छैन भन्ने देखाउँछ। यस्ता दोहोरो शब्द हटाउँदा तपाईंको लेखाइ कसिलो र सटीक हुन्छ, जुन ठ्याक्कै Band 8-को “conveying precise meaning” गुण हो।
Students must learn to cope up with academic pressure.
Students must learn to cope with academic pressure.
सही verb cope with हो, up बिना। बीचमा घुस्ने up एउटा South Asian क्षेत्रीय बानी हो। सही put up with (सहनु)-सँग तुलना गर्नुहोस्, जुन साँच्चै फरक phrasal verb हो।
শিক্ষার্থীদের শিক্ষাগত চাপের সাথে খাপ খাওয়াতে শিখতে হবে. बंगालीमा कुनै up छैन; keep up, put up with जस्ता अरू phrasal verb-सँगको गलत तुलनाले up थपिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Phrasal verb-को accuracy Lexical Resource अन्तर्गत मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ। Cope up with-लाई examiner-ले तुरुन्तै क्षेत्रीय गल्तीको रूपमा चिन्छन्, त्यसैले यसलाई हटाउँदा तपाईंको Speaking band निर्भर रहने स्वाभाविक, native जस्तो गुण अझ तिखो हुन्छ।
The committee comprises of twelve senior members.
The committee comprises twelve senior members. / The committee is composed of twelve senior members. / The committee consists of twelve senior members.
Comprise transitive हो र यसपछि of आउँदैन। of चाहिँ consist of र be composed of-सँग आउँछ। यिनलाई मिसाएर comprises of कहिल्यै नबनाउनुहोस्।
কমিটি বারো জন প্রবীণ সদস্য নিয়ে গঠিত. নিয়ে গঠিত (niye gothito, “formed with/of”) “comprises of”-मा रूपान्तर हुन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Task 1-को pie-chart र process वर्णनमा यो धेरै आउँछ। consists of वा comprises सही रोज्दा कम प्रचलित academic verb-माथिको नियन्त्रण देखिन्छ, जुन Band 7-को range चिह्न हो।
I have visited Cox’s Bazar last winter with my family.
I visited Cox’s Bazar last winter with my family.

सकिइसकेको समय बुझाउने अभिव्यक्ति (last winter, in 2019, two years ago) भए simple past नै चाहिन्छ। सकिइसकेको समय स्पष्ट भनिएको वाक्यमा present perfect आउन सक्दैन। present perfect खुला वा अझै चलिरहेको समयका लागि मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् (I have visited Cox’s Bazar several times)।
আমি গত শীতে পরিবারসহ কক্সবাজার গিয়েছি. बोलचालको बंगालीमा “I went” र “I have gone” दुवैका लागि एउटै past रूप प्रयोग हुन्छ, त्यसैले present perfect आवश्यकताभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Speaking Part 2-मा, जहाँ तपाईं अतीतको अनुभव सुनाउनुहुन्छ, यो tense-को टकराव content-स्तरको गल्ती हो। दुई मिनेटको कुराभरि लगातार past tense राख्नु fluency र accuracy दुवैको बलियो संकेत हो।
I am living in Dhaka since 2015.
I have been living in Dhaka since 2015. / I have lived in Dhaka since 2015.
अतीतमा सुरु भएर अहिलेसम्म चलिरहेको अवधिका लागि present continuous होइन, present perfect वा present perfect continuous चाहिन्छ। since र for जस्ता संकेत-शब्दले तपाईंलाई perfect रूपतर्फ लैजान्छन्।
আমি ২০১৫ সাল থেকে ঢাকায় থাকছি. बंगालीको continuous रूप থাকছি (thakchhi)-ले चलिरहेको अवधि बुझाउँछ, त्यसैले यो English-को present continuous-मा रूपान्तर हुन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Speaking Part 1-मा समयको नियन्त्रणले Band 6 र Band 7-लाई छुट्याउँछ। have been + -ing since pattern धेरै प्रयोग हुने बनावट हो - मुखमा आफैँ आउने नहुन्जेल यसको अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्।

v1_errors_3.title: ३० वटा मुख्य गल्ती (२१–३०)
v1_errors_3.group: अध्याय १ · L1 Interference Fixer (बंगालीको प्रभावले हुने गल्ती)
blocks: My friend told to me that the interview went well.
My friend told me that the interview went well. / My friend said to me that the interview went well.
Tell-पछि व्यक्ति सिधै आउँछ, to बिना (tell me, tell him)। Say-ले भने व्यक्तिअघि to चाहिन्छ (say to me)। यी दुई verb-को pattern फरक छ: tell someone something र say something to someone।
আমার বন্ধু আমাকে বলল যে সাক্ষাৎকারটি ভালো হয়েছে. আমাকে বলল (amake bollo, “told me”)-भित्र “to me”-को अर्थ हुन्छ, जुन English-मा छुट्टै लेखिन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Reported speech Speaking Part 2-का कथाभरि आउँछ। tell/say-को भिन्नता एउटा सटीक शब्द-भिन्नता हो, र यसलाई नियन्त्रण गर्दा धेरै प्रयोग हुने reporting verb-माथि साँचो पकड देखिन्छ।
According to me, the voting age should be lowered.
In my opinion, the voting age should be lowered. / To my mind, the voting age should be lowered.

According to-ले बाहिरको स्रोत जनाउँछ (according to the report, according to experts), तपाईंको आफ्नै विचार होइन। आफ्नो विचारका लागि in my opinion, from my perspective वा I would argue that प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
আমার মতে, ভোটের বয়স কমানো উচিত. আমার মতে (amar mote) “in my opinion”-का लागि निश्चित phrase हो, र यो शाब्दिक रूपमा “according to me”-मा रूपान्तर हुन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** According to me बंगलादेशी Task 2 essay र Speaking Part 3-मा विचार व्यक्त गर्ने phrase-को सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्तीमध्ये एक हो। यसको सट्टा विभिन्न opinion marker प्रयोग गर्दा Lexical Resource र examiner-ले अपेक्षा गर्ने academic register दुवै माथि उठ्छ।
Maximum people in my country depend on agriculture.
Most people in my country depend on agriculture. / The majority of people in my country depend on agriculture.

Maximum noun वा adjective हो, जसको अर्थ सम्भव भएसम्मको सबैभन्दा बढी मात्रा हो (the maximum speed)। यसको अर्थ “most” होइन। कुनै समूहको ठूलो भाग बुझाउन most, the majority of वा the bulk of प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
আমার দেশের বেশিরভাগ মানুষ কৃষির উপর নির্ভর করে. বেশিরভাগ (beshirbhag, “most”)-लाई गलत रूपमा “maximum” अनुवाद गरिन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Maximum people Lexical Resource अन्तर्गत शब्द-छनोटको स्पष्ट गल्ती हो। यसको सट्टा the majority of वा the bulk of प्रयोग गर्दा Task 2-ले पुरस्कृत गर्ने quantifier-को range पनि तपाईंसँग हुन्छ।
I have to give an important exam at the end of this month.
I have to sit an important exam at the end of this month. / I have to take an important exam at the end of this month.
English-मा विद्यार्थीले exam sit वा take गर्छ; examiner वा संस्थाले मात्र exam set वा give गर्छ। Give an exam भन्दा भूमिका उल्टिन्छ।
এই মাসের শেষে আমাকে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পরীক্ষা দিতে হবে. পরীক্ষা দেওয়া (porikkha deoa, “to give an exam”)-मा দেওয়া (deoa, “give”) प्रयोग हुन्छ, त्यसैले विद्यार्थीहरू “give an exam” भन्छन्।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** शिक्षासम्बन्धी शब्द Speaking Part 1-को केन्द्रमा हुन्छन्। Sit an exam (British प्रयोग, IELTS-मा रुचाइने) स्वाभाविक collocation हो, जुन give an exam-भन्दा तुरुन्तै बढी native जस्तो सुनिन्छ।
Try not to do the same mistake in the next test.
Try not to make the same mistake in the next test.

English-ले collocation अनुसार do र make छुट्याउँछ। make-सँग आउँछन्: a mistake, a decision, progress, an effort, an arrangement; do-सँग आउँछन्: homework, research, a favour, business, damage। बंगालीको করা-ले यी सबै समेट्छ, त्यसैले यो विभाजन निश्चित जोडीका रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ।
পরের পরীক্ষায় একই ভুল কোরো না. ভুল করা (bhul kora)-मा করা (kora) प्रयोग हुन्छ, जसले “do” र “make” दुवैलाई समेट्छ, त्यसैले do a mistake बन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** do/make विभाजन भाषाको सबैभन्दा धेरै आउने collocation परीक्षामध्ये एक हो। लगातार सही हुनु Lexical Resource-को बलियो संकेत हो; बारम्बार slip हुँदा तपाईं Band 6-मै रोकिनुहुन्छ।
I have not met my school friends since a long time.
I have not met my school friends for a long time.
Since-पछि कुनै काम सुरु भएको समय-बिन्दु आउँछ (since 2015, since Monday)। For-पछि समयको लम्बाइ आउँछ (for a long time, for three years)। “A long time” अवधि हो, त्यसैले यसपछि for आउँछ।
আমি অনেকদিন ধরে আমার স্কুলের বন্ধুদের সাথে দেখা করিনি. ধরে (dhore)-ले समयको फैलावट जनाउँछ र यसलाई ढिलो-ढालो रूपमा “since” बुझिन्छ।
**Examiner-को नजरमा:** since/for भिन्नता Error 20-को present perfect-सँग सिधै जोडिन्छ। दुवैलाई सँगै पक्का गर्दा Speaking Part 1-भरि दोहोरिरहने सम्बन्धित गल्तीहरूको समूह नै हट्छ।
Please off the fan and light before you leave the room.
Please turn off the fan and the light before you leave the room.
बिजुलीका उपकरणका लागि English-मा turn on र turn off (वा switch on/off) phrasal verb प्रयोग हुन्छ। Off verb होइन, र open/close ढोका र झ्यालका लागि हो, बत्ती र पङ्खाका लागि होइन।
ঘর ছাড়ার আগে ফ্যান আর লাইট বন্ধ করো. বন্ধ করা (bondho kora, “to close/shut off”) “off” बन्छ, र খোলা (khola, “to open”) “open” बन्छ, जसबाट off the fan, open the light बन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Open the light र off the fan प्रस्ट क्षेत्रीय शाब्दिक अनुवाद (calque) हुन्। यी Writing-मा कमै आउँछन्, तर घर र दैनिक दिनचर्याबारे Speaking Part 1-मा देखिन्छन्, जहाँ examiner ठ्याक्कै स्वाभाविक phrasal verb सुन्न खोजिरहेका हुन्छन्।
My all relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.
All my relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.
English-मा all possessive-भन्दा अगाडि आउँछ: all my relatives, all his money, all our efforts। बंगालीको क्रम “my all” उल्टिन्छ। both my parents, half my salary-मा पनि यही नियम लाग्छ।
আমার সব আত্মীয় বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে জড়ো হয়েছিল. আমার সব (amar shob, शाब्दिक रूपमा “my all”)-ले possessive-लाई all-भन्दा अगाडि राख्छ, र त्यही क्रम English-मा सर्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Determiner-को क्रम Grammatical Range and Accuracy-को एउटा सूक्ष्म बुँदा हो। एक्लै हेर्दा सानो हो, तर लगातार सही हुँदा यसले उच्च band-को बोलाइ र लेखाइलाई छुट्याउने सहज, स्वाभाविक प्रवाहमा योगदान दिन्छ।
Myself Rahim, and I am here to talk about my hometown.
My name is Rahim, and I am here to talk about my hometown. / I am Rahim, and I would like to talk about my hometown.
Myself reflexive pronoun हो (I did it myself); यसले नाम परिचय गराउन सक्दैन। नामअघि My name is वा I am प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
আমি রহিম, আর আমি আমার শহর নিয়ে কথা বলতে এসেছি. आफ्नो परिचय घोषणा गर्ने बानी गैर-मानक “Myself Rahim” बन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** IELTS Speaking test-मा औपचारिक रूपमा आफ्नो परिचय दिनुपर्दैन, तर दिनुभयो भने Myself Rahim तुरुन्तै क्षेत्रीय चिह्न बन्छ। स्वाभाविक I am Rahim-ले fluency र lexis-मा बलियो पहिलो छाप छोड्छ।
I passed out from university in 2019 with a degree in economics.
I graduated from university in 2019 with a degree in economics.

Standard English-मा pass out-को अर्थ बेहोस हुनु वा होस गुमाउनु हो। degree पूरा गरेको बुझाउन graduate from वा complete my studies at प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। यो grammar-को गल्ती होइन, false friend (चिनेजस्तो देखिने तर फरक अर्थ भएको शब्द) हो।
यो सिधै बंगालीबाट गरिएको अनुवाद होइन, बरु संस्थागत English-को बानी हो: पूरै दक्षिण एसियामा “pass out” “graduate”-को अर्थमा व्यापक रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

**Examiner-को नजरमा:** Passed out from university सुनेर examiner साँच्चै अलमलमा पर्न सक्छन्, किनभने यसको standard अर्थ “बेहोस भयो” हो। शैक्षिक पृष्ठभूमि लगभग हरेक Speaking Part 1-मा सोधिने भएकाले यसको सट्टा graduated from भन्दा स्पष्टता र register दुवै एकैसाथ जोगिन्छ।

v1_practice.title: Practice · L1 गल्ती पत्ता लगाएर सुधार्नुहोस्
v1_practice.group: अध्याय १ · L1 Interference Fixer (बंगालीको प्रभावले हुने गल्ती)
blocks: Answer key हेर्नुअघि दुवै exercise कलम लिएर पूरै गर्नुहोस्। पहिले key नपढ्नुहोस्; चिन्न सक्नु र आफैँ लेख्न सक्नु एउटै कुरा होइन।

blocks.title: Exercise 1.1 · L1 गल्ती पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्
blocks.instructions: तलका १५ वटा वाक्य प्रत्येकमा बंगालीबाट English-मा अनुवाद गर्दा भएको एउटा लुकेको गल्ती छ। गल्तीमुनि रेखा तान्नुहोस् र वाक्यलाई सही, स्वाभाविक English-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Scientists are still discussing about the real causes of climate change.
items.answer: Scientists are still discussing the real causes of climate change.
items.reason: discuss transitive हो र यसको object सिधै आउँछ; discuss about लेख्दा verb-मा पहिल्यै भएको अर्थ दोहोरिन्छ।

items.prompt: This report comprises of five main sections and a short appendix.
items.answer: This report comprises five main sections and a short appendix. (or consists of)
items.reason: comprise-पछि of आउँदैन; of चाहिँ consist of र be composed of-सँग मात्र आउँछ।

items.prompt: My elder brother is senior than me by four years.
items.answer: My elder brother is senior to me by four years.
items.reason: Latin-बाट आएका comparative (senior, junior, superior, prior)-पछि सधैँ to आउँछ, than कहिल्यै होइन।

items.prompt: My sister is married with a civil engineer from Khulna.
items.answer: My sister is married to a civil engineer from Khulna.
items.reason: निश्चित collocation married to हो; with कसैसँग मिलेर केही गर्दा प्रयोग हुन्छ, विवाहको बन्धन बुझाउन होइन।

items.prompt: I have been staying in this hostel since my first year, and I am living here still now.
items.answer: I have been staying in this hostel since my first year, and I still live here.
items.reason: अतीतमा सुरु भएर अहिले पनि चलिरहेको अवस्थाका लागि present continuous होइन, present perfect चाहिन्छ।

items.prompt: The counsellor gave me two very useful advices about choosing a subject.
items.answer: The counsellor gave me two very useful pieces of advice about choosing a subject.
items.reason: advice uncountable हो, त्यसैले यसमा plural -s लाग्दैन; गन्नुपर्यो भने pieces of advice प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Everyone in our study group are preparing hard for the mock test.
items.answer: Everyone in our study group is preparing hard for the mock test.
items.reason: everyone grammar-को हिसाबले singular हो, जतिसुकै मानिसलाई जनाओस्; in our study group phrase-ले verb बदल्दैन।

items.prompt: Despite of the heavy workload, she submitted every assignment on time.
items.answer: Despite the heavy workload, she submitted every assignment on time.
items.reason: despite-पछि of आउँदैन; in spite of-मा मात्र of रहन्छ।

items.prompt: According to me, public libraries should stay open late into the evening.
items.answer: In my opinion, public libraries should stay open late into the evening.
items.reason: according to-ले बाहिरको स्रोत जनाउँछ, तपाईंको आफ्नै विचार होइन; आफ्नो लागि in my opinion प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The number of private cars on the road are rising sharply each year.
items.answer: The number of private cars on the road is rising sharply each year.
items.reason: वास्तविक subject number (singular) हो; the number of-पछि सधैँ singular verb आउँछ।

items.prompt: It is difficult for many workers to cope up with rapid technological change.
items.answer: It is difficult for many workers to cope with rapid technological change.
items.reason: सही verb cope with हो; थपिएको up एउटा क्षेत्रीय बानी हो, phrase-मा यसको कुनै आधार छैन।

items.prompt: Please open the light; the room is too dark to read in.
items.answer: Please turn on the light; the room is too dark to read in.
items.reason: बत्ती र उपकरण turn on वा off गरिन्छ; open/close ढोका र झ्यालका लागि हो।

items.prompt: We reached to the examination hall twenty minutes before it started.
items.answer: We reached the examination hall twenty minutes before it started. (or arrived at)
items.reason: reach transitive हो र यसपछि कुनै preposition आउँदैन; arrive-पछि at वा in आउँछ।

items.prompt: Most students prefer group study than studying alone at home.
items.answer: Most students prefer group study to studying alone at home.
items.reason: prefer-सँग than होइन, to आउँछ; दुवै option-लाई एउटै रूपमा राख्नुहोस् (study to studying)।

items.prompt: After completing his research, he returned back to his home country.
items.answer: After completing his research, he returned to his home country.
items.reason: return-को अर्थ नै “go back” (फर्केर जानु) हो, त्यसैले back अनावश्यक छ।

blocks.title: Exercise 1.2 · बंगालीबाट Band 9 अनुवाद चुनौती
blocks.instructions: हरेक बंगाली विचार पढ्नुहोस् र त्यसलाई व्यक्त गर्ने एउटा स्वाभाविक, गल्तीरहित IELTS वाक्य लेख्नुहोस्। शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद नगर्नुहोस्; अर्थको अनुवाद गर्नुहोस्। हरेक विचारमा Part A-का trap-हरूमध्ये कम्तीमा एउटा लुकेको छ।

items.prompt: বেশিরভাগ মানুষ মনে করে যে প্রযুক্তি আমাদের দৈনন্দিন জীবনকে অনেক সহজ করেছে।
items.answer: Most people believe that technology has made our daily lives much easier.
items.reason: Trap: most-को ठाउँमा maximum लेख्ने गल्ती; वर्तमानसँग सम्बन्ध भएको परिवर्तनका लागि present perfect प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: যানজট সত্ত্বেও, শহরের বেশিরভাগ মানুষ এখনও ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ি ব্যবহার করতে পছন্দ করে।
items.answer: Despite the traffic congestion, most city dwellers still prefer to use private cars.
items.reason: Trap: despite of; prefer … to।

items.prompt: আমার মতে, সরকারের উচিত শিক্ষা খাতে আরও বেশি বিনিয়োগ করা।
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should invest more heavily in the education sector.
items.reason: Trap: according to me; invest in।

items.prompt: আমি ২০১৮ সাল থেকে এই বিষয়ের উপর গবেষণা করছি।
items.answer: I have been researching this subject since 2018.
items.reason: Trap: since-सँग present continuous; research transitive हो, about चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: দূষণ জনস্বাস্থ্যের জন্য একটি মারাত্মক হুমকি সৃষ্টি করছে।
items.answer: Pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Trap: अस्पष्ट verb-को सट्टा सटीक collocation pose a threat to प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: তরুণ প্রজন্মের জন্য কর্মসংস্থানের সুযোগ তৈরি করা অত্যন্ত জরুরি।
items.answer: It is essential to create employment opportunities for the younger generation.
items.reason: Trap: औपचारिक it is essential to; स्वाभाविक phrase the younger generation।

items.prompt: যদিও অনেক শিক্ষার্থী ইংরেজিতে ভালো, তবুও তারা পরীক্ষায় ভালো ফল করতে পারে না।
items.answer: Although many students are good at English, they fail to perform well in the exam.
items.reason: Trap: good in-लाई good at बनाउनुहोस्; पूरा clause-सँग although।

items.prompt: আমি একদিন আমার নিজের একটি প্রতিষ্ঠান গড়ে তুলতে চাই।
items.answer: I hope to build my own company one day.
items.reason: Trap: शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद होइन, स्वाभाविक build/establish a company र hope to।

items.prompt: দারিদ্র্য দূর করা যেকোনো উন্নয়নশীল দেশের সবচেয়ে বড় চ্যালেঞ্জ।
items.answer: Eradicating poverty is the biggest challenge for any developing nation.
items.reason: Trap: eradicate-ले remove-लाई माथिल्लो स्तरमा लैजान्छ; subject-को रूपमा gerund।

items.prompt: যদি সরকার আরও কঠোর আইন প্রণয়ন করত, তাহলে অপরাধের হার কমে যেত।
items.answer: If the government enacted stricter laws, the crime rate would decrease.
items.reason: Trap: second conditional (if-पछि past, परिणाम भागमा would); the crime rate, the rate of crime are होइन।

v2_intro.title: Band Upgrade Matrix: शब्दको स्तर बढाउने तालिका
blocks: Chapter 1-मा हामीले तपाईंको band तल झार्ने गल्तीहरू हटायौँ। यो chapter-ले तपाईंको band माथि उठाउने सटीक शब्दहरू थप्छ। लगभग हरेक candidate केही धेरै प्रयोग हुने शब्दहरू लिएर आउँछन्, जसबाट उनीहरू चाहिनेभन्दा धेरै काम चलाउँछन्: big, good, bad, very, problem, thing।

यी शब्दहरू गलत होइनन्। यिनीहरू केवल अस्पष्ट छन्, र यही अस्पष्टताले Lexical Resource-लाई Band 6-मा रोकिदिन्छ। कुनै शब्द दुर्लभ वा कठिन भएकै कारण examiner खुसी हुँदैनन्; examiner खुसी हुन्छन् सही शब्दबाट - जुन शब्दले तपाईंले भन्न खोजेको कुरा ठ्याक्कै भन्छ।

बंगलादेशी English-मा सबैभन्दा धेरै खटाइने ३५ वटा शब्दका लागि यो chapter-ले तपाईंलाई एउटा भर्याङ दिन्छ: तपाईंले सायद अहिले प्रयोग गर्ने Band 5.5-को रूप, एउटा Band 7.5 upgrade, र एउटा Band 9.0-को सटीक शब्द। हरेक शब्द कहाँ प्रयोग गर्ने भन्ने स्पष्ट निर्देशन पनि छ। पूरै entry पढ्नुहोस्, माथिको आकर्षक शब्द मात्र होइन। किनभने प्रयोगको नियम र Speaking बनाम Writing-को भागले नै तपाईंलाई यो level-को सबैभन्दा common पासोबाट बचाउँछ: भारी academic शब्द गलत ठाउँमा राखिदिनु। सुरु गर्नुअघि एउटा चेतावनी।
