items.prompt: homogenisation
items.answer: b
accepted: the increasing similarity of different cultures
items.reason: सही उत्तर b: "the increasing similarity of different cultures" - अर्थात् फरक-फरक संस्कृतिहरू दिनदिनै उस्तै बन्दै जानु।

items.prompt: interdependence
items.answer: f
accepted: mutual reliance between countries or groups
items.reason: सही उत्तर f: "mutual reliance between countries or groups" - अर्थात् देश वा समूहहरू एकअर्कामा भर पर्नु।

items.prompt: heritage
items.answer: e
accepted: traditions and history passed down over time

items.prompt: multiculturalism
items.answer: g
accepted: the presence of many cultures within one society
items.reason: सही उत्तर g: "the presence of many cultures within one society" - अर्थात् एउटै समाजमा धेरै संस्कृतिहरू हुनु।

items.prompt: erode
items.answer: d
accepted: to wear away or weaken gradually
items.reason: सही उत्तर d: "to wear away or weaken gradually" - अर्थात् बिस्तारै खियाउनु वा कमजोर बनाउनु।

items.answer: j
accepted: to make weaker or less distinctive
items.reason: सही उत्तर j: "to make weaker or less distinctive" - अर्थात् कमजोर बनाउनु वा आफ्नोपन घटाउनु।

items.prompt: migration
items.answer: a
accepted: the movement of people from one place to another
items.reason: सही उत्तर a: "the movement of people from one place to another" - अर्थात् मानिसहरू एक ठाउँबाट अर्को ठाउँमा सर्नु।

items.prompt: embrace
items.answer: h
accepted: to accept something willingly
items.reason: सही उत्तर h: "to accept something willingly" - अर्थात् कुनै कुरालाई खुसीसाथ स्वीकार गर्नु।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.6.3 · Speaking अभ्यास (Simulation Drill)
blocks.instructions: Part 3-को प्रत्येक प्रश्नको उत्तर २–३ वटा वाक्यमा दिनुहोस्। उत्तरमा कम्तीमा १ वटा target idiom र १ वटा collocation प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि model answer-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Has globalisation been mostly positive or negative for your country?
items.answer: Globalisation has been a mixed blessing: it has connected us to a global marketplace and fostered mutual understanding, yet it also risks eroding traditional values, so the world can feel both closer together and worlds apart.

items.prompt: Do you think local cultures are disappearing because of globalisation?
items.answer: To some extent, yes; global media can erode traditional values and homogenise cultures, though many communities work hard to keep their traditions alive.

items.prompt: How can people protect their traditions in a globalised world?
items.answer: People can protect their traditions by passing them down from generation to generation, celebrating festivals, and teaching their language, all of which keep a strong sense of identity alive.

v4_topic_07.title: Topic 7 · सहरीकरण र पूर्वाधार (Urbanisation and Infrastructure)
blocks: **urbanisation** (सहरीकरण): Rapid urbanisation has strained city services.
**congestion** (भीडभाड, जाम): Traffic congestion wastes both time and fuel.
**overpopulation** (अत्यधिक जनसंख्या): Overpopulation intensifies competition for housing.
**sanitation** (सरसफाइ र ढल व्यवस्थापन): Poor sanitation spreads disease in dense slums.
**slum** (सुकुमबासी बस्ती): Millions live in overcrowded urban slums.
**amenities** (सुविधाहरू): New suburbs often lack basic amenities.
**housing** (आवास): Affordable housing is scarce in major cities.
**relocation** (स्थानान्तरण): The relocation of factories reshaped the local economy.
**urban sprawl** (सहरको अव्यवस्थित फैलावट): Unchecked urban sprawl consumes farmland.
निश्चित अर्थ भएका verb (१० वटा) · past, participle, -ing रूप
**urbanise** (urbanised, urbanised, urbanising): Developing nations are urbanising at record speed.
**migrate** (migrated, migrated, migrating): Rural workers migrate to cities for jobs.
**commute** (commuted, commuted, commuting): Millions commute long distances each day.
**expand** (expanded, expanded, expanding): Cities expand outward as populations grow.
**congest** (congested, congested, congesting): Too many vehicles congest the main roads.
**accommodate** (accommodated, accommodated, accommodating): Cities struggle to accommodate new arrivals.
**relocate** (relocated, relocated, relocating): Some residents were forced to relocate.
**modernise** (modernised, modernised, modernising): The government is modernising the rail network.
**deteriorate** (deteriorated, deteriorated, deteriorating): Ageing infrastructure continues to deteriorate.
**develop** (developed, developed, developing): Planners must develop new residential areas carefully.
**traffic congestion**: Traffic congestion is worsening in most capitals. (Writing)
**affordable housing**: A shortage of affordable housing pushes prices up. (Writing)
**public transport**: Efficient public transport reduces reliance on cars. (Speaking and Writing)

items.prompt: Do you think money is the most important measure of success?

items.prompt: Should governments do more to reduce the gap between rich and poor?

items.prompt: Is it better to work for a company or to be self-employed?

items.prompt: Why is it important to protect traditional culture?
items.answer: Protecting traditional culture matters because it instils a sense of identity and offers a window into the past; customs that stand the test of time connect each generation to the one before it.

items.prompt: Do you think modern life is making traditions disappear?
items.answer: To a certain extent, yes; the fast pace of modern life pushes some customs aside, but renewed interest in heritage means many traditions still stand the test of time.

items.prompt: Should governments spend public money on the arts?
items.answer: I believe they should; public funding sustains the arts, which are an integral part of a nation’s identity and offer a window into its history that the market alone would not preserve.

blocks.instructions: Part 3-को प्रत्येक प्रश्नको उत्तर २–३ वटा वाक्यमा दिनुहोस्। उत्तरमा कम्तीमा १ वटा target idiom र १ वटा collocation प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि model answer-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Do you think advertising has too much influence on people?
items.answer: Advertising certainly has too much influence, since clever campaigns manipulate consumer behaviour and encourage people to jump on the bandwagon of every trend, though a discerning viewer learns to take such messages with a pinch of salt.

items.prompt: Can we still trust the news we read online?
items.answer: Not entirely; much online content is biased or sensationalised, and misinformation spreads like wildfire, so it is wise to take what you read with a pinch of salt and check reliable sources.

items.answer: Social media has transformed how we get information, since breaking news now travels in seconds; the downside is that it also lets rumours spread unchecked.

items.prompt: How can traffic congestion in big cities be reduced?
items.answer: Congestion can be eased by investing in mass transit and introducing congestion charges to discourage private car use; otherwise cities simply grind to a halt at rush hour.

items.prompt: Do you think people rely too much on private cars?
items.answer: More often than not, yes; many people reach for the car out of habit even for short trips, which leaves roads bumper to bumper and worsens emissions.

items.prompt: What could make public transport more attractive to use?
items.answer: Public transport would attract more users if it were cheaper, more frequent, and better connected, so that commuters saw it as a genuine alternative rather than a last resort.

items.prompt: Do you think the generation gap is bigger today than in the past?

items.prompt: Who has more influence on children, parents or friends?

items.prompt: Is it better to grow up in a large family or a small one?

v5_rule.title: कडाइका साथ छुट्याउने नियम
blocks: यो अध्याय एउटै नियममा टिकेको छ। Lexical Resource-मा नम्बर पाउने कि नपाउने भन्ने कुरा अरू कुनै एउटा बानीभन्दा यही नियमले बढी तय गर्छ: informal idiom-को ठाउँ Speaking हो, Writing Task 2 होइन। जुन expression-ले interview-मा तपाईंलाई नम्बर दिलाउँछ, त्यही expression-ले essay-मा नम्बर घटाउन सक्छ। यो लेख्ने शैलीको सानो रोजाइको कुरा होइन; यो register-को नियम हो, र माथिल्लो band-मा ठ्याक्कै register-कै जाँच हुन्छ।

यो भिन्नता किन यति कडा छ, हेरौं। IELTS Speaking-ले स्वाभाविक, तुरुन्तै बोलिएको भाषालाई नम्बर दिन्छ। त्यसैले ठीक ठाउँमा राखिएको idiom (it was a blessing in disguise, I was over the moon) ले देखाउँछ कि तपाईं धाराप्रवाह बोल्ने मान्छेले जस्तै English प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। तर Writing Task 2 चाहिँ एउटा formal academic essay हो।

त्यहाँ idiom पढ्दा हल्का, गम्भीर नभएको र नमिल्दो लाग्छ। Idiom जतिसुकै राम्रो भए पनि यसले तपाईंको लेखाइको tone-लाई Band 6 तिर तान्छ। Examiner-ले “यो candidate-लाई idiom आउँछ कि आउँदैन” भनेर सोधिरहेका हुँदैनन्। Examiner-ले “कुन किसिमको भाषा कहाँ मिल्छ भनेर यो candidate-लाई थाहा छ कि छैन” भनेर सोधिरहेका हुन्छन्।
**Task 2-का लागि सुरक्षित:** के यो पत्रिकाको सम्पादकीय वा academic article-मा स्वाभाविक सुनिन्छ? सुनिन्छ भने essay-मा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
**Speaking-का लागि राख्नुहोस्:** के यो साथीसँगको गफमा सुहाउँछ? सुहाउँछ भने यसलाई Writing Task 2 बाट टाढा राख्नुहोस्।

**Phrasal verb:** धेरै phrasal verb तटस्थ हुन्छन् र लेखाइमा पूरै ठीक हुन्छन् (carry out, bring about, result in)। Task 2 बाट टाढा राख्नुपर्ने चाहिँ informal, idiom जस्ता phrasal verb हुन्: get its act together, cough up, र pull your socks up। शंका लागे एउटै formal verb रोज्नुहोस् (organise, pay, improve)।

v5_idioms_1.title: Speaking-का ५० वटा idiom (१–२५)
blocks: Interview-मा स्वाभाविक सुनिन यिनीहरू प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Part लेबलले कुन idiom कहाँ सबैभन्दा राम्रो मिल्छ भनेर देखाउँछ। यीमध्ये कुनै पनि Task 2 essay-मा नलैजानुहोस्।
**once in a blue moon**: धेरै कमै, कहिलेकाहीं मात्र। उदाहरण: I eat out once in a blue moon.
**a piece of cake**: धेरै सजिलो। उदाहरण: For me, cooking is a piece of cake.
**cost an arm and a leg**: धेरै महँगो हुनु। उदाहरण: Concert tickets cost an arm and a leg.
**a stone’s throw away**: धेरै नजिक। उदाहरण: My office is a stone’s throw away from home.
**a rip-off**: चाहिनेभन्दा धेरै बढी दाम लिइने कुरा। उदाहरण: That cafe is a total rip-off.
**hit it off**: पहिलो भेटमै मिल्नु, तुरुन्तै राम्रो सम्बन्ध बन्नु। उदाहरण: We hit it off the moment we met.
**call it a day**: दिनभरको काम सक्नु, काम रोक्नु। उदाहरण: By six, I usually call it a day.
**get the hang of it**: कुनै काम कसरी गर्ने भनेर सिक्नु। उदाहरण: It took me a week to get the hang of it.
**lend a hand**: सहयोग गर्नु। उदाहरण: I often lend a hand at home.
**money doesn’t grow on trees**: पैसा सीमित हुन्छ, सजिलै आउँदैन। उदाहरण: My parents always said money doesn’t grow on trees.
**hit the books**: मन लगाएर धेरै पढ्नु। उदाहरण: I need to hit the books this weekend.
**over the moon**: एकदमै खुसी। उदाहरण: I was over the moon when I passed.
**on cloud nine**: असाध्यै खुसी, आनन्दमा डुबेको। उदाहरण: On my wedding day, I was on cloud nine.
**down in the dumps**: दुःखी वा मन खिन्न। उदाहरण: I felt down in the dumps after the result.
**butterflies in my stomach**: उत्साहसँगै आउने घबराहट। उदाहरण: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
**get cold feet**: अन्तिम घडीमा डराउनु वा पछि हट्न मन लाग्नु। उदाहरण: I nearly got cold feet before the speech.
**a fish out of water**: नयाँ ठाउँ वा परिवेशमा असहज महसुस गर्नु। उदाहरण: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish out of water.
**the last straw**: सहन सकिने अन्तिम कुरा, जसपछि धैर्य टुट्छ। उदाहरण: The delay was the last straw.
**a blessing in disguise**: असफलता वा नराम्रो घटनाभित्र लुकेको फाइदा। उदाहरण: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
**the icing on the cake**: माथिबाट थपिएको खुसीको बोनस। उदाहरण: The view was the icing on the cake.
**in at the deep end**: कुनै तयारी बिना गाह्रो काममा सिधै हालिनु। उदाहरण: I was thrown in at the deep end on day one.
**burn the midnight oil**: राति अबेरसम्म काम गर्नु वा पढ्नु। उदाहरण: Before finals, I burn the midnight oil.
**go the extra mile**: विशेष मेहनत गर्नु, चाहिनेभन्दा बढी गर्नु। उदाहरण: Good teachers go the extra mile.
**pull your socks up**: आफ्नो प्रयास सुधार्नु, अझ मेहनत गर्नु। उदाहरण: I had to pull my socks up after the mock test.
**get the ball rolling**: कुनै काम सुरु गर्नु। उदाहरण: Let me get the ball rolling on the project.

v5_idioms_2.title: Speaking-का ५० वटा idiom (२६–५०)
blocks: **get to grips with**: बुझ्न वा सम्हाल्न थाल्नु। उदाहरण: It takes time to get to grips with a new city.
**a foot in the door**: सुरुको मौका, भित्र छिर्ने पहिलो अवसर। उदाहरण: An internship gets your foot in the door.
**spread your wings**: आत्मनिर्भर बन्नु र नयाँ कुरा गरेर हेर्नु। उदाहरण: University lets young people spread their wings.
**keep up with the times**: समयसँगै अगाडि बढ्नु, अपडेट रहनु। उदाहरण: Businesses must keep up with the times.
**hit the nail on the head**: ठ्याक्कै सही कुरा भन्नु। उदाहरण: You’ve hit the nail on the head.
**see the bigger picture**: पूरै परिस्थिति बुझ्नु। उदाहरण: Leaders must see the bigger picture.
**think outside the box**: नयाँ र रचनात्मक तरिकाले सोच्नु। उदाहरण: Innovation means thinking outside the box.
**keep an open mind**: नयाँ विचार सुन्न र स्वीकार्न तयार रहनु। उदाहरण: It helps to keep an open mind.
**sit on the fence**: कुनै पक्ष नलिनु, बीचमा बस्नु। उदाहरण: On this issue, I refuse to sit on the fence.
**a mixed blessing**: राम्रो र नराम्रो दुवै पक्ष भएको कुरा। उदाहरण: Social media is a mixed blessing.
**the best of both worlds**: एकैपटक दुई वटा फाइदा। उदाहरण: Remote work offers the best of both worlds.
**every cloud has a silver lining**: नराम्रो कुराबाट पनि राम्रो निस्कन सक्छ। उदाहरण: Every cloud has a silver lining.
**on the same wavelength**: एउटै किसिमले सोच्ने, विचार मिल्ने। उदाहरण: My colleague and I are on the same wavelength.
**in the same boat**: एउटै गाह्रो अवस्थामा परेको। उदाहरण: During the crisis, we were all in the same boat.
**kill two birds with one stone**: एउटै कामबाट दुई वटा काम फत्ते गर्नु। उदाहरण: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone.
**at the drop of a hat**: तुरुन्तै, कुनै हिचकिचाहट बिना। उदाहरण: She would travel at the drop of a hat.
**add fuel to the fire**: नराम्रो अवस्थालाई झन् नराम्रो बनाउनु। उदाहरण: His comment only added fuel to the fire.
**a needle in a haystack**: भेट्टाउन लगभग असम्भव कुरा। उदाहरण: Finding a quiet flat there is like finding a needle in a haystack.
**pull strings**: आफ्नो पहुँच वा प्रभाव प्रयोग गरेर केही पाउनु। उदाहरण: He pulled strings to get the job.
**face the music**: आफ्नो कामको नतिजा स्वीकार गर्नु। उदाहरण: Sooner or later, you have to face the music.
**bite off more than you can chew**: आफूले सक्नेभन्दा धेरै काम हातमा लिनु। उदाहरण: I bit off more than I could chew last term.
**learn something the hard way**: गाह्रो अनुभवबाट सिक्नु। उदाहरण: I learned time management the hard way.
**in the middle of nowhere**: धेरै टाढा, सुनसान ठाउँमा। उदाहरण: The resort was in the middle of nowhere.
**a change of scenery**: ठाउँ बदल्दा पाइने ताजगी। उदाहरण: A holiday gives you a change of scenery.
**the trip of a lifetime**: जीवनभर नबिर्सिने यात्रा। उदाहरण: Visiting the mountains was the trip of a lifetime.

v5_collocations_1.title: Writing-का ५० वटा collocation (१–२५)
blocks: यिनीहरू Writing Task 2 मा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। हरेक collocation formal छ र essay-का लागि मिल्छ।
**it is widely acknowledged that**: धेरैले सत्य भनेर मान्छन् कि। उदाहरण: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
**there is no denying that**: यो अस्वीकार गर्न सकिँदैन कि। उदाहरण: There is no denying that technology has reshaped work.
**a growing body of evidence suggests that**: बढ्दो अनुसन्धानले देखाउँछ कि। उदाहरण: A growing body of evidence suggests that pollution harms cognition.
**it can be argued that**: यस्तो दाबी गर्न सकिन्छ कि। उदाहरण: It can be argued that fees limit access.
**this essay will examine both views**: essay सन्तुलित हुन्छ भनेर संकेत गर्छ। उदाहरण: This essay will examine both views before offering an opinion.
**a widely held view**: धेरैले मान्ने विचार। उदाहरण: A widely held view is that competition improves standards.
**it stands to reason that**: यो तर्कसंगत छ कि। उदाहरण: It stands to reason that better roads reduce delays.
**a compelling argument**: विश्वास दिलाउने तर्क। उदाहरण: There is a compelling argument for renewable subsidies.
**a valid point**: मनासिब दाबी। उदाहरण: Opponents make a valid point about cost.
**proponents argue that**: समर्थकहरू दाबी गर्छन् कि। उदाहरण: Proponents argue that automation raises productivity.
**critics contend that**: विरोधीहरू जोड दिएर भन्छन् कि। उदाहरण: Critics contend that it destroys jobs.
**it is worth noting that**: यो कुरा ध्यान दिन लायक छ कि। उदाहरण: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
**play a pivotal role in**: केन्द्रीय रूपमा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुनु। उदाहरण: Education plays a pivotal role in development.
**give rise to**: कारण बन्नु, जन्माउनु। उदाहरण: Rapid growth gives rise to inequality.
**stem from**: कुनै कुराबाट सुरु हुनु, त्यहीँबाट उत्पन्न हुनु। उदाहरण: Many problems stem from poverty.
**be attributed to**: कुनै कारणले व्याख्या गरिनु। उदाहरण: The decline can be attributed to weak demand.
**a contributing factor**: धेरै कारणमध्ये एउटा। उदाहरण: Poor diet is a contributing factor in obesity.
**have far-reaching consequences**: टाढासम्म असर पर्नु। उदाहरण: Climate change has far-reaching consequences.
**as a direct result of**: सिधै त्यसकै कारणले। उदाहरण: As a direct result of the ban, sales fell.
**while it is true that**: कुनै कुरा मानेर लिँदा। उदाहरण: While it is true that costs are high, benefits outweigh them.
**contrary to popular belief**: धेरैले मान्ने विचारको उल्टो। उदाहरण: Contrary to popular belief, remote work can raise output.
**despite the fact that**: पूरा concession clause सुरु गर्छ। उदाहरण: Despite the fact that it is costly, the plan is justified.
**on the one hand … on the other hand**: दुई पक्षलाई सन्तुलनमा राख्दै। उदाहरण: On the one hand it saves time; on the other, it isolates people.
**to a certain extent**: केही हदसम्म। उदाहरण: This is true to a certain extent.
**address the issue**: समस्या समाधान गर्न काम गर्नु। उदाहरण: Governments must address the issue urgently.

v5_collocations_2.title: Writing-का ५० वटा collocation (२६–५०)
blocks: **tackle the root cause**: समस्याको जरो कारणमाथि काम गर्नु। उदाहरण: Lasting change means tackling the root cause.
**implement effective measures**: राम्रा नीति लागू गर्नु। उदाहरण: Cities should implement effective measures against pollution.
**a viable solution**: काम गर्ने, व्यावहारिक समाधान। उदाहरण: Public transport is a viable solution to congestion.
**weigh the pros and cons**: दुवै पक्ष विचार गर्नु। उदाहरण: Policymakers must weigh the pros and cons.
**strike a balance between**: दुई कुराबीच उचित बीचको बाटो खोज्नु। उदाहरण: We must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
**take into account**: विचार गर्नु, ध्यानमा राख्नु। उदाहरण: Any policy must take into account rural needs.
**a significant proportion of**: उल्लेख्य हिस्सा। उदाहरण: A significant proportion of graduates work abroad.
**the vast majority of**: लगभग सबै। उदाहरण: The vast majority of commuters use trains.
**in the long run**: लामो समयमा। उदाहरण: In the long run, prevention is cheaper.
**in the short term**: छिट्टै, छोटो समयका लागि। उदाहरण: In the short term, costs may rise.
**an integral part of**: अनिवार्य अंग। उदाहरण: Art is an integral part of education.
**gain momentum**: बल बढ्दै जानु, गति लिनु। उदाहरण: The movement has gained momentum.
**pose a serious threat to**: खतरामा पार्नु। उदाहरण: Rising seas pose a serious threat to coasts.
**have a detrimental effect on**: हानि गर्नु। उदाहरण: Stress has a detrimental effect on health.
**reap the benefits of**: फाइदा पाउनु, फल भोग्नु। उदाहरण: Future generations will reap the benefits of this investment.
**at the expense of**: अर्को कुरा त्याग गरेर। उदाहरण: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
**a case in point**: ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने उदाहरण। उदाहरण: Singapore is a case in point.
**to illustrate this**: उदाहरण दिन। उदाहरण: To illustrate this, consider public transport in Tokyo.
**bear in mind that**: याद राख्नु। उदाहरण: We must bear in mind that resources are finite.
**shed light on**: स्पष्ट पार्नु। उदाहरण: The study sheds light on the causes.
**in light of**: विचार गर्दा, यसलाई हेरेर। उदाहरण: In light of these findings, reform is needed.
**from my perspective**: मेरो विचारमा। उदाहरण: From my perspective, the benefits outweigh the risks.
**more often than not**: प्रायः। उदाहरण: More often than not, early action is cheaper.
**by and large**: सामान्यतया। उदाहरण: By and large, the policy has succeeded.
**draw a firm conclusion**: स्पष्ट निर्णयमा पुग्नु। उदाहरण: It is difficult to draw a firm conclusion from limited data.

v5_practice.title: Practice · Register छुट्याउने र idiom सच्याउने

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Register र Style छुट्याउने
blocks.instructions: तलको हरेक वाक्य Writing Task 2 essay-मा लेखिएको जस्तो गरी लेखिएको छ। Underline गरिएको भाषा formal essay-का लागि ठीक छ (W लेख्नुहोस्) कि Speaking-का लागि मात्र हो (S लेख्नुहोस्), छुट्याउनुहोस्। हरेक S-का लागि वाक्यलाई Task 2 मा मिल्ने formal academic English-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Nowadays, a lot of kids are glued to their phones around the clock.
items.answer: S - These days, many children spend excessive time on their smartphones.
items.reason: A lot of kids, glued to, around the clock - यी सबै informal हुन्।

items.prompt: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: The government needs to get its act together on pollution.
items.answer: S - The government must take decisive action on pollution.
items.reason: Get its act together informal हो।

items.prompt: This policy could have far-reaching consequences.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: At the end of the day, it is up to the individual.
items.answer: S - Ultimately, the responsibility lies with the individual.
items.reason: At the end of the day, it is up to - यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: Renewable energy plays a pivotal role in cutting emissions.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Fast food is a rip-off and bad for you.
items.answer: S - Fast food is both overpriced and detrimental to health.
items.reason: A rip-off, bad for you - यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: There is no denying that technology has transformed education.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Loads of people reckon that exams are unfair.
items.answer: S - A significant proportion of people believe that exams are unfair.
items.reason: Loads of, reckon - यी informal हुन्।

items.prompt: Poverty can be attributed to a range of social factors.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Young people these days could not care less about tradition.
items.answer: S - Many young people today show little interest in tradition.
items.reason: Could not care less informal हो।

items.prompt: Governments must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
items.answer: W - appropriate for Task 2.

items.prompt: Social media is a double-edged sword, to be honest.
items.answer: S - Social media brings both clear benefits and serious drawbacks.

v6_essay_1.title: Section 2 · Essay फेरि लेख्ने अभ्यास 1 (Opinion)
blocks: **Task 2-को प्रश्न (Opinion - मत):** Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

blocks.title: Essay 1 · Band 6.0-को मस्यौदा
blocks.instructions: यो Band 6.0 essay-लाई Band 8.5 देखि 9.0 स्तरमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्: idea-हरू उस्तै राख्नुहोस्, तर भाषा सुधार्नुहोस् (L1 बाट आएका गल्ती हटाउनुहोस्, धेरै प्रयोग हुने शब्द बदल्नुहोस्, cohesive device प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, हरेक paragraph-मा एउटा formal collocation थप्नुहोस्)। त्यसपछि model rewrite-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt:
Nowadays, education is a very important thing for everyone. Some people think that university education should be free for all students. I am agree with this idea because it has many good points.

First, free university can help poor students. Many talented students cannot go to university because it is very costly. If education is free, they can also get a chance to study and get a good job. This is good for the whole country because it makes more skilled people.

But some people say that free education is a big problem for the government. The government has to spend a lot of money and this money comes from tax. Also, if university is free, maybe some students will not study seriously.

However, I think the advantages are more than the disadvantages. A country becomes strong when its people are educated. So the government should give importance on free education.

In conclusion, I agree that university education should be free because it helps poor students and it is good for the country.
items.answer:
It is often argued that university education should be provided free of charge to all students. I strongly agree with this view, primarily because it widens access and strengthens the economy in the long run.

The most compelling argument concerns equality of opportunity. At present, many talented young people are unable to attend university because tuition fees are prohibitively expensive. If higher education were free, these students could also pursue their ambitions and secure well-paid employment. Society as a whole would reap the benefits, since a larger pool of skilled graduates drives national productivity.

Admittedly, critics contend that free education places a heavy financial burden on the state, funded ultimately through taxation. They further argue that students may value their studies less when they cost nothing.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks are outweighed by the wider gains. A nation prospers when its population is well educated, and public investment in universities tends to pay for itself through higher earnings and tax revenue. Governments should therefore prioritise funding for higher education.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that university education should be free, as it removes financial barriers for disadvantaged students and yields lasting benefits for the country.
items.reason: Key upgrade-हरू: I am agree-को सट्टा I strongly agree; give importance on-को सट्टा prioritise; but-को सट्टा Admittedly र Nevertheless; एउटा second conditional (if … were free … could); collocation: reap the benefits, place a burden on, drive productivity।

blocks: **Task 2-को प्रश्न (Discuss both views - दुवै मतको छलफल):** Some people think children should start school at a very early age. Others believe they should start later. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

blocks.instructions: यो Band 6.0 essay-लाई Band 8.5 देखि 9.0 स्तरमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्: idea-हरू उस्तै राख्नुहोस्, तर भाषा सुधार्नुहोस् (L1 बाट आएका गल्ती हटाउनुहोस्, धेरै प्रयोग हुने शब्द बदल्नुहोस्, cohesive device प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, हरेक paragraph-मा एउटा formal collocation थप्नुहोस्)। त्यसपछि model rewrite-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt:
There is a big debate about when children should start school. Some people think children should start school when they are very young. Other people think it is better to start later. In this essay I will discuss about both sides.

On one hand, starting school early has many good points. Young children can learn many things quickly. They also learn how to make friends and follow rules. This helps them in the future.

On the other hand, some people think early school is bad for children. Small children need to play and they should not have pressure. If they start too early, maybe they will not enjoy their childhood. Also, they can feel stress.

In my opinion, both sides have good points. But I think it is better to start school at a normal age, not too early and not too late. Children should learn but they should also have time to play.

In conclusion, there are different opinions about this topic. I think a balance is the best way for children.
items.answer:
There is considerable debate about the ideal age for children to begin formal schooling. While some argue that children should start as early as possible, others maintain that a later start is preferable. This essay will examine both views before giving my opinion.

On the one hand, an early start offers clear advantages. Young children absorb new knowledge remarkably quickly, and school helps them develop social skills such as making friends and following rules, which benefit them throughout life.

On the other hand, critics contend that beginning school too soon can be detrimental. Young children need ample time to play and should not face academic pressure prematurely; otherwise, they may lose the freedom of childhood and experience unnecessary stress.

From my perspective, both positions have merit, but the most sensible approach is to strike a balance: children should begin at a moderate age, neither too early nor too late, so that structured learning and free play can coexist.

In conclusion, although opinions on this issue differ, I believe a balanced starting age best serves children’s long-term development.
items.reason: Key upgrade-हरू: discuss about-को सट्टा examine; good points-को सट्टा advantages र merit; bad-को सट्टा detrimental; strike a balance; on the one hand … on the other hand सटीक रूपमा प्रयोग।

blocks.instructions: यो Band 6.0 essay-लाई Band 8.5 देखि 9.0 स्तरमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्: idea-हरू उस्तै राख्नुहोस्, तर भाषा सुधार्नुहोस् (L1 बाट आएका गल्ती हटाउनुहोस्, धेरै प्रयोग हुने शब्द बदल्नुहोस्, cohesive device प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, हरेक paragraph-मा एउटा formal collocation थप्नुहोस्)। त्यसपछि model rewrite-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt:
Traffic congestion is a very big problem in many cities today. There are many causes of this problem and we can find some solutions also.

The main cause is that there are too many cars on the road. Nowadays, many people can buy their own car, so the roads become full. Another cause is that public transport is not good in many cities, so people prefer private cars. Also, roads are old and small.

This problem causes many difficulties. People waste a lot of time in traffic and it also creates pollution.

There are some solutions for this problem. First, the government should make public transport better so that people use it. Second, they can build more roads and flyovers. Also, they can make a rule to reduce cars in the city center.

In conclusion, traffic congestion is a serious problem but it can be solved if the government takes good steps.
items.answer:
Traffic congestion has become a pressing problem in many cities. This essay will outline its principal causes before proposing several viable solutions.

The primary cause is the sheer number of vehicles on the roads. As incomes rise, private car ownership has soared, leaving streets heavily congested. A further factor is inadequate public transport, which pushes commuters toward private cars, while ageing and narrow road networks compound the problem. The consequences are significant: commuters waste countless hours in gridlock, and vehicle emissions worsen urban air quality.

Fortunately, the issue can be addressed. Governments should first invest in efficient mass transit so that commuters have an attractive alternative to driving. Expanding the road network and building flyovers would ease the burden on existing routes. In addition, introducing a congestion charge would discourage private car use in city centres.

In conclusion, although traffic congestion is a serious problem, it can be substantially reduced if authorities implement effective measures, particularly by improving public transport and discouraging unnecessary car journeys.
items.reason: Key upgrade-हरू: very big problem-को सट्टा pressing problem; soared, gridlock, ease the burden, congestion charge, implement effective measures; also-को सट्टा A further factor र In addition।

v6_essay_4.title: Section 2 · Essay फेरि लेख्ने अभ्यास 4 (Advantages and disadvantages)
blocks: **Task 2-को प्रश्न (Advantages and disadvantages - फाइदा र बेफाइदा):** More and more people are working from home. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

blocks.title: Essay 4 · Band 6.0-को मस्यौदा
blocks.instructions: यो Band 6.0 essay-लाई Band 8.5 देखि 9.0 स्तरमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्: idea-हरू उस्तै राख्नुहोस्, तर भाषा सुधार्नुहोस् (L1 बाट आएका गल्ती हटाउनुहोस्, धेरै प्रयोग हुने शब्द बदल्नुहोस्, cohesive device प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, हरेक paragraph-मा एउटा formal collocation थप्नुहोस्)। त्यसपछि model rewrite-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt:
These days, more and more people are working from home. Some people think it has many advantages, but others think it has disadvantages. In my opinion, the advantages are more.

There are many good things about working from home. First, people can save time because they do not need to travel to office. So they can spend this time with family. Second, they feel relaxed and comfortable in their home.

But there are also some bad things. When people work from home, they can feel lonely. Also, sometimes it is difficult to focus because of family and other distractions. Some people also work less.

However, I think the advantages are bigger. With good discipline, people can do their work properly at home. Companies also save money on office rent.

In conclusion, working from home has both good and bad sides, but I believe the advantages are more than the disadvantages.
items.answer:
In recent years, remote working has become increasingly widespread. While it carries certain drawbacks, I firmly believe that its advantages outweigh them.

The benefits are considerable. Firstly, employees no longer need to commute, which saves a great deal of time that can instead be spent with family. Secondly, working in the comfort of one’s own home can reduce stress and improve wellbeing.

Admittedly, there are disadvantages. Remote workers may feel isolated from colleagues, and domestic distractions can make it difficult to concentrate; a minority may also become less productive without direct supervision.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks can largely be overcome. With sufficient self-discipline, most people can work just as effectively from home, and employers benefit too, since they can reduce expenditure on office space. On balance, the flexibility and savings that remote working offers are more significant than its shortcomings.

In conclusion, although working from home has both merits and limitations, I am convinced that its advantages, particularly greater flexibility and reduced commuting, clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Key upgrade-हरू: good things र bad things-को सट्टा benefits र drawbacks; bigger-को सट्टा outweigh; reduce expenditure; On balance; the advantages are more-को सट्टा its advantages clearly outweigh।

v6_essay_5.title: Section 2 · Essay फेरि लेख्ने अभ्यास 5 (Two-part direct question)
blocks: **Task 2-को प्रश्न (Two-part direct question - दुई भागको सिधा प्रश्न):** Many people today prefer fast food to home-cooked meals. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative development?

items.prompt:
Nowadays, many people prefer fast food instead of home-cooked meals. There are some reasons for this and I think it is a negative development.

There are many reasons why people like fast food. The main reason is that people are very busy today, so they do not have time to cook. Fast food is quick and easy. Another reason is that fast food is tasty and cheap. Also, there are many fast food shops everywhere.

However, I think this is a negative thing. Fast food has a lot of fat and sugar, so it is very bad for health. It causes many diseases like obesity. Home-cooked food is more healthy and clean.

In conclusion, people prefer fast food because it is quick and cheap, but I think it is a negative development because it is bad for our health.
items.answer:
These days, a growing number of people favour fast food over home-cooked meals. This essay will explain why this shift has occurred and argue that it is, on balance, a negative development.

Several factors explain the trend. The primary reason is the hectic pace of modern life: many people simply lack the time to prepare meals, and fast food is quick and convenient. In addition, it is inexpensive and palatable, and outlets are now ubiquitous in most cities.

However, I regard this development as largely detrimental. Fast food is typically high in fat, salt, and sugar, and therefore has a harmful effect on health, contributing to conditions such as obesity and heart disease. Home-cooked meals, by contrast, are generally more nutritious and hygienic.

In conclusion, although people increasingly turn to fast food because it is fast and affordable, I believe the trend is a negative one, since it poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Key upgrade-हरू: prefer … instead of-को सट्टा favour … over; tasty-को सट्टा palatable; everywhere-को सट्टा ubiquitous; very bad for health-को सट्टा has a harmful effect on health र poses a serious threat to public health।

v6_speaking_1.title: Speaking simulation 1 · Describe a place you enjoy visiting.
blocks: Workbook-को यो दोस्रो भागमा ५ वटा पूरा Speaking simulation छन्। हरेकमा एउटा Part 2 cue card, एउटा model long-turn उत्तर, model उत्तरसहित केही Part 3 follow-up प्रश्न, र एउटा छोटो lexical analysis छ। Model-हरू स्वाभाविक बोलचालको register-मा लेखिएका छन्, त्यसैले तिनमा contraction र idiom खुलेर प्रयोग गरिएका छन्। Speaking-का लागि यो ठ्याक्कै सही हो, र Writing Task 2-का लागि ठ्याक्कै गलत: ध्यान दिनुहोस्, यी उत्तरलाई माथि उठाउने idiom-खालको भाषालाई नै अध्याय ५ ले तपाईंको essay बाट टाढा राख्न भनेको थियो।
सक्नुहुन्छ भने आफ्नो कुरा record गर्नुहोस्।
Model-का हरेक idiom र collocation-मुनि रेखा तान्नुहोस्।
तपाईंले त्यो स्तरको केही बोल्न सक्नुभयो कि भनेर जाँच्नुहोस्।
Examiner ले केमा नम्बर दिन्थे भनेर पत्ता लगाउन lexical analysis प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

**Part 2 cue card · Describe a place you enjoy visiting.**
You should say:
• where it is
• how often you go there
• what you do there
• why you enjoy visiting it

I’d like to talk about a small hill town called Bandarban, in the southeast of Bangladesh. It isn’t exactly a stone’s throw away from where I live, so I only manage to go there once in a blue moon, maybe once a year, but it’s always worth the long journey.

What I love about it is that it’s completely off the beaten track. While a lot of tourists head to the crowded beaches, Bandarban is quieter and surrounded by breathtaking scenery: green hills, winding rivers, and tiny villages. When I’m there, I usually go hiking, explore the local markets, and just soak up the peace and quiet.

The main reason I enjoy it so much is that it gives me a real change of scenery. Living in a busy city, I’m always caught up in the daily grind, so escaping to the hills feels like a breath of fresh air. The last time I went, I reached the top of a hill right at sunrise, and honestly, that view was the icing on the cake. It was almost the trip of a lifetime, and I came back feeling completely recharged.
**Why do people enjoy travelling to new places?**

I think travel broadens people’s horizons. When you visit somewhere unfamiliar, you experience a different culture and way of life, which gives you a fresh perspective. For a lot of people it’s also a chance to escape their routine and recharge, so it’s really the best of both worlds: you relax and you learn something at the same time.

By and large, yes. Tourism can boost the local economy and create jobs, especially in remote areas. That said, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because mass tourism can put a strain on local resources and even degrade natural attractions, so it has to be managed carefully.
**Do people travel more now than in the past?**

Definitely. Air travel has become far more affordable, and social media makes distant places look appealing, so more people have caught the travel bug. In the past, international travel was a luxury; nowadays, it’s within reach for the average family.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn-ले स्वाभाविक idiom-हरूबाट नम्बर पाउँछ (a stone’s throw away, once in a blue moon, off the beaten track, a change of scenery, the daily grind, a breath of fresh air, the icing on the cake, the trip of a lifetime), जुन सहज वर्णनभित्र बुनिएका छन्; साथै collocation breathtaking scenery पनि छ। Part 3-मा register अलिकति छलफलतिर सर्छ, र broaden horizons, the best of both worlds, boost the local economy, a double-edged sword, र put a strain on आउँछन्। यी हरेक Speaking-का हुन्; एउटा पनि Task 2 essay-को होइन।

v6_speaking_2.title: Speaking simulation 2 · Describe a skill you would like to learn.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a skill you would like to learn.**
You should say:
• what the skill is
• how you would learn it
• how long it might take
• why you want to learn it

A skill I’d really love to learn is playing the guitar. I’ve wanted to pick it up for years, but I’ve never had the time to properly sit down and practise.

I’d probably learn it through a mix of online tutorials and a local teacher, because I think I’d need someone to help me get the hang of the basics. I imagine it would be a steep learning curve at first, especially learning the chords, and I’d have to burn the midnight oil to make real progress. Realistically, it might take a year or so before I could play a full song without stumbling.

The main reason I want to learn it is that music is a wonderful way to unwind after a long day. At the moment I’m caught up in the daily grind, and I think playing an instrument would help me relax and switch off completely. On top of that, being able to play at family gatherings would be the icing on the cake. Even if I’m never brilliant at it, I’d be over the moon just to strum a few tunes for the people I love.
**Is it better to learn a skill from a teacher or by yourself?**

It depends on the skill, but I think a teacher gives you a real head start. They can spot your mistakes and stop you from picking up bad habits. That said, teaching yourself builds discipline, so ideally you’d combine the two and get the best of both worlds.
**Why do some people find it hard to learn new skills as adults?**

More often than not, it comes down to time and confidence. Adults are busy and afraid of failing, so they give up before they really get to grips with it. Children, by contrast, learn through trial and error without worrying about looking silly.

Absolutely. I’d argue that schools place too much emphasis on exams and not enough on practical, transferable skills. Teaching things like budgeting or basic coding would equip students far better for real life.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn पढाइ र मेहनतसँग जोडिएका idiom-मा भर पर्छ (pick it up, get the hang of, a steep learning curve, burn the midnight oil, the daily grind, switch off, the icing on the cake, over the moon), साथै स्वाभाविक verb unwind। Part 3-मा a head start, the best of both worlds, get to grips with, trial and error, र essay-शैलीका collocation place emphasis on, transferable skills, र equip students ले register माथि उठाउँछन्, जसले candidate हल्का कथा भन्नेबाट तर्कपूर्ण छलफलसम्म सजिलै जान सक्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ।

v6_speaking_3.title: Speaking simulation 3 · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.**
You should say:
• what it is
• how you use it
• how often you use it
• why it is so useful to you

The piece of technology I find most useful is, without a doubt, my smartphone. It sounds obvious, but I honestly couldn’t get through the day without it. I use it around the clock, from the moment I wake up to the moment I go to sleep.

I rely on it for pretty much everything: checking emails, navigating unfamiliar streets, paying bills, and staying in touch with family. Because so much information is at my fingertips, tasks that used to take hours are now a piece of cake. If I need directions, for instance, I no longer have to ask around; I just tap the screen and go.

The main reason it’s so useful is that it’s basically several devices rolled into one, so it saves me a huge amount of time. Of course, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because I can easily end up glued to the screen, but as long as I keep it in check, the benefits far outweigh that. For me, it’s genuinely a game changer, and it’s honestly hard to imagine going back to life without it.
**Has technology made people’s lives easier or more stressful?**

It’s genuinely both. On the one hand, technology has transformed the way we work and communicate, making everything faster. On the other, being constantly connected can be exhausting, and a lot of people struggle to switch off. So I’d say it’s a mixed blessing.
**Do you think people rely too much on technology?**

More often than not, yes. Many of us can’t navigate without a map app or even remember a phone number anymore. It’s convenient, but it does make you wonder whether we’re quietly losing some basic skills along the way.
**How might technology change the way we work in the future?**

I imagine automation will reshape the job market completely. A lot of routine tasks will be automated, which could render some jobs obsolete, but it should also create brand-new roles. The key will be helping people keep up with the times through proper retraining.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn सहज सुनिन technology-खालका idiom प्रयोग गर्छ (around the clock, at my fingertips, a piece of cake, a double-edged sword, glued to the screen, keep it in check, a game changer)। Part 3-मा formal तिर ढल्केका collocation आउँछन्: transform the way we, a mixed blessing, reshape the job market, render obsolete, र keep up with the times। यो यस्तो candidate-को राम्रो उदाहरण हो, जो Part 2-मा कुराकानीको शैलीमा र Part 3-मा बढी विश्लेषणात्मक शैलीमा बोल्न सक्छन्, तर कहिल्यै essay जस्तो कडा हुँदैनन्।

v6_speaking_4.title: Speaking simulation 4 · Describe a time when you helped someone.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a time when you helped someone.**
You should say:
• who you helped
• how you helped them
• why they needed help
• how you felt about helping them

I’d like to talk about a time I helped a younger cousin of mine who was struggling with his studies. He was in at the deep end, preparing for a big exam, and he was really down in the dumps because he’d fallen badly behind.

I offered to lend a hand and tutor him a couple of evenings a week. We went through the topics he found difficult, and I tried to help him get to grips with the trickier concepts. It wasn’t always a piece of cake, because he’d lost a lot of confidence, so I had to go the extra mile to keep him motivated.

He needed help because both his parents worked long hours and couldn’t sit with him, so he’d basically been left to cope on his own. In the end, he pulled his socks up and passed with flying colours.

Honestly, I was over the moon when I heard the result. Helping him turned out to be a real labour of love, and seeing him succeed was the icing on the cake. It reminded me just how rewarding it is to give someone a helping hand when they need it.
**Why is it important to help others in society?**

I think helping others creates a stronger sense of community. When people lend a hand, it builds trust and mutual support, which benefits everyone. A society where people only look out for themselves tends to be far more divided.
**Should helping others be taught in schools?**

Definitely. Schools play a pivotal role in shaping a child’s character, so encouraging students to volunteer instils values like empathy and responsibility. If children learn to help early on, it usually stays with them for life.
**Do people help each other less than they used to?**

It’s hard to say, but many would argue that busy, urban lifestyles have made people more self-centred. That said, social media has also made it easier to organise help quickly, so in some ways the spirit of helping is alive and well, just in a different form.

**Lexical analysis:** यो long turn एउटा अनुभवको कथा भन्छ, त्यसैले यसमा स्वाभाविक idiom धेरै छन्: in at the deep end, down in the dumps, lend a hand, get to grips with, a piece of cake, go the extra mile, pull his socks up, pass with flying colours, over the moon, a labour of love, the icing on the cake, र a helping hand। जबरजस्ती नघुसाई सँगै प्रयोग गर्दा यिनले साँचो fluency देखाउँछन्। त्यसपछि Part 3-मा बढी academic play a pivotal role in, shaping character, र instil values आउँछन्, जुन समाजबारेको अमूर्त छलफलमा मिल्छन्।

v6_speaking_5.title: Speaking simulation 5 · Describe an environmental problem in your area.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe an environmental problem in your area.**
You should say:
• what the problem is
• what causes it
• how it affects people
• what could be done to solve it

The biggest environmental problem in my city is air pollution, which has become a really pressing concern over the last few years. On a bad day, the air is so hazy that you can barely see across the street.

The main causes are the sheer number of vehicles on the roads and the emissions from nearby factories. Because the city has grown so quickly, the infrastructure simply hasn’t kept up, so traffic is bumper to bumper for most of the day, and all those vehicles emit huge amounts of pollution.

It affects people in a big way. Many residents suffer from breathing problems, and children and the elderly are hit the hardest. Honestly, on some mornings it feels like the whole city grinds to a halt under a blanket of smog.

As for solutions, I think the authorities need to invest in public transport and gradually discourage private car use, perhaps through a congestion charge. Planting more trees and creating green spaces would help too. It certainly won’t be solved overnight, but if everyone plays their part, I’m hopeful things can improve.
**Whose responsibility is it to protect the environment?**

I’d say it’s a shared responsibility. Governments need to implement effective measures and regulate industry, but individuals also have to play their part by cutting their carbon footprint. Neither side can solve it alone.
**Are people today more environmentally aware than before?**

By and large, yes. People are far more conscious of issues like climate change, and going green has become quite mainstream. That said, awareness doesn’t always translate into action, so there’s still a long way to go.

To a certain extent. Renewable energy and cleaner transport are genuine game changers that could mitigate a lot of damage. But technology alone isn’t a silver bullet; it has to go hand in hand with real changes in how we live and consume.

**Lexical analysis:** यो topic essay-को विषयसँग नजिक भएकाले long turn-ले स्वाभाविक idiom (bumper to bumper, grinds to a halt, play their part) लाई अध्याय ४ मा पनि आउने topic collocation-सँग मिसाउँछ (a pressing concern, emissions, infrastructure, invest in public transport, discourage private car use, congestion charge, green spaces)। Part 3 अझ तर्कको भाषातिर जान्छ: implement effective measures, carbon footprint, going green, mitigate, a game changer, a silver bullet, र go hand in hand। यसले Speaking Part 3 र essay vocabulary बीचको उपयोगी मेल देखाउँछ, र idiom-हरूले कुरालाई कण्ठ गरेर भनेजस्तो नभई स्वाभाविक बोलीजस्तो सुनाउँछन्।

v1_intro.title: L1 Interference Fixer للطالب البنغلاديشي
v1_intro.group: الفصل 1 · L1 Interference Fixer (أخطاء سببها تأثير البنغالية)
blocks: يخسر معظم الـ candidates من بنغلاديش أسهل الدرجات هنا. الجمل الموجودة في هذا الفصل لا يكتبها طلاب ضعفاء، بل يكتبها طلاب أقوياء يتكلمون بطلاقة، لكن لغتهم الإنجليزية تتشكل بهدوء تحت تأثير البنغالية.
كل خطأ في الأسفل هو ترجمة أمينة لفكرة صحيحة تمامًا في البنغالية. المشكلة ليست في البنغالية، بل في نقل تركيب الجملة البنغالية إلى الإنجليزية كلمةً بكلمة، والـ examiner يلاحظ ذلك فورًا.
هذا يسمى تأثير اللغة الأم (L1 interference). وهو خطأ يمكن توقّعه، وله أنماط ثابتة، ولأن له أنماطًا ثابتة فمن الممكن إصلاحه. اعمل على الأخطاء الثلاثين كلها، وسجّل الأخطاء التي تقع فيها أنت.

بعد ذلك حلّ مجموعتي التمارين في النهاية بالقلم قبل أن تنظر إلى الإجابات. كل خطأ يعطيك 5 أشياء: الجملة الخاطئة، ومنطق البنغالية الذي ينتجها، والتصحيح بمستوى Band 9، والقاعدة الدقيقة في الـ grammar أو المفردات، ورأي الـ examiner في ما يكلّفك هذا الخطأ.

v1_errors_1.title: الأخطاء الثلاثون الأساسية (1–10)
v1_errors_1.group: الفصل 1 · L1 Interference Fixer (أخطاء سببها تأثير البنغالية)
blocks: I discussed about the problem with my teacher.
I discussed the problem with my teacher.

Discuss هو transitive verb: يأخذ object مباشرًا بدون preposition بعده. ونفس الشيء ينطبق على enter وapproach وreach وmarry وrequest وlack. تقول discuss a problem، وليس discuss about a problem. وإذا أردت noun فاستخدم have a discussion about.
আমি শিক্ষকের সাথে সমস্যাটি নিয়ে আলোচনা করেছি. كلمة নিয়ে (niye) تحمل معنى “about”، لذلك يضيف الطلاب about بعد discuss.

**رأي الـ examiner:** هذا الـ preposition وحده من أوضح العلامات التي تكشف أن الكاتب من بنغلاديش. ويدخل الخطأ تحت Grammatical Range and Accuracy وتحت Lexical Resource معًا، لأنه خطأ collocation. إذا حدث مرة واحدة فهو زلّة؛ أما إذا تكرر فهو عادة راسخة تبقيك عند Band 6.5.
The writer emphasised on the need for reform.
The writer emphasised the need for reform. / The writer placed emphasis on the need for reform.
Emphasise هو transitive ولا يأخذ preposition. الـ preposition on يأتي فقط مع صيغة الـ noun: place emphasis on وput stress on. اختر تركيبًا واحدًا ولا تخلط بين الاثنين.
লেখক সংস্কারের প্রয়োজনীয়তার উপর জোর দিয়েছেন. জোর দেওয়া (jor deoa، “أن تعطي تأكيدًا”) يأتي مع উপর (upor، “on”)، لذلك تنتقل on إلى الإنجليزية.

**رأي الـ examiner:** يظهر هذا الخطأ كثيرًا في مقالات Task 2 عن ما “يبرزه” نص أو سياسة ما. عندما تكتبه صحيحًا تُظهر للـ examiner أنك تتحكم في صيغة الـ verb وصيغة الـ noun لنفس الفكرة، وهذه المرونة هي بالضبط ما يكافئه Band 7.
We reached to the station just before the train left.
We reached the station just before the train left. / We arrived at the station just in time.
Reach هو transitive: نقول reach a place بدون preposition. وإذا فضّلت arrive فهو يأخذ at (لمكان محدد) أو in (لمنطقة كبيرة): arrive at the station، arrive in Dhaka.
আমরা স্টেশনে পৌঁছেছি. اللاحقة المكانية ে (-e، “إلى/في”) على كلمة স্টেশন تتحول إلى to في الإنجليزية.
**رأي الـ examiner:** Reach to خطأ صغير لكنه متكرر في القصص التي تحكيها في Speaking Part 2. إصلاحه يزيل خصمًا متكررًا في الدقة (accuracy) من طريقة سردك.
My cousin is married with a doctor.
My cousin is married to a doctor.
الـ collocation الثابت هو married to، وليس married with أبدًا. تفعل شيئًا with شخص آخر، لكنك married to هذا الشخص. قارن مع engaged to وrelated to.
আমার চাচাতো ভাইয়ের একজন ডাক্তারের সাথে বিয়ে হয়েছে. সাথে (shathe) معناها “with”، لذلك تأتي with بعد married.

**رأي الـ examiner:** مفردات العلاقات العائلية تظهر باستمرار في Speaking Part 1 (موضوع العائلة). خطأ الـ collocation هنا صغير وحده، لكنه يبقى في ذهن الـ examiner الذي يستمع ليرى هل تستخدم الكلمات مع شركائها الطبيعيين.
My manager is senior than me.
My manager is senior to me. / My manager is more experienced than I am.

مجموعة صغيرة من الـ comparative adjectives ذات الأصل اللاتيني تأخذ to وليس than: senior to وjunior to وsuperior to وinferior to وprior to. أما الـ comparatives العادية (bigger، faster) فقط فتأخذ than.
আমার ম্যানেজার আমার থেকে সিনিয়র. থেকে (theke) تعني “from” وتعني “than” معًا، لذلك يستخدم الطلاب than بعد senior.
**رأي الـ examiner:** استخدام superior to وprior to بشكل صحيح علامة هادئة على Band 7.5. فهو يُظهر أنك تعرف مفردات أقل شيوعًا والـ collocations الخاصة بها، وهذا ما تكافئه الـ band descriptors مباشرة.
I prefer reading books than watching television.
I prefer reading books to watching television.
Prefer تأخذ to وليس than: prefer A to B. وعندما يكون الخياران verbs، اجعلهما بنفس الصيغة: prefer reading to watching. والتركيب البديل هو would rather read than watch، وهنا تكون than صحيحة.
আমি টেলিভিশন দেখার থেকে বই পড়া বেশি পছন্দ করি. مرة أخرى থেকে (theke، “than/from”) تجرّ معها than.
**رأي الـ examiner:** Prefer من أكثر الـ verbs استخدامًا في Speaking Part 1. ونمط prefer to من أكثر الإصلاحات فائدة في هذا الفصل مقابل جهد قليل، لأنك ستستخدمه في كل مقابلة تقريبًا.
She is very good in mathematics and physics.
She is very good at mathematics and physics.
الـ adjectives التي تصف المهارة تأخذ at: good at وskilled at وtalented at وpoor at. أما in فتُستخدم فقط مع مجال كامل في تركيب مختلف (a degree in physics).
সে অঙ্ক আর পদার্থবিজ্ঞানে খুব ভালো. اللاحقة المكانية ে (-e، “في”) على أسماء المواد تتحول إلى in.

**رأي الـ examiner:** وصف قدراتك أمر لا مفر منه في Speaking Part 1 (الدراسة والعمل). الفرق بين good at وgood in اختبار كلاسيكي لتركيب adjective مع preposition، والدقة المستمرة هنا ترفع مستوى الـ collocations عندك.
My teacher gave me a very useful advice.
My teacher gave me a very useful piece of advice. / My teacher gave me some very useful advice.
Advice هو uncountable: لا يأخذ a/an، ولا s- للجمع، ويأخذ verb مفردًا. لكي تعدّه استخدم تعبيرًا للتجزئة (partitive): a piece of advice، two pieces of advice.
আমার শিক্ষক আমাকে একটি খুব দরকারি উপদেশ দিয়েছেন. উপদেশ (upodesh، “advice”) اسم يُعدّ (countable) في البنغالية، لذلك يُضاف إليه একটি (ekti، “a/one”).

**رأي الـ examiner:** التحكم في الـ uncountable nouns موجود في قائمة الأخطاء الشائعة عند طلاب جنوب آسيا لسبب واضح. كتابة a advice أو advices علامة فورية على Band 6 في تكوين الكلمات؛ أما تصحيح piece of فيُظهر أنك تعرف القاعدة.
The library provides many informations and equipments.
The library provides a great deal of information and equipment.

Information وequipment وfurniture وresearch وknowledge وaccommodation وtraffic وprogress كلها uncountable في الإنجليزية، ولا تأخذ s- أبدًا. عبّر عن كميتها بـ a great deal of أو a large amount of أو much.
লাইব্রেরি অনেক তথ্য এবং সরঞ্জাম সরবরাহ করে. তথ্য (tottho) وসরঞ্জাম (shoronjam) تتصرفان ككلمات تُعدّ في البنغالية، لذلك تُضاف s- للجمع في الإنجليزية.
**رأي الـ examiner:** هذه الكلمات الثماني تظهر في كل مقالة أكاديمية تقريبًا. جمع كلمة واحدة منها بشكل متكرر يكفي لإنزال Lexical Resource إلى Band 6، لأن تكوين الكلمات يُقيَّم داخل هذا المعيار.
I am completely agree with this statement.
I completely agree with this statement. / I am in complete agreement with this statement.
Agree هو verb كامل، وليس adjective. لا يأخذ am/is/are. استخدم إما الـ verb (I agree) أو الـ noun phrase (I am in agreement). ولا تكتب am agree أبدًا.
আমি এই বক্তব্যের সাথে সম্পূর্ণ একমত. একমত (ekmot) حالة تعني “in agreement”، فتبدو مثل adjective، لذلك يضيف الطلاب am.

**رأي الـ examiner:** مقالات agree and disagree هي أكثر أنواع Task 2 شيوعًا. البدء بـ I am agree في الجملة الأولى يعطي انطباعًا بمستوى grammar عند Band 5.5 قبل أن يقرأ الـ examiner حجتك. هذا إصلاح ذو قيمة عالية.

v1_errors_2.title: الأخطاء الثلاثون الأساسية (11–20)
v1_errors_2.group: الفصل 1 · L1 Interference Fixer (أخطاء سببها تأثير البنغالية)
blocks: Everybody in my office are working overtime this week.
Everybody in my office is working overtime this week.
Everybody وeveryone وsomebody وnobody وeach وneither كلها مفردة من ناحية الـ grammar وتأخذ verb مفردًا، مهما كان عدد الأشخاص الذين تصفهم. والعبارة التي تأتي في الوسط (in my office) لا تغيّر هذا.
আমার অফিসের সবাই এই সপ্তাহে অতিরিক্ত সময় কাজ করছে. সবাই (shobai، “everybody”) تشير إلى أشخاص كثيرين، لذلك يبدو الـ verb وكأنه جمع.
**رأي الـ examiner:** الـ subject-verb agreement مع الـ indefinite pronouns زلّة متكررة عند Band 6. ولأنها تتكرر في النص كله، فإن تثبيت عادة صحيحة واحدة هنا يحمي درجاتك في كل فقرة.
One of my friend is studying in Canada.
One of my friends is studying in Canada.
بعد one of يجب أن يكون الـ noun جمعًا (one of my friends)، لأنك تختار واحدًا من مجموعة. أما الـ verb فيبقى مفردًا لأن الـ subject الحقيقي هو one: one of my friends is.
আমার এক বন্ধু কানাডায় পড় ছে. এক বন্ধু (ek bondhu، “صديق واحد”) مفرد في البنغالية، لذلك تبقى friend مفردة.
**رأي الـ examiner:** هذا فخ من جزأين: noun جمع وverb مفرد. عادةً يصلح الطلاب نصفًا وينسون النصف الآخر. تصحيح الاثنين معًا علامة واضحة على دقة Band 7 في Speaking Part 1.
Every students must bring their identity card.
Every student must bring their identity card. / All students must bring their identity cards.
Every وeach يأتي بعدهما دائمًا noun مفرد وverb مفرد: every student is. وإذا أردت noun جمعًا فغيّر الـ determiner إلى all: all students are.
প্রত্যেক ছাত্রকে তাদের পরিচয়পত্র আনতে হবে. الأسماء في البنغالية لا تُجبر على صيغة الجمع، لذلك تُفهم ছাত্র (chhatro، “student”) على أنها مرنة.
**رأي الـ examiner:** Every مع noun جمع خطأ أساسي في العدّ (countability) يضع سقفًا سريعًا لـ Grammatical Range and Accuracy. والإصلاح آلي بمجرد أن تربط في ذهنك every بالمفرد.
The number of road accidents are increasing every year.
The number of road accidents is increasing every year.

الـ subject في هذه الجملة هو number (مفرد)، وليس accidents. التركيب The number of + plural noun يأخذ verb مفردًا. قارن مع a number of + plural noun، ومعناه “عدة” ويأخذ verb جمعًا: a number of accidents are unreported.
সড় ক দুর্ঘটনার সংখ্যা প্রতি বছর বাড় ছে. فكرة الجمع “accidents” تقع مباشرة قبل الـ verb فتسحبه نحو الجمع.
**رأي الـ examiner:** هذه العبارة بالضبط، the number of، أداة أساسية في Task 1. والـ agreement الصحيح معها من أوضح المكاسب في الدقة عند وصف البيانات.
Despite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.
Despite the heavy rain, the ceremony continued. / In spite of the heavy rain, the ceremony continued.
Despite لا تأخذ of. أما In spite of فتحتفظ بـ of. وبعد الاثنين يأتي noun أو صيغة ing-، وليس clause كاملة أبدًا. للـ clause الكاملة استخدم although: Although it rained heavily, the ceremony continued.
ভারী বৃষ্টি সত্ত্বেও, অনুষ্ঠান চলতে থাকল. সত্ত্বেও (sotteo) تُترجم إلى “in spite of”، لذلك يخلط الطلاب بين التعبيرين فينتج despite of.

**رأي الـ examiner:** خلط despite of من أكثر أخطاء الاستدراك (concession) شيوعًا في كتابة Task 2 عند طلاب بنغلاديش. ولأن الاستدراك حركة أساسية في المقالة، يظهر هذا الخطأ كثيرًا ويستحق أن تتخلص منه تمامًا.
After his studies, he returned back to his hometown.
After his studies, he returned to his hometown.
Return تعني أصلًا “go back”، لذلك returned back تكرار لا داعي له. ونفس التكرار يحدث في repeat again وrevert back وreverse back وascend up. استخدم الـ verb وحده.
পড়াশোনা শেষে সে তার নিজ শহরে ফিরে গেছে. ফিরে যাওয়া (phire jaoa) تحمل أصلًا معنى “returning back”، لذلك تُضاف back فوقها في الإنجليزية.

**رأي الـ examiner:** التكرار نقطة ضعف في Lexical Resource: فهو يُظهر أن معنى الكلمة لم يُفهم تمامًا. حذف هذا التكرار يجعل كتابتك أكثر إحكامًا ودقة، وهذه بالضبط صفة Band 8: “conveying precise meaning”.
Students must learn to cope up with academic pressure.
Students must learn to cope with academic pressure.
الـ verb هو cope with، بدون up. وإضافة up عادة إقليمية في جنوب آسيا. قارن مع put up with (يتحمّل) الصحيح، وهو phrasal verb مختلف فعلًا.
শিক্ষার্থীদের শিক্ষাগত চাপের সাথে খাপ খাওয়াতে শিখতে হবে. لا توجد up في الجملة البنغالية؛ بل تُضاف up بالقياس الخاطئ على phrasal verbs أخرى مثل keep up وput up with.

**رأي الـ examiner:** دقة الـ phrasal verbs تُقيَّم تحت Lexical Resource. والـ examiners يعرفون cope up with فورًا كخطأ إقليمي، لذلك حذفه يقوّي الطابع الطبيعي القريب من لغة أهل اللغة، وهو ما تعتمد عليه درجتك في Speaking.
The committee comprises of twelve senior members.
The committee comprises twelve senior members. / The committee is composed of twelve senior members. / The committee consists of twelve senior members.
Comprise هو transitive ولا يأخذ of. الـ of تنتمي إلى consist of وbe composed of. لا تخلط بينها أبدًا لتكتب comprises of.
কমিটি বারো জন প্রবীণ সদস্য নিয়ে গঠিত. নিয়ে গঠিত (niye gothito، “مكوَّن من”) تقابل “comprises of”.
**رأي الـ examiner:** هذا خطأ مفضّل في وصف الـ pie charts والعمليات (process) في Task 1. اختيار consists of أو comprises بشكل صحيح يُظهر تحكمك في verb أكاديمي أقل شيوعًا، وهي علامة تنوّع عند Band 7.
I have visited Cox’s Bazar last winter with my family.
I visited Cox’s Bazar last winter with my family.

تعبير الزمن المنتهي (last winter، in 2019، two years ago) يفرض الـ simple past. لا يمكن أن يأتي الـ present perfect مع زمن منتهٍ مذكور. استخدم الـ present perfect فقط لزمن مفتوح أو مستمر (I have visited Cox’s Bazar several times).
আমি গত শীতে পরিবারসহ কক্সবাজার গিয়েছি. البنغالية في المحادثة تستخدم صيغة ماضٍ واحدة لـ “I went” و“I have gone” معًا، لذلك يُستخدم الـ present perfect أكثر من اللازم.
**رأي الـ examiner:** تعارض الأزمنة هذا خطأ يمسّ المحتوى في Speaking Part 2، حيث تحكي تجربة ماضية. استخدام الـ past tense بشكل ثابت طوال حديث مدته دقيقتان علامة قوية على الـ fluency والدقة.
I am living in Dhaka since 2015.
I have been living in Dhaka since 2015. / I have lived in Dhaka since 2015.

المدة التي بدأت في الماضي وما زالت مستمرة الآن تحتاج إلى الـ present perfect أو الـ present perfect continuous، وليس الـ present continuous. والكلمتان الدالتان since وfor تسحبانك نحو صيغة الـ perfect.
আমি ২০১৫ সাল থেকে ঢাকায় থাকছি. الصيغة المستمرة في البنغالية থাকছি (thakchhi) تغطي المدة المستمرة، لذلك تقابلها في الإنجليزية الـ present continuous.
**رأي الـ examiner:** التحكم في الإطار الزمني يفصل Band 6 عن Band 7 في Speaking Part 1. ونمط have been + -ing since تركيب شائع جدًا يستحق أن تتدرب عليه حتى يصبح تلقائيًا.

v1_errors_3.title: الأخطاء الثلاثون الأساسية (21–30)
v1_errors_3.group: الفصل 1 · L1 Interference Fixer (أخطاء سببها تأثير البنغالية)
blocks: My friend told to me that the interview went well.
My friend told me that the interview went well. / My friend said to me that the interview went well.
Tell يأخذ الشخص مباشرة بدون to (tell me، tell him). أما Say فيحتاج to قبل الشخص (say to me). الـ verbs الاثنان لهما نمطان مختلفان: tell someone something مقابل say something to someone.
আমার বন্ধু আমাকে বলল যে সাক্ষাৎকারটি ভালো হয়েছে. আমাকে বলল (amake bollo، “told me”) تحمل معنى “to me”، فيُكتب هذا المعنى صراحةً في الإنجليزية.
**رأي الـ examiner:** الكلام المنقول (reported speech) موجود في كل قصص Speaking Part 2. والفرق بين tell وsay تمييز دقيق في المفردات، والتحكم فيه يُظهر سيطرة حقيقية على أفعال النقل الشائعة.
According to me, the voting age should be lowered.
In my opinion, the voting age should be lowered. / To my mind, the voting age should be lowered.
According to تقدّم مصدرًا خارجيًا (according to the report، according to experts)، وليس رأيك أنت. لرأيك الشخصي استخدم in my opinion أو from my perspective أو I would argue that.
আমার মতে, ভোটের বয়স কমানো উচিত. আমার মতে (amar mote) عبارة ثابتة بمعنى “in my opinion”، وتُترجم حرفيًا أكثر من اللازم إلى “according to me”.

**رأي الـ examiner:** According to me من أكثر أخطاء عبارات الرأي تكرارًا في مقالات Task 2 وفي Speaking Part 3 عند طلاب بنغلاديش. استبدالها بمجموعة متنوعة من عبارات الرأي يرفع Lexical Resource ويرفع المستوى الأكاديمي (register) الذي يتوقعه الـ examiners.
Maximum people in my country depend on agriculture.
Most people in my country depend on agriculture. / The majority of people in my country depend on agriculture.
Maximum هو noun أو adjective يعني أعلى كمية ممكنة (the maximum speed). ولا يعني “most”. للجزء الأكبر من مجموعة استخدم most أو the majority of أو the bulk of.
আমার দেশের বেশিরভাগ মানুষ কৃষির উপর নির্ভর করে. বেশিরভাগ (beshirbhag، “most”) تُترجم خطأً إلى “maximum”.
**رأي الـ examiner:** Maximum people خطأ واضح في اختيار الكلمة تحت Lexical Resource. واستبدالها بـ the majority of أو the bulk of يعطيك أيضًا تنوعًا في أدوات الكمية (quantifiers) الذي يكافئه Task 2.
I have to give an important exam at the end of this month.
I have to sit an important exam at the end of this month. / I have to take an important exam at the end of this month.
في الإنجليزية، الطالب sits أو takes an exam؛ والـ examiner أو المؤسسة فقط هي التي sets أو gives الامتحان. Give an exam تعكس الأدوار.
এই মাসের শেষে আমাকে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পরীক্ষা দিতে হবে. পরীক্ষা দেওয়া (porikkha deoa، “أن تعطي امتحانًا”) تستخدم দেওয়া (deoa، “give”)، لذلك يقول الطلاب “give an exam”.
**رأي الـ examiner:** مفردات التعليم أساسية في Speaking Part 1. وSit an exam (استخدام بريطاني مفضّل في IELTS) collocation طبيعي يبدو فورًا أقرب إلى لغة أهل اللغة من give an exam.
Try not to do the same mistake in the next test.
Try not to make the same mistake in the next test.

الإنجليزية تفرّق بين do وmake حسب الـ collocation. تقول make a mistake وa decision وprogress وan effort وan arrangement؛ وتقول do homework وresearch وa favour وbusiness وdamage. الكلمة البنغالية করা تغطي كل هذه، لذلك يجب أن تحفظ هذا التقسيم كأزواج ثابتة.
পরের পরীক্ষায় একই ভুল কোরো না. ভুল করা (bhul kora) تستخدم করা (kora)، التي تغطي “do” و“make” معًا، فينتج do a mistake.
**رأي الـ examiner:** التقسيم بين do وmake من أكثر اختبارات الـ collocation تكرارًا في اللغة. الدقة المستمرة فيه علامة قوية في Lexical Resource؛ والزلّات المتكررة تضع سقفًا عند Band 6.
I have not met my school friends since a long time.
I have not met my school friends for a long time.
بعد Since تأتي نقطة زمنية بدأ فيها الشيء (since 2015، since Monday). وبعد For تأتي مدة زمنية (for a long time، for three years). و“A long time” مدة، لذلك تأخذ for.
আমি অনেকদিন ধরে আমার স্কুলের বন্ধুদের সাথে দেখা করিনি. ধরে (dhore) تدل على امتداد زمني، وتُفهم بشكل غير دقيق على أنها “since”.
**رأي الـ examiner:** الفرق بين since وfor مرتبط مباشرة بالـ present perfect في الخطأ 20. إتقان الاثنين معًا يزيل مجموعة من الأخطاء المترابطة التي كانت ستتكرر لولا ذلك في كل Speaking Part 1.
Please off the fan and light before you leave the room.
Please turn off the fan and the light before you leave the room.
الإنجليزية تستخدم الـ phrasal verbs turn on وturn off (أو switch on/off) مع الأجهزة الكهربائية. Off ليست verb، وopen/close تُستخدمان مع الأبواب والنوافذ، وليس مع المصابيح والمراوح.
ঘর ছাড়ার আগে ফ্যান আর লাইট বন্ধ করো. বন্ধ করা (bondho kora، “يغلق/يطفئ”) تصبح “off”، وখোলা (khola، “يفتح”) تصبح “open”، فينتج off the fan وopen the light.

**رأي الـ examiner:** Open the light وoff the fan ترجمات حرفية إقليمية لا يمكن أن تخطئها الأذن. نادرًا ما تظهر في Writing، لكنها تظهر في Speaking Part 1 عن البيت والروتين اليومي، حيث يستمع الـ examiner بالضبط إلى الـ phrasal verbs الطبيعية.
My all relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.
All my relatives gathered for the wedding celebration.
في الإنجليزية تأتي all قبل الـ possessive: all my relatives، all his money، all our efforts. الترتيب البنغالي “my all” معكوس. ونفس الشيء في both my parents وhalf my salary.
আমার সব আত্মীয় বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে জড়ো হয়েছিল. আমার সব (amar shob، حرفيًا “my all”) تضع الـ possessive قبل all، فينتقل هذا الترتيب إلى الإنجليزية.

**رأي الـ examiner:** ترتيب الـ determiners نقطة دقيقة في Grammatical Range and Accuracy. هي صغيرة وحدها، لكن عندما تكون صحيحة باستمرار تساهم في السلاسة والطبيعية التي تميّز الكلام والكتابة في الـ bands الأعلى.
Myself Rahim, and I am here to talk about my hometown.
My name is Rahim, and I am here to talk about my hometown. / I am Rahim, and I would like to talk about my hometown.
Myself هو reflexive pronoun (I did it myself)؛ ولا يمكن أن يقدّم اسمًا. استخدم My name is أو I am ثم الاسم.
আমি রহিম, আর আমি আমার শহর নিয়ে কথা বলতে এসেছি. عادة تقديم النفس بإعلان الاسم تتحول إلى العبارة غير الصحيحة “Myself Rahim”.

**رأي الـ examiner:** في اختبار IELTS Speaking لست مطالبًا بتقديم نفسك رسميًا، لكن إذا فعلت فإن Myself Rahim علامة إقليمية فورية. أما I am Rahim الطبيعية فتترك انطباعًا أول أقوى في الـ fluency والمفردات.
I passed out from university in 2019 with a degree in economics.
I graduated from university in 2019 with a degree in economics.
في الإنجليزية القياسية pass out تعني يُغمى عليه أو يفقد الوعي. لإنهاء شهادة جامعية استخدم graduate from أو complete my studies at. هذه كلمة مخادعة (false friend)، وليست خطأ grammar.
هذه عادة من الإنجليزية المستخدمة في المؤسسات، وليست ترجمة مباشرة من البنغالية: “pass out” تُستخدم على نطاق واسع في جنوب آسيا بمعنى “graduate”.

**رأي الـ examiner:** Passed out from university قد تربك الـ examiner فعلًا، لأن معناها القياسي “fainted”. وبما أن الخلفية التعليمية تُسأل في كل Speaking Part 1 تقريبًا، فإن استبدالها بـ graduated from يحمي وضوح المعنى والـ register في الوقت نفسه.

v1_practice.title: Practice · اكتشف أخطاء الـ L1 وصحّحها
v1_practice.group: الفصل 1 · L1 Interference Fixer (أخطاء سببها تأثير البنغالية)
blocks: حلّ التمرينين كاملين بالقلم قبل أن تنظر إلى الإجابات. لا تقرأ الإجابات أولًا؛ فالتعرّف على الخطأ ليس مثل إنتاج الجملة الصحيحة بنفسك.

blocks.title: Exercise 1.1 · اكتشف خطأ الـ L1
blocks.instructions: كل جملة من الجمل الـ 15 التالية فيها خطأ واحد مخفي سببه الترجمة من البنغالية إلى الإنجليزية. ضع خطًا تحت الخطأ، ثم أعد كتابة الجملة بإنجليزية صحيحة وطبيعية.

items.prompt: Scientists are still discussing about the real causes of climate change.
items.answer: Scientists are still discussing the real causes of climate change.
items.reason: discuss هو transitive ويأخذ الـ object مباشرة؛ وdiscuss about تكرّر معنى يحمله الـ verb أصلًا.

items.prompt: This report comprises of five main sections and a short appendix.
items.answer: This report comprises five main sections and a short appendix. (or consists of)
items.reason: comprise لا تأخذ of؛ الـ of تنتمي فقط إلى consist of وbe composed of.

items.prompt: My elder brother is senior than me by four years.
items.answer: My elder brother is senior to me by four years.
items.reason: الـ comparatives ذات الأصل اللاتيني (senior، junior، superior، prior) تأخذ to، وليس than أبدًا.

items.prompt: My sister is married with a civil engineer from Khulna.
items.answer: My sister is married to a civil engineer from Khulna.
items.reason: الـ collocation الثابت هو married to؛ وwith تُستخدم لفعل شيء مع شخص، وليس لرابطة الزواج.

items.prompt: I have been staying in this hostel since my first year, and I am living here still now.
items.answer: I have been staying in this hostel since my first year, and I still live here.
items.reason: الوضع الذي بدأ في الماضي وما زال مستمرًا الآن يحتاج إلى الـ present perfect، وليس الـ present continuous.

items.prompt: The counsellor gave me two very useful advices about choosing a subject.
items.answer: The counsellor gave me two very useful pieces of advice about choosing a subject.
items.reason: advice هو uncountable، لذلك لا يأخذ s- للجمع؛ ولكي تعدّه استخدم pieces of advice.

items.prompt: Everyone in our study group are preparing hard for the mock test.
items.answer: Everyone in our study group is preparing hard for the mock test.
items.reason: everyone مفرد من ناحية الـ grammar مهما كان عدد الأشخاص الذين يشير إليهم؛ والعبارة in our study group لا تغيّر الـ verb.

items.prompt: Despite of the heavy workload, she submitted every assignment on time.
items.answer: Despite the heavy workload, she submitted every assignment on time.
items.reason: despite لا تأخذ of؛ فقط in spite of تحتفظ بـ of.

items.prompt: According to me, public libraries should stay open late into the evening.
items.answer: In my opinion, public libraries should stay open late into the evening.
items.reason: according to تقدّم مصدرًا خارجيًا، وليس رأيك أنت؛ استخدم in my opinion لرأيك الشخصي.

items.prompt: The number of private cars on the road are rising sharply each year.
items.answer: The number of private cars on the road is rising sharply each year.
items.reason: الـ subject الحقيقي هو number (مفرد)؛ وthe number of تأخذ دائمًا verb مفردًا.

items.prompt: It is difficult for many workers to cope up with rapid technological change.
items.answer: It is difficult for many workers to cope with rapid technological change.
items.reason: الـ verb هو cope with؛ وup الزائدة عادة إقليمية لا أساس لها في العبارة.

items.prompt: Please open the light; the room is too dark to read in.
items.answer: Please turn on the light; the room is too dark to read in.
items.reason: المصابيح والأجهزة نقول لها turned on أو off؛ وopen/close تُستخدمان مع الأبواب والنوافذ.

items.prompt: We reached to the examination hall twenty minutes before it started.
items.answer: We reached the examination hall twenty minutes before it started. (or arrived at)
items.reason: reach هو transitive ولا يأخذ preposition؛ أما arrive فتأخذ at أو in.

items.prompt: Most students prefer group study than studying alone at home.
items.answer: Most students prefer group study to studying alone at home.
items.reason: prefer تأتي مع to وليس than؛ واجعل الخيارين بنفس الصيغة (study to studying).

items.prompt: After completing his research, he returned back to his home country.
items.answer: After completing his research, he returned to his home country.
items.reason: return تعني أصلًا “go back”، لذلك back زائدة.

blocks.title: Exercise 1.2 · تحدّي الترجمة من البنغالية إلى Band 9
blocks.instructions: اقرأ كل فكرة مكتوبة بالبنغالية، واكتب جملة IELTS واحدة طبيعية وخالية من الأخطاء تعبّر عنها. لا تترجم كلمة بكلمة؛ ترجم المعنى. كل فكرة تخفي فخًا (trap) واحدًا على الأقل من Part A.

items.prompt: বেশিরভাগ মানুষ মনে করে যে প্রযুক্তি আমাদের দৈনন্দিন জীবনকে অনেক সহজ করেছে।
items.answer: Most people believe that technology has made our daily lives much easier.
items.reason: Trap: maximum بدل most؛ استخدم الـ present perfect لتغيير له علاقة بالحاضر.

items.prompt: যানজট সত্ত্বেও, শহরের বেশিরভাগ মানুষ এখনও ব্যক্তিগত গাড়ি ব্যবহার করতে পছন্দ করে।
items.answer: Despite the traffic congestion, most city dwellers still prefer to use private cars.
items.reason: Trap: despite of؛ prefer … to.

items.prompt: আমার মতে, সরকারের উচিত শিক্ষা খাতে আরও বেশি বিনিয়োগ করা।
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should invest more heavily in the education sector.
items.reason: Trap: according to me؛ invest in.

items.prompt: আমি ২০১৮ সাল থেকে এই বিষয়ের উপর গবেষণা করছি।
items.answer: I have been researching this subject since 2018.
items.reason: Trap: الـ present continuous مع since؛ وresearch هو transitive، بدون about.

items.prompt: দূষণ জনস্বাস্থ্যের জন্য একটি মারাত্মক হুমকি সৃষ্টি করছে।
items.answer: Pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Trap: استخدم الـ collocation الدقيق pose a threat to بدل verb غامض.

items.prompt: তরুণ প্রজন্মের জন্য কর্মসংস্থানের সুযোগ তৈরি করা অত্যন্ত জরুরি।
items.answer: It is essential to create employment opportunities for the younger generation.
items.reason: Trap: التعبير الرسمي it is essential to؛ والعبارة الطبيعية the younger generation.

items.prompt: যদিও অনেক শিক্ষার্থী ইংরেজিতে ভালো, তবুও তারা পরীক্ষায় ভালো ফল করতে পারে না।
items.answer: Although many students are good at English, they fail to perform well in the exam.
items.reason: Trap: good in تصبح good at؛ وalthough مع clause كاملة.

items.prompt: আমি একদিন আমার নিজের একটি প্রতিষ্ঠান গড়ে তুলতে চাই।
items.answer: I hope to build my own company one day.
items.reason: Trap: التعبير الطبيعي build/establish a company وhope to، وليس ترجمة كلمة بكلمة.

items.prompt: দারিদ্র্য দূর করা যেকোনো উন্নয়নশীল দেশের সবচেয়ে বড় চ্যালেঞ্জ।
items.answer: Eradicating poverty is the biggest challenge for any developing nation.
items.reason: Trap: eradicate أقوى من remove؛ وgerund في موقع الـ subject.

items.prompt: যদি সরকার আরও কঠোর আইন প্রণয়ন করত, তাহলে অপরাধের হার কমে যেত।
items.answer: If the government enacted stricter laws, the crime rate would decrease.
items.reason: Trap: الـ second conditional (الماضي بعد if، وwould في النتيجة)؛ the crime rate، وليس the rate of crime are.

v2_intro.title: Band Upgrade Matrix: جدول لرفع مستوى كلماتك
blocks: الفصل 1 أزال الأخطاء التي تُنزل درجتك. وهذا الفصل يضيف الدقة التي ترفعها. كل طالب يأتي ومعه مجموعة صغيرة من الكلمات التي يستخدمها أكثر من اللازم ويحمّلها عملًا كثيرًا: big وgood وbad وvery وproblem وthing.

هذه الكلمات ليست خاطئة. هي فقط غامضة، والغموض هو ما يضع سقفًا لـ Lexical Resource عند Band 6. الـ examiner لا ينبهر بكلمة نادرة لمجرد أنها نادرة؛ بل ينبهر بالكلمة المناسبة، أي الكلمة التي تقول بالضبط ما تقصده.

لخمس وثلاثين كلمة من أكثر الكلمات استهلاكًا في إنجليزية طلاب بنغلاديش، يعطيك هذا الفصل سُلّمًا: صيغة Band 5.5 التي تستخدمها غالبًا الآن، ثم ترقية بمستوى Band 7.5، ثم اختيار دقيق بمستوى Band 9.0، مع تعليمات واضحة عن المكان المناسب لكل منها. اقرأ الشرح كاملًا، وليس الكلمة الفخمة في الأعلى فقط، لأن قاعدة الاستخدام والفرق بين Speaking وWriting هما ما يحميك من أكثر فخ شائع في هذا المستوى: وضع كلمة أكاديمية ثقيلة في المكان الخطأ. وإليك تحذيرًا قبل أن تبدأ.

لا تحاول استخدام كل كلمات Band 9.0 في كل جملة. النص المحشو بـ plethora وmyriad وparadigm يبدو محفوظًا وغير طبيعي، والـ examiners يعاقبون على ذلك بالضبط. المهارة هي الاختيار: كلمة دقيقة واحدة في المكان الذي كانت فيه كلمة غامضة.
التنوّع (range) مع الدقة (accuracy)، وليس التنوّع على حساب الدقة.

v2_matrix_1.title: جدول الـ Upgrade (1–9: big … beautiful)
blocks: Dhaka is a big city with a big population.
