সমস্যা (shomossha) adalah satu-satunya kata untuk semua jenis masalah, sehingga pelajar tidak pernah memvariasikannya. English punya skala dari issue (ringan) sampai crisis (parah).
Pollution has a bad effect on health.
impact, influence, outcome, result. “Pollution has a serious impact on health.” Pakai impact untuk efek yang kuat, outcome dan result untuk apa yang muncul dari sebuah penyebab.
consequence, repercussion, ramification, implication. Consequence adalah hasil langsung; repercussion adalah efek susulan yang tidak langsung; ramification adalah efek berantai yang rumit.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Writing, impact dan consequence adalah kata inti. Perhatikan ejaannya: noun-nya adalah effect (a positive effect), bukan affect.
প্রভাব (probhab) berarti effect, influence, dan impact sekaligus. English memisahkan effect (hasil) dari influence (kekuatan yang terus membentuk).
The most important thing is a good education.
factor, aspect, element, feature. “The most important factor is a sound education.” Thing tidak punya tempat dalam tulisan akademik; sebutkan apa yang Anda maksud.
phenomenon, component, dimension, consideration. Phenomenon menyebut tren yang diamati; dimension menyebut satu sisi dari isu yang rumit.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Thing dapat diterima di Speaking tetapi lemah; di Writing, thing adalah tanda Band 6 yang jelas. Ganti setiap thing dengan factor, aspect, atau element.
জিনিস (jinish) berarti benda dan ব্যাপার (byapar) berarti perkara atau urusan. Keduanya melebur menjadi thing dalam English pelajar. Pilih noun yang spesifik sebagai gantinya.

v2_matrix_4.title: Upgrade matrix (28–35: way … common)
blocks: There are many ways to reduce pollution.

method, approach, means, strategy. “There are several effective methods of reducing pollution.” Pakai approach untuk sikap atau pendekatan secara keseluruhan, strategy untuk rangkaian tindakan yang direncanakan.
mechanism, avenue, measure, initiative. Measure ideal untuk paragraph solusi (stringent measures); avenue berarti jalan yang mungkin untuk mencapai sebuah tujuan.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Writing, method, approach, dan measure menggantikan way. Di Speaking, way terdengar alami (a good way to relax).
উপায় (upay, “cara”) dan পথ (poth, “jalan/jalur”) sama-sama muncul sebagai way. English memisahkan jalan secara harfiah dari arti kiasan, yaitu method atau approach.
The government spends a lot of money on defence.
funds, finances, spending, budget. “The government allocates substantial funds to defence.” Pakai funds untuk uang yang disisihkan untuk sebuah tujuan, expenditure untuk uang yang dibelanjakan.
capital, resources, revenue, expenditure. Capital adalah uang untuk investasi; revenue adalah pendapatan; expenditure adalah kata formal untuk pengeluaran.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, money tidak masalah. Di Writing, lebih baik pakai funds, expenditure, dan resources, terutama dalam essay tentang ekonomi dan belanja pemerintah.
টাকা (taka) adalah uang dalam bentuk tunai, sedangkan অর্থ (ortho) berarti kekayaan atau keuangan. English membedakan money (umum) dari capital, funds, dan revenue berdasarkan peran ekonominya.
This issue is very important and very serious.

highly, extremely, particularly, considerably. “This issue is highly significant and extremely serious.” Very ditambah adjective yang lemah adalah pola Band 6; lebih baik upgrade adjective-nya (very important menjadi crucial).
profoundly, exceptionally, remarkably, acutely. Acutely aware, profoundly influenced, exceptionally rare: pasangkan adverb dengan pasangan alaminya.

**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, really dan so terdengar alami. Di Writing, ganti very dengan adjective yang lebih kuat, bukan hanya adverb yang lebih kuat: very big menjadi substantial, bukan very big menjadi extremely big.

খুব (khub) dan অনেক (onek) bisa ditempelkan pada hampir semua kata, sehingga very dipakai berlebihan dalam English. Langkah band yang lebih tinggi adalah memilih satu kata yang kuat, bukan memperkuat kata yang lemah.
A lot of people use public transport every day.

numerous, a large number of, a great deal of, a significant proportion of. “A significant proportion of the population relies on public transport.” Cocokkan quantifier dengan noun-nya: a great deal of untuk uncountable, numerous untuk countable.
a multitude of, a wealth of, countless, an abundance of. Pakai kata-kata ini dengan hemat; satu a wealth of experience yang ditempatkan dengan baik lebih kuat daripada a lot of yang diulang-ulang.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, a lot of dan loads of terdengar alami. Di Writing, numerous dan a significant proportion of menaikkan ketepatan, terutama dalam deskripsi data Task 1.
অনেক (onek) dan বহু (bohu) mencakup “many” (countable) dan “much” (uncountable). English memaksa pemisahan: many books, much information.
traditional, long-established, former, aged. “Many long-established traditions are fading.” Pakai traditional untuk adat kebiasaan, former untuk keadaan sebelumnya, elderly untuk orang.
antiquated, outdated, time-honoured, obsolete. Antiquated dan obsolete berarti ketinggalan zaman; time-honoured berarti dihormati karena sudah lama ada.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, old tidak masalah, tetapi pakai elderly untuk orang demi kesopanan. Di Writing, traditional, outdated, dan long-established membawa makna yang tepat.

পুরনো (purono, “benda lama”) dan বৃদ্ধ (briddho, “orang tua”) adalah kata yang berbeda dalam bahasa Bangla, tetapi pelajar tetap memakai old untuk keduanya. English lebih sopan memakai elderly untuk orang.
New technology has made life easier.
modern, recent, contemporary, emerging. “Emerging technologies have simplified daily life.” Pakai emerging untuk sesuatu yang baru muncul, contemporary untuk masa kini.
innovative, cutting-edge, novel, state-of-the-art. Innovative berarti baru dan kreatif; cutting-edge dan state-of-the-art berarti paling canggih yang ada; novel berarti baru dari segi jenisnya.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, new dan the latest terdengar alami. Di Writing, innovative dan emerging menambah kekuatan, terutama dalam essay tentang teknologi.
নতুন (notun) berarti new, fresh, recent, dan modern sekaligus. English memisahkan recent (dari segi waktu) dari innovative (dari segi orisinalitas).
He is a very famous scientist in our country.
well-known, prominent, popular, leading. “He is a prominent scientist in our country.” Pakai prominent dan leading untuk kepentingan yang dihormati, popular untuk sesuatu yang disukai banyak orang.
renowned, eminent, distinguished, celebrated. Renowned dan eminent berarti dihormati secara luas karena prestasi; celebrated berarti dipuji secara publik.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, famous terdengar alami. Di Writing, prominent, renowned, dan eminent adalah pilihan akademik; famous bisa terdengar santai dalam essay.
বিখ্যাত (bikkhato, “terkenal karena prestasi”) dan জনপ্রিয় (jonopriyo, “populer/disukai”) berbeda dalam bahasa Bangla. English mencocokkannya dengan renowned versus popular, yang artinya tidak sama.
It is common to see people using smartphones everywhere.
widespread, frequent, usual, typical. “Smartphone use has become widespread.” Pakai widespread untuk sesuatu yang ditemukan di wilayah luas, typical untuk sesuatu yang mewakili.
prevalent, ubiquitous, pervasive, commonplace. Prevalent berarti umum di suatu tempat atau waktu; ubiquitous berarti ada di mana-mana; pervasive berarti menyebar ke setiap bagian.
**Speaking vs Writing:** Di Speaking, common tidak masalah. Di Writing, prevalent dan widespread lebih tepat (obesity is prevalent among children).
সাধারণ (shadharon, “biasa/umum”) dan প্রচলিত (procholito, “sedang berlaku/tersebar luas”) berbeda dalam bahasa Bangla. English memisahkan common (biasa) dari prevalent (terjadi secara luas).

v2_practice.title: Practice · Upgrade dan cocokkan
blocks: Kerjakan kedua exercise dengan pena sebelum melihat kunci jawaban.

blocks.title: Exercise 2.1 · Latihan Lexical Upgrade
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang setiap kalimat Band 5.5 menjadi satu kalimat Band 8.5 sampai 9.0 yang alami, dengan mengganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai dengan upgrade yang tepat dari matrix. Pertahankan maknanya; jangan memaksakan lebih dari satu atau dua kata tingkat lanjut per kalimat.

items.prompt: Pollution is a very big problem, and the government must solve it fast.
items.answer: Pollution is a pressing issue that the government must tackle urgently.
items.reason: Upgrade: big problem menjadi pressing issue; solve fast menjadi tackle urgently.

items.prompt: The internet is a good thing because it helps students a lot.
items.answer: The internet is highly beneficial because it enables students to learn far more efficiently.
items.reason: Upgrade: good thing menjadi highly beneficial.

items.prompt: Many people think that money is very important for a happy life.
items.answer: Many people believe that financial security is essential to a contented life.
items.reason: Upgrade: money/important/happy semuanya di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Climate change is a very dangerous thing, and it affects many countries.
items.answer: Climate change is a grave threat that affects numerous countries.
items.reason: Upgrade: very dangerous thing menjadi grave threat.

items.prompt: New technology has changed our life and made many things easy.
items.answer: Emerging technologies have transformed our lives and simplified countless tasks.
items.reason: Upgrade: new technology/changed di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Rich countries should help poor countries to reduce poverty.
items.answer: Affluent nations should support developing countries in reducing poverty.
items.reason: Upgrade: rich/poor countries/help di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Tourism is good for the economy, but it can also be bad for the environment.
items.answer: Tourism is beneficial to the economy, yet it can also be detrimental to the environment.
items.reason: Upgrade: good for/bad for di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Education is a very important way to solve the problem of unemployment.
items.answer: Education is a crucial means of addressing unemployment.
items.reason: Upgrade: very important way/solve the problem of di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Big cities have a lot of traffic, and this causes many problems.
items.answer: Large cities suffer from heavy traffic congestion, which gives rise to numerous difficulties.
items.reason: Upgrade: big/a lot of traffic/causes many problems di-upgrade.

items.prompt: Social media is a very famous thing among young people, and it is changing the way they talk.
items.answer: Social media is immensely popular among young people and is reshaping the way they communicate.
items.reason: Upgrade: very famous thing/talk di-upgrade.

blocks: **Mengapa ini berhasil:** setiap kata yang samar (big, good, thing, help, change) diganti dengan kata yang tepat dan sesuai collocation-nya, dan itulah yang menaikkan Lexical Resource dari Band 6 ke Band 8.

blocks.title: Exercise 2.2 · Cocokkan dengan Konteks
blocks.instructions: Pilih kata di dalam kurung yang cocok dengan makna yang tepat. Option-nya adalah synonym yang mirip tetapi punya pemakaian yang berbeda, diambil dari matrix. Ketik kata tersebut.

items.prompt: A worldwide campaign helped to ______ smallpox completely. (alleviate / eradicate)
items.answer: eradicate
items.reason: artinya menghapus sepenuhnya; alleviate hanya berarti meringankan, jadi tidak cocok di sini.

items.prompt: Painkillers can ______ chronic pain even when the illness cannot be cured. (alleviate / eradicate)
items.answer: alleviate
items.reason: kata ini meringankan rasa sakit yang sudah ada; eradicate tidak mungkin karena ada “cannot be cured.”

items.prompt: Coastal barriers ______ the damage caused by seasonal storm surges. (mitigate / eradicate)
items.answer: mitigate
items.reason: mitigate the damage berarti mengurangi tingkat keparahannya; ini collocation yang baku.

items.prompt: House prices ______ dramatically during the property boom. (soared / declined)
items.answer: soared
items.reason: soar berarti kenaikan besar yang cepat, cocok dengan “dramatically.”

items.prompt: After the reform, unemployment ______ steadily for three years. (declined / soared)
items.answer: declined
items.reason: penurunan bertahap cocok dengan “steadily”; soared akan bertentangan dengannya.

items.prompt: Clean drinking water is ______ to public health; without it, disease spreads. (trivial / vital)
items.answer: vital
items.reason: artinya sangat penting; trivial adalah lawannya dan bertentangan dengan kalimat ini.

items.prompt: The invention of the printing press ______ the spread of knowledge. (revolutionised / reduced)
items.answer: revolutionised
items.reason: perubahan radikal dan bertahan lama cocok untuk mesin cetak (printing press).

items.prompt: Widespread deforestation can ______ severe flooding in low-lying regions. (trigger / mitigate)
items.answer: trigger
items.reason: artinya memicu sebuah peristiwa yang merugikan; mitigate akan membalik maknanya.

items.prompt: The latest report ______ a sharp rise in youth unemployment. (highlights / conceals)
items.answer: highlights
items.reason: artinya menarik perhatian pada sebuah temuan; conceals adalah lawannya.

items.prompt: Only ______ families could afford private tutors in the nineteenth century. (affluent / impoverished)
items.answer: affluent
items.reason: artinya kaya; impoverished berarti sebaliknya.

items.prompt: Regular physical activity can ______ the risk of several chronic diseases. (diminish / worsen)
items.answer: diminish
items.reason: artinya membuat lebih sedikit; worsen bertentangan dengan manfaat olahraga.

items.prompt: Automation is expected to ______ the labour market over the coming decade. (reshape / preserve)
items.answer: reshape
items.reason: artinya mengubah secara signifikan; preserve berarti mempertahankan tanpa perubahan.

items.prompt: Rising fuel prices have ______ serious concern among daily commuters. (generated / resolved)
items.answer: generated
items.reason: artinya menghasilkan atau menyebabkan; resolved berarti diselesaikan, yaitu kebalikannya.

items.prompt: International charities work to ______ the suffering of displaced families. (alleviate / aggravate)
items.answer: alleviate
items.reason: artinya meringankan penderitaan; aggravate berarti memperburuknya.

items.prompt: Tourism is a ______ source of income for many small island nations. (crucial / trivial)
items.answer: crucial
items.reason: artinya sangat penting; trivial adalah lawannya.

v3_verbs_1.title: 100 verb berdampak tinggi (1–50)
blocks: Bacalah kolom-kolomnya sebagai satu word family. Kekuatan utama tabel ini bukan menghafal bentuk past tense, tetapi kemampuan berpindah dari satu bentuk ke bentuk lain dalam satu baris. Jika increase (verb) terlalu sering Anda pakai, beralihlah ke an increase (noun) atau increasing (adjective), lalu susun ulang kalimatnya. Fleksibilitas seperti inilah yang dinilai tinggi oleh Lexical Resource.
**noun**: anggota noun yang paling berguna dari family ini
**adjective**: anggota adjective yang paling berguna dari family ini
**preposition**: preposition yang paling sering muncul setelah verb atau noun-nya
**-**: tidak ada bentuk satu kata yang umum untuk kelas itu, atau tidak ada preposition yang tetap
Ejaan mengikuti aturan British (analyse, emphasise, utilise) - IELTS menerima ejaan ini dan memang mengharapkannya.

v3_verbs_2.title: 100 verb berdampak tinggi (51–100)
blocks: Verb affect memiliki noun effect, bukan affect. Ini jebakan ejaan yang paling sering diuji dalam bahasa Inggris, jadi bacalah baris 5 dua kali: Anda affect sesuatu (verb), dan effect adalah hasilnya (noun).

Sebagian besar baris memungkinkan Anda melakukan paraphrase dengan mengganti kelas kata. “The policy improved education” bisa menjadi “the policy led to an improvement in education” atau “the policy had a beneficial effect on education.” Latihlah perpindahan dalam satu baris ini sampai terasa otomatis; inilah mesin paraphrase di Bab 5.

v3_linking.title: Panduan upgrade linking word
blocks: Cohesion dinilai secara langsung - di Writing lewat criterion Coherence and Cohesion, dan di Speaking sebagai bagian dari Fluency and Coherence. Kebanyakan kandidat menghubungkan ide dengan and, but, so, because, dan also. Kata-kata ini tidak salah, tetapi tulisan yang seluruhnya bergantung pada kata-kata ini menunjukkan level Band 6. Solusinya adalah sekumpulan device tingkat lebih tinggi yang terkontrol, dipakai dengan tepat, dan tidak ditumpuk satu di atas yang lain.
furthermore, moreover, in addition, additionally, what is more
Renewable energy is clean. Furthermore, it is becoming cheaper each year.
however, nevertheless, in contrast, conversely, on the contrary
The scheme was expensive. Nevertheless, it delivered clear benefits.
notwithstanding, despite this, even so, admittedly, granted that
Notwithstanding the cost, the investment proved worthwhile.
owing to, due to, on account of, as a result of, given that, since
Owing to a shortage of teachers, class sizes have grown.
consequently, therefore, thus, hence, as a result, accordingly
Demand fell sharply; consequently, prices dropped.
Some favour strict rules; conversely, others prefer flexibility.
for instance, to illustrate, namely, such as
Several cities, such as Dhaka and Chittagong, are expanding rapidly.
in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance, ultimately
On balance, the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.
Setelah “due to” dan “owing to” harus ada noun, bukan clause.
Due to the government invested more, education improved.
Owing to greater investment, education improved. / Education improved because the government invested more.
Device ini diikuti oleh noun atau noun phrase. Jika Anda ingin clause lengkap dengan subject dan verb, gunakan because.
The plan was costly, however, it worked.
The plan was costly. However, it worked. / The plan was costly; however, it worked.
Jika however menghubungkan dua kalimat lengkap, sebelumnya harus ada titik atau semicolon dan sesudahnya koma. Jika hanya ada koma di kedua sisinya, terjadilah comma splice, dan ini mengurangi nilai.

Satu cohesive device untuk setiap ide sudah cukup. Memulai tiga kalimat berturut-turut dengan Moreover, Furthermore, In addition adalah penggunaan berlebihan yang mekanis, dan examiner secara tegas mengurangi nilai untuk hal ini. Variasikan device-nya, dan biarkan beberapa kalimat terhubung hanya lewat maknanya. Range berarti variasi, bukan kepadatan.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Drill Bentuk Verb dan Collocation
blocks.instructions: Lengkapi setiap kalimat dengan bentuk yang benar dari verb di dalam kurung, atau dengan preposition yang tepat jika bagian kosongnya tidak disertai verb. Gunakan tabel 100 verb untuk memeriksa bentuk dan pasangan preposition.

items.prompt: Over the past decade, the urban population has ______ (grow) by nearly twenty per cent.
items.answer: grown
items.reason: present perfect memerlukan has + V3; grow adalah verb irregular (grew, grown).

items.prompt: If food prices continue ______ (rise), many families will struggle.
items.answer: to rise
accepted: rising
to rise / rising
items.reason: continue bisa diikuti bentuk infinitive maupun bentuk -ing.

items.prompt: Rural households often depend ______ agriculture for their entire income.
items.answer: on
items.reason: depend on adalah collocation yang tetap.

items.prompt: Many students benefit ______ free online learning resources.
items.answer: from
items.reason: benefit from.

items.prompt: Between 2000 and 2010, car sales ______ (peak) at forty thousand units.
items.answer: peaked
items.reason: simple past untuk rentang waktu yang sudah selesai.

items.prompt: Air pollution in the capital has ______ (rise) sharply since 2010.
items.answer: risen
items.reason: present perfect (has risen); rise adalah verb intransitive, jadi tidak memiliki object.

items.prompt: Governments should invest more heavily ______ public transport.
items.answer: in
items.reason: invest in.

items.prompt: Smallpox was completely ______ (eradicate) by the end of the 1970s.
items.answer: eradicated
items.reason: passive voice memerlukan was + V3.

items.prompt: Automation may ______ (undermine) job security in several sectors.
items.answer: undermine
items.reason: bentuk dasar muncul setelah modal may.

items.prompt: The report ______ (focus) mainly on youth unemployment.
items.answer: focuses
items.reason: present simple, orang ketiga tunggal (the report focuses on).

items.prompt: By 2020, the jobless rate had ______ (fall) to a record low.
items.answer: fallen
items.reason: past perfect memerlukan had + V3; fall adalah verb irregular (fell, fallen).

items.prompt: Tourism contributes significantly ______ the local economy.
items.answer: to
items.reason: contribute to.

items.prompt: Strict penalties can ______ (deter) people ______ committing crimes.
items.answer: deter … from
accepted: deter ... from
deter from
items.reason: bentuk dasar setelah can; strukturnya adalah deter someone from doing.

items.prompt: The company has been ______ (invest) heavily in renewable technology.
items.answer: investing
items.reason: present perfect continuous memerlukan has been + V4.

items.prompt: Chronic water shortages often result ______ poor long-term planning.
items.answer: from
items.reason: result from menunjuk ke sebab; result in menunjuk ke akibat.

items.prompt: Renewable sources are gradually ______ (replace) fossil fuels.
items.answer: replacing
items.reason: present continuous memerlukan are + V4.

items.prompt: The new curriculum is ______ (design) to ______ (enhance) critical thinking.
items.answer: designed … enhance
accepted: designed ... enhance
designed enhance
items.reason: bentuk passive-nya is designed; bentuk dasar setelah to.

items.prompt: Coastal communities must ______ (adapt) ______ rising sea levels.
items.answer: adapt … to
accepted: adapt ... to
adapt to
items.reason: bentuk dasar setelah must; adapt to.

items.prompt: Over the last century, average temperatures have ______ (rise) steadily.
items.answer: risen
items.reason: present perfect (have risen).

items.prompt: The charity has ______ (provide) thousands of families ______ clean water.
items.answer: provided … with
accepted: provided ... with
provided with
items.reason: present perfect has provided; provide someone with something.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Transformasi dengan Cohesive Device
blocks.instructions: Paragraph di bawah ini kira-kira berada di level Band 6.0. Idenya sudah benar, tetapi kalimat-kalimatnya pendek dan hanya dihubungkan dengan connector dasar. Tulis ulang menjadi satu paragraph yang terhubung baik di level Band 8.0 sampai 9.0, dengan memakai cohesive device tingkat lebih tinggi secara tepat dan bervariasi. Jangan menambahkan ide baru; perbaiki hanya penghubung dan alurnya.

items.prompt: Online education has become very popular. It is cheaper than traditional classes. Students can also study from home. But it has some problems. There is less interaction with teachers. Also, many students lack self-discipline. So, a lot of them do not finish their courses. Online education is useful. But it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.answer: Online education has grown enormously in popularity, largely because it is cheaper than traditional classes and allows students to study from home. Notwithstanding these advantages, it carries certain drawbacks. To begin with, there is far less interaction with teachers. Moreover, many learners lack the self-discipline that independent study demands; consequently, a significant proportion fail to complete their courses. Online education is therefore undeniably useful, yet it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.reason: because dengan tepat memperkenalkan clause lengkap, sedangkan Notwithstanding dengan tepat diikuti noun phrase (these advantages), bukan clause; semicolon sebelum consequently menggabungkan dua clause yang saling berkaitan; tidak ada device yang diulang, sehingga cohesion-nya bervariasi, bukan mekanis.

v4_intro.title: Menguasai vocabulary per topic: cara memakai 15 topic
blocks: Lima belas bidang di bab ini adalah topic yang muncul lagi dan lagi di IELTS. Apa pun bunyi pertanyaannya, essay Task 2 dan jawaban Speaking Anda akan memakai vocabulary ini. Setiap topic memberi Anda satu paket lengkap: sepuluh academic noun, sepuluh precise verb, sepuluh collocation dan adjective, lima formal collocation yang dibuat untuk Writing Task 2, dan lima idiom alami yang dibuat untuk Speaking.

Perbedaan antara dua kelompok terakhir ini sangat penting, dan Chapter 5 khusus membahasnya. Di sini, cukup perhatikan bahwa kelompok formal diberi label Writing dan kelompok idiom diberi label Speaking - jangan dicampur. Pelajari setiap topic, lalu kerjakan tiga exercise-nya sebelum melihat jawaban. Catatan tentang arti dalam bahasa Indonesia: arti ini memberi makna sehari-hari dari setiap academic noun, supaya istilah itu terikat pada sesuatu yang sudah Anda kenal.
Jangan menerjemahkan kata demi kata ke dalam essay Anda; pakailah istilah bahasa Inggrisnya dalam collocation yang alami.

v4_topic_01.title: Topic 1 · Lingkungan dan Perubahan Iklim (Environment and Climate Shift)
blocks: **emission** (emisi / pelepasan gas): Industrial emissions are a leading driver of global warming.
**deforestation** (penggundulan hutan): Widespread deforestation has accelerated the loss of natural habitats.
**biodiversity** (keanekaragaman hayati): The destruction of wetlands threatens the region’s biodiversity.
**ecosystem** (ekosistem): Even small changes in temperature can disrupt a fragile ecosystem.
**degradation** (kerusakan / penurunan kualitas): Soil degradation reduces agricultural productivity over time.
**sustainability** (keberlanjutan): Long-term sustainability must guide national energy policy.
**conservation** (pelestarian): The conservation of freshwater resources is now an urgent priority.
**pollutant** (zat pencemar): Vehicle exhaust releases harmful pollutants into the atmosphere.
**depletion** (menipisnya sumber daya): The depletion of fossil fuels has intensified the search for alternatives.
**carbon footprint** (jejak karbon): Individuals can reduce their carbon footprint by using public transport.
Precise verb (10) · dengan bentuk past, participle, -ing
**emit** (emitted, emitted, emitting): Factories emit large quantities of greenhouse gases.
**deplete** (depleted, depleted, depleting): Overfishing has depleted marine stocks worldwide.
**mitigate** (mitigated, mitigated, mitigating): Reforestation can mitigate the effects of climate change.
**conserve** (conserved, conserved, conserving): Households should conserve water during the dry season.
**pollute** (polluted, polluted, polluting): Untreated waste continues to pollute major rivers.
**degrade** (degraded, degraded, degrading): Intensive farming gradually degrades the soil.
**offset** (offset, offset, offsetting): Companies can offset emissions by funding tree planting.
**preserve** (preserved, preserved, preserving): Protected areas help preserve endangered species.
**exploit** (exploited, exploited, exploiting): Nations must stop exploiting natural resources recklessly.
**contaminate** (contaminated, contaminated, contaminating): Chemical runoff can contaminate groundwater.
**renewable energy**: Investment in renewable energy is rising steadily. (Writing)
**fossil fuels**: We remain heavily dependent on fossil fuels. (Writing)
**environmentally friendly**: Many consumers now prefer environmentally friendly products. (Speaking and Writing)
**a pressing environmental concern**: Air quality has become a pressing environmental concern. (Writing)
**greenhouse gas emissions**: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires global cooperation. (Writing)
**irreversible damage**: Rising sea levels could cause irreversible damage to coastlines. (Writing)
**carbon neutral**: Several cities aim to become carbon neutral by 2050. (Writing)
**finite resources**: Water and oil are finite resources that must be managed carefully. (Writing)
**eco-friendly** (Speaking): I try to make eco-friendly choices, like carrying a reusable bottle. (Speaking)
**climate change** (adjective use, climate-related): Climate-related disasters are becoming more frequent. (Writing)
**pose a serious threat to**: Rising temperatures pose a serious threat to food security.
**at the expense of**: Economic growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
**strike a balance between**: Governments must strike a balance between development and conservation.
**have a detrimental impact on**: Plastic waste has a detrimental impact on marine life.
**take collective action**: Only collective action can address the climate crisis effectively.
Idiom dan expression untuk Speaking (5) · hanya untuk Speaking
**a drop in the ocean**: Recycling at home helps, but it is a drop in the ocean compared with industry. (Part 3)
**the tip of the iceberg**: The visible pollution is just the tip of the iceberg. (Part 3)
**go green**: More families are trying to go green these days. (Part 1)
**weather the storm**: Coastal communities have to weather the storm of frequent flooding. (Part 3)
**a breath of fresh air**: Escaping to the countryside is a real breath of fresh air. (Part 2)

blocks.title: Exercise 4.1.2 · Melengkapi Kalimat Essay
blocks.instructions: Lengkapi setiap kalimat Task 2 dengan satu kata atau frasa dari topic ini.

items.prompt: Governments must ______ a balance between industrial growth and environmental protection.
items.answer: strike

items.prompt: Burning fossil fuels releases harmful ______ into the atmosphere.
items.answer: pollutants

items.prompt: Investment in ______ energy is essential if we are to cut emissions.
items.answer: renewable

items.prompt: Deforestation causes ______ damage that cannot be undone.
items.answer: irreversible

items.prompt: Individuals can lower their carbon ______ by choosing public transport.
items.answer: footprint

blocks: **Why:** soal melengkapi kalimat ini menguji collocation yang tetap (strike a balance, renewable energy, irreversible damage, carbon footprint), bukan hanya arti kata.

blocks.title: Exercise 4.1.3 · Drill Simulasi Speaking
blocks.instructions: Jawab setiap pertanyaan Part 3 dalam dua sampai tiga kalimat, dengan memakai minimal satu target idiom dan satu collocation. Lalu bandingkan jawaban Anda dengan model answer.

items.prompt: What can ordinary people do to protect the environment?
items.answer: Ordinary people can go green in small ways, such as cutting their carbon footprint by using public transport, though individual effort alone is only a drop in the ocean without industrial reform.

items.prompt: Do you think individual effort is enough to solve climate change?
items.answer: Individual effort matters, but on its own it is a drop in the ocean; without governments taking collective action and industries cutting emissions, personal choices cannot reverse the damage.

items.prompt: How might cities become more environmentally friendly in the future?
items.answer: In future, cities could become far greener by investing in public transport, expanding green spaces, and adopting renewable energy, which together would shrink their carbon footprint.

v4_topic_02.title: Topic 2 · Pendidikan dan Ilmu Mengajar (Education and Pedagogy)
blocks: **curriculum** (kurikulum): A modern curriculum should balance theory with practical skills.
**pedagogy** (ilmu mengajar / pedagogi): Effective pedagogy adapts to the needs of individual learners.
**literacy** (kemampuan baca-tulis): Improving adult literacy is a key development goal.
**assessment** (penilaian): Continuous assessment reduces the pressure of a single final exam.
**enrolment** (pendaftaran masuk sekolah / kampus): University enrolment has risen sharply over the past decade.
**discipline** (disiplin): Self-discipline is essential for successful independent study.
**attainment** (pencapaian): Educational attainment is closely linked to future income.
**vocation** (pekerjaan / keahlian kejuruan): Vocational training prepares students for specific trades.
**aptitude** (bakat / kemampuan alami): Standardised tests attempt to measure academic aptitude.
**scholarship** (beasiswa): Scholarships enable talented students from poor families to study.
Precise verb (10) · dengan bentuk past, participle, -ing
**enrol** (enrolled, enrolled, enrolling): Thousands of students enrol in online courses each year.
**acquire** (acquired, acquired, acquiring): Children acquire language most easily when young.
**cultivate** (cultivated, cultivated, cultivating): Good schools cultivate curiosity, not just obedience.
**assess** (assessed, assessed, assessing): Teachers assess progress through regular feedback.
**foster** (fostered, fostered, fostering): Group projects foster teamwork and communication.
**memorise** (memorised, memorised, memorising): Rote learning encourages students to memorise rather than understand.
**specialise** (specialised, specialised, specialising): Undergraduates specialise in their chosen field in later years.
**motivate** (motivated, motivated, motivating): Skilled teachers motivate even reluctant learners.
**broaden** (broadened, broadened, broadening): Travel broadens young people’s understanding of the world.
**equip** (equipped, equipped, equipping): Practical training equips graduates with job-ready skills.
**higher education**: Access to higher education has widened considerably. (Writing)
**critical thinking**: Universities should develop students’ critical thinking. (Writing)
**well-rounded education**: A well-rounded education includes arts as well as sciences. (Writing)
**lifelong learning**: The modern economy demands lifelong learning. (Writing)
**academic performance**: Sleep has a direct effect on academic performance. (Writing)
**student-centred**: A student-centred approach places learners at the heart of the lesson. (Writing)
**compulsory education**: Compulsory education should last until at least sixteen. (Writing)
**hands-on experience**: Internships give students valuable hands-on experience. (Speaking and Writing)
**rote learning**: Rote learning has limited long-term benefit. (Writing)
**highly qualified**: The school employs highly qualified teachers. (Speaking and Writing)
**lay the foundation for**: Early schooling lays the foundation for later success.
**bridge the skills gap**: Vocational courses help bridge the skills gap in industry.
**equip students with**: Education should equip students with practical, transferable skills.
**place emphasis on**: Some systems place too much emphasis on examinations.
**broaden one’s horizons**: Studying abroad can broaden a young person’s horizons.
Idiom dan expression untuk Speaking (5) · hanya untuk Speaking
**learn the ropes**: It took me a few weeks to learn the ropes at university. (Part 2)
**a steep learning curve**: The first year of my degree was a steep learning curve. (Part 2)
**pass with flying colours**: She passed her final exams with flying colours. (Part 1)
**hit the books**: Before exams, I really have to hit the books. (Part 1)
**think outside the box**: Good teachers encourage you to think outside the box. (Part 3)

blocks.title: Exercise 4.2.3 · Drill Simulasi Speaking
blocks.instructions: Jawab setiap pertanyaan Part 3 dalam dua sampai tiga kalimat, dengan memakai minimal satu target idiom dan satu collocation. Lalu bandingkan jawaban Anda dengan model answer.

items.prompt: Do you think exams are the best way to assess students?
items.answer: Exams measure knowledge under pressure, but they reward rote learning over critical thinking, so continuous assessment often gives a fairer picture of a student’s real attainment.

items.prompt: How important is a university degree in today’s job market?
items.answer: A degree still opens doors, but it no longer guarantees a well-paid job; employers increasingly value hands-on experience and transferable skills alongside academic attainment.

items.prompt: Should schools focus more on practical skills or academic knowledge?
items.answer: Ideally schools should do both, yet many place too much emphasis on academic knowledge; teaching practical skills would equip students far better for real life.

v4_topic_03.title: Topic 3 · Teknologi dan Otomatisasi (Technology and Automation)
blocks: **automation** (otomatisasi): Automation has replaced many routine factory jobs.
**innovation** (inovasi): Constant innovation keeps the technology sector growing.
**connectivity** (konektivitas / jaringan koneksi): High-speed connectivity has transformed rural businesses.
**surveillance** (pengawasan): Digital surveillance raises serious concerns about privacy.
**algorithm** (algoritma): Social media algorithms decide what users see.
**infrastructure** (infrastruktur): Reliable digital infrastructure is now essential for the economy.
**obsolescence** (menjadi usang): Rapid obsolescence forces consumers to replace devices often.
**integration** (integrasi / penggabungan): The integration of technology into classrooms is uneven.
**artificial intelligence** (kecerdasan buatan): Artificial intelligence is reshaping many professions.
**digital divide** (kesenjangan digital): The digital divide leaves poorer communities behind.
Precise verb (10) · dengan bentuk past, participle, -ing
**automate** (automated, automated, automating): Firms increasingly automate repetitive tasks.
**innovate** (innovated, innovated, innovating): Companies that fail to innovate quickly fall behind.
**streamline** (streamlined, streamlined, streamlining): New software has streamlined the ordering process.
**integrate** (integrated, integrated, integrating): Schools are integrating tablets into daily lessons.
**revolutionise** (revolutionised, revolutionised, revolutionising): The smartphone has revolutionised communication.
**facilitate** (facilitated, facilitated, facilitating): Video calls facilitate remote collaboration.
**hack** (hacked, hacked, hacking): Criminals can hack poorly protected networks.
**upgrade** (upgraded, upgraded, upgrading): Users must regularly upgrade their software.
**disrupt** (disrupted, disrupted, disrupting): Streaming services have disrupted the film industry.
**monitor** (monitored, monitored, monitoring): Employers can monitor staff activity online.
**cutting-edge technology**: The lab uses cutting-edge technology. (Speaking and Writing)
**user-friendly**: A user-friendly interface encourages wider adoption. (Writing)
**data privacy**: Data privacy has become a major public concern. (Writing)
**technological advancement**: Technological advancement has boosted productivity. (Writing)
**screen time**: Excessive screen time may harm children’s development. (Speaking and Writing)
**remote working**: Remote working became widespread after the pandemic. (Writing)
**tech-savvy**: Younger users tend to be more tech-savvy. (Speaking)

items.prompt: Is prison the best way to deal with criminals?

items.prompt: Do you think the causes of crime are mainly social or individual?

items.answer: Money matters, but it is not the only measure of success; a person who climbs the career ladder while struggling to make ends meet may be far less content than someone with modest means and a fulfilling life.

v5_rule.title: Aturan pemisahan yang ketat
blocks: Bab ini bertumpu pada satu aturan yang menentukan nilai Lexical Resource lebih banyak daripada kebiasaan lain mana pun: informal idiom tempatnya di Speaking, bukan di Writing Task 2. Expression yang sama yang memberi Anda nilai di interview bisa justru mengurangi nilai Anda di essay. Ini bukan sekadar soal selera gaya; ini aturan register, dan register justru yang diuji di band yang lebih tinggi.

Inilah alasan pemisahannya begitu tegas. IELTS Speaking menghargai bahasa yang alami dan spontan, jadi idiom yang dipakai di tempat yang tepat (it was a blessing in disguise, I was over the moon) menunjukkan bahwa Anda bisa memakai bahasa Inggris seperti penutur yang fasih. Sebaliknya, Writing Task 2 adalah formal academic essay.

Dalam konteks itu, idiom terasa santai, tidak serius, dan tidak pada tempatnya, dan menurunkan nada tulisan Anda ke arah Band 6, sehebat apa pun idiom-nya. Examiner tidak bertanya “apakah kandidat ini tahu idiom.” Examiner bertanya “apakah kandidat ini tahu di mana setiap jenis bahasa seharusnya dipakai.”
**Aman untuk Task 2:** Apakah ini akan terdengar wajar di tajuk rencana koran atau artikel akademik? Jika ya, pakailah di essay Anda.
**Simpan untuk Speaking:** Apakah ini akan terdengar cocok dalam obrolan santai dengan teman? Jika ya, jangan pakai di Writing Task 2.

**Phrasal verb:** Banyak phrasal verb bersifat netral dan sama sekali tidak masalah dalam tulisan (carry out, bring about, result in). Yang informal dan bersifat idiom, yang harus dijauhkan dari Task 2, adalah get its act together, cough up, dan pull your socks up. Jika ragu, pilih satu verb formal saja (organise, pay, improve).

v5_idioms_1.title: 50 idiom untuk Speaking (1–25)
blocks: Pakailah idiom ini agar terdengar alami di interview. Label Part menunjukkan di bagian mana setiap idiom paling cocok. Jangan bawa satu pun ke essay Task 2.

**money doesn’t grow on trees**: uang itu terbatas, tidak mudah didapat. Contoh: My parents always said money doesn’t grow on trees.
**hit the books**: belajar dengan giat. Contoh: I need to hit the books this weekend.

**down in the dumps**: sedih atau murung. Contoh: I felt down in the dumps after the result.
**butterflies in my stomach**: rasa gugup bercampur gembira. Contoh: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
**get cold feet**: tiba-tiba ragu atau gugup di saat terakhir. Contoh: I nearly got cold feet before the speech.
**a fish out of water**: merasa canggung di lingkungan baru. Contoh: On my first day abroad, I felt like a fish out of water.
**the last straw**: hal terakhir yang masih bisa ditoleransi. Contoh: The delay was the last straw.
**a blessing in disguise**: manfaat tersembunyi di balik sebuah kemunduran. Contoh: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
**the icing on the cake**: bonus tambahan yang menyenangkan. Contoh: The view was the icing on the cake.

v5_collocations_1.title: 50 collocation untuk Writing (1–25)
blocks: Pakailah collocation ini di Writing Task 2. Semuanya formal dan cocok untuk essay.
**it is widely acknowledged that**: banyak orang menerima bahwa ini benar. Contoh: It is widely acknowledged that education reduces poverty.
**there is no denying that**: tidak dapat disangkal bahwa. Contoh: There is no denying that technology has reshaped work.
**a growing body of evidence suggests that**: semakin banyak penelitian menunjukkan bahwa. Contoh: A growing body of evidence suggests that pollution harms cognition.
**it can be argued that**: dapat dikatakan secara masuk akal bahwa. Contoh: It can be argued that fees limit access.
**this essay will examine both views**: menandakan essay yang seimbang. Contoh: This essay will examine both views before offering an opinion.
**a widely held view**: pendapat yang umum. Contoh: A widely held view is that competition improves standards.
**it stands to reason that**: masuk akal bahwa. Contoh: It stands to reason that better roads reduce delays.
**a compelling argument**: argumen yang meyakinkan. Contoh: There is a compelling argument for renewable subsidies.
**a valid point**: klaim yang masuk akal. Contoh: Opponents make a valid point about cost.
**proponents argue that**: para pendukung menyatakan bahwa. Contoh: Proponents argue that automation raises productivity.
**critics contend that**: para penentang menegaskan bahwa. Contoh: Critics contend that it destroys jobs.
**it is worth noting that**: ada hal yang layak diperhatikan. Contoh: It is worth noting that results vary by region.
**play a pivotal role in**: sangat penting, berperan utama. Contoh: Education plays a pivotal role in development.
**give rise to**: menyebabkan. Contoh: Rapid growth gives rise to inequality.
**stem from**: berasal dari. Contoh: Many problems stem from poverty.
**be attributed to**: dapat dijelaskan oleh. Contoh: The decline can be attributed to weak demand.
**a contributing factor**: salah satu dari beberapa penyebab. Contoh: Poor diet is a contributing factor in obesity.
**have far-reaching consequences**: memiliki dampak yang luas. Contoh: Climate change has far-reaching consequences.
**as a direct result of**: disebabkan secara langsung oleh. Contoh: As a direct result of the ban, sales fell.
**while it is true that**: mengakui suatu poin. Contoh: While it is true that costs are high, benefits outweigh them.
**contrary to popular belief**: berlawanan dengan pendapat umum. Contoh: Contrary to popular belief, remote work can raise output.
**despite the fact that**: memperkenalkan clause concession yang lengkap. Contoh: Despite the fact that it is costly, the plan is justified.
**on the one hand … on the other hand**: menimbang dua sisi. Contoh: On the one hand it saves time; on the other, it isolates people.
**to a certain extent**: sebagian. Contoh: This is true to a certain extent.
**address the issue**: menangani suatu masalah. Contoh: Governments must address the issue urgently.

v5_collocations_2.title: 50 collocation untuk Writing (26–50)
blocks: **tackle the root cause**: menangani penyebab yang mendasarinya. Contoh: Lasting change means tackling the root cause.
**implement effective measures**: menerapkan kebijakan yang baik. Contoh: Cities should implement effective measures against pollution.
**a viable solution**: jawaban atau solusi yang bisa dijalankan. Contoh: Public transport is a viable solution to congestion.
**weigh the pros and cons**: mempertimbangkan kedua sisi. Contoh: Policymakers must weigh the pros and cons.
**strike a balance between**: mencari titik tengah yang adil. Contoh: We must strike a balance between growth and conservation.
**take into account**: mempertimbangkan. Contoh: Any policy must take into account rural needs.
**a significant proportion of**: bagian yang cukup besar. Contoh: A significant proportion of graduates work abroad.
**the vast majority of**: hampir semua. Contoh: The vast majority of commuters use trains.
**in the long run**: dalam jangka panjang. Contoh: In the long run, prevention is cheaper.
**in the short term**: dalam waktu dekat, untuk sementara. Contoh: In the short term, costs may rise.
**an integral part of**: bagian yang sangat penting. Contoh: Art is an integral part of education.
**gain momentum**: semakin kuat. Contoh: The movement has gained momentum.
**pose a serious threat to**: membahayakan. Contoh: Rising seas pose a serious threat to coasts.
**have a detrimental effect on**: merugikan. Contoh: Stress has a detrimental effect on health.
**reap the benefits of**: menikmati hasilnya. Contoh: Future generations will reap the benefits of this investment.
**at the expense of**: dengan mengorbankan hal lain. Contoh: Growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
**a case in point**: contoh yang tepat. Contoh: Singapore is a case in point.
**to illustrate this**: untuk memberi contoh. Contoh: To illustrate this, consider public transport in Tokyo.
**bear in mind that**: mengingat. Contoh: We must bear in mind that resources are finite.
**shed light on**: menjelaskan, memperjelas. Contoh: The study sheds light on the causes.
**in light of**: mempertimbangkan, mengingat. Contoh: In light of these findings, reform is needed.
**from my perspective**: menurut pendapat saya. Contoh: From my perspective, the benefits outweigh the risks.
**more often than not**: biasanya. Contoh: More often than not, early action is cheaper.
**by and large**: secara umum. Contoh: By and large, the policy has succeeded.
**draw a firm conclusion**: mencapai penilaian yang jelas. Contoh: It is difficult to draw a firm conclusion from limited data.

v6_intro.title: Workbook lengkap: cara menggunakannya
blocks: Di bab ini, semua isi buku digabungkan dalam kondisi ujian. Part 1 berisi dua latihan: dua puluh sentence transformation yang menaikkan kalimat Band 6 yang datar menjadi kalimat Band 9 yang rapi, dan lima essay Band 6 lengkap yang harus Anda tulis ulang di level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0. Kerjakan dengan pena, coba setiap item sebelum membaca model-nya, lalu nilai jawaban Anda sendiri dengan key sambil bertanya: tool mana dari Bab 1 sampai 5 yang belum Anda terapkan?

v6_transformations.title: Section 1 · 20 sentence transformation

blocks.title: Section 1: 20 Tantangan Sentence Transformation
blocks.instructions: Setiap kalimat di bawah ini kira-kira berada di level Band 6.0. Tulis ulang masing-masing menjadi satu kalimat Band 9.0: tingkatkan vocabulary-nya, perbaiki kesalahan yang berasal dari bahasa ibu, dan buat strukturnya lebih ringkas. Yang dituju adalah ketepatan, bukan sekadar kata yang lebih panjang.

items.prompt: Nowadays, technology is a very important thing in our life.
items.answer: In the modern era, technology plays an indispensable role in our daily lives.
items.reason: Upgrade: very important thing diganti dengan indispensable role.

items.prompt: Many people think that money can make them happy.
items.answer: Many people believe that wealth is the key to happiness.
items.reason: Upgrade: think menjadi believe; money menjadi wealth; susunan kalimat lebih ringkas.

items.prompt: Pollution is a big problem and it is very bad for our health.
items.answer: Pollution poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Upgrade: big problem dan very bad dilebur menjadi satu collocation yang tepat.

items.prompt: The government should give more money to education.
items.answer: The government should allocate greater funding to education.
items.reason: Upgrade: give more money to diganti dengan allocate greater funding.

items.prompt: A lot of students go abroad to get a good job.
items.answer: A significant proportion of students go abroad in pursuit of well-paid employment.
items.reason: Upgrade: a lot of menjadi a significant proportion of; a good job menjadi well-paid employment.

items.prompt: Cutting trees is a very bad thing for the environment.
items.answer: Deforestation has a detrimental effect on the environment.
items.reason: Upgrade: cutting trees menjadi deforestation; very bad thing menjadi detrimental effect.

items.prompt: Children spend too much time on their phones and it is not good.
items.answer: Children spend excessive time on their phones, which can be detrimental to their development.
items.reason: Upgrade: not good yang samar diganti dengan akibat yang jelas dan tepat.

items.prompt: Public transport can help to reduce traffic in the cities.
items.answer: An efficient public transport system can substantially reduce urban traffic congestion.
items.reason: Upgrade: help to reduce traffic menjadi reduce traffic congestion.

items.prompt: Exams give a lot of pressure to students.
items.answer: Examinations place considerable pressure on students.
items.reason: Upgrade: give a lot of pressure to diganti dengan place considerable pressure on.

items.prompt: Tourism is good for the economy of a country.
items.answer: Tourism makes a substantial contribution to a nation’s economy.
items.reason: Upgrade: good for the economy diganti dengan makes a substantial contribution.

items.prompt: Poor people cannot get good healthcare.
items.answer: Disadvantaged people often lack access to adequate healthcare.
items.reason: Upgrade: poor people cannot get good diganti dengan lack access to adequate.

items.prompt: Social media has changed the way people talk to each other.
items.answer: Social media has fundamentally transformed the way people communicate.
items.reason: Upgrade: changed the way people talk diganti dengan transformed the way people communicate.

items.prompt: Fast food is popular but it causes many health problems.
items.answer: Although fast food is popular, it gives rise to numerous health problems.
items.reason: Upgrade: but … causes many diganti dengan although … gives rise to numerous.

items.prompt: Big companies should do more to save the environment.
items.answer: Large corporations should do more to protect the environment.
items.reason: Upgrade: big companies menjadi large corporations; save menjadi protect.

items.prompt: Learning English is very important for getting a good job.
items.answer: A command of English is crucial for securing well-paid employment.
items.reason: Upgrade: learning English is very important for getting a good job diganti dengan susunan nominal yang tepat.

items.prompt: The rich are becoming richer and the poor are becoming poorer.
items.answer: The gap between rich and poor continues to widen.
items.reason: Upgrade: comparative yang diulang-ulang diganti dengan satu clause yang tepat.

items.prompt: Watching too much TV is a waste of time for children.
items.answer: Excessive television viewing is an unproductive use of children’s time.
items.reason: Upgrade: watching too much TV is a waste of time dinaikkan ke register formal.

items.prompt: Crime happens because people do not have jobs.
items.answer: Crime often stems from unemployment and a lack of opportunity.
items.reason: Upgrade: happens because people do not have jobs diganti dengan stems from unemployment.

items.prompt: Old traditions are disappearing because of modern life.
items.answer: Long-standing traditions are gradually disappearing as a result of modern life.
items.reason: Upgrade: old menjadi long-standing; because of menjadi as a result of.

items.prompt: Renewable energy is better than fossil fuels.
items.answer: Renewable energy is a cleaner and more sustainable alternative to fossil fuels.
items.reason: Upgrade: better than yang samar diganti dengan alasan-alasan yang tepat.

blocks: **Mengapa ini berhasil:** setiap transformation mengganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai dengan kata yang tepat, menggabungkan dua clause yang lemah menjadi satu kalimat yang terkontrol, dan menukar linker biasa dengan cohesive device yang akurat. Gabungan ketepatan dan kontrol inilah yang menaikkan sebuah kalimat dari Band 6 ke Band 9.

v6_essay_1.title: Section 2 · Penulisan ulang essay 1 (Opinion)
blocks: **Pertanyaan Task 2 (Opinion - opini):** Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

blocks.title: Essay 1 · draf Band 6.0
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang essay Band 6.0 ini ke level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0: pertahankan idenya, tingkatkan bahasanya (hilangkan kesalahan dari L1, ganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai, gunakan cohesive device, tambahkan satu formal collocation di setiap paragraph). Lalu bandingkan dengan model rewrite.

items.prompt:
Nowadays, education is a very important thing for everyone. Some people think that university education should be free for all students. I am agree with this idea because it has many good points.

First, free university can help poor students. Many talented students cannot go to university because it is very costly. If education is free, they can also get a chance to study and get a good job. This is good for the whole country because it makes more skilled people.

But some people say that free education is a big problem for the government. The government has to spend a lot of money and this money comes from tax. Also, if university is free, maybe some students will not study seriously.

However, I think the advantages are more than the disadvantages. A country becomes strong when its people are educated. So the government should give importance on free education.

In conclusion, I agree that university education should be free because it helps poor students and it is good for the country.
items.answer:
It is often argued that university education should be provided free of charge to all students. I strongly agree with this view, primarily because it widens access and strengthens the economy in the long run.

The most compelling argument concerns equality of opportunity. At present, many talented young people are unable to attend university because tuition fees are prohibitively expensive. If higher education were free, these students could also pursue their ambitions and secure well-paid employment. Society as a whole would reap the benefits, since a larger pool of skilled graduates drives national productivity.

Admittedly, critics contend that free education places a heavy financial burden on the state, funded ultimately through taxation. They further argue that students may value their studies less when they cost nothing.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks are outweighed by the wider gains. A nation prospers when its population is well educated, and public investment in universities tends to pay for itself through higher earnings and tax revenue. Governments should therefore prioritise funding for higher education.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that university education should be free, as it removes financial barriers for disadvantaged students and yields lasting benefits for the country.
items.reason: Upgrade utama: I am agree menjadi I strongly agree; give importance on menjadi prioritise; but menjadi Admittedly dan Nevertheless; sebuah second conditional (if … were free … could); collocation reap the benefits, place a burden on, drive productivity.

v6_essay_2.title: Section 2 · Penulisan ulang essay 2 (Discuss both views)
blocks: **Pertanyaan Task 2 (Discuss both views - bahas kedua pandangan):** Some people think children should start school at a very early age. Others believe they should start later. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

blocks.title: Essay 2 · draf Band 6.0
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang essay Band 6.0 ini ke level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0: pertahankan idenya, tingkatkan bahasanya (hilangkan kesalahan dari L1, ganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai, gunakan cohesive device, tambahkan satu formal collocation di setiap paragraph). Lalu bandingkan dengan model rewrite.

items.prompt:
There is a big debate about when children should start school. Some people think children should start school when they are very young. Other people think it is better to start later. In this essay I will discuss about both sides.

On one hand, starting school early has many good points. Young children can learn many things quickly. They also learn how to make friends and follow rules. This helps them in the future.

On the other hand, some people think early school is bad for children. Small children need to play and they should not have pressure. If they start too early, maybe they will not enjoy their childhood. Also, they can feel stress.

In my opinion, both sides have good points. But I think it is better to start school at a normal age, not too early and not too late. Children should learn but they should also have time to play.

In conclusion, there are different opinions about this topic. I think a balance is the best way for children.
items.answer:
There is considerable debate about the ideal age for children to begin formal schooling. While some argue that children should start as early as possible, others maintain that a later start is preferable. This essay will examine both views before giving my opinion.

On the one hand, an early start offers clear advantages. Young children absorb new knowledge remarkably quickly, and school helps them develop social skills such as making friends and following rules, which benefit them throughout life.

On the other hand, critics contend that beginning school too soon can be detrimental. Young children need ample time to play and should not face academic pressure prematurely; otherwise, they may lose the freedom of childhood and experience unnecessary stress.

From my perspective, both positions have merit, but the most sensible approach is to strike a balance: children should begin at a moderate age, neither too early nor too late, so that structured learning and free play can coexist.

In conclusion, although opinions on this issue differ, I believe a balanced starting age best serves children’s long-term development.
items.reason: Upgrade utama: discuss about menjadi examine; good points menjadi advantages dan merit; bad menjadi detrimental; strike a balance; on the one hand … on the other hand dipakai dengan tepat.

v6_essay_3.title: Section 2 · Penulisan ulang essay 3 (Problem and solution)
blocks: **Pertanyaan Task 2 (Problem and solution - masalah dan solusi):** Traffic congestion is a growing problem in many cities. What are the causes, and what solutions can you suggest?

blocks.title: Essay 3 · draf Band 6.0
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang essay Band 6.0 ini ke level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0: pertahankan idenya, tingkatkan bahasanya (hilangkan kesalahan dari L1, ganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai, gunakan cohesive device, tambahkan satu formal collocation di setiap paragraph). Lalu bandingkan dengan model rewrite.

items.prompt:
Traffic congestion is a very big problem in many cities today. There are many causes of this problem and we can find some solutions also.

The main cause is that there are too many cars on the road. Nowadays, many people can buy their own car, so the roads become full. Another cause is that public transport is not good in many cities, so people prefer private cars. Also, roads are old and small.

This problem causes many difficulties. People waste a lot of time in traffic and it also creates pollution.

There are some solutions for this problem. First, the government should make public transport better so that people use it. Second, they can build more roads and flyovers. Also, they can make a rule to reduce cars in the city center.

In conclusion, traffic congestion is a serious problem but it can be solved if the government takes good steps.
items.answer:
Traffic congestion has become a pressing problem in many cities. This essay will outline its principal causes before proposing several viable solutions.

The primary cause is the sheer number of vehicles on the roads. As incomes rise, private car ownership has soared, leaving streets heavily congested. A further factor is inadequate public transport, which pushes commuters toward private cars, while ageing and narrow road networks compound the problem. The consequences are significant: commuters waste countless hours in gridlock, and vehicle emissions worsen urban air quality.

Fortunately, the issue can be addressed. Governments should first invest in efficient mass transit so that commuters have an attractive alternative to driving. Expanding the road network and building flyovers would ease the burden on existing routes. In addition, introducing a congestion charge would discourage private car use in city centres.

In conclusion, although traffic congestion is a serious problem, it can be substantially reduced if authorities implement effective measures, particularly by improving public transport and discouraging unnecessary car journeys.
items.reason: Upgrade utama: very big problem menjadi pressing problem; soared, gridlock, ease the burden, congestion charge, implement effective measures; also menjadi A further factor dan In addition.

v6_essay_4.title: Section 2 · Penulisan ulang essay 4 (Advantages and disadvantages)
blocks: **Pertanyaan Task 2 (Advantages and disadvantages - kelebihan dan kekurangan):** More and more people are working from home. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

blocks.title: Essay 4 · draf Band 6.0
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang essay Band 6.0 ini ke level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0: pertahankan idenya, tingkatkan bahasanya (hilangkan kesalahan dari L1, ganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai, gunakan cohesive device, tambahkan satu formal collocation di setiap paragraph). Lalu bandingkan dengan model rewrite.

items.prompt:
These days, more and more people are working from home. Some people think it has many advantages, but others think it has disadvantages. In my opinion, the advantages are more.

There are many good things about working from home. First, people can save time because they do not need to travel to office. So they can spend this time with family. Second, they feel relaxed and comfortable in their home.

But there are also some bad things. When people work from home, they can feel lonely. Also, sometimes it is difficult to focus because of family and other distractions. Some people also work less.

However, I think the advantages are bigger. With good discipline, people can do their work properly at home. Companies also save money on office rent.

In conclusion, working from home has both good and bad sides, but I believe the advantages are more than the disadvantages.
items.answer:
In recent years, remote working has become increasingly widespread. While it carries certain drawbacks, I firmly believe that its advantages outweigh them.

The benefits are considerable. Firstly, employees no longer need to commute, which saves a great deal of time that can instead be spent with family. Secondly, working in the comfort of one’s own home can reduce stress and improve wellbeing.

Admittedly, there are disadvantages. Remote workers may feel isolated from colleagues, and domestic distractions can make it difficult to concentrate; a minority may also become less productive without direct supervision.

Nevertheless, these drawbacks can largely be overcome. With sufficient self-discipline, most people can work just as effectively from home, and employers benefit too, since they can reduce expenditure on office space. On balance, the flexibility and savings that remote working offers are more significant than its shortcomings.

In conclusion, although working from home has both merits and limitations, I am convinced that its advantages, particularly greater flexibility and reduced commuting, clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Upgrade utama: good things dan bad things menjadi benefits dan drawbacks; bigger menjadi outweigh; reduce expenditure; On balance; the advantages are more menjadi its advantages clearly outweigh.

v6_essay_5.title: Section 2 · Penulisan ulang essay 5 (Two-part direct question)
blocks: **Pertanyaan Task 2 (Two-part direct question - pertanyaan langsung dua bagian):** Many people today prefer fast food to home-cooked meals. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative development?

blocks.title: Essay 5 · draf Band 6.0
blocks.instructions: Tulis ulang essay Band 6.0 ini ke level Band 8.5 sampai 9.0: pertahankan idenya, tingkatkan bahasanya (hilangkan kesalahan dari L1, ganti kata yang terlalu sering dipakai, gunakan cohesive device, tambahkan satu formal collocation di setiap paragraph). Lalu bandingkan dengan model rewrite.

items.prompt:
Nowadays, many people prefer fast food instead of home-cooked meals. There are some reasons for this and I think it is a negative development.

There are many reasons why people like fast food. The main reason is that people are very busy today, so they do not have time to cook. Fast food is quick and easy. Another reason is that fast food is tasty and cheap. Also, there are many fast food shops everywhere.

However, I think this is a negative thing. Fast food has a lot of fat and sugar, so it is very bad for health. It causes many diseases like obesity. Home-cooked food is more healthy and clean.

In conclusion, people prefer fast food because it is quick and cheap, but I think it is a negative development because it is bad for our health.
items.answer:
These days, a growing number of people favour fast food over home-cooked meals. This essay will explain why this shift has occurred and argue that it is, on balance, a negative development.

Several factors explain the trend. The primary reason is the hectic pace of modern life: many people simply lack the time to prepare meals, and fast food is quick and convenient. In addition, it is inexpensive and palatable, and outlets are now ubiquitous in most cities.

However, I regard this development as largely detrimental. Fast food is typically high in fat, salt, and sugar, and therefore has a harmful effect on health, contributing to conditions such as obesity and heart disease. Home-cooked meals, by contrast, are generally more nutritious and hygienic.

In conclusion, although people increasingly turn to fast food because it is fast and affordable, I believe the trend is a negative one, since it poses a serious threat to public health.
items.reason: Upgrade utama: prefer … instead of menjadi favour … over; tasty menjadi palatable; everywhere menjadi ubiquitous; very bad for health menjadi has a harmful effect on health dan poses a serious threat to public health.

v6_speaking_1.title: Speaking simulation 1 · Describe a place you enjoy visiting.
blocks: Paruh kedua workbook ini berisi lima Speaking simulation lengkap. Masing-masing memiliki satu Part 2 cue card, satu model jawaban long turn, beberapa pertanyaan lanjutan Part 3 dengan model jawabannya, dan satu lexical analysis singkat. Model-model ini ditulis dalam register lisan yang alami, jadi banyak memakai contraction dan idiom. Itu sangat tepat untuk Speaking, dan sangat salah untuk Writing Task 2: perhatikan bahwa bahasa idiomatis yang menaikkan nilai jawaban-jawaban ini adalah bahasa yang sama yang menurut Bab 5 harus Anda jauhkan dari essay Anda.
Beri diri Anda satu menit untuk membuat rencana.
Bicaralah selama dua menit sebelum membaca model-nya.
Rekam suara Anda sendiri jika bisa.
Garis bawahi setiap idiom dan collocation di model.
Periksa apakah Anda menghasilkan sesuatu di level itu.
Gunakan lexical analysis untuk mengetahui apa saja yang akan diberi nilai oleh examiner.

**Part 2 cue card · Describe a place you enjoy visiting.**
You should say:
• where it is
• how often you go there
• what you do there
• why you enjoy visiting it

I’d like to talk about a small hill town called Bandarban, in the southeast of Bangladesh. It isn’t exactly a stone’s throw away from where I live, so I only manage to go there once in a blue moon, maybe once a year, but it’s always worth the long journey.

What I love about it is that it’s completely off the beaten track. While a lot of tourists head to the crowded beaches, Bandarban is quieter and surrounded by breathtaking scenery: green hills, winding rivers, and tiny villages. When I’m there, I usually go hiking, explore the local markets, and just soak up the peace and quiet.

The main reason I enjoy it so much is that it gives me a real change of scenery. Living in a busy city, I’m always caught up in the daily grind, so escaping to the hills feels like a breath of fresh air. The last time I went, I reached the top of a hill right at sunrise, and honestly, that view was the icing on the cake. It was almost the trip of a lifetime, and I came back feeling completely recharged.
**Why do people enjoy travelling to new places?**

I think travel broadens people’s horizons. When you visit somewhere unfamiliar, you experience a different culture and way of life, which gives you a fresh perspective. For a lot of people it’s also a chance to escape their routine and recharge, so it’s really the best of both worlds: you relax and you learn something at the same time.

By and large, yes. Tourism can boost the local economy and create jobs, especially in remote areas. That said, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because mass tourism can put a strain on local resources and even degrade natural attractions, so it has to be managed carefully.
**Do people travel more now than in the past?**

Definitely. Air travel has become far more affordable, and social media makes distant places look appealing, so more people have caught the travel bug. In the past, international travel was a luxury; nowadays, it’s within reach for the average family.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn ini mendapat nilai lewat idiom yang alami (a stone’s throw away, once in a blue moon, off the beaten track, a change of scenery, the daily grind, a breath of fresh air, the icing on the cake, the trip of a lifetime) yang dirangkai ke dalam deskripsi yang lancar, ditambah collocation breathtaking scenery. Di Part 3, register sedikit bergeser ke arah diskusi, dengan munculnya broaden horizons, the best of both worlds, boost the local economy, a double-edged sword, dan put a strain on. Semua ungkapan ini cocok untuk Speaking; tidak satu pun cocok untuk essay Task 2.

v6_speaking_2.title: Speaking simulation 2 · Describe a skill you would like to learn.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a skill you would like to learn.**
You should say:
• what the skill is
• how you would learn it
• how long it might take
• why you want to learn it

A skill I’d really love to learn is playing the guitar. I’ve wanted to pick it up for years, but I’ve never had the time to properly sit down and practise.

I’d probably learn it through a mix of online tutorials and a local teacher, because I think I’d need someone to help me get the hang of the basics. I imagine it would be a steep learning curve at first, especially learning the chords, and I’d have to burn the midnight oil to make real progress. Realistically, it might take a year or so before I could play a full song without stumbling.

The main reason I want to learn it is that music is a wonderful way to unwind after a long day. At the moment I’m caught up in the daily grind, and I think playing an instrument would help me relax and switch off completely. On top of that, being able to play at family gatherings would be the icing on the cake. Even if I’m never brilliant at it, I’d be over the moon just to strum a few tunes for the people I love.
**Is it better to learn a skill from a teacher or by yourself?**

It depends on the skill, but I think a teacher gives you a real head start. They can spot your mistakes and stop you from picking up bad habits. That said, teaching yourself builds discipline, so ideally you’d combine the two and get the best of both worlds.
**Why do some people find it hard to learn new skills as adults?**

More often than not, it comes down to time and confidence. Adults are busy and afraid of failing, so they give up before they really get to grips with it. Children, by contrast, learn through trial and error without worrying about looking silly.

Absolutely. I’d argue that schools place too much emphasis on exams and not enough on practical, transferable skills. Teaching things like budgeting or basic coding would equip students far better for real life.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn ini bertumpu pada idiom tentang belajar dan usaha (pick it up, get the hang of, a steep learning curve, burn the midnight oil, the daily grind, switch off, the icing on the cake, over the moon) dan verb alami unwind. Part 3 menaikkan register dengan a head start, the best of both worlds, get to grips with, trial and error, serta collocation bergaya essay place emphasis on, transferable skills, dan equip students, yang menunjukkan bahwa kandidat mampu berpindah dari cerita santai ke argumen yang beralasan.

v6_speaking_3.title: Speaking simulation 3 · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a piece of technology you find useful.**
You should say:
• what it is
• how you use it
• how often you use it
• why it is so useful to you

The piece of technology I find most useful is, without a doubt, my smartphone. It sounds obvious, but I honestly couldn’t get through the day without it. I use it around the clock, from the moment I wake up to the moment I go to sleep.

I rely on it for pretty much everything: checking emails, navigating unfamiliar streets, paying bills, and staying in touch with family. Because so much information is at my fingertips, tasks that used to take hours are now a piece of cake. If I need directions, for instance, I no longer have to ask around; I just tap the screen and go.

The main reason it’s so useful is that it’s basically several devices rolled into one, so it saves me a huge amount of time. Of course, it’s a bit of a double-edged sword, because I can easily end up glued to the screen, but as long as I keep it in check, the benefits far outweigh that. For me, it’s genuinely a game changer, and it’s honestly hard to imagine going back to life without it.
**Has technology made people’s lives easier or more stressful?**

It’s genuinely both. On the one hand, technology has transformed the way we work and communicate, making everything faster. On the other, being constantly connected can be exhausting, and a lot of people struggle to switch off. So I’d say it’s a mixed blessing.
**Do you think people rely too much on technology?**

More often than not, yes. Many of us can’t navigate without a map app or even remember a phone number anymore. It’s convenient, but it does make you wonder whether we’re quietly losing some basic skills along the way.
**How might technology change the way we work in the future?**

I imagine automation will reshape the job market completely. A lot of routine tasks will be automated, which could render some jobs obsolete, but it should also create brand-new roles. The key will be helping people keep up with the times through proper retraining.

**Lexical analysis:** Long turn ini memakai idiom bernuansa teknologi (around the clock, at my fingertips, a piece of cake, a double-edged sword, glued to the screen, keep it in check, a game changer) supaya terdengar santai dan lancar. Part 3 memunculkan collocation yang lebih formal: transform the way we, a mixed blessing, reshape the job market, render obsolete, dan keep up with the times. Ini contoh bagus kandidat yang bisa bercakap-cakap santai di Part 2 dan lebih analitis di Part 3 tanpa pernah terdengar kaku seperti essay.

v6_speaking_4.title: Speaking simulation 4 · Describe a time when you helped someone.
blocks:
**Part 2 cue card · Describe a time when you helped someone.**
You should say:
• who you helped
• how you helped them
• why they needed help
• how you felt about helping them

I’d like to talk about a time I helped a younger cousin of mine who was struggling with his studies. He was in at the deep end, preparing for a big exam, and he was really down in the dumps because he’d fallen badly behind.

I offered to lend a hand and tutor him a couple of evenings a week. We went through the topics he found difficult, and I tried to help him get to grips with the trickier concepts. It wasn’t always a piece of cake, because he’d lost a lot of confidence, so I had to go the extra mile to keep him motivated.

He needed help because both his parents worked long hours and couldn’t sit with him, so he’d basically been left to cope on his own. In the end, he pulled his socks up and passed with flying colours.

Honestly, I was over the moon when I heard the result. Helping him turned out to be a real labour of love, and seeing him succeed was the icing on the cake. It reminded me just how rewarding it is to give someone a helping hand when they need it.
**Why is it important to help others in society?**

I think helping others creates a stronger sense of community. When people lend a hand, it builds trust and mutual support, which benefits everyone. A society where people only look out for themselves tends to be far more divided.
**Should helping others be taught in schools?**

Definitely. Schools play a pivotal role in shaping a child’s character, so encouraging students to volunteer instils values like empathy and responsibility. If children learn to help early on, it usually stays with them for life.
**Do people help each other less than they used to?**

It’s hard to say, but many would argue that busy, urban lifestyles have made people more self-centred. That said, social media has also made it easier to organise help quickly, so in some ways the spirit of helping is alive and well, just in a different form.
