Position स्पष्ट छ, तर conclusion अस्पष्ट छ।
मुख्य idea-हरू छन्, तर केही राम्ररी विकसित छैनन्।
जानकारी तार्किक रूपमा मिलाइएको छ, स्पष्ट progression सहित।
Connective राम्रोसँग प्रयोग गर्नुभयो, तर कहिलेकाहीं यान्त्रिक वा गलत तरिकाले।
Paragraph प्रयोग गर्नुभयो, तर सधैं तार्किक रूपमा होइन।
पर्याप्त vocabulary प्रयोग गर्नुभयो; कम प्रचलित शब्द प्रयोग गर्ने प्रयास छ, केही गल्तीसहित।
Spelling / शब्दका गल्ती छन्, तर अर्थ बुझ्न बाधा पुर्‍याउँदैनन्।
Simple र complex दुवै sentence प्रयोग गर्नुभयो।
केही grammar र punctuation गल्ती छन्, तर अर्थ स्पष्ट छ।
Task 1 का लागि मात्र - Task Achievement
मुख्य trend र फरकहरू स्पष्ट रूपमा देखाउनुभयो।
मुख्य point-हरू राम्रोसँग समेट्नुभयो; अझै विस्तार गर्न सकिन्थ्यो।
Task 2 का लागि मात्र - Task Response
प्रश्नका सबै भागको उत्तर राम्रोसँग दिनुभयो।
मुख्य idea-हरू राम्रोसँग प्रस्तुत र व्याख्या गरिएका छन्; supporting idea-हरू कतै-कतै focus गुमाउँछन्।
सबै जानकारी र idea-हरू तार्किक रूपमा मिलाइएका छन् र सहज रूपमा अघि बढ्छन्।
विभिन्न अवस्थामा connective प्रयोग गर्नुभयो; एक-दुई ठाउँमा कम/बढी प्रयोग (under/over-use)।
Paragraph राम्रा छन्, हरेकमा एउटा स्पष्ट मुख्य topic छ।
फराकिलो दायराका शब्द, सही तरिकाले प्रयोग गरिएका; कम प्रचलित शब्द पनि राम्रोसँग प्रयोग।
विभिन्न किसिमका complex sentence, सही structure र प्रयोगसहित।
Grammar र punctuation गल्ती एकदमै कम।
Task 1 का लागि मात्र - Task Achievement
Task ले मागेका सबै कुरा उपयुक्त तरिकाले लेख्नुभयो।
सबै मुख्य point-हरू राम्रोसँग प्रस्तुत र व्याख्या गर्नुभयो।
Task 2 का लागि मात्र - Task Response
Task-का सबै पक्ष राम्रोसँग समेटिएका छन्।
सान्दर्भिक, विस्तृत supporting idea-हरू प्रयोग गर्नुभयो।
सबै जानकारी र idea-हरू तार्किक रूपमा मिलाइएका छन्।
Paragraphing पर्याप्त र उपयुक्त छ; linking मुस्किलले मात्र देखिन्छ।
विविध vocabulary, सहज र सही प्रयोग।
कम प्रचलित शब्द सीपपूर्वक प्रयोग; गल्ती विरलै।
Band 8-का सबै कुरा, साथमा समयको दबाबमा पढेलेखेको native लेखकबाट पनि हुने विरलै चिप्लाइ मात्र। पूर्ण रूपमा स्वाभाविक, त्रुटिहीन, र task-का हरेक माग पूरा।
भर्याङ पढ्नुहोस् - ठूला उफ्राइ कहाँ छन्
"आंशिक" बाट "सबै भाग"; overview देखा पर्छ; position स्पष्ट हुन्छ
प्रश्नको हरेक भागको उत्तर दिनुहोस्; Task 1-मा सधैं overview लेख्नुहोस्; Task 2-मा introduction मै आफ्नो opinion भन्नुहोस्
"केही गल्ती" बाट "एकदमै कम गल्ती"; idea विकसित हुन्छन्; linking स्वाभाविक हुन्छ
निश्चित नभएको जुनसुकै वाक्य काट्नुहोस्; हरेक idea-का लागि व्याख्या + उदाहरण दिनुहोस्; connective कम तर सही
"राम्रो" बाट "सीपपूर्ण र सटीक"; गल्ती लगभग छैनन्
अझ सटीक, फराकिलो vocabulary; structure-मा अझ विविधता; एक पटक पूरै revision
**Band 6-मा अड्किनुको सबैभन्दा common कारण:** लेखाइ धेरैजसो सही छ, तर idea-हरू सूचीमा मात्र राखिएका छन्, विकसित गरिएका छैनन्; र हरेक paragraph-मा एक-दुईवटा "भद्दा" गल्ती छन्। दुवै सुधार्न सकिन्छ।
आफ्नो band आफैं अनुमान गर्नुहोस् - छिटो self-test
मैले प्रश्नको हरेक भागको उत्तर दिएँ (T2) / overview सहित मुख्य feature-हरू report गरें (T1)।
Introduction र conclusion-मा मेरो position स्पष्ट छ (T2 मा मात्र)।
हरेक idea-को कम्तीमा एक वाक्य व्याख्या छ, र Task 2-मा एउटा उदाहरण।
हरेक दुई-तीन वाक्यमा एउटा linking word - हरेक वाक्यमा होइन।
कुनै linking word दोहोरिएको छैन, र कुनै पनि गलत अर्थमा प्रयोग भएको छैन।
एउटै paragraph-मा कुनै पनि मुख्य noun दुई पटकभन्दा बढी आएको छैन।
निश्चित नभएको कुनै शब्द प्रयोग गरिनँ।
हरेक paragraph-मा कम्तीमा एउटा शुद्ध complex sentence।
सबै टिक → सम्भवतः Band 7 वा माथि। आधा टिक → Band 6। त्योभन्दा कम → Band 5। हरेक practice पछि, AI feedback हेर्नुअघि यो गर्नुहोस्।

t1_rules.title: Task 1-का ground rules
blocks: नियम हो: कम्तीमा 150 शब्द। तर upper limit दिइएको हुँदैन, त्यसैले सबैले सोध्छन्: maximum कति? एक शब्दमा उत्तर - १८०।
150 भन्दा कम कहिल्यै होइन। 148 शब्द लेख्नुभयो भने पनि नम्बर काटिन्छ।
२०० भन्दा माथि नजानुहोस्। जति धेरै शब्द, उति धेरै गल्तीको सम्भावना, र Task 2-का लागि (जसको भार दोब्बर छ) उति कम समय।
Answer sheet-मा भएको ठाउँमा १७०–१८० शब्दको उत्तर सजिलै अटाउँछ। Extra sheet चाहियो भने बुझ्नुहोस्, तपाईं धेरै लेख्दै हुनुहुन्छ।
के शब्दमा count हुन्छ, के हुँदैन
IELTS-को official नियम सजिलो छ: तपाईंले लेखेको सबै कुरा शब्द हो - a, an, the, in, of, अङ्क (2010), प्रतिशत - सबै। Hyphen भएको शब्द एउटै शब्द हो (twenty-five = १ शब्द)।
प्रश्नबाट जस्ताको तस्तै copy गरेको वाक्य examiner-को नजरमा "तपाईंको लेखाइ" होइन। ती शब्द count भए पनि तपाईंको क्षमताको प्रमाण मानिँदैन; उल्टै "paraphrase गर्न सक्दैन" भन्ने छाप पर्छ।

Examiner बसेर शब्द गन्दैनन् - उनीहरूसँग त्यति समय हुँदैन। उनीहरू लेखाइको लम्बाइ आँखाले अनुमान गर्छन्। त्यसैले exam hall-मा शब्द गनेर समय बर्बाद नगर्नुहोस्; बरु पहिल्यै पत्ता लगाउनुहोस् कि तपाईंको हस्ताक्षरमा 170 शब्दले कति लाइन लिन्छ (प्रायः १२–१४ लाइन)।
जुनसुकै लेखाइमा तीन भाग हुन्छन्: introduction, body, conclusion। Task 1-मा हामी ४ वटा paragraph लेख्छौं:
सबैभन्दा ठूला २–३ वटा feature, कुनै अङ्क बिना
दोस्रो समूहको detail, अङ्क र तुलनासहित

**Overview किन दोस्रो paragraph-मा?** धेरै किताबले overview-लाई अन्त्यमा "conclusion" को रूपमा लेख्न भन्छन्। त्यो पनि चल्छ, तर जोखिम छ: समय सकियो भने overview नै छुट्छ, र overview नभए Task Achievement-मा पूरै एक band घट्छ। त्यसैले overview introduction-को ठीक पछि लेख्नुहोस्। समय बाँकी भए अन्त्यमा एक लाइनको closing sentence थप्न सक्नुहुन्छ - नथपे पनि केही बिग्रँदैन।
Data स्वाभाविक रूपमा तीन भागमा बाँडिन्छ भने body-मा ३ वटा paragraph पनि हुन सक्छन्; तर २ वटा नै safe default हो।
IELTS authority भन्छ, Task 1-का लागि २० मिनेट। कारण: Task 1-मा सबै data दिइएकै हुन्छ, त्यसैले तरिका एकपटक सिकेपछि यो लेख्न तुलनात्मक रूपमा सजिलो हुन्छ। Task 2-को महत्त्व र भार धेरै बढी छ।
Visual पढ्ने, axis/unit/legend बुझ्ने, मुख्य point-मा चिनो लगाउने

हामी दृढतापूर्वक भन्छौं: कुनै पनि हालतमा Task 1-मा २० मिनेटभन्दा बढी नलगाउनुहोस्। धेरैले Task 1 निकै ध्यान दिएर लामो लेख्छन्, अनि Task 2 हतारमा सक्छन् - यो घाटाको सौदा हो। २० मिनेट पुगेपछि जुन वाक्यमा हुनुहुन्छ त्यो सकेर Task 2-मा जानुहोस्।
Diagram (कुनै चीज कसरी काम गर्छ / life cycle)

प्रायः एउटा type मात्र एक्लै आउँछ। कहिलेकाहीँ दुई type-को combination आउँछ (जस्तै bar chart + pie chart)। हरेक type कसरी लेख्ने भन्ने कुरा पछिका भागमा graph-सहित विस्तारमा देखाइएको छ; त्यसैले अहिलेलाई नाम मात्र याद गर्नुहोस्।

Task 1-ले तपाईं दिइएको data राम्ररी describe गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ कि सक्नुहुन्न भनेर assess गर्छ। त्यसैले कुनै opinion, "यस्तो किन भयो" भन्ने कुनै व्याख्या, कुनै सल्लाह - पूरै निषेध छ। "I think / I believe / probably because of the pandemic" - यस्तो एउटा वाक्यले पनि Task Achievement घटाउँछ, किनकि त्यो जानकारी chart-मा छैन।
२. I, we, you प्रयोग गर्नु हुँदैन
Report impersonal हुन्छ। The chart shows… लेख्नुहोस्, We can see… वा You can notice… कहिल्यै होइन।
३. Graph पूरै नबुझी लेख्न सुरु गर्नु हुँदैन (V.V.I)

सबै पढ्नुहोस् - title, दुवै axis-का label, unit, legend। आफैंलाई सोध्नुहोस्: के नापिएको छ? कुन unit-मा? कुन अवधिमा? कति वटा category? एक वाक्यमा आफैंलाई बुझाउन सक्नुभयो भने मात्र लेख्न सुरु गर्नुहोस्। नबुझी लेख्न थाल्नुभयो भने गलत कुराको वर्णन हुन्छ।
पहिलो वाक्य (The graph shows…) सधैं present tense-मा।
Visual-मा बितेका साल छन् भने data-को वर्णन past tense-मा: Sales rose in 2010.
कुनै साल छैन भने present: Most households recycle glass.
भविष्यका साल छन् भने will/shall होइन - लेख्नुहोस्: is expected / projected / forecast / predicted / anticipated to + verb: Solar output is expected to triple by 2030.
Process र diagram → present simple, प्रायः passive: The pulp is then dried.

पर्दैन, यो optional हो। Overview लेखिसकेको छ भने conclusion-ले त्यही दोहोर्याउँछ मात्र। समय छ भने एक लाइन लेख्नुहोस्, छैन भने छोडिदिनुहोस् - score-मा असर पर्दैन। लेख्नुभयो भने त्यो summary हो; opinion कहिल्यै होइन।

**Task 1 - के नगर्ने (avoid-list)**
▸ कुनै opinion / सल्लाह / कारणको व्याख्या होइन।
▸ I, we, you होइन।
▸ प्रश्नको वाक्य copy होइन।
▸ Overview बिना लेख्ने होइन; overview-मा अङ्क होइन।
▸ सबै अङ्क एक-एक गरी लेख्दै जाने ("data dump") होइन।
▸ एउटै trend verb वा एउटै connective तीन पटक होइन।
▸ Combination task-मा एउटा graph-लाई अर्को graph-सँग तुलना नगर्नुहोस् - तुलना सधैं एउटै graph भित्र हुन्छ। (धेरै वटा pie chart छन् भने pie-हरूबीच तुलना गर्नुहोस्।)
▸ २०० भन्दा बढी शब्द होइन, २० मिनेटभन्दा बढी होइन।
▸ Bullet, heading वा note होइन - पूरा वाक्यमा paragraph।

**Task 1 - के पक्का गर्ने (must-list)**
**Line, column/bar र pie chart-का लागि:**
▸ तुलना गर्ने मौका छ भने अवश्य तुलना गर्नुहोस्।
▸ Connective words अवश्य प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
▸ प्रश्नका शब्दको सट्टा सकेसम्म synonym (shows → illustrates; number → figure; percentage → proportion)।
▸ समय उल्लेख छैन भने present tense; छ भने त्यही समय अनुसारको tense।
▸ धेरै वटा pie chart छन् भने pie-हरूबीच inter-compare गर्नुहोस्।
**Flow chart र diagram-का लागि:**
▸ धेरैजसो अवस्थामा passive form।
▸ Cycle हो कि non-cycle - ध्यान दिनुहोस्। Cycle हो भने मन लागेको जुनसुकै point-बाट वर्णन सुरु गर्न सकिन्छ; cycle होइन भने starting point-बाट।
▸ Diagram-मा निश्चित segmentation (भाग) छ भने त्यही भाग अनुसार paragraph बनाउनुहोस्।
▸ सबैभन्दा मुख्य: arrow पछ्याउँदै वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
▸ Conclusion चाहिँदैन; समय उल्लेख छैन भने present tense (flow chart-मा प्रायः हुँदैन)।
अङ्क र तुलनाको भाषा - हरेक type-मा चाहिन्छ
Preposition - Task 1-को सबैभन्दा common grammar गल्ती
गलत preposition = गलत data = Task Achievement कम। "increased to 20%" र "increased by 20%" को अर्थ पूरै फरक हो।
roughly, approximately, about, around, nearly, almost, just under, just over, a little more than, close to
half, a third, a quarter, three-quarters, one in five, one in ten, twice as many as, three times higher than, double, treble
higher / lower than, far more than, slightly less than, the same as, similar to, in contrast to, compared with, whereas, while, respectively
the highest, the lowest, the second largest, followed by, at the bottom, the only one to fall, the majority, the minority

t1_line_intro_overview.title: Line Graph - चरण-चरणमा: Introduction र Overview
blocks: Line graph सबैभन्दा धेरै आउँछ, र यहाँ जे सिक्नुहुन्छ (introduction, overview, trend-को भाषा, तुलना) - बाँकी सबै type-मा त्यही काम लाग्छ। त्यसैले यो भाग बिस्तारै, ध्यान दिएर पढ्नुहोस्।

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
The graph below shows the number of visitors (in thousands) to Greenhill National Park between 1990 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 150 words.
Introduction लेख्ने २ वटा तरिका सिकाउँछु: (१) पाँच-प्रश्न तरिका, (२) वाक्य-फ्रेम तरिका। दुवै सिक्नुहोस्; exam-मा जुन छिटो याद आउँछ त्यही प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
Graph-बाट ५ वटा प्रश्नको उत्तर निकाल्नुहोस् - introduction-का सबै सामग्री पाउनुहुन्छ:
1. What type of graph is it?
visitors more than doubled overall, with a big drop in the mid-2010s
पहिलो ४ वटा उत्तर सँगै मिलाउनुभयो भने पहिलो वाक्य तयार हुन्छ:
The line graph shows the number of visitors to a national park, in thousands, from 1990 to 2020.
तर यो त लगभग प्रश्नकै copy हो। अब शब्द बदलौं:
illustrates, depicts, gives information about, presents, compares (धेरै line भए)
how many people visited, visitor numbers, the figures for visitors, the amount of visitors (✗ - मानिस गन्न सकिन्छ, त्यसैले number/how many)
"in + unit" structure: in thousands / in metric tonnes / in per cent / in US dollars
from 1990 to 2020 · over a thirty-year period ending in 2020 · over three decades from 1990 · for 30 years up to 2020 · in the period 1990–2020
Duration-का लागि ६ वटा structure - प्रश्नमा भएको structure छोडेर अर्को लिनुहोस्:
For (period) up to ______ (For 30 years up to 2020)
From ______ for the next/following (period) (From 1990 for the next 30 years)
Over a period of ______ up to ______ (Over a period of 30 years up to 2020)
अब ५ नम्बरको उत्तर दोस्रो वाक्यको रूपमा थप्नुहोस्। पूरा introduction:

The line graph illustrates how many people visited Greenhill National Park, in thousands, over the thirty years from 1990 to 2020. Visitor numbers more than doubled over the period despite a sharp fall in the mid-2010s.
यो तरिकामा एउटा निश्चित format-का खाली ठाउँ प्रश्नबाट जानकारी लिएर भर्नुहुन्छ:

**Sentence 1:** The [line / bar / column graph · pie chart · table · diagram] + [describes / exhibits / illustrates / compares / demonstrates / indicates] + [information - paraphrase गरेर] + [measurement - in + unit] + [duration]
**Sentence 2:** Gist - highest / lowest / biggest rise / biggest fall - कुनै एउटा।
उही graph-का लागि अरू ३ किसिमका introduction - ध्यान दिनुहोस्, हरेकमा शब्द र क्रम फरक छन्, र gist पनि फरक छ:
The line graph describes the number of people who visited Greenhill National Park, in thousands, between 1990 and 2020. The lowest figures were recorded in the first five years.
The given line graph demonstrates the annual visitor figures for Greenhill National Park, measured in thousands, from 1990 for the following three decades. Attendance peaked in 2020.
Visitor numbers at Greenhill National Park have been depicted through the line graph in thousands over a period of 30 years up to 2020. The steepest decline occurred between 2010 and 2015.
अलि uncommon format-मा लेखिएको introduction-ले बढी score ल्याउन मद्दत गर्छ। तर सावधान - introduction-को पहिलो वाक्य अनिवार्य रूपमा present tense-मा हुनुपर्छ।
Overview = graph-का सबैभन्दा ठूला २–३ वटा कुरा, कुनै अङ्क बिना। के भन्न सकिन्छ:
समग्र दिशा (overall direction): बढ्यो / घट्यो / उतारचढाव भयो
सबैभन्दा बढी र सबैभन्दा कम कहिले / कुन
कुनै ठूलो अपवाद (एउटा ठूलो गिरावट, एउटा crossover)
धेरै line भए: अन्त्यमा को सबैभन्दा माथि, को तल
सुरु गर्ने शब्द: Overall, … / It is clear that … / The most striking feature is …
Overall, visitor numbers rose considerably over the period, although the growth was interrupted by a sharp decline in the mid-2010s. The figure at the end of the period was the highest recorded.

t1_line_body.title: Line Graph - Body, trend-को भाषा र Conclusion
blocks: Body paragraph-मा हामी graph-को मुख्य जानकारी वर्णन गर्छौं। कति लेख्ने भन्ने कुरा graph-मा कति जानकारी छ भन्नेमा भर पर्छ:
Graph-मा धेरै जानकारी छ भने main / significant data र trend मात्र लेख्नुहोस्।
Graph-मा थोरै जानकारी छ भने लगभग सबै जानकारी वर्णन गर्नुपर्छ - किनकि १५० शब्दभन्दा कम भयो भने negative marking हुन्छ।
सुरु र अन्त्यको तुलना; दुई बराबर मान

प्रश्न हातमा पर्नासाथ graph-का सबै significant point र trend-मा चिनो लगाउनुहोस् (IELTS-को question paper-मा मन लागेजस्तो चिनो लगाउन पाइन्छ)। चिनो लगाएका हरेक trend-लाई एउटा number दिनुहोस् - अनि थाहा हुन्छ, कति वटा कुरा छलफल गर्नुपर्छ:
चित्रमा ५ वटा trend-मा चिनो लगाइएको छ

हरेक परिवर्तन व्याख्या गर्न एउटा verb चाहिन्छ (दिशा: बढ्यो कि घट्यो)। परिवर्तनको किसिम / मात्रा फरक-फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले verb-सँग एउटा adverb चाहिन्छ (कति जोडले / कति)। साथै कति समयसम्म र कति परिवर्तन भयो भन्ने पनि बताउनुपर्छ। अर्थात् एउटा trend वर्णनमा पाँच कुरा हुन्छन्:

**Subject + verb + adverb + time + amount changed**
Visitor numbers + rose + sharply + between 1995 and 2005 + to 480,000.
remained stable / steady / constant / unchanged, stayed at, levelled off, plateaued, maintained the same level, showed no change
stability, a plateau, a levelling-off, no change
rose, increased, grew, climbed, went up, ascended
a rise, an increase, growth, a climb
soared, surged, jumped, rocketed, shot up, leapt, boomed
a surge, a jump, a boom, a leap
fell, declined, decreased, dropped, dipped, went down, reduced
a fall, a decline, a decrease, a drop, a dip
plunged, plummeted, slumped, collapsed, dived, halved
a plunge, a slump, a collapse
peaked at, reached a high / low of, hit a low of, bottomed out at
a peak, a high, a low, a trough
dramatically, sharply, steeply, considerably, significantly, substantially, markedly, drastically, rapidly, quickly
dramatic, sharp, steep, considerable, significant, substantial, marked, drastic, rapid
slightly, marginally, a little, minimally, slowly
Trend 1-का लागि adverb चाहिँदैन, किनकि कुनै परिवर्तन छैन। बाँकीमा सही adverb छान्नुहोस्, र उस्तै किसिमका परिवर्तनमा एउटै adverb दोहोर्याउनुको सट्टा अर्को adverb लिनुहोस्।
अब हरेक trend-का लागि वाक्य - ३ किसिमका format-मा

हरेक trend तीन तरिकाले लेख्न सकिन्छ: (क) verb + adverb, (ख) There was a + adjective + noun, (ग) एउटा मात्र बलियो verb (adverb बिना)। Exam-मा तीनै वटा मिसाएर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, ताकि structure दोहोरिँदैन।
(क) The number of visitors remained constant / stable / unchanged at 200,000 between 1990 and 1995.
(ख) There was no change in visitor numbers for the first five years, which stayed at 200,000.
(ग) Visitor numbers plateaued at 200,000 from 1990 to 1995.
(क) Visitor numbers rose sharply / increased dramatically / grew rapidly by 280,000 to 480,000 between 1995 and 2005.
(ख) There was a dramatic / sharp / steep rise of 280,000 in the following decade, to 480,000.
(ग) Attendance soared / surged / jumped to 480,000 in 2005, more than double the 1995 figure.
(क) The figure then fell slightly / dipped marginally by 10,000 to 470,000 in 2010.
(ख) There was a slight / marginal / small dip in numbers over the next five years, to 470,000.
(क) Visitors fell sharply / dropped steeply / declined considerably by 120,000 to 350,000 between 2010 and 2015.
(ख) There was a sharp / steep / considerable fall of 120,000 in the next five years, to 350,000.
(ग) Attendance plunged / slumped / plummeted to 350,000 in 2015.
(क) The number climbed strongly / rose markedly by 170,000 to a peak of 520,000 in the last five years.
(ख) There was a strong / marked recovery in the final period, with numbers reaching a high of 520,000.
(ग) Visitors rebounded / recovered to a record 520,000 in 2020.
थप: उतारचढाव (fluctuation) - यो graph-मा छैन, तर exam-मा आउँछ
(क) The figure fluctuated considerably / varied widely between 300,000 and 430,000 over the period.
(ख) There was considerable fluctuation in the figure, which moved between 300,000 and 430,000.
(ग) Numbers oscillated between roughly 300,000 and 430,000 throughout.
एउटै जानकारीबाट structure-मा विविधता ल्याउन तत्वहरूलाई यताउता सार्न सकिन्छ:
Information + verb + adverb + time + amount: Visitor numbers fell sharply between 2010 and 2015 by 120,000.
Information + verb + adverb + amount + time: Visitor numbers fell sharply by 120,000 between 2010 and 2015.
Time + information + verb + adverb + amount: Between 2010 and 2015, visitor numbers fell sharply by 120,000.
There was a + adjective + noun + in + information + time: There was a sharp fall of 120,000 in visitor numbers between 2010 and 2015.
Information + saw / experienced / recorded + a + adjective + noun + time: Visitor numbers saw a sharp fall between 2010 and 2015.
Time + saw + a + adjective + noun + in + information: The period 2010–2015 saw a sharp fall in visitor numbers.
याद राख्नुहोस्, structure र vocabulary-को repetition-ले तपाईंको score घटाउँछ। अनि जहाँ मिल्छ त्यहाँ connective word प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
पाँच वटा trend-लाई दुई paragraph-मा बाँडौं: पहिलो paragraph-मा trend 1–2, दोस्रो paragraph-मा trend 3–5। हरेक trend-का लागि माथिका तीन format-बाट एउटा छान्छौं - ताकि structure दोहोरिँदैन:

For the first five years the number of visitors remained constant at 200,000. After 1995, however, the figure grew rapidly, reaching 480,000 in 2005, more than double the starting level.

This was followed by a decade of decline. Numbers dipped slightly to 470,000 in 2010 and then fell sharply to 350,000 over the next five years. In the final period the trend reversed, and visitors climbed to a peak of 520,000 in 2020, the highest figure recorded.
ध्यान दिनुहोस्: हरेक वाक्यमा अङ्क, दिशा, मात्रा र समय छ; कुनै structure दुई पटक आएको छैन; connective-हरूले (however, this was followed by, then, in the final period) reader-लाई बाटो देखाउँछन्।

Task 1-को conclusion मूलतः पूरै task-को summary हो। यो optional हो - समय छैन भने छोडिदिनुहोस्। छ भने connective list-बाट एउटा concluding connective लिएर एक वाक्य लेख्नुहोस्: कुनै उल्लेखनीय कुरा, वा overall summary।
In summary / To sum up / To recapitulate, despite the setback after 2010, the park attracted far more visitors at the end of the period than at the beginning.
सधैं याद राख्नुहोस्: **Task 1-को conclusion-मा कुनै personal opinion लेख्नु हुँदैन।**

The line graph illustrates how many people visited Greenhill National Park, in thousands, over the thirty years from 1990 to 2020.

Overall, visitor numbers rose considerably over the period, although the growth was interrupted by a sharp decline in the mid-2010s. The figure at the end of the period was the highest recorded.

For the first five years the number of visitors remained constant at 200,000. After 1995, however, the figure grew rapidly, reaching 480,000 in 2005, more than double the starting level.

This was followed by a decade of decline. Numbers dipped slightly to 470,000 in 2010 and then fell sharply to 350,000 over the next five years. In the final period the trend reversed, and visitors climbed to a peak of 520,000 in 2020, the highest figure recorded.

In summary, despite the setback after 2010, the park attracted far more visitors at the end of the period than at the beginning.
यो line graph निकै simple छ - basic concept बुझाउन बनाइएको। Real IELTS-मा यति सजिलो graph आउँदैन; दुई-तीन वटा line, वा line graph-सँग अर्को graph-को combination आउँछ। अब ती हेरौं।

t1_line_double.title: दुई line भएको graph - तुलना गरेर लेख्ने
blocks: The graph shows the percentage of households owning a car and a bicycle in one European city between 2000 and 2020.
Households owning a car / a bicycle, 2000–2020 (%)

यहाँ मात्र होइन - जुनसुकै Task 1 पाएपछि पहिलो काम topic राम्ररी बुझ्नु हो। "Percentage of households owning a car and a bicycle" - अर्थात् graph-ले २००० देखि २०२० सम्म कति प्रतिशत परिवारसँग car छ र कति प्रतिशतसँग bicycle छ भनेर देखाउँछ। दुई कुरा याद राख्नुहोस्: data दुई फरक चीजको हो (car र bicycle), र data बितेको समयको हो, त्यसैले past tense।

Horizontal axis-मा ५ वर्षको अन्तरमा साल छन् (2000, 2005 … 2020)। Vertical axis-मा प्रतिशत छ, ० देखि १०० सम्म। दुई वटा line उल्टो दिशामा जान्छन् - एउटा घट्दै छ, एउटा बढ्दै छ - र २०१५ मा तिनीहरू एक-अर्कालाई काट्छन् (crossover)। यही काटिने बिन्दु graph-को सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण feature हो।
Car: २००५ सम्म थोरै बढ्यो (70 → 72), त्यसपछि १५ वर्षसम्म घट्यो (72 → 48)।
Bicycle: पूरै अवधिभर बढ्यो (25 → 68), २००५ पछि झन् छिटो।
२०२०: bicycle car-भन्दा २० point माथि - २००० को ठीक उल्टो चित्र।
Graph-मा धेरै जानकारी छ र सबै छलफल गर्न सम्भव छैन (हातमा २० मिनेट मात्र छ, word limit पनि दिमागमा राख्नुपर्छ)। त्यसैले यही ४ वटा point हाम्रो report हो।
पहिलेकै structure-मा: The ___ graph compares/describes + information + measurement + duration + main feature।

The line graph compares the proportion of households owning a car with the proportion owning a bicycle in a European city over two decades from 2000. Car ownership declined while bicycle ownership rose, and the two figures crossed in 2015.
Overall, cars became steadily less common and bicycles steadily more common, so that by the end of the period the bicycle had overtaken the car as the more widely owned of the two.
धेरैले दुई वटा line-लाई दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै paragraph-मा अलग-अलग लेख्छन्, किनकि यही सबैभन्दा सजिलो लाग्छ। तर graph analysis भनेकै compare and contrast हो। Body मिलाउने २ वटा तरिका:
Line अनुसार: para 1 = car, para 2 = bicycle - हरेकमा अर्कोसँग तुलना।
समय अनुसार: para 1 = 2000–2010, para 2 = 2010–2020 - हरेकमा दुवै line।
Line-हरू एकै समयमा काटिन्छन् वा दिशा बदल्छन् भने "समय अनुसार" राम्रो हुन्छ, किनकि तब crossover सिधै वर्णन गर्न सकिन्छ। यहाँ हामी त्यही गर्छौं।
Car-को trend-बाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्, structure: information + verb + adverb + amount + time। त्यसपछि contrasting connective प्रयोग गरेर bicycle:

In 2000, cars were far more common than bicycles: 70% of households had a car, compared with only a quarter that had a bicycle. Car ownership edged up to 72% in 2005 before beginning to decline, falling to 65% by 2010. Meanwhile, bicycle ownership grew steadily, reaching 42% in the same year.

The following decade saw the gap close and then reverse. In 2015 both figures stood at exactly 55%. By 2020, however, car ownership had dropped to under half of households (48%), whereas the bicycle figure had climbed to 68%, twenty percentage points higher.
तुलनाको भाषा - यो उत्तरमा प्रयोग भएका र अरू पनि
far more common than · compared with · only a quarter · meanwhile · in the same year · the gap closed · both stood at · whereas · twenty percentage points higher
twice as high as · the reverse was true for · the two lines converged / diverged · X overtook Y · the difference narrowed / widened · X lagged behind Y · X caught up with Y · at the same level as
⚠ **Percentage point:** 25% बाट 40% हुँदा वृद्धि "15 percentage points" हो, "15 percent" होइन। (15 percent वृद्धि भनेको 25 → 28.75 हो।)

The line graph compares the proportion of households owning a car with the proportion owning a bicycle in a European city over two decades from 2000.

Overall, cars became steadily less common and bicycles steadily more common, so that by the end of the period the bicycle had overtaken the car as the more widely owned of the two.

In 2000, cars were far more common than bicycles: 70% of households had a car, compared with only a quarter that had a bicycle. Car ownership edged up to 72% in 2005 before beginning to decline, falling to 65% by 2010. Meanwhile, bicycle ownership grew steadily, reaching 42% in the same year.

The following decade saw the gap close and then reverse. In 2015 both figures stood at exactly 55%. By 2020, however, car ownership had dropped to under half of households (48%), whereas the bicycle figure had climbed to 68%, twenty percentage points higher.

In summary, the positions of the two vehicles were completely reversed over the twenty years.

t1_line_complex.title: धेरै line र भविष्यको अनुमान (projection) भएको graph
blocks: Line graph पूरै स्पष्ट बनाउन अर्को एउटा, अलि जटिल graph हेरौं।
The graph shows electricity generated from four sources in one country from 2000 to 2020, with projections to 2030 (terawatt-hours).

"Electricity generated from four sources … with projections" - graph-ले ४ वटा स्रोतबाट (coal, gas, wind, solar) कति बिजुली उत्पादन भयो भनेर देखाउँछ: २००० देखि २०२० सम्मको वास्तविक data, र २०३० को अनुमान। पहिलेका graph-को तुलनामा यो complex छ - तर तरिका उही हो।
Horizontal axis: १० वर्षको अन्तर, २०००–२०३०। बीचमा, २०२० मा एउटा dotted line छ - त्यसको बायाँतिर बितेको समय, दायाँतिर भविष्य (dotted line-हरू projection हुन्)। Vertical axis: TWh, ०–१२०।
केही data बितेको समयको हो, केही भविष्यको - tense-मा सावधान। बितेको समयका लागि past tense। भविष्यका लागि will होइन - खास vocabulary:

It is predicted / forecast / estimated / expected / projected / anticipated that X will …
X is expected / projected / forecast / predicted to + verb
The forecast / projection is for X to …
X is likely to …
४ वटा line - सबै वर्णन गर्दा २०० शब्द नाघ्छ। धेरै trend भएकाले ध्यान दिएर छान्नुहोस्:
Coal: सुरुमा सबैभन्दा ठूलो (120), त्यसपछि आधा (60), अनुमान अनुसार लगभग शून्य (15) - सबैभन्दा ठूलो गिरावट।
Gas: बढेर coal-लाई उछिन्यो (100), अनुमान अनुसार थोरै घट्नेछ (80)।
Wind: लगभग शून्यबाट 45; अनुमान अनुसार दोब्बर भएर सबैभन्दा ठूलो बन्नेछ (90)।
Solar: शून्यबाट 25; अनुमान अनुसार लगभग तेब्बर (70)।
The line graph shows how much electricity was produced from coal, gas, wind and solar power in one country between 2000 and 2020, together with forecasts for 2030.

Overall, the country is moving away from coal towards renewable energy. Coal was the leading source at the start but is expected to be the smallest by 2030, while wind is projected to become the largest and gas peaks before declining.
Body paragraph कसरी बाँड्ने भनेर पहिल्यै ध्यान दिएर निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। २ वटा option:
(i) सबै fuel-को २०२० सम्मको data para 1-मा, projection para 2-मा।
(ii) Coal र gas (ठूला स्रोत) एउटा para-मा, wind र solar (renewable) अर्को para-मा।
यहाँ हामी (i) लिन्छौं, किनकि बितेको/भविष्य छुट्याउँदा tense पनि स्पष्ट रहन्छ र compare/contrast गर्न सजिलो हुन्छ।

In 2000 coal dominated, generating 120 TWh, twice the output of gas, while wind and solar produced almost nothing. Over the next twenty years coal fell by half to 60 TWh, and gas rose steadily to overtake it, reaching 100 TWh in 2020. Wind grew from 2 to 45 TWh in the same period, and solar, which had been zero, reached 25 TWh.

These trends are expected to continue and even accelerate. By 2030 coal is projected to fall to just 15 TWh, and gas is forecast to decline slightly to 80. In contrast, wind is predicted to double to 90 TWh, making it the largest source, and solar is expected to almost triple to 70 TWh.
ध्यान दिनुहोस्: para 1-मा एउटा पनि projection-शब्द छैन, जबकि para 2-को हरेक वाक्यमा छ (expected, projected, forecast, predicted) - र कुनै शब्द दोहोरिएको छैन।
Introduction paraphrase गरिएको, एक वाक्य, present tense।
Overview दोस्रो paragraph-मा, अङ्क बिना; ठूलो trend + (धेरै line भए) अन्त्यमा को माथि/तल।
४–६ वटा key point छान्नुहोस् (start, end, peak, trough, crossover, biggest change) - सबै point होइन।
हरेक trend-वाक्यमा दिशा + मात्रा + अङ्क + समय।
कुनै verb, adverb वा connective तीन पटक होइन।
Preposition check: by / to / at / from…to।
बितेको data → past tense; projection → expected/projected language।

t1_bar.title: भाग ख - Bar / Column Graph
blocks: Line graph-मा तपाईंले जे सिक्नुभयो - चार paragraph-को template, introduction लेख्ने २ वटा तरिका, संख्याको भाषा - यहाँ पनि ठ्याक्कै त्यही हो। फरक यति मात्र हो: graph-को कथा कसरी पत्ता लगाउने र body कसरी मिलाउने। हरेक type-सँग graph सहित एउटा पूरा उदाहरण दिइएको छ।
पहिलो प्रश्न: तेर्सो axis-मा समय छ कि category?
Line graph जस्तै - trend, बढ्ने र घट्ने
तुलना - सबैभन्दा धेरै, सबैभन्दा कम, क्रम, फरक
higher / lower than, the most, followed by
दुवै - category-हरूको तुलना + हरेक कसरी बदलियो

⚠ Category-का bar-हरू "rise" वा "fall" हुँदैनन्। समय नभएको graph-मा तपाईंले rose/fell लेख्नुभयो भने examiner-ले तपाईंले graph बुझ्नुभएन भन्ने ठान्छ। यसरी लेख्नुहोस्: X is higher than Y; X has the largest share.
The bar chart shows the amount of coffee consumed per person in five countries in 2022.
Unit: kg per person per year। समय: एउटै वर्ष (2022) - त्यसैले trend होइन, तुलना; tense: past (2022) वा present - दुवै चल्छ, तर एउटैमा टिक्नुहोस्।
सबैभन्दा धेरै: Finland (12); सबैभन्दा कम: Japan (3.6)। Finland, Japan-भन्दा तीन गुणाभन्दा बढी छ।
२ वटा समूह देखिन्छन्: २ वटा Nordic देश धेरै माथि छन् (12, 9.9); बाँकी ३ वटा 6-भन्दा तल छन्।
The bar chart compares how much coffee people in five countries drank per head in 2022, measured in kilograms per year.
Overall, the two Nordic countries consumed far more coffee than the other three, with Finland well ahead of every other nation and Japan at the bottom of the list.
Category graph-मा body समूह अनुसार मिलाउनुहोस्: paragraph १ = माथिको समूह, paragraph २ = बाँकी। हरेक समूहमा क्रम र फरक बताउनुहोस्।

Finland recorded the highest consumption by a clear margin, at 12 kg per person, followed by Norway with just under 10 kg. Between them, these two countries drank roughly twice as much coffee per head as any of the others.

The remaining three countries formed a distinct lower group. Brazil, despite being a major coffee producer, consumed 6.1 kg per person, about half the Finnish figure. The United States came next at 4.7 kg, while Japan had the lowest consumption of all, at 3.6 kg, less than a third of the amount in Finland.
(यहाँ "despite being a major coffee producer" सामान्य ज्ञान हो, graph-मा छैन; Band 7 लेख्नेहरूले पनि कहिलेकाहीँ यस्तो कुरा घुसाउँछन्। सुरक्षित रहन चाहनुहुन्छ भने यसलाई नलेख्नुहोस्।)
The chart shows how people in the city of Riverton travelled to work in 2000 and 2020.
How people travelled to work in Riverton, 2000 and 2020
Unit: प्रतिशत (commuter-हरूको)। २ वटा वर्ष → past tense, र दुई दिशाको तुलना: (क) एउटै वर्षमा mode-हरूबीच, (ख) एउटै mode-को २ वटा वर्षबीच।
Car दुवै वर्षमा सबैभन्दा ठूलो छ, तर धेरै घट्यो (55 → 40)। Bus पनि घट्यो (25 → 20)।
Train दोब्बरभन्दा बढी भयो (10 → 22), bicycle तीन गुणा (4 → 12)। Walking उस्तै रह्यो (6)।
कथा: शहर private car-बाट टाढिँदै गयो।
The bar chart compares the percentage of commuters in Riverton who used five different methods of transport to get to work in 2000 and in 2020.

Overall, the car remained the most popular way to travel to work in both years, but its share fell noticeably, while rail and cycling became far more common. Walking was the only mode that showed no change.

In 2000, more than half of commuters (55%) drove to work, and a further quarter took the bus. By 2020 both of these figures had fallen, the car to 40% and the bus to 20%, although the car was still the leading choice.

In contrast, the share of people travelling by train or metro more than doubled, from 10% to 22%, making it the second most common mode in 2020. Cycling grew even faster in relative terms, tripling from 4% to 12%. Walking, meanwhile, stayed constant at 6% in both years.
the most / least popular · the largest / smallest share · the highest / lowest figure · in first / second place · followed by · at the bottom · the only category to …
accounted for · made up · represented · a quarter / a third / half of · one in five
more than doubled · tripled · halved · fell by … percentage points · in relative terms · by comparison · the reverse was true for
far higher than · slightly lower than · roughly the same as · twice as … as · X times more than · compared with · whereas · while

**Bar graph-मा हुने सामान्य गल्तीहरू:** (१) bar-हरूलाई बायाँबाट दायाँ एक-एक गरी वर्णन गर्नु - बरु समूह बनाउनुहोस्: ठूलाहरू, साना-हरू, बदलिएकाहरू। (२) समय नभएको chart-मा increased/decreased लेख्नु। (३) unit बिर्सनु (प्रतिशत? संख्या? हजारमा?)।

t1_table.title: Table - चरणबद्ध रूपमा
blocks: Table हेर्दा सजिलो लाग्छ, तर प्रायः यही सबैभन्दा गाह्रो type हो - किनकि trend संख्याभित्र लुकेको हुन्छ, graph-मा जस्तो आँखामा आफैँ ठोक्किँदैन। तपाईंले आफैँ खोज्नुपर्छ।
Title, row label, column label र unit पढ्नुहोस्।
हरेक row बायाँबाट दायाँ हेर्नुहोस्: बढ्दै छ, घट्दै छ, कि उस्तै छ?
हरेक column माथिबाट तल हेर्नुहोस्: कुन row सबैभन्दा धेरै, कुन सबैभन्दा कम?
चिनो लगाउनुहोस्: सबैभन्दा ठूलो संख्या, सबैभन्दा सानो संख्या, total (छ भने), र अरूजस्तो व्यवहार नगर्ने row/column।
समूह छुट्याउनुहोस्: एकै किसिमले व्यवहार गर्ने row-हरू एउटै paragraph-मा जान्छन्।
The table shows the number of international students (in thousands) studying in four countries in 2010, 2015 and 2020.
Marked: red = highest, green = lowest, yellow = exceptions
चिनो लगाइएको table: रातो = सबैभन्दा धेरै, हरियो = सबैभन्दा कम, पहेँलो = अपवाद
USA सधैँ सबैभन्दा ठूलो छ, र बढ्यो (690 → 1,075) - 2020-मा दस लाख नाघ्यो।
Australia संख्या घटेको एक मात्र देश हो (330 → 290), त्यसपछि बलियोसँग बढ्यो (460)।
Canada सुरुमा सबैभन्दा सानो थियो (95), तर पाँच गुणाभन्दा बढी बढेर (530) झन्डै UK बराबर पुग्यो।
The table gives the number of overseas students, in thousands, enrolled in the USA, the UK, Australia and Canada at five-year intervals between 2010 and 2020.

Overall, all four countries hosted more international students at the end of the decade than at the start. The USA remained by far the largest destination throughout, while Canada, though the smallest in 2010, showed the fastest growth of all.
Paragraph १ = २ वटा ठूला, लगातार बढ्दै गएका देश (USA, UK)। Paragraph २ = pattern तोड्ने २ वटा देश (Australia, Canada)।

The USA attracted 690,000 foreign students in 2010, already more than the other three countries combined. This figure climbed to 975,000 in 2015 and passed one million (1,075,000) by 2020. The UK, in second place, grew more slowly, from 400,000 to 430,000 and then to 550,000.

Australia was the only country whose numbers fell, dropping from 330,000 to 290,000 between 2010 and 2015, before recovering strongly to 460,000. Canada, meanwhile, recorded the most dramatic rise: its total of just 95,000 in 2010 nearly doubled to 170,000 by 2015 and then tripled again to 530,000, almost level with the UK.
संख्यालाई सम्बन्धमा बदल्नुहोस्: more than the other three combined · nearly doubled · almost level with · five times larger।
सानो table (४×३ = १२ वटा संख्या) भए झन्डै सबै संख्या चाहिन्छ; ठूलो table (६×५ = ३०) भए ८–१० वटा।
Pattern-सँग नमिल्ने कुरा उल्लेख गर्नुहोस् (the only country whose numbers fell) - अपवाद सधैँ एउटा "main feature" हो।
Row-को क्रममा (माथिबाट तल) नलेख्नुहोस् - व्यवहारको क्रममा लेख्नुहोस्।

t1_pie.title: Pie Chart - चरणबद्ध रूपमा
blocks: Pie chart-ले एउटा पूरा चीजका भागहरू देखाउँछ। त्यसैले यहाँको भाषा trend-को होइन, अनुपात (proportion)-को हो।
X accounts for / makes up / represents / constitutes 40% of the total · X takes up a quarter
the largest / smallest segment / share / proportion / category · the dominant use · a negligible 2%
half · just over / under half · a third · roughly a quarter · three-quarters · one in five · one in ten
the remaining 15% · the rest · together, A and B make up two-thirds · A and B combined
The pie chart shows the composition of household waste in one city.
Composition of household waste in one city
एउटा मात्र pie हुँदा: सबैभन्दा ठूलो segment-बाट सबैभन्दा सानोतिर जानुहोस्, र साना-हरूलाई एकै ठाउँमा समूह बनाउनुहोस्। Overview = कुन segment (वा segment-हरू) हावी छन्। समय छैन, त्यसैले present tense।

The pie chart shows what proportion of the waste produced by households in one city falls into each of six categories.

Overall, food is by far the largest component, and food and paper together make up more than half of all household waste, whereas garden waste and miscellaneous items form only a small fraction.

Food waste accounts for just over a third of the total (34%), and paper and cardboard for a further 22%. These two categories combined therefore represent 56% of everything that households throw away. Plastics are the third largest category, at 18%, or almost one in five items.

The remaining three categories are considerably smaller. Glass and metal together make up 12%, garden waste 9%, and other materials just 5%, the smallest share on the chart. In total, these three account for roughly a quarter of household waste.
(१६० शब्द। ध्यान दिनुहोस्: एउटा पनि rose/fell छैन; हरेक संख्याको छेउमा fraction वा तुलना छ।)
२ वा बढी pie chart - exam-मा धेरै आउने

प्रायः एउटै कुरा २ वटा वर्षमा वा २ वटा ठाउँमा हुन्छ। त्यसपछि पूरा काम भनेको २ वटा pie-मा एउटै segment-को तुलना गर्नु हो। पहिले pie १ पूरै, अनि pie २ पूरै वर्णन गर्नु - यो Band 5-को टिपिकल answer हो, किनकि यसमा कुनै तुलना हुँदैन।
The charts show how adults in one country spent their time online in 2015 and 2023.
How adults spent their time online
Entertainment (social media, video) धेरै बढ्यो; information र work-का लागि प्रयोग धेरै घट्यो।
सबैभन्दा ठूलो segment बदलियो: 2015-मा news (30%), 2023-मा social media (40%)।
The two pie charts compare the proportion of online time that adults in one country devoted to five activities in 2015 and 2023.

Overall, internet use shifted strongly from information and work towards entertainment. Social media replaced news as the largest single activity, and together with video streaming it came to account for almost two-thirds of all online time by 2023.

In 2015 social media took up a quarter of people's time online, but by 2023 this had risen to 40%, the largest share on either chart. Video streaming showed a similar pattern, growing from 15% to a quarter, and online shopping increased more modestly, from 10% to 15%.

The two remaining categories moved in the opposite direction. Reading news and looking for information, which had been the biggest activity in 2015 at 30%, fell to just 12% eight years later. The decline in email and work-related use was even steeper in relative terms, from a fifth of online time to only 8%.

**Pie chart-मा हुने सामान्य गल्तीहरू:**
▸ "The pie chart increased" - pie बढ्दैन; **segment**-को **share** बढ्छ।
▸ "which was 100%" भन्नु वा total प्रमाणित गर्न segment-हरू जोड्नु।
▸ एउटा मात्र pie-मा (समयको तुलना नभई) rose/fell - is the largest, accounts for लेख्नुहोस्।
▸ Percentage point: 25% → 40% भनेको "a rise of 15 percentage points" हो, "15 percent" होइन।
▸ पहिले एउटा पूरा pie, अनि अर्को पूरा pie - सधैँ २ वटा pie-लाई segment-segment गरी तुलना गर्नुहोस्।

t1_combination.title: Combination - २ वटा फरक visual सँगै
blocks: कहिलेकाहीँ तपाईंलाई २ वटा visual दिइन्छ - जस्तै एउटा bar chart (कुल संख्या) र एउटा pie chart (एउटा वर्षको भाग-भाग), वा map + table। नियमहरू:
Introduction-ले दुवै visual समेट्छ, एक वा दुई वाक्यमा।
Overview-ले हरेक visual-बाट एउटा-एउटा main point दिन्छ।

हरेक visual-का लागि एउटा body paragraph। तुलना एउटै visual-भित्र गर्नुहोस्; २ वटा visual-बीच तुलना नगर्नुहोस् - प्रश्नले नै तिनलाई जोडेको छ भने बाहेक (जस्तै pie भनेको bar chart-को अन्तिम वर्षको भाग-भाग हो - तब जोड्न सकिन्छ)।
दुवैलाई लगभग बराबर शब्द दिनुहोस्। धेरै विद्यार्थीले पहिलो visual-मै सबै खर्च गर्छन् र दोस्रोमा दुई लाइन मात्र लेख्छन्।
The bar chart shows the number of visitors to the National Science Museum from 2015 to 2020, and the pie chart shows where these visitors came from in 2020.
Visitors to the National Science Museum · Where 2020 visitors came from
Bar: पाँच वर्ष लगातार बढ्यो (420 → 600), त्यसपछि 2020-मा ठूलो गिरावट (210 - 2019-को एक तिहाइ)।
Pie: 2020-का visitor-मध्ये 55% स्थानीय, 30% देशका अरू ठाउँबाट, 15% विदेशी → 85% स्वदेशी।
२ वटा visual जोडिएका छन् (pie = 2020-को bar), त्यसैले "of those 210,000…" भन्न सकिन्छ।

The bar chart records annual attendance at the National Science Museum from 2015 to 2020, while the pie chart shows the breakdown of the 2020 audience by place of origin.

Overall, five consecutive years of growth were abruptly reversed in 2020, when visitor numbers fell to their lowest level of the period. That diminished audience was overwhelmingly domestic, with residents of the host city alone accounting for more than half of all visits.

Attendance rose without interruption from 420,000 in 2015 to 600,000 in 2019, a cumulative increase of 43%. Growth was most rapid in the middle of the period, with gains of around 50,000 to 60,000 a year in 2017 and 2018, before slowing slightly in 2019. The following year saw a dramatic collapse to 210,000, roughly a third of the 2019 peak and half the 2015 starting figure.

Of these visitors, 55% were local and a further 30% travelled from other parts of the country, meaning that domestic visitors made up 85% of the total. International tourists represented the remaining 15%, equivalent to a little over 30,000 people.

अन्तिम paragraph-मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: 15% × 210,000 ≈ 31,500 - २ वटा visual ठीकसँग जोडिएका छन्, किनकि pie त्यही वर्षको हो। तर "Local visitors increased" भने लेख्न मिल्दैन - 2015-को pie छैन, त्यसैले तुलना गर्ने data नै छैन। Chart-मा नभएको कुरा कहिल्यै नलेख्नुहोस्; र "probably because of the pandemic" - यो opinion हो, निषेधित।
निर्णय गरेँ: तुलना कि trend (कि दुवै)?
लेख्नुअघि सबैभन्दा धेरै, सबैभन्दा कम, सबैभन्दा ठूलो परिवर्तन र अपवादमा चिनो लगाएँ।
Overview-मा leader र main pattern छ, संख्या बिना।
Data पढ्ने क्रममा होइन, व्यवहार अनुसार मिलाएँ।
सकेसम्म संख्यालाई सम्बन्धमा व्यक्त गरेँ (double, a third, level with)।
Pie: pie-हरूलाई segment-segment गरी तुलना गरेँ; अनुपातका शब्द; rose/fell समयको तुलनामा मात्र।
Combination: हरेक visual-को आफ्नै paragraph; cross-comparison प्रश्नले जोडेको भए मात्र; शब्द बराबर बाँडेँ।
कुनै opinion छैन, chart-बाहिरको जानकारी छैन।

t1_process.title: भाग ग - Flow Chart (Process) · Cycle · Diagram
blocks: यी type-हरूमा संख्या हुँदैन। त्यसैले trend पनि हुँदैन। यहाँ तपाईं चरणहरू (process), भागहरू र तिनीहरू कसरी जोडिएका छन् (diagram), वा कुनै ठाउँमा भएका परिवर्तन (map) वर्णन गर्नुहुन्छ। Paragraph-को template उस्तै हो: introduction → overview → २ वटा body paragraph।
कति वटा चरण (stage) छन्? कहाँबाट सुरु हुन्छ, कहाँ सकिन्छ?
Linear (सुरु → अन्त्य) कि cycle (अन्त्य फेरि सुरुमा फर्कन्छ)?
Man-made (कारखानाको process) कि natural (जलचक्र, कुनै जनावरको जीवनचक्र)?
स्पष्ट भाग (segment) छन्? छन् भने हरेक भाग एउटा body paragraph हो।
कुन label-हरू noun हुन्, जसलाई verb-मा बदल्नुपर्छ? ("crushing" → is crushed)
Man-made process → passive (the beans are roasted)। Natural process → active (water evaporates)।
First / To begin with · Next · Then · After that · Once this is complete · At the following stage · Subsequently · Meanwhile · In the final stage · Finally

is collected, sorted, cleaned, washed, mixed, heated, cooled, pressed, dried, cut, packed, transported, stored, filtered, separated · is converted into · passes through · is fed into · is removed / added
in order to · so that · which allows / enables … to …
The diagram shows how olive oil is produced.
९ वटा चरण, linear (harvesting → bottling), man-made, त्यसैले passive + present।
स्वाभाविक विभाजन: चरण १–५ = olive तयार पार्ने र कुच्ने; चरण ६–९ = तेल छुट्याउने र प्याक गर्ने। → २ वटा body paragraph।
Label-बाट verb: harvesting → are harvested; washing → are washed; crushing → are crushed; mixing → is stirred; bottling → is bottled।
Process-को introduction-मा भन्नुहोस्: के उत्पादन हुन्छ / कसरी काम गर्छ + कति वटा चरण छन्।
The diagram illustrates the nine stages involved in turning freshly picked olives into bottled olive oil.
Overview-मा: linear कि cycle, natural कि man-made, कति वटा मुख्य phase, सुरु र अन्त्य के हो।
Overall, this is a linear, man-made process in three main phases: the olives are first cleaned, then crushed and mixed to release the oil, and finally the oil is separated, filtered and packaged.

The process begins when olives are harvested from the trees between October and December. Any leaves and twigs are removed, and the fruit is washed. The clean olives are then crushed into a thick paste, which is stirred slowly for about thirty minutes so that the tiny drops of oil combine into larger ones.

Next, the paste is placed in a centrifuge, which spins it at high speed to separate the oil from the water and solid matter. The oil that comes out is filtered to remove any remaining particles and stored in stainless steel tanks. In the final stage, it is poured into bottles, ready for sale.

(Intro/overview सहित १६३ शब्द। ध्यान दिनुहोस्: हरेक चरण passive छ; sequencer-मा विविधता - begins when, then, which, next, in the final stage; "so that the tiny drops…" - यो diagram-का label-मा छ भने लेख्न सकिन्छ, छैन भने होइन।)

**Process-मा हुने सामान्य गल्तीहरू:**
▸ Diagram-मा नभएको जानकारी थप्नु (कति तापक्रम, कति समय) - label-मा छ भने मात्र।
▸ कुनै चरण किन हुन्छ भनेर व्याख्या गर्नु, diagram-ले भनेको छैन भने।
▸ Trend-का शब्द (increase, decrease) - यहाँ संख्या नै छैन।
▸ "Then… Then… Then…" - sequencer-हरू फेरबदल गर्नुहोस्।
▸ Overview छुटाउनु - चरणको संख्या, सुरु, अन्त्य, cycle हो कि होइन, बताउनुहोस्।

Cycle-को साँचो "सुरु" हुँदैन। त्यसैले तर्कसंगत सुरुको बिन्दु रोज्नुहोस् (जलचक्रमा evaporation; कीराको लागि अण्डा), यो cycle हो भनेर स्पष्ट भन्नुहोस्, र अन्तिम चरणलाई फेरि पहिलोसँग जोड्नुहोस्। Natural process → active voice, present simple।
The diagram shows the life cycle of a butterfly.

The diagram illustrates the four stages in the life of a butterfly, from egg to adult.

Overall, this is a natural, continuous cycle in which an egg develops through a feeding stage and a resting stage into an adult insect, which in turn produces new eggs, so the process never ends.

The cycle begins when an adult butterfly lays its eggs on the leaf of a plant. After a few days, a caterpillar hatches from each egg and spends the following two to three weeks eating leaves and growing rapidly. Once it is fully grown, the caterpillar attaches itself to a stem and forms a hard protective case known as a chrysalis.

Inside this case, over a period of roughly two weeks, the insect's body is completely transformed. Eventually an adult butterfly breaks out of the chrysalis. Finally, the adult finds a mate and lays eggs of its own on a fresh leaf, and the cycle begins again.

ध्यान दिनुहोस्: active voice (lays, hatches, spends, attaches, breaks out); "and the cycle begins again" भनेर सुरुमा फर्किनु; समयको जानकारी (two to three weeks, two weeks) diagram-का label-बाट आएको हो।
Diagram - कुनै चीज कसरी काम गर्छ
Diagram-ले कुनै मेसिन वा system-का भागहरू र ती कसरी जोडिएका छन् भनेर देखाउँछ। यो process जस्तै हो, तर क्रमसँगै स्थान (position) पनि बताउनुपर्छ।
consists of · is made up of · comprises · has three main parts
is attached to · is connected to · is linked to · is mounted on · is fitted with · runs from … to …
is located above / below / beside / inside / on top of · at the base of · to the left / right of · in the centre
flows through · passes through · enters / exits at · is fed into · is pumped / carried / channelled to · rises / falls
which allows … to · so that · in order to · this prevents / ensures …
The diagram shows how a rainwater harvesting system works in a school.
Rainwater harvesting system for a school
भागहरू: roof → gutter → downpipe (leaf filter) → first-flush diverter → underground tank (10,000 L) → pump → overhead tank → toilets & garden taps; overflow pipe → drain।
पानीको बाटो पछ्याउँदै एउटा क्रम छ, त्यसैले process जस्तै लेख्छौँ; साथै कुन चीज कहाँ छ (underground, overhead, on the roof)।
२ वटा body paragraph: (१) संकलन र सफाइ (roof → tank), (२) भण्डारण र प्रयोग (tank → taps)।

The diagram illustrates the components of a rainwater collection system installed at a school and shows how rain falling on the roof is stored and reused.

Overall, water is collected from the roof, cleaned in two stages, stored in an underground tank and then pumped to a rooftop tank, from which it supplies the school's toilets and garden taps.

Rain that lands on the sloping roof runs into a gutter along its edge and then down a vertical pipe fitted with a filter that catches leaves. Below this, a device known as a first-flush diverter sends the first, dirtiest water to the drain and allows the rest to continue into a 10,000-litre tank buried underground.

When water is needed, an electric pump located beside the tank lifts it through a pipe to a smaller tank on the roof of the building. From there it flows by gravity to the toilets and the garden taps. If the underground tank becomes full, an overflow pipe carries the excess water to the drain.
Task-मा २ वटा design छन् भने (जस्तै २ किसिमका पुल वा २ किसिमका जग), हरेकलाई छोटकरीमा वर्णन गर्नुहोस् र त्यसपछि तुलना गर्नुहोस् - तब फरकहरू नै main feature हुन्।

t1_map.title: Map - चरणबद्ध रूपमा
blocks: एउटै ठाउँ, २ वटा समय (सबैभन्दा धेरै आउने)
Past (was built), वा दोस्रो map "today/now" हो भने present perfect (has been built)

Compass खोज्नुहोस् (प्रायः north माथि हुन्छ)। दुवै map-मा देखिने landmark खोज्नुहोस् (नदी, main road) - दिशा बताउन यिनै चाहिन्छन्।

Overview = परिवर्तनको समग्र स्वरूप: more built-up / larger / more modern / farmland turned into housing / expanded eastwards।

समूहहरू: (१) तट र harbour (पूर्व/उत्तर-पूर्व), (२) दक्षिण र केन्द्र। Overview: सानो माछा मार्ने गाउँ → ठूलो पर्यटकीय र आवासीय शहर; main road र पुराना घरहरू बाँकी छन्।

The two maps show how the coastal town of Seabrook has developed since 1980.

Overall, the town has grown from a small fishing settlement into a much larger tourist and residential centre. Most of the change has taken place along the coast and on the former farmland to the south, while the original main road and the houses beside it have been kept.

The greatest transformation is along the eastern shore. The beach, which in 1980 was undeveloped, is now lined with hotels, and the fishing harbour in the north-east has been extended to include a ferry terminal.

South of the main road, the farmland has disappeared completely and has been replaced by a housing estate and a shopping centre, served by a new ring road that curves around the southern edge of the town. In the south-west, about half of the forest has been cut down to make way for a golf course. In the centre, the school has been enlarged to roughly twice its original size, but the original houses along the main road remain as they were.

ध्यान दिनुहोस्: (१) 1980-को map छुट्टै वर्णन गरिएको छैन - परिवर्तन मात्र; (२) हरेक वाक्यमा दिशा छ (eastern shore, north-east, south of, south-west, in the centre); (३) "today" भएकाले present perfect (has been extended, has disappeared); (४) उस्तै रहेका कुराहरू पनि उल्लेख गरिएका छन्।

**Map-मा हुने सामान्य गल्तीहरू:**
▸ पहिले map १ पूरै, अनि map २ पूरै - यो तुलना होइन, २ वटा सूची (inventory) मात्र हो।
▸ Tense: विगतको map → past; योजना → future (will be built / is to be built)।
▸ दिशा नबताउनु - "there is a school and a road" पढेर पाठकले केही बुझ्दैन।
▸ उस्तै रहेका कुरा बिर्सनु - "के उस्तै रह्यो" overview-को भाग हो।
▸ "The town developed because tourists came" - कारण chart-मा छैन; यो opinion हो।
Process: चरणको संख्या, सुरु र अन्त्य, linear/cycle - overview-मा।
Process: present simple; man-made → passive, natural → active; sequencer-मा विविधता।
Diagram: भागहरूको नाम, स्थान, बहावको क्रम।
Map: परिवर्तनहरू (२ वटा inventory होइन); compass direction; उस्तै रहेका कुराहरूको उल्लेख।
Visual-मा नभएको केही थपिनँ; कुनै opinion छैन।
यो भागसँगै Task 1-का सबै type सकिए। अर्को अध्यायमा: हरेक type-का लागि विद्यार्थीहरूले लेखेका Band 5, 6, 7, 8-का answer, छलफलसहित।
